That the first line of the Song of Amergin has the variant readings ‘stag of seven tines’ and ‘ox of seven fights’ suggests that in Ireland during the Bronze Age, as in Crete and Greece, both stag and bull were sacred to the Great Goddess. In Minoan Crete the bull became dominant as the Minotaur, ‘Bull-Minos’, but there was also a Minelaphos, ‘Stag-Minos’, who figured in the cult of the Moon-goddess Britomart, and a Minotragos, ‘Goat-Minos’ cult. The antlers found in the burial at New Grange suggest that the stag was the royal beast of the Irish Danaans, and the stag figures prominently in Irish myth: an incident in The Cattle Raid of Cuailgne, part of the Cuchulain saga, shows that a guild of deer-priests called ‘The Fair Lucky Harps’ had their headquarters at Assaroe in Donegal. Oisin was born of the deer-goddess Sadb and at the end of his life, when mounted on the fairy-steed of Niamh of the Golden Hair and sped by the wailing of the Fenians to her island paradise, he was shown a vision: a hornless fawn pursued over the waters of the sea by the red-eared white hounds of Hell. The fawn was himself. There is a parallel to this in the Romance of Pwyll Prince of Dyfed: Pwyll goes out hunting and meets Arawn King of Annwm mounted on a pale horse hunting a stag with his white, red-eared hounds. In recognition of Pwyll’s courtesy, Arawn, though sending him down to Annwm – for the stag is Pwyll’s soul – permits him to reign there in his stead. Another parallel is in the Romance of Math the Son of Mathonwy: Llew Llaw in the company of the faithless Blodeuwedd sees a stag being baited to death: it is his soul, and almost immediately afterwards he is put to death by her lover Gronw.
阿默金之歌第一行的异文「七角之鹿」和「七战之牛」表明，在青铜时代爱尔兰，如同在克里特和希腊一样，鹿和牛都 sacred 于大女神。在米诺斯克里特，牛作为弥诺陶罗斯（Minotaur，「牛-弥诺斯」）占据主导，但也有一位弥涅拉福斯（Minelaphos，「鹿-弥诺斯」），出现在月女神布里托玛耳忒（Britomart）的崇拜中，以及一位弥诺特拉戈斯（Minotragos，「山羊-弥诺斯」）崇拜。纽格兰奇墓葬中发现的鹿角表明鹿是爱尔兰达南人（Danaans）的王兽，而鹿在爱尔兰神话中极为突出：《库利牛袭》（The Cattle Raid of Cuailgne）——库丘林传奇的一部分——中的一个插曲显示，一个名为「美丽幸运竖琴」（The Fair Lucky Harps）的鹿祭司公会的总部在多尼戈尔的阿萨罗。莪辛（Oisin）为鹿女神萨德布（Sadb）所生，在他生命的尽头，当他骑着金发尼芙的仙马在芬尼亚人的哀号中飞向她的岛屿天堂时，他看到了一个幻象：一只无角幼鹿被地狱的红耳白犬追逐着越过海面。那幼鹿就是他本人。《迪韦德亲王普伊尔传奇》（Romance of Pwyll Prince of Dyfed）中有一个类似的情节：普伊尔外出狩猎，遇见骑灰马的安温之王阿劳恩（Arawn）用红耳白犬追逐一头雄鹿。为了回报普伊尔的礼让，阿劳恩虽然把他送到安温——因为那头鹿就是普伊尔的灵魂——却允许他在那里代替自己统治。另一个类似在《马思·马索尼之子传奇》（Romance of Math the Son of Mathonwy）中：卢·劳与不忠的布洛杜韦德（Blodeuwedd）看到一头雄鹿被围困至死：那就是他的灵魂，紧接着他就被她的情人格罗努（Gronw）杀死。

The fate of the antlered king – of whom Cernunnos, ‘the horned one’ of Gaul, is a familiar example – is expressed in the early Greek myth of Actaeon whom Artemis metamorphosed into a stag and hunted to death with her dogs. She did this at her anodos, or yearly reappearance, when she refreshed her virginity by bathing naked in a sacred fountain; after which she took another lover. The Irish Garbh Ogh with her pack of hounds was the same goddess: her diet was venison and eagles’ breasts. This ancient myth of the betrayed stag-king survives curiously in the convention, which is British as well as Continental, that gives the cuckold a branching pair of antlers. The May-day stag-mummers of Abbot’s Bromley in Staffordshire are akin to the stag-mummers of Syracuse in ancient Sicily, and to judge from an epic fragment concerned with Dionysus, one of the mummers disguised as an Actaeon stag was originally chased and eaten. In the Lycaean precinct of Arcadia the same tradition of the man dressed in deer skins who is chased and eaten survived in Pausanias’s day, though the chase was explained as a punishment for trespassing. From Sardinia comes a Bronze Age figurine of a man-stag with horns resembling the foliage of an oak, a short tail, an arrow in one hand and in the other a bow that has turned into a wriggling serpent. His mouth and eyes express an excusable terror at the sight; for the serpent is death. That the stag was part of the Elysian oracular cult is shown in the story of Brut the Trojan’s visit to the Island of Leogrecia, where the moon-oracle was given him while sleeping in the newly-flayed hide of a white hart whose blood had been poured on the sacrificial fire.
角王的命运——高卢的切尔努诺斯（Cernunnos，「有角者」）是一个常见例子——在早期希腊神话中阿克泰翁（Actaeon）的故事里得到了表达：阿尔忒弥斯将他变成一头鹿，用她的猎犬将他追杀至死。她是在自己的 anodos（年度再现）之时做此事的，当时她在圣泉中裸浴以恢复贞洁；之后她另取一位情人。爱尔兰的加尔布·奥格（Garbh Ogh）带着她的猎犬群就是同一位女神：她以鹿肉和鹰胸为食。这个被背叛的鹿王的古老神话奇怪地留存于给被戴绿帽者一对分叉鹿角的惯例中——这一惯例既是不列颠的也是大陆的。斯塔福德郡阿博茨布罗姆利的五朔节鹿假面舞者与古西西里叙拉古的鹿假面舞者同源，从一段涉及狄俄尼索斯的史诗残篇来看，一位假扮为阿克泰翁之鹿的舞者最初会被追逐并被分食。在阿卡迪亚的吕凯乌斯圣域，穿鹿皮的人被追逐并被吃掉的传统一直持续到保萨尼亚斯（Pausanias）时代，尽管追逐被解释为对擅入的惩罚。撒丁岛出土了一件青铜时代的人鹿雕像，其角如橡树叶，短尾，一手持箭，另一手持一张已变为蠕动蛇的弓。他的嘴和眼表达了对所见之物的可以理解的恐惧；因为蛇即死亡。鹿是极乐世界神谕崇拜的一部分，这在特洛伊人布鲁图造访勒奥格雷西亚岛的故事中有所体现——他在那里在新剥的白鹿皮上睡觉时获得了月亮神谕，鹿血被倒入祭火中。

The stag-cult is far older than the Cretan Minelaphos: he is shown in palaeolithic paintings in the Spanish caves of Altamira and in the Caverne des Trois Frères at Ariège in the French Pyrenees, dating from at least 20,000 BC. The Altamiran paintings are the work of the Aurignacian people, who have also left records of their ritual in the caves of Domboshawa, and elsewhere in Southern Rhodesia. At Domboshawa a ‘Bushman’ painting, containing scores of figures, shows the death of a king who wears an antelope mask and is tightly corseted; as he dies, with arms outflung and one knee upraised, he ejaculates and his seed seems to form a heap of corn. An old priestess lying naked beside a cauldron is either mimicking his agony, or perhaps inducing it by sympathetic magic. Close by, young priestesses dance beside a stream, surrounded by clouds of fruit and heaped baskets; beasts are led off laden with fruit; and a huge bison bull is pacified by a priestess accompanied by an erect python. The cults of stag and bull were evidently combined at Domoshawa; but the stag is likely to have been the more royal beast, since the dying king is given the greater prominence. The cults were also combined by the Aurignacians. In a Dordogne cave painting a bull-man is shown dancing and playing a musical instrument shaped like a bow.
鹿崇拜远早于克里特的弥涅拉福斯：在西班牙阿尔塔米拉洞穴和法国比利牛斯阿列日省的三兄弟洞（Caverne des Trois Frères）的旧石器时代壁画中，其年代至少可追溯到公元前两万年。阿尔塔米拉壁画是奥瑞尼亚人的作品，他们在南罗得西亚的敦博沙瓦（Domboshawa）洞穴和其他地方也留下了仪式记录。在敦博沙瓦，一幅包含数十个人物的「布须曼人」壁画展示了一位戴羚羊面具、被紧紧束腰的国王之死；他临死时双臂张开、一膝上举，射出精液，精液似乎形成了一堆谷物。一位赤裸躺在锅旁的老女祭司不是在模仿他的痛苦，就是可能通过交感巫术引发它。旁边，年轻的女祭司们在溪流旁舞蹈，周围是云朵般的果实和堆满的篮子；驮着果实的牲畜被牵走；一头巨大的野牛被一位女祭司和一条直立的蟒蛇安抚。鹿和牛的崇拜在敦博沙瓦显然结合在一起；但鹿可能更为王性，因为垂死的国王被赋予了更突出的位置。奥瑞尼亚人也结合了这两种崇拜。在多尔多涅的一幅洞穴壁画中，一个牛人被描绘为正在跳舞并演奏一种弓形的乐器。

The Minotragos goat-cult in Crete seems to have been intermediate between the cults of Minelaphos and Minotaur. Amalthea, the nurse of Cretan Zeus, was a goat. The Goddess Athene carried an aegis (‘goatskin’) shield, made it was said from Amalthea’s hide which had been previously used by her father Zeus as a prophylactic coat. The Goddess Libya appeared in triad to Jason on the shores of Lake Triton, Athene’s birthplace, when the Argo was landlocked there, and was clad in goatskins; she thereby identified herself with Aega, sister of Helice (‘willow branch’) and daughter of a king of Crete – Aega who was the human double of the goat Amalthea; and with Athene herself. The tradition of the Libyan origin of Athene is supported by a comparison of Greek and Roman methods of augury. In Libya the year begins in the autumn with the winter rains and the arrival of birds from the North; but in Northern Europe and the Black Sea area it begins in Spring with the arrival of birds from the South. In most Greek states the year began in the autumn and the Greek augurs faced north when observing birds, presumably because they derived their tradition from the birth-place of Athene, patroness of augury. On the other hand, the Roman augurs faced south, presumably because the Dardanians (whose patrician descendants in the early Roman Republic were alone permitted to take auguries) had migrated from the Black Sea area where birds arrive from Palestine and Syria in the Spring. The Roman year began in the Spring.
克里特的弥诺特拉戈斯山羊崇拜似乎介于弥涅拉福斯和弥诺陶罗斯崇拜之间。阿玛尔忒亚（Amalthea），克里特宙斯的乳母，是一头山羊。女神雅典娜携带一面羊皮盾（aegis），据说用阿玛尔忒亚的皮制成——此前她父亲宙斯曾将其用作防护衣。女神利比亚（Libya）以三位一体的形式出现在伊阿宋面前——在特里同湖畔，即雅典娜的出生地，当时阿尔戈号被困于此——她身披山羊皮；由此她将自己等同于埃伽（Aega）——赫利刻（Helice，「柳枝」）的姐妹、一位克里特国王之女——埃伽是山羊阿玛尔忒亚的人间替身；也等同于雅典娜本人。雅典娜的利比亚起源传说可通过比较希腊和罗马的占卜方法来支持。在利比亚，一年始于秋季的冬雨和北方候鸟的到来；但在北欧和黑海地区，一年始于春季南方候鸟的到来。在大多数希腊城邦中一年始于秋季，希腊占卜师观鸟时面朝北方，大概是因为他们的传统源自占卜守护神雅典娜的出生地。另一方面，罗马占卜师面朝南方，大概是因为达尔达尼亚人（其贵族后裔在早期罗马共和国中独占占卜权）从黑海地区迁徙而来——那里的鸟在春季从巴勒斯坦和叙利亚飞来。罗马一年始于春季。

The goat-Dionysus, or Pan, was a powerful deity in Palestine. He may have come there from Libya by way of Egypt or taken a roundabout northern route by way of Crete, Thrace, Asia Minor and Syria. The Day of Atonement scape-goat was a left-handed sacrifice to him under the name of Azazel, and the source of the Jordan was a grotto sacred to him as Baal Gad, the goat king, eponymous ancestor of the tribe of Gad. The prohibition in Deuteronomy XIV against seething a kid in its mother’s milk is puzzling only if sentimentally read; it is clearly written in the severe style of the remainder of the chapter, which begins with a prohibition against self-disfigurement at funerals, and directed against a eucharistic rite no longer tolerated by the priesthood of Jehovah. The clue is to be found in the well-known Orphic formula:
山羊神狄俄尼索斯，或潘，在巴勒斯坦是一位强大的神祇。他可能是从利比亚经埃及来到那里，或走了一条迁回的北方路线，经克里特、色雷斯、小亚细亚和叙利亚。赎罪日的替罪羊是以阿撒泻勒（Azazel）之名向他献的一种左手祭，约旦河的源头是一个以他为巴勒加德（Baal Gad，山羊之王）——迦得（Gad）部族的同名祖先——而 sacred 的洞穴。《申命记》第十四章禁止用山羊羔在其母奶中煮的禁令，只有在感性地解读时才令人困惑；它显然以本章其余部分的严厉风格写成——本章始于禁止在丧礼中自残——针对一种不再被耶和华祭司阶层容忍的圣餐仪式。线索见于著名的俄耳甫斯公式：

Like a kid I have fallen into milk
Like a kid I have fallen into milk（如山羊羔我坠入乳中）





which was a password for initiates when they reached Hades and were challenged by the guardians of the dead. They had become one with The Kid, that is to say the immortal Dionysus, originally Cretan Zagreus or Zeus, by partaking of his flesh, and with the Goat-goddess, his mother, in whose cauldron and milk he had been seethed.1 A song about the birth of the gods on one of the recently discovered Ras Shamra tablets contains an express injunction to seethe a kid in its mother’s milk.
这是入教者到达冥府被死者守护者盘问时的口令。他们已与「山羊羔」——即不朽的狄俄尼索斯，原为克里特的扎格柔斯（Zagreus）或宙斯——合为一体，方法是分食其肉；也与山羊女神——他的母亲——合为一体，在她的锅中和奶中他被煮过。¹ 最近发现的拉斯沙姆拉（Ras Shamra）泥版中有一首关于诸神诞生的歌，其中明确指示用山羊羔在其母奶中煮。

The prohibition in Deuteronomy explains the glib and obviously artificial myth of Esau, Jacob, Rebeccah and the blessing of Isaac, which is introduced into Genesis XXVII to justify the usurpation by the Jacob tribe of priestly and royal prerogatives belonging to the Edomites. The religious picture iconotropically2 advanced in support of the myth seems to have illustrated the kid-eating ceremony in Azazel’s honour. Two celebrants wearing goatskin disguises are shown at a seething cauldron presided over by the priestess (Rebeccah), one of them with bow and quiver (Esau) the other (Jacob) being initiated into the mysteries by the old leader of the fraternity (Isaac) who whispers the secret formula into his ear, blesses him and hands him – a piece of the kid to eat. The ceremony probably included a mock-slaughter and resurrection of the initiate, and this would account for the passage at the close of the chapter where Esau murderously pursues Jacob, Rebeccah directs affairs and the orgiastic ‘daughters of Heth’ in Cretan costume stand by. The two kids are probably an error: the same kid is shown twice, first being taken from its mother, and then being plunged into the cauldron of milk.
《申命记》的禁令解释了以扫、雅各、利百加和以撒祝福的那个圆滑而显然人为编造的神话——它被插入《创世记》第二十七章，以为雅各部族篡夺属于以东人的祭司和王室特权辩护。为支持该神话而以圣像倒置法（iconotropy）²提出的宗教画面似乎描绘了以阿撒泻勒之名的山羊羔食用仪式。画面中两位穿山羊皮伪装的参与者在一位女祭司（利百加）主持的沸腾锅旁，其中一位持弓和箭袋（以扫），另一位（雅各）正在由公会的老首领（以撒）传授秘仪——后者在他耳边低语秘密公式，祝福他，并递给他一块山羊羔肉吃。仪式可能包括入教者的假杀与复活，这可以解释本章结尾以扫追杀雅各、利百加指挥一切以及穿着克里特服装的狂欢「赫特之女」在旁的段落。两只山羊羔可能是错误的：同一只山羊羔被画了两次，先是从母羊身边被取走，然后被投入奶锅中。

Nonnus, the Orphic writer, explains the shift in Crete from the goat to the bull-sacrifice by saying that Zagreus, or Dionysus, was a horned infant who occupied the throne of Zeus for a day. The Titans tore him in pieces and ate him after he had raced through his changes of shape: Zeus with the goatskin coat, Cronos making rain, an inspired youth, a lion, a horse, a horned snake, a tiger, a bull. It was as a bull that the Titans ate him. The Persian Mithras was also eaten in bull form.
俄耳甫斯作家农诺斯（Nonnus）这样解释克里特从山羊祭到牛祭的转变：扎格柔斯即狄俄尼索斯是一个有角的婴儿，曾占据宙斯王座一日。提坦们在他经历变形之后将他撕碎并分食：穿羊皮衣的宙斯、降雨的克洛诺斯（Cronos）、受启的青年、狮子、马、有角蛇、虎、牛。提坦们是在他变为牛形时将他吃掉的。波斯密特拉也是以牛形被分食。

There seems to have been a goat-cult in Ireland before the arrival of the Danaans and Milesians, for in a passage in the Book of the Dun Cow ‘goatheads’ are a sort of demon associated with leprechauns, pigmies, and the Fomorians, or African aborigines.1 But by the time of the Ulster hero Cuchulain, the traditional date of whose death is 2 AD, the royal bull-cult was well established. His destiny was bound up with that of a brown bull-calf, son of Queen Maeve’s famous Brown Bull. The Morrigan, the Fate-goddess, when she first met Cuchulain, warned him that only while the calf was still a yearling would he continue to live. The central episode in the Cuchulain saga is the War of the Bulls, fought between the armies of Maeve and her husband King Ailell as the result of an idle quarrel about two bulls. At the close of it, the Brown Bull, Cuchulain’s other self, kills his rival, the White-horned, which considering itself too noble to serve a woman, has deserted Maeve’s herd for the herd of Ailell; it then goes mad with pride, charges a rock and dashes out its brains. It is succeeded by its calf, and Cuchulain dies.
在达南人和米利都人到达之前，爱尔兰似乎已有山羊崇拜，因为在《棕牛皮书》（Book of the Dun Cow）的一段中，「山羊头」是一种与小矮妖、侏儒和福摩里人（Fomorians，即非洲原住民）有关的恶魔。¹ 但到了乌尔斯特英雄库丘林时代——其传统死亡日期为公元2年——王室牛崇拜已稳固确立。他的命运与一头棕色牛犊——梅芙女王著名的棕牛之子——紧密相连。命运女神莫里甘（Morrigan）初见库丘林时警告他，只有当牛犊仍为一岁之内时他才能继续存活。库丘林传奇的核心情节是「公牛之战」，因梅芙与其丈夫艾莱尔国王（King Ailell）关于两头公牛的无谓争执而在两军之间爆发。结尾时，棕牛——库丘林的另一个自我——杀死了对手白角牛——后者认为自己太高贵而不愿侍奉女人，从梅芙的牛群叛逃到艾莱尔的牛群——然后因骄傲而发狂，撞向一块岩石，脑浆碎裂。它的牛犊继之而起，而库丘林也随之死去。

The bull-cult was also established in Wales at an early date. In a Welsh poetic dialogue contained in the Black Book of Carmarthen, Gwyddno Garanhir, Elphin’s father, describes the hero Gwyn as: ‘A bull of conflict, quick to disperse an embattled host’, and ‘bull of conflict’ here and in later poems seems to have been a sacred title rather than a complimentary metaphor; as ‘hawk’ and ‘eagle’ also were.
牛崇拜在威尔士也早已确立。在《卡马森黑皮书》（Black Book of Carmarthen）中的一首威尔士诗歌对话中，埃尔芬之父瓜伊德诺·加兰希尔（Gwyddno Garanhir）将英雄格温描述为：「冲突之牛，迅速驱散对阵之师」，此处的「冲突之牛」在后来诗歌中似乎是一种神圣称号而非恭维比喻；正如「鹰」和「雕」也是。

***



The War of the Bulls contains an instance of the intricate language of myth: the Brown Bull and the White-horned were really royal swine-herds who had the power of changing their shapes. It seems that in ancient times swine-herds had an altogether different standing from that conveyed in the parable of the Prodigal Son: to be a swine-herd was originally to be a priest in the service of the Death-goddess whose sacred beast was a pig.1 The War of the Bulls is introduced by the Proceedings of the Grand Bardic Academy, a seventh-century satire against the greed and arrogance of the ruling caste of bards, apparently composed by some member of an earlier oracular fraternity which had been dispossessed with the advent of Christianity. The leading character here is Marvan, royal swineherd to King Guaire of Connaught; he may be identified with Morvran (‘black raven’) son of the White Sow-goddess Cerridwen, who appears as Afagddu in the similar Welsh satire The Romance of Taliesin. In revenge for the loss of a magical white boar, at once his physician, music-maker and messenger, which the ruling bards have persuaded Guaire to slaughter, he routs them in a combat of wit and reduces them to silence and ignominy; Seanchan Torpest, the President of the Academy, addresses him as ‘Chief Prophet of Heaven and Earth’. There is a hint in the Romance of Branwen that the swine-herds of Matholwch King of Ireland were magicians, with a power of foreseeing the future. And this hint is expanded in Triad 56 which attributes to Coll ap Collfrewr, the magician, one of ‘the Three Powerful Swine-herds of the Isle of Britain’, the introduction into Britain of wheat and barley. But the credit was not really his. The name of the White Sow whom he tended at Dallwr in Cornwall and who went about Wales with gifts of grain, bees and her own young, was Hen Wen, ‘the Old White One’. Her gift to Maes Gwenith (‘Wheatfield’) in Gwent was three grains of wheat and three bees. She was, of course, the Goddess Cerridwen in beast disguise. (The story is contained in three series of Triads printed in the Myvyrian Archaiology.) The unpleasant side of her nature was shown by her gift to the people of Arvon of a savage kitten, which grew up to be one of the Three Plagues of Anglesey, ‘the Palug Cat’. Cerridwen then is a Cat-goddess as well as a Sow-goddess. This links her with the Cat-as-corn-spirit mentioned by Sir James Frazer as surviving in harvest festivals in north and north-eastern Germany, and in most parts of France and with the monster Chapalu of French Arthurian legend.
《公牛之战》包含神话错综语言的一个例子：棕牛和白角牛其实是具有变形能力的王室猪倌。在古代，猪倌的地位似乎与《荡子比喻》中所传达的截然不同：做猪倌原本就是做死亡女神——其圣兽为猪——的祭司。¹《公牛之战》以《大吟游学院纪事》（Proceedings of the Grand Bardic Academy）为引子——这是一篇七世纪讽刺统治阶层吟游诗人贪婪与傲慢的作品，显然由某个在基督教到来后被夺权的前神谕公会成员所作。主角是马尔万，康诺特国王瓜伊雷（King Guaire）的王室猪倌；他可以等同于白母猪女神凯丽杜恩（Cerridwen）之子莫尔弗兰（Morvran，「黑乌鸦」）——后者在类似的威尔士讽刺作品《塔列辛传奇》中以阿法格杜（Afagddu）之名出现。为了报复统治诗人说服瓜伊雷宰杀了他那既是医师、乐师又是信使的神奇白野猪，他以机智之战击败了他们，使他们沉默蒙耻；学院院长申坎·托尔佩斯特（Seanchan Torpest）称他为「天地之首席预言者」。《布兰文传奇》暗示爱尔兰国王马索尔赫（Matholwch）的猪倌是魔法师，有预见未来的能力。这一暗示在三联体第56条中得到扩展——该条将小麦和大麦引入不列颠的功绩归于魔法师科尔·阿普·科尔弗雷尔（Coll ap Collfrewr），他是「不列颠岛三大有力猪倌」之一。但这功绩实际上并非他的。他在康沃尔的达尔沃尔照料的白母猪——带着谷物、蜜蜂和她自己的幼崽走遍威尔士——名叫亨温（Hen Wen，「老白」）。她给格温特的麦斯格尼思（Maes Gwenith，「麦田」）的礼物是三粒麦子和三只蜜蜂。她当然是女神凯丽杜恩的兽形化身。（此故事见于《米维里安考古学》[Myvyrian Archaiology]中三组三联体。）她本性中不愉快的一面体现在她给阿尔文人民的礼物——一只凶猛的小猫，它长大后成为安格尔西三大瘟疫之一——「帕卢格猫」（the Palug Cat）。因此凯丽杜恩既是猪女神也是猫女神。这将她与詹姆斯·弗雷泽爵士提到的作为谷灵的猫联系起来——后者存留于德国北部和东北部以及法国大部分地区的丰收节中，也与法国亚瑟王传说中的怪物夏帕卢（Chapalu）相关。

There was also a Cat-cult in Ireland. A ‘Slender Black Cat reclining upon a chair of old silver’ had an oracular cave-shrine in Connaught at Clogh-magh-righ-cat, now Clough, before the coming of St. Patrick. This cat gave very vituperative answers to inquirers who tried to deceive her and was apparently an Irish equivalent of the Egyptian Cat-goddess Pasht. Egyptian cats were slender, black, long-legged and small-headed. Another seat of the Irish cat-cult was Knowth, a burial in Co. Meath of about the same date as New Grange. In The Proceedings of the Grand Bardic Academy the Knowth burial chamber is said to have been the home of the King-cat Irusan, who was as large as a plough-ox and once bore Seanchan Torpest, the chief-ollave of Ireland, away on its back in revenge for a satire. In his Poetic Astronomy, Hyginus identifies Pasht with the White Goddess by recording that when Typhon suddenly appeared in Greece – but whether he is referring to an invasion or to a volcanic eruption, such as destroyed most of the island of Thera, is not clear – the gods fled, disguised in bestial forms: ‘Mercury into an ibis, Apollo into a crane, a Thracian bird, Diana into a cat.’
爱尔兰也有猫崇拜。在圣帕特里克到来之前，「一只斜靠在旧银椅上的纤瘦黑猫」在康诺特的克洛赫-马格-里格-卡特（Clogh-magh-righ-cat，今克洛）有一座神谕洞穴圣殿。这只猫对试图欺骗她的询问者给出非常尖刻的回答，显然是埃及猫女神帕斯特（Pasht）的爱尔兰对应物。埃及猫纤瘦、黑色、长腿、小头。爱尔兰猫崇拜的另一据点是诺斯——米斯郡的一座墓葬，年代与纽格兰奇大致相同。在《大吟游学院纪事》中，诺斯墓室据说是猫王伊鲁桑（Irusan）的居所——它大如耕牛，曾因一首讽刺诗将爱尔兰首席奥拉夫申坎·托尔佩斯特驮在背上带走。希吉努斯在其《诗学天文学》中将帕斯特等同于白女神——他记录道，当堤丰突然出现在希腊时——但不清楚他指的是入侵还是火山爆发，如摧毁了锡拉岛大部分的那种——众神逃走，伪装为兽形：「墨丘利变为朱鹭，阿波罗变为鹤——一种色雷斯鸟，狄阿娜变为猫。」

The Old White Sow’s gift to the people of Rhiwgyverthwch was a wolf cub which also became famous. The Wolf-as-corn-spirit survives in roughly the same area as the Cat-as-corn-spirit; and in the island of Rügen the woman who binds the last sheaf is called ‘The Wolf’ and must bite the lady of the house and the stewardess, who placate her with a large piece of meat. So Cerridwen was a Wolf-goddess too, like Artemis. It looks as if she came to Britain between 2500–2000 BC with the New Stone Age long-headed agriculturists from North Africa.
老白母猪给里夫吉弗瑟赫人的礼物是一只狼崽，后来也出了名。作为谷灵的狼存活于与猫大致相同的地区；在吕根岛上，捆扎最后一捆麦的女人被称为「狼」，必须咬女主人和管家——她们以一大块肉来安抚她。因此凯丽杜恩也是狼女神，如阿尔忒弥斯一样。看来她是在公元前2500年至2000年之间与来自北非的新石器时代长头农业者一起来到不列颠的。

Why the cat, pig, and wolf were considered particularly sacred to the Moon-goddess is not hard to discover. Wolves howl to the moon and feed on corpse-flesh, their eyes shine in the dark, and they haunt wooded mountains. Cats’ eyes similarly shine in the dark, they feed on mice (symbol of pestilence), mate openly and walk inaudibly, they are prolific but eat their own young, and their colours vary, like the moon, between white, reddish and black. Pigs also vary between white, reddish and black, feed on corpse-flesh, are prolific but eat their own young, and their tusks are crescent-shaped.
为何猫、猪和狼被认为特别 sacred 于月女神并不难发现。狼对月嗥叫，以尸体为食，眼睛在黑暗中发光，出没于林木茂密的山中。猫眼同样在黑暗中发光，以鼠为食（鼠象征瘟疫），公开交配，步履无声，繁殖力强却会吃自己的幼崽，其颜色如月亮般在白、红和黑之间变化。猪也在白、红和黑之间变化，以尸体为食，繁殖力强却会吃自己的幼崽，其獠牙呈新月形。

1 Sir Thomas Browne generously remarked in his Urn Burial that ‘what song the Sirens sang, or what name Achilles assumed when he hid himself among women, though puzzling questions are not beyond all conjecture’. According to Suetonius the guesses made by various scholars whom the Emperor Tiberius consulted on this point were ‘Cercysera’ on account of the distaff (kerkis) that Achilles wielded; ‘Issa’, on account of his swiftness (aissoi, I dart); ‘Pyrrha’ on account of his red hair. Hyginus gives his vote for Pyrrha. My conjecture is that Achilles called himself Dacryoessa (‘the tearful one’) or, better, Drosoessa (‘the dewy one’), drosos being a poetic synonym for tears. According to Apollonius his original name Liguron (‘wailing’) was changed to Achilles by his tutor Cheiron. This is to suggest that the Achilles-cult came to Thessaly from Liguria. Homer punningly derives Achilles from achos (‘distress’), but Apollodorus from a ‘not’ and cheile ‘lips’, a derivation which Sir James Frazer calls absurd; though ‘Lipless’ is quite a likely name for an oracular hero.
¹ 托马斯·布朗爵士在其《瓮葬》中慷慨地说，「塞壬唱了什么歌，或阿喀琉斯混迹于女子之中时用了什么名字，虽是令人困惑的问题，却非全然不可臆测」。据苏埃托尼乌斯记载，提比略皇帝就此咨询的各位学者的猜测有：「刻尔基塞拉」（Cercysera）——因阿喀琉斯所纺的卷线杆（kerkis）；「伊萨」（Issa）——因他的敏捷（aissoi，我疾飞）；「皮拉」（Pyrrha）——因他的红发。希吉努斯投票支持皮拉。我的猜测是阿喀琉斯自称达克里奥埃萨（Dacryoessa，「流泪者」），或更好的是德罗索埃萨（Drosoessa，「露珠者」），drosos 是眼泪的诗意同义词。据阿波罗尼乌斯记载，他原名利古隆（Liguron，「哀号」），被其导师喀戎改为阿喀琉斯。这暗示阿喀琉斯崇拜从利古里亚来到色萨利。荷马以双关语将阿喀琉斯（Achilles）追溯自 achos（「痛苦」），但阿波罗多洛斯从 a「不」和 cheile「嘴唇」——詹姆斯·弗雷泽爵士称此派生荒谬；尽管「无唇者」对一位神谕英雄来说是相当可能的名字。



1 I find that I have been anticipated in this explanation by Maimonides (‘Rambam’), the twelfth-century Spanish Jew who reformed the Judaic religion and was, incidentally, Saladin’s physician-royal. In his Guide to the Erring he reads the text as an injunction against taking part in Ashtaroth worship.
¹ 我发现这一解释已被迈蒙尼德（Maimonides，「兰巴姆」[Rambam]）——十二世纪改革犹太教的西班牙犹太人，也是萨拉丁的御医——所预见。在其《迷途者指南》中，他将该文本解读为禁止参与阿斯塔蒂（Ashtaroth）崇拜的命令。

2 In the preface to my King Jesus I define iconotropy as a technique of deliberate misrepresentation by which ancient ritual icons are twisted in meaning in order to confirm a profound change of the existent religious system – usually a change from matriarchal to patriarchal – and the new meanings are embodied in myth. I adduce examples from the myths of Pasiphaë, Oedipus, and Lot.
² 在我的《耶稣王》序言中，我将圣像倒置法定义为一种蓄意歪曲的技巧，通过将古代仪式圣像的含义扭转来确认现存宗教体系的深刻变革——通常是从母系到父系的变革——新含义被融入神话中。我以帕西法厄、俄狄浦斯和罗得的神话为例。



1 Demons and bogeys are invariably the reduced gods or priests of a superseded religion: for example the Empusae and Lamiae of Greece who in Aristophanes’s day were regarded as emissaries of the Triple Goddess Hecate. The Lamiae, beautiful women who used to seduce, enervate and suck the blood of travellers, had been the orgiastic priestesses of the Libyan Sea-goddess Lamia; and the Empusae, demons with one leg of brass and one ass’s leg were relics of the Set cult – the Lilim, or Children of Lilith, the devotees of the Hebrew Owl-goddess, who was Adam’s first wife, were ass-haunched.
¹ 恶魔和妖怪无一例外是被取代宗教的退化神祇或祭司：例如希腊的恩普萨（Empusae）和拉弥亚（Lamiae）——在阿里斯托芬时代被视为三重女神赫卡忒的使者。拉弥亚——那些以色相引诱、削弱并吸血的美丽女子——曾是利比亚海女神拉弥亚的狂欢女祭司；而恩普萨——一腿为铜一腿为驴腿的恶魔——是塞特崇拜的遗物。利利姆（Lilim），即莉莉丝之子——希伯来猫头鹰女神的信徒，她是亚当的第一任妻子——是驴臀的。



1 Evidence of a similar function in early Greece is the conventional epithet dios, ‘divine’ applied in the Odyssey to the swine-herd Eumaeus. Because of the horror in which swineherds were held by the Jews and Egyptians and the contempt in which, thanks to the Prodigal Son, they have long been held in Europe, the word is usually mistranslated ‘honest or worthy’ though admitted to be an hapax legomenon. It is true that except on one night of the year – the full moon that fell nearest to the winter solstice, when the pig was sacrificed to Isis and Osiris and its flesh eaten by every Egyptian – the taboo on any contact with pigs was so strong that swine-herds though full-blooded Egyptians (according to Herodotus) were avoided like the plague and forced to marry within their own caste; but this was a tribute to their sanctity rather than anything else. The public hangman is similarly avoided in France and England because he has courageously undertaken, in the interests of public morality, a peculiarly horrible and thankless trade.
¹ 早期希腊存在类似功能的证据是《奥德赛》中常规性地将猪倌欧迈俄斯称为 dios——「神圣的」。由于犹太人和埃及人对猪倌的厌恶，以及因《荡子比喻》而在欧洲长期对猪倌的蔑视，这个词通常被误译为「诚实的或值得尊敬的」，尽管人们承认它是一个孤义词（hapax legomenon）。事实上，除一年中只有一个夜晚——最接近冬至的满月之夜，此时向伊西斯和奥西里斯献猪，每个埃及人都吃猪肉——之外，对与猪有任何接触的禁忌如此强烈，以至于猪倌虽然是纯正的埃及人（据希罗多德），却像瘟疫一样被回避，被迫在自家种姓内婚配；但这是对他们神圣性的致敬而非其他。法国和英国的公共绞刑官同样被回避，因为他勇敢地为了公共道德承担了一项特别可怕且吃力不讨好的职业。





Chapter Thirteen

title: 第十三章
content:
PALAMEDES AND THE CRANES
帕拉墨得斯与鹤





What interests me most in conducting this argument is the difference that is constantly appearing between the poetic and prosaic methods of thought. The prosaic method was invented by the Greeks of the Classical age as an insurance against the swamping of reason by mythographic fancy. It has now become the only legitimate means of transmitting useful knowledge. And in England, as in most other mercantile countries, the current popular view is that ‘music’ and old-fashioned diction are the only characteristics of poetry which distinguish it from prose: that every poem has, or should have, a precise single-strand prose equivalent. As a result, the poetic faculty is atrophied in every educated person who does not privately struggle to cultivate it: very much as the faculty of understanding pictures is atrophied in the Bedouin Arab. (T. E. Lawrence once showed a coloured crayon sketch of an Arab Sheikh to the Sheikh’s own clansmen. They passed it from hand to hand, but the nearest guess as to what it represented came from a man who took the sheikh’s foot to be the horn of a buffalo.) And from the inability to think poetically – to resolve speech into its original images and rhythms and re-combine these on several simultaneous levels of thought into a multiple sense – derives the failure to think clearly in prose. In prose one thinks on only one level at a time, and no combination of words needs to contain more than a single sense; nevertheless the images resident in words must be securely related if the passage is to have any bite. This simple need is forgotten, what passes for simple prose nowadays is a mechanical stringing together of stereotyped word-groups, without regard for the images contained in them. The mechanical style, which began in the counting-house, has now infiltrated into the university, some of its most zombiesque instances occurring in the works of eminent scholars and divines.
在推进这一论证时最让我感兴趣的是诗性思维与散文思维之间不断出现的差异。散文思维由古典时代的希腊人发明，作为防止理性被神话幻想淹没的保险。如今它已成为传递有用知识的唯一合法手段。而在英国，如同在大多数商业国家一样，当前流行观点认为「音乐」和老式措辞是诗歌区别于散文的唯一特征：每首诗都有或应该有一个精确的单一散文等价物。结果，诗性能力在每个不私下努力培养它的受教育者身上萎缩：很像贝都因阿拉伯人理解图画的能力萎缩。（T. E. 劳伦斯曾向一位阿拉伯酋长的族人展示该酋长的彩色蜡笔画像。他们传阅观看，但最接近的猜测是一个人把酋长的脚当成了水牛角。）而无法进行诗性思维——即将言语分解为其原始意象和节奏，然后在多个同时思维层面上重新组合为多重含义——导致散文中也无法清晰思考。散文中一次只在一个层面上思考，任何词的组合不需要包含超过一种含义；然而，词语中固有的意象必须牢固相关，段落才能有力量。这个简单的需求被遗忘了，当今所谓的简单散文不过是将陈词滥调的词组机械地串联起来，不顾其中所含的意象。这种始于账房的机械风格现已渗透到大学中，其最僵尸化的实例出现在著名学者和神学家的著作中。

Mythographic statements which are perfectly reasonable to the few poets who can still think and talk in poetic shorthand seem either nonsensical or childish to nearly all literary scholars. Such statements, I mean, as: ‘Mercury invented the alphabet after watching the flight of cranes’, or ‘Menw ab Teirgwaedd saw three rowan-rods growing out of the mouth of Einigan Fawr with every kind of knowledge and science written on them’.The best that the scholars have yet done for the poems of Gwion is ‘wild and sublime’; and they never question the assumption that he, his colleagues and his public were people of either stunted or undisciplined intelligence.
对少数仍能以诗性速记思维和交谈的诗人来说完全合理的神话学陈述，在几乎所有文学学者看来要么是无稽之谈要么是幼稚的。我指的是这样的陈述：「墨丘利观察鹤的飞行后发明了字母表」，或「门武·阿普·特尔格瓦德看到三根花楸枝从艾尼根·毛尔口中长出，上面写有各种知识和技术」。学者们对格维翁诗歌所能做出的最好评价是「狂野而崇高」；他们从不质疑这样的假设——格维翁及其同行和受众是智力发育不全或缺乏教养的人。

The joke is that the more prose-minded the scholar the more capable he is supposed to be of interpreting ancient poetic meaning, and that no scholar dares to set himself up as an authority on more than one narrow subject for fear of incurring the dislike and suspicion of his colleagues. To know only one thing well is to have a barbaric mind: civilization implies the graceful relation of all varieties of experience to a central humane system of thought. The present age is peculiarly barbaric: introduce, say, a Hebrew scholar to an ichthyologist or an authority on Danish place names and the pair of them would have no single topic in common but the weather or the war (if there happened to be a war in progress, which is usual in this barbaric age). But that so many scholars are barbarians does not matter so long as a few of them are ready to help with their specialized knowledge the few independent thinkers, that is to say the poets, who try to keep civilization alive. The scholar is a quarryman, not a builder, and all that is required of him is that he should quarry cleanly. He is the poet’s insurance against factual error. It is easy enough for the poet in this hopelessly muddled and inaccurate modern world to be misled into false etymology, anachronism and mathematical absurdity by trying to be what he is not. His function is truth, whereas the scholar’s is fact. Fact is not to be gainsaid; one may put it in this way, that fact is a Tribune of the People with no legislative right, but only the right of veto. Fact is not truth, but a poet who wilfully defies fact cannot achieve truth.
可笑的是，学者越是散文头脑，就越被认为有能力诠释古代诗歌含义；而且没有学者敢在多于一个狭窄领域自称权威，以免招致同行的反感和猜疑。只精通一件事就是有野蛮人的头脑：文明意味着将所有种类的经验优雅地关联到一个中心的人文思想体系。当今时代特别野蛮：比如说，把一位希伯来语学者介绍给一位鱼类学家或丹麦地名专家，他们除了天气或战争（如果恰好有战争正在进行——这在野蛮时代是常事）之外没有一个共同话题。但这么多学者是野蛮人并不重要，只要其中少数人愿意以自己的专业知识帮助那少数试图让文明存活的独立思考者——即诗人。学者是采石工，不是建筑工，对他的唯一要求是把石头采得干净。他是诗人防范事实错误的保险。在这个混乱而不准确的现代世界中，诗人很容易因为试图做自己不是的人而误入虚假词源、时代错误和数学荒谬。他的职能是真理，而学者的职能是事实。事实不容否认；可以这样讲：事实是一位只有否决权而无立法权的人民保民官。事实不是真理，但蓄意违背事实的诗人无法达到真理。

The story about Mercury and the cranes occurs in the Fables of Caius Julius Hyginus who, according to the well-informed Suetonius, was a native of Spain, a freedman of the Emperor Augustus, the Curator of the Palatine Library, and a friend of the poet Ovid. Like Ovid, Hyginus ended his life in Imperial disfavour. If he is the learned author of the Fables attributed to him, they have since been abbreviated and botched by unlearned editors; yet they are admitted to contain ancient mythological matter of great importance, not found elsewhere.
关于墨丘利与鹤的故事见于盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·希吉努斯的《寓言集》，据博学的苏埃托尼乌斯记载，希吉努斯是西班牙人，奥古斯都皇帝的释奴，帕拉蒂尼图书馆馆长，诗人奥维德的朋友。与奥维德一样，希吉努斯晚年失宠于皇室。如果他确实是归于他名下的《寓言集》的博学作者，那些寓言后来已被不学无术的编辑者删节和糟蹋；但人们承认其中包含别处未见的重要古代神话材料。

In his last Fable (277) Hyginus records:
在最后一篇寓言（第277篇）中希吉努斯记录道：

1. That the Fates invented the seven letters: Alpha, [Omicron], Upsilon, Eta, Iota, Beta, and Tau.
1. 命运三女神发明了七个字母：Alpha、[Omicron]、Upsilon、Eta、Iota、Beta 和 Tau。

Or, alternatively, that Mercury invented them after watching the flights of cranes ‘which make letters as they fly’.
或者说，墨丘利在观察鹤的飞行后发明了它们——「鹤飞行时排成字母形状」。

2. that Palamedes, son of Nauplius, invented eleven others.
2. 诺普利乌斯之子帕拉墨得斯发明了另外十一个。

3. that Epicharmus of Sicily added Theta and Chi (or Psi and Pi).
3. 西西里的厄皮卡穆斯增加了 Theta 和 Chi（或 Psi 和 Pi）。

4. that Simonides added Omega, Epsilon, Zeta and Psi (or Omega, Epsilon, Zeta and Phi).
4. 西摩尼德斯增加了 Omega、Epsilon、Zeta 和 Psi（或 Omega、Epsilon、Zeta 和 Phi）。





There is no word here about Cadmus the Phoenician, who is usually credited with the invention of the Greek alphabet, the characters of which are indisputably borrowed from the Phoenician alphabet. The statement about Epicharmus reads nonsensically, unless ‘of Sicily’ is a stupid editorial gloss that has intruded into the text. Simonides was a well-known sixth-century BC Greek poet who used the Cadmean Greek alphabet and did introduce certain new characters into his manuscripts, later adopted throughout Greece; and Epicharmus of Sicily, the well-known writer of comedies who lived not long afterwards and was a member of the family of Asclepiads at Cos, evidently seemed to the editor of the Fables a likely co-worker with Simonides. The original legend, however, probably refers to another, far earlier, Epicharmus, an ancestor of the writer of comedies. The Asclepiads traced their descent to Apollo’s son Asclepius, or Aesculapius, the physician god of Delphi and Cos, and claimed to inherit valuable therapeutic secrets from him. Two Asclepiads are mentioned in the Iliad as having been physicians to the Greeks in the siege of Troy.
此处没有提及通常被认为发明了希腊字母表的腓尼基人卡德摩斯——希腊字母确然借自腓尼基字母。关于厄皮卡穆斯的陈述读起来荒谬，除非「西西里的」是一个愚蠢的编辑注释混入了文本。西摩尼德斯是著名的公元前六世纪希腊诗人，使用卡德摩斯希腊字母表，确实在其手稿中引入了某些新字符，后来被全希腊采用；而西西里的厄皮卡穆斯——不久后居住的著名喜剧作家，科斯岛阿斯克勒庇俄斯家族成员——显然在编辑者看来很可能是西摩尼德斯的合作者。然而原始传说可能指的是另一位远早的厄皮卡穆斯——那位喜剧作家的祖先。阿斯克勒庇俄斯家族将血统追溯到阿波罗之子阿斯克勒庇俄斯，即德尔斐和科斯的医神，并声称从他继承了宝贵的治疗秘术。《伊利亚特》中提到两位阿斯克勒庇俄斯家族成员在特洛伊围城战中担任希腊人的医师。

As for Palamedes, son of Nauplius, he is credited by Philostratus the Lemnian, and by the scholiast on Euripides’s Orestes, with the invention not only of the alphabet, but also of lighthouses, measures, scales, the disc, and the ‘art of posting sentinels’. He took part in the Trojan War as an ally of the Greeks and at his death was granted a hero-shrine on the Mysian coast of Asia Minor opposite Lesbos.
至于诺普利乌斯之子帕拉墨得斯，利姆诺斯人菲洛斯特拉托斯和欧里庇得斯《俄瑞斯忒斯》的注释者都认为他不仅发明了字母表，还发明了灯塔、度量衡、铁饼和「布哨之术」。他作为希腊盟友参加了特洛伊战争，死后在小亚细亚密西亚海岸——莱斯博斯岛对面——获得了一座英雄圣祠。

The Three Fates are a divided form of the Triple Goddess, and in Greek legend appear also as the Three Grey Ones and the Three Muses.
命运三女神是三重女神的分化形式，在希腊传说中也以三位灰衣老妪和三位缪斯的形式出现。

Thus, the first two statements made by Hyginus account for the ‘thirteen letters’ which, according to some authorities (Diodorus Siculus says) formed the ‘Pelasgian alphabet’ before Cadmus increased them to sixteen. Diodorus evidently means thirteen consonants, not thirteen letters in all, which would not have been sufficient. Other authorities held that there had been only twelve of them. Aristotle, at any rate gives the numbers of letters in the first Greek alphabet as thirteen consonants and five vowels and his list of letters corresponds exactly with the Beth-Luis-Nion, except that he gives Zeta for H-aspirate and Phi for F – but, in the case of Phi, at least, early epigraphic evidence is against him. This is not the only reference to the Pelasgian alphabet. Eustathius, the Byzantine grammarian, quotes an ancient scholiast on Iliad, II, 841 to the effect that the Pelasgians were called Dioi (‘divine’) because they along of all the Greeks preserved the use of letters after the Deluge – the Deluge meaning to the Greeks the one survived by Deucalion and Pyrrha. Pyrrha, ‘the red one’, is perhaps the Goddess-mother of the Puresati or Pulesati, the Philistines.
因此，希吉努斯的前两条陈述解释了据某些权威（狄奥多鲁斯·西库卢斯说）组成「佩拉斯吉字母表」的「十三个字母」——在卡德摩斯将其增至十六个之前。狄奥多鲁斯显然指的是十三个辅音，而非总共十三个字母——那将不够用。其他权威认为只有十二个。亚里士多德无论如何给出了第一个希腊字母表中的字母数为十三个辅音和五个元音，他的字母列表与贝斯-路易斯-尼恩字母表完全对应，只是他以 Zeta 代替 H-送气音，以 Phi 代替 F——但至少在 Phi 的情况下，早期铭文证据不利于他。这并非对佩拉斯吉字母表的唯一提及。拜占庭语法学家尤斯塔修斯引用了《伊利亚特》II, 841 的一条古代注释，大意是佩拉斯吉人被称为 Dioi（「神圣的」），因为在所有希腊人中唯独他们在洪水之后保留了文字的使用——此处洪水对希腊人来说是指丢卡利翁和皮拉所幸存的那场。皮拉，「红色者」，也许就是普雷萨蒂人或普勒萨蒂人——即非利士人——的女神母亲。

The Lycians of Asia Minor are described by Herodotus as having come from Crete; so are their neighbours the Carians, who claimed to be kin to the Lydians and Mysians and spoke much the same barbaric, that is to say, non-Greek language. The Carians, formerly members of the Minoan Empire, had dominated the Aegean between the fall of Cnossos in 1400 BC and the Dorian invasion of 1050 BC. Herodotus found the Lycians the least Grecianized of these four nations and recorded that they reckoned descent through the mother, not the father. Female independence of male tutelage and matrilinear descent were characteristic of all peoples of Cretan stock; and the same system survived in parts of Crete long after its conquest by the Greeks. Firmicus Maternus reported it in the fourth century AD.1 The Lydians retained another vestige of the system – girls habitually prostituted themselves before marriage, and then disposed of their earnings and their persons as they thought fit.
希罗多德描述小亚细亚的吕西亚人来自克里特；他们的邻居卡里亚人也是如此——后者声称与吕底亚人和密西亚人有亲缘关系，说的大致是同样的蛮语，即非希腊语。卡里亚人原为米诺斯帝国成员，在公元前1400年克诺索斯陷落和公元前1050年多里安人入侵之间主宰了爱琴海。希罗多德发现吕基亚人是这四个民族中最少希腊化的，并记录他们按母系而非父系计算血统。女性独立于男性监护和母系传承是所有克里特血统民族的特征；同一体系在克里特被希腊人征服很久后仍在部分地区存续。菲尔米库斯·马特尔努斯在公元四世纪报道了这一点。¹ 吕底亚人保留了该体系的另一痕迹——女孩习惯在婚前卖淫，然后随心所欲地处置她们的收入和自身。

Palamedes, then, ruled over the Mysians, who were of Cretan stock, but he had a Greek father; his name means perhaps ‘Mindful of the Ancient One’, and he assisted the Three Fates (the Three Muses) in the composition of the Greek alphabet. But it was well known to the ancients, as it is to us, that all the inventions credited to Palamedes originated in Crete. It follows that a Greek alphabet, based on a Cretan not a Phoenician model, was raised from five vowels and thirteen consonants to five vowels and fifteen consonants, by Epicharmus, an early Asclepiad.
因此帕拉墨得斯统治了属于克里特血统的密西亚人，但他有一位希腊父亲；他的名字可能意为「铭记古老者」，他协助命运三女神（三位缪斯）组成了希腊字母表。但古人也如我们一样清楚，归于帕拉墨得斯的所有发明都起源于克里特。由此可知，一个基于克里特而非腓尼基模型的希腊字母表，由五元音和十三辅音增至五元音和十五辅音，是由早期阿斯克勒庇俄斯家族成员厄皮卡穆斯完成的。

But why did Hyginus not specify the eleven consonants of Palamedes, as he specified the original seven letters and the additions by Epicharmus and Simonides? We must first find out why he quotes Beta and Tau as the two consonants invented by the Three Fates at the same time as the five vowels.
但为何希吉努斯没有具体说明帕拉墨得斯的十一个辅音，而具体说明了原始的七个字母以及厄皮卡穆斯和西摩尼德斯的增补？我们必须先弄清为何他引用 Beta 和 Tau 作为命运三女神与五个元音同时发明的两个辅音。

Simonides, a native of Ceos, introduced into Athens, where he was domiciled, the double-consonants Psi and Xi, the distinction between the vowels Omicron and Omega (short and long O), and the distinction between the vowels Eta and Epsilon (long and short E). These changes were not, however, publicly adopted there until the archonship of Euclides (403 BC). To Eta, when thus distinguished from Epsilon, was allotted the character H, which had hitherto belonged to the aspirate H; and the aspirate H became merely a ‘rough breathing’, a miniature decrescent moon, while its absence in a word beginning with a vowel was denoted by a ‘smooth breathing’, a crescent moon. The Digamma F (which had a V sound) had disappeared as an Attic character long before the time of Simonides; and in many words was supplanted by the letter Phi, invented to represent the FF sound which had hitherto been spelt PH. But the Digamma was retained for some generations longer by the Aeolian Greeks and disappeared among the Dorians (the last to use it) during this same archonship of Euclides – at about the same time, in fact, as Gwydion and Amathaon won the Battle of the Trees in Britain.
西摩尼德斯，塞奥斯岛人，将双辅音 Psi 和 Xi、元音 Omicron 和 Omega（短 O 和长 O）的区别、以及元音 Eta 和 Epsilon（长 E 和短 E）的区别引入他定居的雅典。然而这些变更直到欧克里德斯执政官任期（公元前403年）才在雅典被公开采用。当 Eta 从 Epsilon 中区分出来后，被分配了字符 H——此前属于送气音 H——送气音 H 变成了仅仅是「粗气符」，一个微小的渐亏月牙形，而以元音开头的词中无送气则用「平气符」，一个月牙形表示。双伽马 F（有 V 音）在西摩尼德斯时代很久之前已从阿提卡字符中消失；在许多词中被字母 Phi 取代——Phi 是为表示此前拼写为 PH 的 FF 音而发明的。但双伽马在伊奥利亚希腊人中又保留了几代，在多里安人（最后使用它的）中于欧克里德斯执政官任期内消失——事实上大约与格维翁和阿马松在不列颠赢得树木之战同时。

This is a queer business. Though it is possible that the V sound had altogether dropped out of ordinary Greek speech and that therefore the Digamma F was an unnecessary letter, this is by no means certain; and the aspirate H was certainly still an integral part of the language. Why then was the aspirate supplanted by Eta? Why was a new character not found for the Eta sound? Why were the unnecessary double-consonants Psi, previously written Pi-Sigma, and Xi, previously written Kappa-Sigma, introduced at the same time? Only religious doctrine can have accounted for this awkward change.
这是一件怪事。虽然 V 音可能已完全从普通希腊语口语中消失，因此双伽马 F 是不必要的字母，但这并非确定无疑；而送气音 H 肯定仍是语言的组成部分。那么为何送气音被 Eta 取代？为何不为 Eta 音找一个新字符？为何同时引入不必要的双辅音 Psi（此前写作 Pi-Sigma）和 Xi（此前写作 Kappa-Sigma）？只有宗教教义能解释这一别扭的变更。

One of the reasons is given in the same fable. Hyginus connects the four additional letters of Simonides with Apollo’s zither – Apollo in cithaera ceteras literas adjecit. This means, I think, that each of the seven strings of the zither, originally Cretan but brought from Asia Minor to Greece about 676 BC by Terpander of Lesbos, now had a letter allotted to it, and that twenty-four, the new number of letters in the alphabet, had a sacred significance in the therapeutic music with which Apollo and his son Aesculapius were honoured in their island shrines. Simonides, it must be noted, belonged to a Cean bardic guild in the service of Dionysus who, according to Plutarch, a priest of Delphian Apollo, was ‘also at home in Delphi’. Both Apollo and Dionysus, as we have seen, were gods of the solar year. So were Aesculapius and Hercules; and this was an age of religious amalgamation.
原因之一在同一篇寓言中给出。希吉努斯将西摩尼德斯的四个增补字母与阿波罗的齐特拉琴联系起来——Apollo in cithaera ceteras literas adjecit。我认为这意味着齐特拉琴的七根弦——原为克里特乐器，约公元前676年由莱斯博斯岛的特尔潘德从小亚细亚传入希腊——如今每根弦被分配了一个字母，而二十四——字母表中新的字母数——在阿波罗及其子阿斯克勒庇俄斯于岛屿圣殿中所受尊崇的治疗音乐中具有神圣意义。须注意西摩尼德斯属于一个服务于狄俄尼索斯的塞奥斯吟游公会——据德尔斐阿波罗祭司普鲁塔克说，狄俄尼索斯「在德尔斐也有居所」。如我们所见，阿波罗和狄俄尼索斯都是太阳年之神。阿斯克勒庇俄斯和赫拉克勒斯也是如此；而这是一个宗教融合的时代。

Hyginus says that the original thirteen-consonant alphabet was taken by Mercury into Egypt, brought back by Cadmus into Greece, and thence taken by Evander the Arcadian into Italy, where his mother Carmenta (the Muse) adapted them to the Latin alphabet of fifteen letters. He describes this Mercury as the same one who invented athletic games: in other words, he was a Cretan, or of Cretan stock. And Mercury in Egypt was Thoth, the God whose symbol was a crane-like white ibis, who invented writing and who also reformed the calendar. The story begins to make good historical sense. Hyginus has perhaps drawn it from an Etruscan source: for the Etruscans, or Tyrrhenians, were of Cretan stock, and held the crane in reverence. Cranes fly in V-formation and the characters of all early alphabets, nicked with a knife on the rind of boughs – as Hesiod wrote his poems – or on clay tablets, were naturally angular.
希吉努斯说，最初的十三辅音字母表由墨丘利带入埃及，由卡德摩斯带回希腊，再由阿卡迪亚人埃万德带入意大利，其母卡门塔（即缪斯）将其改编为十五字母的拉丁字母表。他将这位墨丘利描述为发明了竞技运动的同一位：换言之，他是克里特人或克里特血统。而墨丘利在埃及即图特，其象征是鹤一般的白朱鹭，他发明了文字并改革了历法。故事开始有了良好的历史意义。希吉努斯可能取自伊特鲁里亚来源：因为伊特鲁里亚人即第勒尼安人是克里特血统，并尊崇鹤。鹤以 V 字队形飞行，而所有早期字母表的字符——用刀刻在树枝皮上（如赫西俄德写诗）或泥版上——自然是有棱角的。

So Hyginus knew that the five vowels of the Arcadian alphabet belonged to an earlier religious system than the seven vowels of the Classical Greek alphabet, and that in Italy these seven vowels were sacred to the Goddess Carmenta; also that in Italy a six-consonant sacred alphabet was used some six centuries before the Greek twenty-four-letter ‘Dorian’ alphabet from which all Italian alphabets – Etruscan, Umbrian, Oscan, Faliscan and Latin – are known to derive. In this, Hyginus is supported by Pliny who states positively in his Natural History that the first Latin alphabet was a Pelasgian one. He does not mention his authority but it was probably Gnaeus Gellius, the well-informed second-century BC historian, whom he quotes in the same passage as holding that Mercury first invented letters in Egypt and that Palamedes invented weights and measures. One must assume from the lack of inscriptional evidence in support of Hyginus’s record that this alphabet was confined, as the Beth-Luis-Nion originally was, to use in deaf-and-dumb signalling. About Carmenta we know from the historian Dionysus Periergetes that she gave oracles to Hercules and lived to the age of 110 years. 110 was a canonical number, the ideal age which every Egyptian wished to reach and the age at which, for example, the patriarch Joseph died. The 110 years were made up of twenty-two Etruscan lustra of five years each; and 110 years composed the ‘cycle’ taken over from the Etruscans by the Romans. At the end of each cycle they corrected irregularities in the solar calendar by intercalation and held Saecular Games. The secret sense of 22 – sacred numbers were never chosen haphazardly – is that it is the measure of the circumference of the circle when the diameter is 7. This proportion, now known as pi, is no longer a religious secret; and is used today only as a rule-of-thumb formula, the real mathematical value of pi being a decimal figure which no-one has yet been able to work out because it goes on without ever ending, as does, in a neat recurrent sequence. Seven lustra add up to thirty-five years, and thirty-five at Rome was the age at which a man was held to reach his prime and might be elected Consul. (The same age was fixed upon by a Classically-minded Convention as the earliest at which an American might be elected President of the United States.) The nymph Egeria, the oak-queen who instructed King Numa of Rome, was ‘the fourth Carmenta’. If the age of each Carmenta – or course of Sibylline priestesses – was 110 years, Numa reigned not earlier than 330 years after Evander’s arrival in Italy, the traditional date of which is some sixty years before the Fall of Troy, i.e., 1243 BC.
因此希吉努斯知道，阿卡迪亚字母表的五个元音属于比古典希腊字母表七个元音更早的宗教体系，在意大利这七个元音 sacred 于女神卡门塔；他还知道在意大利，一个六辅音神圣字母表在希腊二十四字母「多里安」字母表之前约六个世纪就已使用——所有意大利字母表（伊特鲁里亚、翁布里亚、奥斯坎、法利斯坎和拉丁）均已知源自该字母表。在此，希吉努斯得到普林尼的支持，后者在《自然史》中明确指出第一个拉丁字母表是佩拉斯吉字母表。他未提及来源，但可能是博学的公元前二世纪史家格奈乌斯·盖利乌斯——他在同一段落中引用其为墨丘利最早在埃及发明文字、帕拉墨得斯发明度量衡的权威。鉴于缺乏铭文证据支持希吉努斯的记录，必须假定这套字母表如贝斯-路易斯-尼恩字母表最初一样，仅限于聋哑手语信号使用。关于卡门塔，我们从史家狄奥尼修斯·佩里埃格特斯得知她曾向赫拉克勒斯发布神谕并活到一百一十岁。110 是一个规范数字，是每个埃及人希望达到的理想年龄，也是例如族长约瑟去世的年龄。110 年由二十二次伊特鲁里亚五年卢斯特拉组成；110 年构成罗马人从伊特鲁里亚人那里接管的「周期」。每个周期结束时，他们通过置闰修正太阳历的不规则之处并举行世俗运动会。22 的秘密含义——神圣数字从非随意选择——是当直径为 7 时圆周的量度。这一比例即如今所称的 π，不再是什么宗教秘密；如今仅作为经验公式使用，π 的真正数学值是一个无人能算尽的小数——它无限延伸，以一种工整的循环序列。七个卢斯特拉合计三十五年，三十五岁在罗马被视为男子达到壮年并可当选执政官的年龄。（同一年龄被一位崇尚古典的制宪会议定为美国人可当选总统的最早年龄。）宁芙埃格里娅——指导罗马国王努马的橡树女王——是「第四位卡门塔」。如果每位卡门塔——或西比拉女祭司团一届——的年龄为 110 年，则努马统治不早于埃万德到达意大利后 330 年，后者的传统日期约为特洛伊陷落前六十年，即公元前 1243 年。

Evander was banished from Arcadia because he had killed his father; and this implies the supersession of the Triple Goddess, Carmenta or Thetis, by Olympian Zeus. Thetis was the Aeolian Greek name for Carmenta, at whose prompting Evander had struck the blow; and for a king to kill his father (or kingly predecessor) at the prompting of his Goddess mother was common in Italy and Greece at that period. The traditional reason for Partholan’s Danaan invasion of Ireland and Brutus’s Dardanian invasion of Britain is the same: both were banished for parricide. The date, 1243 BC, corresponds with that given by the later Greeks for the Achaean invasion, namely 1250 BC. This was not the original invasion but, apparently, a southward movement, under Dorian pressure, of Achaeans settled in North-western Greece. The story of Pelias and Neleus, sons of Poseidon who dispossessed the Minyans of Iolcos in Thessaly and Pylos in the Western Peloponnese, refers to this invasion which resulted in the institution of Olympianism.
埃万德因杀父而被逐出阿卡迪亚；这暗示三重女神卡门塔或忒提斯被奥林匹亚宙斯取代。忒提斯是卡门塔的伊奥利亚希腊名，正是在她的促使下埃万德挥出了那一击；在女神母亲的促使下国王弑父（或杀死前任国王）在那个时代的意大利和希腊很常见。帕尔托兰的达南人入侵爱尔兰和布鲁图的达尔达尼亚人入侵不列颠的传统原因相同：两者都因弑父而被放逐。公元前1243年这一日期与后期希腊人给出的阿卡亚人入侵日期即公元前1250年相符。这不是最初的入侵，而显然是在多里安人压力下，定居在希腊西北部的阿卡亚人向南迁徙。佩利亚斯和涅琉斯——波塞冬之子，夺取了色萨利伊奥尔科斯和伯罗奔尼撒西部皮洛斯的弥尼安人——的故事指的是导致了奥林匹亚主义确立的这次入侵。

But has not the story of the invention of the pre-Cadmean alphabet of Palamedes, which was taken to Italy by Evander the Arcadian before the Dorian invasion of Greece, been lying concealed all this time in the confusingly iconotropic myth of Perseus and the Gorgon Medusa? Cannot the Palamedes story be recovered intact by the simple method of restoring the Perseus myth to iconographic form, and then re-interpreting the iconographs which compose it?
但是，帕拉墨得斯的前卡德摩斯字母表——在多里安人入侵希腊之前由阿卡迪亚人埃万德带到意大利——的发明故事，是否一直隐藏在令人困惑的、经过圣像倒置的珀尔修斯与戈耳工美杜莎的神话之中？难道不能通过简单地将珀尔修斯神话还原为图像形式，然后重新诠释组成它的图像，来完整地恢复帕拉墨得斯的故事吗？

The myth is that Perseus was sent to cut off the head of the snaky-locked Gorgon Medusa, a rival of the Goddess Athene, whose baleful look turned men into stone; and that he could not accomplish the task until he had gone to the three Graeae, ‘Grey Ones’, the three old sisters of the Gorgons who had only one eye and one tooth between them, and by stealing eye and tooth had blackmailed them into telling him where the grove of the three nymphs was to be found. From the three nymphs he then obtained winged sandals like those of Hermes, a bag to put the Gorgon’s head into, and a helmet of invisibility. Hermes also kindly gave him a sickle; and Athene gave him a mirror and showed him a picture of Medusa so that he would recognize her. He threw the tooth of the Three Grey Ones, and some say the eye also, into Lake Triton, to break their power, and flew on to Tartessus where the Gorgons lived in a grove on the borders of the ocean; there he cut off the sleeping Medusa’s head with the sickle, first looking into the mirror so that the petrifying charm should be broken, thrust the head into his bag, and flew home pursued by other Gorgons.
神话是这样的：珀尔修斯被派去砍下蛇发戈耳工美杜莎——女神雅典娜的对手，她恶毒的目光能将人变为石头——的头颅；他无法完成任务，直到找到三位格雷埃——「灰衣者」，戈耳工们的三位老姐妹，她们只有一只眼和一颗牙在三人之间共用——通过偷走眼和牙，他勒索她们告诉他三位宁芙的树林在何处。从三位宁芙处他获得了如赫尔墨斯般的飞鞋、一个装戈耳工头颅的口袋和一顶隐形头盔。赫尔墨斯还善意地给了他一把镰刀；雅典娜给了他一面镜子并让他看了美杜莎的画像以便认出她。他将三位灰衣者的牙——有人说还有眼——扔入特里同湖以断绝她们的力量，然后飞往塔特苏斯，戈耳工们住在那里大洋边的一片树林中；他用镰刀砍下熟睡的美杜莎的头颅——先看镜子以破解石化法术——将头颅塞入口袋，在其余戈耳工的追逐下飞回家中。

The three Nymphs must be understood as the Three Graces, that is to say, the Triple Love-Goddess. The Graeae were also known as the Phorcides, which means the daughters of Phorcus, or Orcus, and according to the Scholiast on Aeschylus had the form of swans – which is probably an error for cranes, due to a misreading of a sacred picture, since cranes and swans, equally sacred birds, are alike in flying in V-formation. They were, in fact, the Three Fates. Phorcus, or Orcus, became a synonym for the Underworld; it is the same word as porcus, a pig, the beast sacred to the Death-goddess, and perhaps as Parcae, a title of the Three Fates, usually called Moirae, ‘the distributors’. Orc is ‘pig’ in Irish; hence the Orcades, or Orkneys, abodes of the Death-goddess. Phorcus was also reputedly the father of the Gorgon Medusa, whom the Argives in Pausanias’s day described as a beautiful Libyan queen decapitated by their ancestor Perseus after a battle with her armies, and who may therefore be identified with the Libyan snake-goddess Lamia (Neith) whom Zeus betrayed and who afterwards killed children.
三位宁芙应被理解为三位美惠女神，即三重爱神。格雷埃也被称为福尔基德斯，意为福尔库斯或奥尔库斯之女，据埃斯库罗斯的注释者说她们呈天鹅形——这可能是因误读圣画而将鹤误认为天鹅，因为鹤和天鹅同为神圣之鸟，均以 V 字队形飞行。她们事实上是命运三女神。福尔库斯或奥尔库斯成为冥界的同义词；它与 porcus（猪）——死亡女神的圣兽——是同一个词，也许还与 Parcae——命运三女神的称号，通常称为莫伊赖即「分配者」——相同。Orc 在爱尔兰语中意为「猪」；因此奥克尼群岛即死亡女神的居所。福尔库斯也据说是戈耳工美杜莎的父亲，而在保萨尼亚斯时代阿尔戈斯人将美杜莎描述为一位美丽的利比亚女王，在与他们的祖先珀尔修斯交战后被斩首，因此她可以等同于利比亚蛇女神拉弥亚（即奈特[Neith]）——被宙斯背叛后转而杀婴的女神。

Imagine the pictures on a vase. First, a naked young man cautiously approaching three shrouded women of whom the central one presents him with an eye and a tooth; the other two point upwards to three cranes flying in a V-formation from right to left. Next, the same young man, wearing winged sandals and holding a sickle, stands pensively under a willow tree. (Willows are sacred to the Goddess, and cranes breed in willow groves.) Next, another group of three beautiful young women sit side by side in a grove with the same young man standing before them. Above them three cranes fly in the reverse direction. One presents him with winged sandals, another with a bag, the third with a winged helmet. Next, various sea-monsters are shown and a helmeted Sea-goddess, with a trident, holding a mirror in which a Gorgon’s face is reflected; and the young man is seen flying, bag and sickle in hand, towards a grove with his head turned to look at the mirror. From the bag peeps out the Gorgon’s head. The tooth and eye are painted, enlarged, on either side of him, so that he seems to have thrown them away. He is followed by three menacing winged women with Gorgon faces.
想象花瓶上的画面。首先，一个裸体青年谨慎地接近三位蒙面女子，中间那位递给他一只眼和一颗牙；另外两位指向上方，三只鹤正从右向左以 V 字队形飞行。接着，同一青年穿着飞鞋手持镰刀，沉思地站在一棵柳树下。（柳树 sacred 于女神，鹤在柳林中繁殖。）然后，另一组三位美丽年轻女子并排坐在树林中，同一青年站在她们面前。上方三只鹤朝相反方向飞。一位递给他飞鞋，另一位递给他口袋，第三位递给他有翼头盔。接着，各种海怪出现，一位戴头盔持三叉戟的海女神拿着一面镜子，镜中映出戈耳工的面孔；青年手持口袋和镰刀飞向一片树林，头转向看镜子。口袋中露出戈耳工的头。牙和眼被放大画在他两侧，似乎是他扔掉的。他身后跟着三位面容狰狞的有翼女子。

This completes the pictures on the vase and one comes again to the first group.
花瓶画面到此结束，回到第一组。

The myth in its familiar form, like that of Zeus’s betrayal of Lamia, is descriptive of the breaking of the Argive Triple Goddess’s power by the first wave of Achaeans, figured as Perseus, ‘the destroyer’. But the original meaning of the iconographs seems to be this: Mercury, or Hermes, or Car, or Palamedes, or Thoth, or whatever his original name was, is given poetic sight by the Shrouded Ones (his mother Carmenta, or Maia, or Danaë, or Phorcis, or Medusa, or whatever her original name was, in her prophetic aspect of the Three Fates) and the power to take omens from the flight of birds; also the power to understand the alphabetic secret represented by the cranes. The tooth was a divinatory instrument, like the one under which Fionn used to put his thumb – after eating the salmon of knowledge – whenever he needed magical counsel. Carmenta has invented the alphabet, but is assigning the thirteen consonants to her son, while keeping the five vowels sacred to herself. He goes off with his sickle, which is moon-shaped in her honour, like the sickle which the Gallic Arch-Druid subsequently used for cutting mistletoe; and will presently cut the first alphabet twig from the grove; in front of which the Goddess, unshrouded now, and playing the nymph not the crone, is discovered sitting in gracious trinity. She gives him as his regalia a winged helmet and winged sandals, symbolizing the swiftness of poetic thought, and a bag in which to keep his letters well hidden.
神话在人们熟悉的形式中，如宙斯背叛拉弥亚的故事一样，描述了阿尔戈斯三重女神的权力被第一波阿卡亚人——以珀尔修斯「毁灭者」为形象——所打破。但图像的原始含义似乎是这样的：墨丘利，或赫尔墨斯，或卡尔，或帕拉墨得斯，或图特，或无论他原名为何，从蒙面者处（他母亲卡门塔，或迈亚，或达那厄，或福尔基斯，或美杜莎，或无论她原名为何，作为命运三女神的预言面相）获得了诗性视觉和从鸟的飞行中占卜的力量；以及理解鹤所代表的字母秘密的力量。那颗牙是一种占卜工具，如同芬恩每次需要魔法指教时——在吃了知识之鲑后——放在拇指下的那颗。卡门塔发明了字母表，但只将十三个辅音分配给儿子，将五个元音保留为 sacred 于自己。他带着镰刀离去——镰刀呈月牙形以致敬她，如同后来的高卢大德鲁伊切割槲寄生所用的镰刀；他即将从树林中砍下第一根字母树枝；在树林前，女神——如今已揭去面纱，以少女而非老妪的面貌出现——被发现优雅地以三位一体之姿端坐。她给他作为徽章的有翼头盔和飞鞋——象征诗性思维的迅捷——以及一个口袋以妥善隐藏他的字母。

Next, she is revealed as Athene, the Goddess of Wisdom, who was born on the shores of Lake Triton in Libya and seems to have been originally, before her monstrous rebirth from Father Zeus’s head, the Libyan Triple Goddess Neith, whom the Greeks called Lamia, or Libya. Peeping from his bag there is now a Gorgon’s head, which is merely an ugly mask assumed by priestesses on ceremonial occasions to frighten away trespassers; at the same time they made hissing noises, which accounts for Medusa’s snake locks. There never was a real Gorgon (as J. E. Harrison was the first to point out); there was only a prophylactic ugly face formalized into a mask. The ugly face at the mouth of the bag symbolizes that the secrets of the alphabet, which are the real contents, are not to be divulged or misused. A Gorgon’s mask was similarly put on the doors of all ovens and kilns in ancient Greece to frighten away the bogeys (and inquisitive children) who might spoil the baking. The winged ‘Gorgons’ in this picture are escorting, not pursuing, Mercury: they are the Triple Goddess again who, by wearing these ritual masks, is protecting him from profane eyes. She is also shown on the earth holding out her mirror with a Gorgon’s face reflected in it, to protect him in his poetic flight. He is taking the bag to Tartessus, the Aegean colony on the Guadalquivir; whence presumably the Milesians would carry it to Ireland. Gades, now Cadiz, the principal city of Tartessus, is said by the Augustan historian Velleius Paterculus to have been founded in 1100 BC, thirteen years before the foundation of Utica in North Africa. Perseus’ flight was displayed in gold and silver inlay on the Shield of Hercules, as extravagantly described by Hesiod; who places it between a scene of the Muses singing to a lyre near a dolphin-haunted sea, and one of the Three Fates standing outside a populous seven-gated city. If this city is his own seven-gated Thebes, then the icon which Hesiod has misread is a Boeotian variant of the Mercury myth, and the hero with the tasselled alphabet-bag and the attendant Gorgons is Cadmus the Theban.
接着，她以雅典娜——智慧女神——的面貌显现，她出生于利比亚的特里同湖畔，在从父亲宙斯头中怪异重生之前，似乎原为利比亚三重女神奈特——希腊人称之为拉弥亚或利比亚。他的口袋中此时露出一个戈耳工头颅，那不过是女祭司在仪式场合佩戴以吓退闯入者的丑陋面具；同时她们发出嘶嘶声，这解释了美杜莎的蛇发。从未有过真正的戈耳工（如 J. E. 哈里森最先指出的）；只有一张被形式化为面具的预防性丑脸。袋口的丑脸象征字母表的秘密——即口袋的真实内容——不可泄露或滥用。古希腊所有烤炉和窑的门上也同样放置戈耳工面具，以吓退可能破坏烘焙的妖怪（和好奇的孩子）。画面中有翼的「戈耳工」是在护送而非追逐墨丘利：她们又是三重女神，通过佩戴这些仪式面具保护他免受凡俗之眼窥视。她还在地面上举着映有戈耳工面孔的镜子，以在他诗性飞翔中保护他。他正将口袋带往塔特苏斯——瓜达尔基维尔河上的爱琴海殖民地；大概米利都人将从那里将其带到爱尔兰。加德斯，今加的斯，塔特苏斯的主要城市，据奥古斯都时代史家维莱乌斯·帕特尔库卢斯记载，建于公元前 1100 年，比北非乌提卡建城早十三年。珀尔修斯的飞行以金银镶嵌展示在赫拉克勒斯的盾牌上，如赫西俄德华丽描述的那样；赫西俄德将其置于缪斯在海豚出没的海边弹琴歌唱的场景，和三位命运女神站在一座人口稠密的七门城市之外的场景之间。如果这座城市就是他自己的七门底比斯，那么赫西俄德误读的图像是墨丘利神话的彼奥提亚变体，而手持流苏字母袋、由戈耳工随行的英雄就是底比斯的卡德摩斯。

Mercury arrived safely at Tartessus, to judge from a cryptic remark by Pausanias (I, 35, 8) that ‘there is a tree at Gades that takes diverse forms’, which seems to refer to the tree-alphabet. Gades (Cadiz) is built on Leon, an island of Tartessus; the older city was on the western shore and included a famous temple of Cronos mentioned by Strabo. It is likely that the island was once, like Pharos, both a sepulchral island and a trading depôt. Pherecydes guessed that it was the original ‘Red Island’, Erytheia, over which three-bodied Geryon ruled, but on the insufficient ground that the pasture there was very rich and that Hercules had an ancient shrine on the eastern shore. Pausanias (X, 4, 6) records the more plausible legend that Leon was originally owned by the Giant Tityus who, as will be shown in Chapter Sixteen, was really Cronos – the god of the middle, or fool’s finger, consigned to Tartarus by Zeus. (Titias whom Hercules killed and Tityus whom Zeus killed are doublets.) The shrine of Hercules seems to have been set up by the colonists of 1100 BC, some four hundred years before Phoenician colonists came there from Tyre, having been ordered by an oracle to settle near the Pillars of Hercules. The Phoenicians subsequently worshipped Cronos as Moloch and Hercules as Melkarth. Strabo quotes Poseidonius for holding that the Pillars of Hercules were not, as was vulgarly supposed, the two heights of Gibraltar and Ceuta, but two pillars set up before his shrine; and I have suggested in my King Jesus (Chapter XVI) that such columns were connected with the secret of the Pelasgian alphabet. So it is likely that the pre-Phoenician Hercules of Tartessus was Palamedes, or the lion-skinned God Ogmios: whom the Irish credited with the invention of the alphabet that they ‘had out of Spain’ and whom Gwion, in his Elegy on ‘Ercwlf’, celebrates as a planter of alphabetic pillars. The people of Tartessus were famous in Classical times for the respect they paid to old men, and Ogmios according to Lucian was represented as an aged Hercules. That the Gorgons lived in a grove at Tartessus can mean only that they had an alphabetic secret to guard. This Ogmian Hercules was also worshipped by the early Latins. King Juba II of Mauretania, who was also an honorary duumvir of Gades, is quoted by Plutarch (Roman Questions 59) as his authority for saying that Hercules and the Muses once shared an altar because he had taught Evander’s people the alphabet. This tallies with Hyginus’s account of how Carmenta, the Triple Muse, taught Evander, and Dionysus Periergetes’ account of how she ‘gave oracles to Hercules’.
墨丘利安全抵达了塔特苏斯——从保萨尼亚斯一句隐晦的话（I, 35, 8）可以判断：「加德斯有一棵会变幻形态的树」，这似乎指的是树木字母表。加德斯（加的斯）建在塔特苏斯的莱昂岛上；旧城在西岸，包括斯特拉波提到的一座著名的克洛诺斯神庙。该岛可能曾如法罗斯一样，既是墓葬岛又是贸易站。费雷基德斯猜测它是原始的「红岛」厄律提亚——三身革律翁所统治之地——但理由不充分，只因那里的牧场很丰美且赫拉克勒斯在东岸有一座古老圣殿。保萨尼亚斯（X, 4, 6）记载了更合理的传说：莱昂原属巨人提提俄斯所有——如第十六章所示，他实为克洛诺斯——即中间指或愚者指之神，被宙斯打入塔耳塔洛斯。（赫拉克勒斯杀死的提提阿斯和宙斯杀死的提提俄斯是二重身。）赫拉克勒斯圣殿似乎是由公元前 1100 年的殖民者建立的，比腓尼基殖民者从推罗来此早约四百年——后者奉神谕之命在赫拉克勒斯之柱附近定居。腓尼基人随后将克洛诺斯崇拜为摩洛赫，将赫拉克勒斯崇拜为美尔卡特。斯特拉波引用波塞冬尼乌斯的话说，赫拉克勒斯之柱并非如俗人所想是直布罗陀和休达的两座山，而是竖在他圣殿前的两根柱子；我在《耶稣王》（第十六章）中建议这些柱子与佩拉斯吉字母表的秘密有关。因此，塔特苏斯的前腓尼基赫拉克勒斯很可能是帕拉墨得斯，或狮皮神奥格米奥斯：爱尔兰人认为是他发明了他们「从西班牙带来」的字母表，格维翁在其《埃尔克武夫挽歌》中赞颂他为字母柱的树立者。塔特苏斯人在古典时代以敬老著称，而据琉善记载，奥格米奥斯被描绘为一位老年的赫拉克勒斯。戈耳工们住在塔特苏斯的树林中，只能意味着她们有一个字母秘密要守护。这位奥格米奥斯的赫拉克勒斯也受到早期拉丁人崇拜。普鲁塔克（《罗马问题》59）引用毛里塔尼亚国王朱巴二世——他也是加德斯的名誉双头官——为权威说，赫拉克勒斯和缪斯曾共享一座祭坛，因为他教了埃万德的人民字母表。这与希吉努斯关于三重缪斯卡门塔教导埃万德的叙述，以及狄奥尼修斯·佩里埃格特斯关于她「向赫拉克勒斯发布神谕」的叙述一致。

Isidore, Archbishop of Seville, who died in 636 AD, wrote an encyclopaedic work called Twenty Books Concerning Origins or Etymologies, based on a wide, if uncritical, study of Christian and pagan literature, which is the most valuable repository of Iberian tradition extant. In it he treats of the invention of the alphabet. He does not present Palamedes or Hercules or Ogma or Mercury or Cadmus as the original benefactor, but the Goddess herself and names Greece as the land of origin:
塞维利亚大主教伊西多尔，卒于公元636年，写了一部百科全书式著作《论起源或词源二十书》，基于对基督教和异教文献的广泛——虽然不够批判性的——研究，是现存最有价值的伊比利亚传统宝库。在其中他论述了字母表的发明。他没有将帕拉墨得斯或赫拉克勒斯或奥格玛或墨丘利或卡德摩斯作为最初的恩人，而是女神本人，并指出希腊为起源之地：

Aegyptiorum litter as Isis regina, Inachis [sic] regis filia, de Graecia veniens in Aegyptum repperit et Aegyptis tradidit.



As for the Egyptian alphabet, Queen Isis, daughter of King Inachus, coming from Greece to Egypt brought them with her and gave them to the Egyptians.
至于埃及字母表，伊西斯女王，伊纳科斯国王之女，从希腊来到埃及时将它们带来并交给了埃及人。



Originum I, iii (4–10).
Originum I, iii (4–10).（《起源》第一卷第三章4–10节。）





Inachus, a river-god and legendary king of Argos, was the father both of the Goddess Io, who became Isis when she reached Egypt, and of the hero Phoroneus, founder of the Pelasgian race, who has been already identified with the God Bran, alias Cronos. Isidore was a compatriot of Hyginus (who reported the legend of Mercury’s return to Greece from Egypt with the Pelasgian alphabet); he distinguishes the Egyptian alphabet both from the hieroglyphic and demotic scripts, and ascribes the invention of the ordinary Greek alphabet to the Phoenicians.
伊纳科斯，一位河神和阿戈斯的传说国王，既是女神伊奥——到达埃及后成为伊西斯——的父亲，也是英雄福罗纽斯——佩拉斯吉种族的创立者，已被等同于神布兰即克洛诺斯——的父亲。伊西多尔是希吉努斯的同胞（后者报道了墨丘利将佩拉斯吉字母表从埃及带回希腊的传说）；他将埃及字母表与象形文字和世俗体文字区分开来，并将普通希腊字母表的发明归于腓尼基人。

What material Mercury’s bag was made of, can be discovered in the parallel myth of Manannan, son of Lyr, a Goidelic Sun-hero, predecessor of Fionn and Cuchulain, who carried the Treasures of the Sea (i.e., the alphabet secret of the Peoples of the Sea) in a bag made of the skin of a crane; and in the myth of Mider, a Goidelic Underworld-god, corresponding with the British Arawn (‘Eloquence’) King of Annwm, who lived in a castle in Manannan’s Isle of Man with three cranes at his gate whose duty was to warn off travellers, croaking out: ‘Do not enter – keep away – pass by!’ Perseus’s bag must have been a crane-bag, for the crane was sacred to Athene and to Artemis, her counterpart at Ephesus, as well as being the inspiration for Hermes’s invention of letters. The flying Gorgons, then, are cranes with Gorgon-faces,1 and watch over the secrets of the crane-bag, itself protected by a Gorgon head. It is not known what sort of a dance the Crane Dance was that, according to Plutarch, Theseus introduced into Delos except that it was performed around a horned altar and represented the circles that coiled and uncoiled in the Labyrinth. My guess is that it imitated the fluttering love-dance of courting cranes, and that each movement consisted of nine steps and a leap. As Polwart says in his Flyting with Montgomery (1605):
墨丘利的口袋用什么材料制成，可以从平行神话中发现：海神曼纳南·麦克·利尔（Manannan son of Lyr），一位戈伊德尔太阳英雄，芬恩和库丘林的前身，用鹤皮口袋携带大海之宝（即海洋民族的字母秘密）；以及米德尔——一位戈伊德尔冥界神，对应不列颠的阿劳恩（「辩才」），安温之王——住在曼纳南的马恩岛上一座城堡中，门口有三只鹤负责驱赶旅人，嘎嘎叫道：「不得入内——退后——走开！」珀尔修斯的口袋必定是鹤皮袋，因为鹤 sacred 于雅典娜和她在以弗所的对应者阿尔忒弥斯，也是赫尔墨斯发明文字的灵感来源。因此飞翔的戈耳工就是长着戈耳工面孔的鹤¹，守护着鹤皮袋的秘密——鹤皮袋本身由戈耳工头颅保护。据普鲁塔克记载，忒修斯引入提洛岛的鹤舞是何种舞蹈不得而知，只知道它围绕一座有角祭坛表演，代表迷宫中盘绕和展开的圆圈。我的猜测是它模仿鹤求偶时扑翼的舞蹈，每个动作由九步一跳组成。如波尔沃特在其《与蒙哥马利的对骂》（1605）中所说：

The crane must aye
The crane must aye（鹤必须）



Take nine steps ere shee flie.
Take nine steps ere shee flie.（先走九步方才飞起。）





The nine steps prove her sacred to the Triple Goddess; and so does her neck, feathered white and black with reddish skin showing through, or (in the case of the Numidian, or Balearic, crane) with red wattles. Cranes make their spectacular migrations from the Tropic of Cancer to the Arctic Circle and back twice yearly, flying in chevron formation with loud trumpetings at an enormous height; and this must have attached them to the Hyperborean cult as messengers flying to the other world which lies at the back of the North Wind. But Thoth who invented hieroglyphs, was symbolized by the ibis, another wader also sacred to the moon; and the Greeks identified Thoth with Hermes, conductor of souls and messenger of the gods, whom Pherecydes addressed as ‘ibis-shaped’. So Hermes is credited with having invented the alphabet after watching the flight of cranes, and the crane takes on the scholarly attributes of the ibis, which did not visit Greece.
九步证明她 sacred 于三重女神；她的脖子也是——白色和黑色羽毛间透出微红皮肤，或（在努米底亚即巴利阿里鹤的情况下）有红色肉垂。鹤每年两次从北回归线迁徙到北极圈再返回，以 V 字队形在高空大声鸣叫飞行；这必然使她们与极北崇拜联系起来，作为飞往北风背后另一个世界的信使。但发明象形文字的图特以朱鹭为象征，另一种同样 sacred 于月亮的涉禽；希腊人将图特等同于赫尔墨斯——灵魂引导者和众神使者，费雷基德斯称之为「朱鹭形」。因此赫尔墨斯被归功于观察鹤的飞行后发明了字母表，而鹤承担了不访问希腊的朱鹭的学术属性。

A peculiarity of wading birds such as the crane and heron is that, when they have speared a quantity of small fish in a river ready to take home to their young, they arrange them on the bank with the tails set together in the form of a wheel, which was formerly the symbol of the sun, and of the king’s life. This must have astonished the ancients as it astonished me as a boy when I saw a heron doing it in the Nantcoll River in North Wales: but naturalists explain the arrangement as merely intended to make the fish more easily picked up and carried home. In ancient Ireland the association of the crane with literary secrets is suggested by the augury given by its sudden appearance: a cessation of war; for one of the poet’s main functions was to part combatants, and he himself took no part in battle. In Greece the crane was associated with poets not only in the story of Apollo’s metamorphosis into ‘a crane, a Thracian bird’ – meaning the red-wattled Numidian crane which visited the Northern Aegean – but in the story of Ibycus, the sixth-century BC Greek erotic poet who, having spent the best part of his life in the island of Samos, was one day set upon by bandits in a lonely place near Corinth and mortally wounded. He called upon a passing flock of cranes to avenge his death and soon afterwards the cranes hovered over the heads of the audience in the Corinthian open-air theatre; whereupon one of the murderers, who was present, cried out: ‘Look, the avengers of Ibycus!’ He was arrested and made a full confession.
鹤和鹭等涉禽的一个特点是：当它们在河中捕到大量小鱼准备带回去给幼雏时，会将鱼排列在岸上，尾对尾摆成轮状——轮子曾是太阳和王命的象征。这必定使古人惊讶，如同我小时候在北威尔士南特科尔河看到一只鹭这样做时一样惊讶：但博物学家解释这种排列只是为了方便将鱼叼起带回家。在古爱尔兰，鹤的突然出现所给出的占卜暗示了它与文学秘密的联系：战争的停止；因为诗人的主要职能之一是分开战斗者，而诗人本人不参与战斗。在希腊，鹤与诗人的联系不仅见于阿波罗变为「一只鹤，一种色雷斯鸟」——指红肉垂的努米底亚鹤，它访问北爱琴海——的故事中，也见于伊比库斯的故事：公元前六世纪希腊爱情诗人伊比库斯，在萨摩斯岛度过了大半生后，有一天在科林斯附近一个僻静之处遭到强盗袭击而受致命伤。他呼唤一群飞过的鹤为他报仇，不久后鹤群在科林斯露天剧场的观众头顶盘旋；其中一个在场凶手喊道：「看，伊比库斯的复仇者！」他被逮捕并全面招供。

To sum up the historical argument. A Greek alphabet which consisted of thirteen, and later fifteen, consonants and five vowels sacred to the Goddess, and which was ultimately derived from Crete, was current in the Peloponnese before the Trojan War. It was taken to Egypt – though perhaps only to the port of Pharos – and there adapted to Semitic use by Phoenician traders who brought it back into Greece some centuries later when the Dorians had all but destroyed the Mycenaean culture. The characters with their Semitic names were then adapted to the existing Epicharmian system contained in the so-called Pelasgian characters and usually called Cadmean, perhaps because they were current in Boeotian Cadmea. Later, Simonides, a devotee of Dionysus, modified the Cadmean alphabet in conformity with some obscure religious theory.
总结历史论证。一个由十三个、后来十五个辅音和五个 sacred 于女神的元音组成的希腊字母表——最终源自克里特——在特洛伊战争之前已流通于伯罗奔尼撒。它被带到埃及——尽管可能只到了法罗斯港——在那里由腓尼基商人改编为闪语使用，几个世纪后当多里安人几乎摧毁了迈锡尼文明时，他们将之带回希腊。带有闪语名称的字符随后被改编到包含在所谓佩拉斯吉字符中、通常称为卡德摩斯字母的现有厄皮卡穆斯体系中——也许因为这些字符流通于彼奥提亚的卡德摩斯。后来，狄俄尼索斯的信徒西摩尼德斯根据某种晦涩的宗教理论修改了卡德摩斯字母表。

This is a plausible account. The history of the Greek alphabet has come to light in the last few years. It is now known to have originated in Cretan hieroglyphs, which by late Minoan times had been reduced to something between an alphabet and a syllabary of fifty-four signs: only four more than the Sanskrit system allegedly invented by the Goddess Kali, each letter of which was one of the skulls in her necklace. The Mycenaeans borrowed this Cretan system and did their best to adapt it to the needs of Greek. Messrs Ventris and Chadwick, who in 1953 solved the secret of the Mycenaean Linear Script B (1450–1400 BC) found it to consist of about eighty-eight different phonetic signs. It had also been introduced in earlier, more cumbrous, forms into Cyprus, Caria and Lycia. (In the Iliad, VI, 168 ff. occurs the story of how Bellerophon left Argos and handed the King of the Lycians a tablet covered with signs.) From the sixteenth century BC onward three or four attempts were made to simplify the various syllabaries then current in the near East into pure alphabets. The most successful of these was the Phoenician, from which the ‘Cadmean’ Greek characters derive. The Semitic princes of Syria wrote Assyrian cuneiform in their correspondence with the Pharaohs of Egypt until the twelfth century BC, but their merchants had long before been using the Phoenician alphabet, in which one third of the characters was borrowed from the Cretan system – though whether directly from Crete or indirectly through Greece or Asia Minor is doubtful – the remainder from Egyptian hieroglyphs.
这是一个说得通的叙述。希腊字母表的历史在近几年才浮出水面。如今已知它起源于克里特象形文字，到米诺斯晚期已缩减为一种介于字母表和五十四符号音节文字之间的东西：仅比据称为女神迦梨发明的梵语体系多四个符号——后者每个字母都是她项链上的一颗头骨。迈锡尼人借用了这套克里特体系并尽力将其适应希腊语的需要。文特里斯和查德威克先生于1953年破解了迈锡尼线形文字 B（公元前1450–1400年）的秘密，发现它由约八十八个不同的语音符号组成。它还以更早、更笨拙的形式被引入塞浦路斯、卡里亚和吕西亚。（《伊利亚特》VI, 168 以下记载了柏勒洛丰离开阿戈斯后交给吕西亚国王一块写满符号的泥版的故事。）从公元前十六世纪起，人们进行了三四次尝试，将近东当时流通的各种音节文字简化为纯字母表。其中最成功的是腓尼基字母表，「卡德摩斯」希腊字符即由此而来。叙利亚的闪语王公在与埃及法老通信时使用亚述楔形文字直到公元前十二世纪，但他们的商人很久以前就已使用腓尼基字母表——其中三分之一的字符借自克里特体系——尽管是直接从克里特还是间接经希腊或小亚细亚借用尚有疑问——其余的来自埃及象形文字。

There is nothing to show that the Phoenicians invented the principle of reducing a syllabary to letters; and according to Professor Eustace Glotz’s Aegean Civilization the names of such Phoenician characters as are not Semitic names for the objects represented in the corresponding Egyptian hieroglyphs cannot be explained in terms of any Semitic language, while their forms are clearly derived from the Cretan lineal script. The Semites, though good business men, were not an inventive people, and the unexplained names of the letters are therefore likely to be Greek. The Danaan Greeks probably simplified the Cretan syllabary into a sacred alphabet and passed it on to the Phoenicians – though confiding only the abbreviations of the letter-names to them and altering the order of letters so as not to give away the secret religious formula that they spelt out. The earliest Phoenician inscription is on a potsherd found at Bethshemeth in Palestine dating from the sixteenth century BC. The Palaio-Sinaitic and Ras Shamra alphabets may have been composed in emulation of the Phoenician; they were based on cuneiform, not on Cretan or Egyptian hieroglyphs. The Egyptians had been working towards an alphabet concurrently with the Cretans and it is difficult to say who first achieved the task; it was probably the Egyptians.
没有证据表明腓尼基人发明了将音节文字简化为字母的原则；据尤斯塔斯·格洛茨教授的《爱琴文明》，那些腓尼基字符中非闪语名称的字符——即对应的埃及象形文字所表示物体的闪语名称无法解释的——其形式明显源自克里特线形文字。闪语族虽是优秀的商人，却不是发明的民族，因此那些无法解释的字母名称很可能是希腊语。达南希腊人可能将克里特音节文字简化为一套神圣字母表并将其传给腓尼基人——但只向他们透露了字母名称的缩写，并打乱了字母顺序，以免泄露它们拼出的秘密宗教公式。最早的腓尼基铭文是在巴勒斯坦贝特舍梅什发现的一块公元前十六世纪的陶片。古西奈和拉斯沙姆拉字母表可能是仿照腓尼基字母表编制的；它们基于楔形文字，而非克里特或埃及象形文字。埃及人与克里特人同时一直在朝字母表方向努力，很难说谁先完成了这一任务；可能是埃及人。

Now it is remarkable that the names of several letters in the Irish Beth-Luis-Nion correspond more exactly with their counterparts in the Hebrew alphabet, which is Phoenician, than with their Classical Greek counterparts.
