That I may blind him in his hour of joy.（使我在他欢乐之时致盲他。）





For the mistletoe, the berries of which were formerly prized both as an allheal and as an aphrodisiac, is not a tree in the sense that it grows in the earth; it subsists on other trees. There are two sorts of mistletoe, the mistletoe proper and the loranthus. The Greeks distinguished them as, respectively, hypear and ixos or ixias. The loranthus is found in Eastern Europe, but not in Western and, unlike mistletoe proper, grows on oaks. It also grows on tamarisks, and its flame-coloured leaves may have been the original ‘burning bush’ from which Jehovah appeared to Moses. Whether the loranthus was once native to Western Europe, or whether the Celtic Druids brought it with them from the Danube area where their religion was first formulated, or whether they grafted mistletoe proper from poplar, apple, or other host-trees, on their oaks, cannot be determined. It is most likely that they grafted it, to judge from the insistence in Norse myth on oak-mistletoe. Virgil notes that the mistletoe is the only tree that leafs freshly in wintry weather. Its colours are white, green and gold like the pillars and lintel shown to Herodotus in the ancient temple of Hercules at Tyre. On midsummer day, in ancient Europe, the Eye of the year was blinded with a mistletoe stake, all the other trees (according to the Norse legend) having refused to do so. The Church now admits holly and ivy as reputable church decorations at Christmas, but forbids the mistletoe as pagan. However, mistletoe cannot be ousted from its sovereignty of Midwinter, and the exchange of kisses forbidden at all other seasons is still permitted under its bough, if it has berries on it. Chemists have tried to learn how mistletoe won the name ‘all-heal’, by analyzing its alkaloids. They can find none of any curative virtue, though this is not final proof of the mistletoe’s medicinal valuelessness. Camomile, for example, has medicinal properties, but no extractable alkaloid. A plant is rarely awarded mystic virtue unless it has some property beneficial to man. Yet the spectacle of green leaves and white berries on an otherwise bare tree may have been sufficiently odd to invest mistletoe with supernatural powers. The wood, by the way, is extremely hard and tough, mistletoe being slow-growing; Haedur’s mistletoe spear which pierced Balder’s gentle breast in the legend was no poetic fancy – I once cut one for myself in Brittany.
因为槲寄生——其浆果昔日既被珍视为万灵药也被视为催情剂——就其生长在土地中而言并非一棵树；它寄生在其他树上。槲寄生有两种：正槲寄生和桑寄生。希腊人分别称之为 hypear 和 ixos 或 ixias。桑寄生见于东欧但不见于西欧，与正槲寄生不同，它生长在橡树上。它也生长在柽柳上，其火焰色的叶子可能就是耶和华向摩西显现的原始「燃烧荆棘」。桑寄生是否曾经原产于西欧，或凯尔特德鲁伊是否从其宗教最初形成的多瑙河地区带来了它，或他们是否将正槲寄生从杨树、苹果或其他寄主树上嫁接到橡树上，无法确定。最可能的是他们进行了嫁接——从北欧神话对橡树槲寄生的坚持来看。维吉尔指出槲寄生是唯一在冬季长出新叶的树。它的颜色是白、绿和金，如同希罗多德在提尔古老的赫拉克勒斯神庙中所见的柱和楣。在仲夏日，古代欧洲的年之眼被一根槲寄生桩致盲——所有其他树（据北欧传说）都拒绝这样做。教会如今承认冬青和常春藤是圣诞节合法的教堂装饰，但禁止槲寄生为异教之物。然而，槲寄生无法被逐出其冬至主权地位，在其他季节被禁止的接吻仍允许在其枝下进行——如果上面有浆果的话。化学家们试图通过分析其生物碱来了解槲寄生如何赢得「万灵」之名。他们找不到任何有治疗价值的生物碱，尽管这并非槲寄生药用无价值的最终证明。例如甘菊有药用特性但无可提取生物碱。一种植物很少被赋予神秘力量，除非它有某种有益于人的特性。然而，在一棵光秃秃的树上看到绿叶和白浆果的奇观可能已足够使槲寄生获得超自然力量。顺便说一句，槲寄生的木质极为坚硬——因为槲寄生生长缓慢；传说中黑瑟尔的槲寄生矛刺穿了巴尔德尔温柔的心胸——这不是诗意幻想——我在布列塔尼曾为自己削过一根。

This calendar explains the reference in Gwion’s Preiddeu Annwm to the ‘ox with seven-score knobs on his collar’: the ox is the first flight of five months, consisting of 140 days; it is presumably followed by a lion of one hundred and twelve days, and a serpent of the same length, to justify the two texts already quoted (in Chapter Eight) from Euripides and the Welsh poet Cynddelw – both appealing to the God of the year to appear as a wild bull, a fire-breathing lion and a many-headed snake. The griffon-eagle must be the creature of the extra day, since the god becomes immortal in this form. This year of Bull, Lion, Serpent and Eagle is Babylonian: the calendar beast, called Sir-rush on the Dragon Gate at Babylon having the body and horns of a bull, forelegs and mane of a lion, head scales and tail of a serpent, hindlegs and feet of an eagle. The calendar has several secret qualities. One is that the number of vowels is increased to seven, the Roebuck’s own number. Another is that II in Ogham makes a ten-stroke letter, and AA makes a two-stroke letter: thus the aggregate number of letter-strokes for the complete twenty-two letter alphabet is 72, a number constantly recurring in early myth and ritual; for 72 is the multiple of the nine, the number of lunar wisdom, and eight the number of solar increase.1 72, Mr. Clyde Stacey suggests, is also linked to the Goddess, astronomically, by the seventy-two-day season during which her planet Venus moves successively from maximum eastern elongation to inferior conjunction (closest approach to earth) and thence to maximum west elongation. A third quality is that the proportion of all the letters in the alphabet to the vowels is 22 to 7, which, as has already been mentioned, is the mathematical formula, once secret, for the relation of the circumference of the circle to the diameter.
这个历法解释了格维翁《安温的战利品》中对「颈圈上有七道二十个瘤的公牛」的指涉：公牛是第一组五个月，共 140 天；大概后面跟着一头 112 天的狮子和一条同样长度的蛇，以印证第八章引用的欧里庇得斯和威尔士诗人辛德尔的文本——两者都呼吁年之神以野牛、喷火狮子和多头蛇的形态出现。狮鹫-鹰必定是额外日之兽，因为神以此形态获得不朽。这牛、狮、蛇、鹰之年是巴比伦的：巴比伦龙门上的历法之兽称为 Sir-rush，具有公牛的身体和角、狮子的前腿和鬃毛、蛇的头鳞和尾巴、鹰的后腿和爪。这个历法有几个秘密特性。一是元音数量增至七个——獐鹿的本数。另一个是在欧甘文中 II 构成十笔字母，AA 构成两笔字母：因此完整二十二字母表的总笔画数为 72——这个数字在早期神话和仪式中反复出现；因为 72 是九（月亮智慧之数）和八（太阳增长之数）的乘积。¹ 克莱德·斯塔西先生建议，72 在天文学上也与女神相关——她的行星金星从最大东大距依次运行到下合（最接近地球）再到最大西大距，恰好七十二天。第三个特性是字母表中所有字母与元音的比例为 22 比 7——如前所述，这是圆周与直径关系的曾经秘密的数学公式。

Before examining the fourth and, for our purpose, the most important quality of this calendar, the poetic relation between Hazel and Apple must be considered. It has now been established that the Roebuck, originally a White Hind, hides in the thicket, and that the thicket is composed of twenty-two sacred trees. The poet naturally asks a further question: ‘But where exactly is the beast lodged in the grove?’
在考察这个历法第四个也是对我们的目的最重要的特性之前，必须考虑榛树与苹果之间的诗性关系。现在已经确立，獐鹿——原为白牝鹿——藏在灌丛中，而灌丛由二十二棵神圣的树组成。诗人自然要进一步问：「但兽究竟藏在树林中的何处？」

‘Where?’ is the question that should always weigh most heavily with poets who are burdened with the single poetic Theme of life and death. As Professor Ifor Williams has pointed out, it is because the cuckoo utters its ‘Where?’ so constantly that it is represented in early Welsh poetry as a kill-joy: for ‘cw-cw’, pronounced ‘ku-ku’ means ‘where? where?’. It cries: ‘Where is my love gone? Where are my lost companions?’ Curiously enough, the same sentiment occurs in Omar Khayyam’s elegy where the ‘solitary ring-dove’ broods in the ruined palace crying: ‘Ku? Ku? Ku? Ku?’ – the Iranian for ‘where’ being the same as Welsh; and in Greek myth Tereus the hoopoe cries ‘Pou? Pou?’ for his lost brides. ‘Where’ in English is derived, according to the Oxford English Dictionary, ‘from the interrogative stem qua’. Nearly all interrogatives in Indo-European languages begin with Q (except where Q has been, as in Greek, changed into a P or, as in German, into a W), and in Old Scots ‘where’ is spelt ‘Quhair’. Q, in fact, is the letter of perpetual question. Latin has a fine range of Q’s:
「何处？」是背负生死这一单一诗性主题的诗人最应沉重对待的问题。如伊弗·威廉姆斯教授所指出的，正是因为杜鹃不断发出「何处？」的叫声，它在早期威尔士诗歌中被表现为扫兴者：因为「cw-cw」发音「ku-ku」意为「何处？何处？」。它叫道：「我的爱人在哪里？我失去的同伴在哪里？」奇怪的是，同样的情感出现在奥玛·海亚姆的挽歌中——「孤鸽」在废墟宫殿中哀鸣：「Ku? Ku? Ku? Ku?」——伊朗语的「何处」与威尔士语相同；而希腊神话中戴胜鸟忒瑞斯也为失去的新娘喊「Pou? Pou?」。据《牛津英语词典》，英语中的「where」源自「疑问词干 qua」。几乎所有印欧语言的疑问词都以 Q 开头（除非 Q 如在希腊语中变为 P，或在德语中变为 W），在古苏格兰语中「where」拼为「Quhair」。Q 事实上是永恒之问的字母。拉丁语有一系列以 Q 开头的疑问词：

Quare? Quis? Qua? Quid? Qualis? Qui? Quo? Quomodo? Quando? Quorsum? Quoties? Quantum? Quot?





And the Serpent’s dangerous question Quidni? ‘Why not?’ ‘Where?’ is ‘Quă?’
而蛇的危险之问是 Quidni?——「为何不？」「何处？」是「Quă?」

But the Muse’s promise to the poet is ‘Seek patiently, and you shall find’, so where else should the Wild Hind be hiding except under the Q tree, which is the Wild Apple?
但缪斯对诗人的承诺是「耐心寻找，你将发现」，那么除了在 Q 树即野苹果树下，野牝鹿还能藏在哪里？

Valentin Iremonger, the poet, has confirmed this for me in the Hearings of the Scholars:
瓦伦丁·艾尔蒙格——诗人——在《学者听闻录》中为我确认了这一点：

Queirt dano is o chrand regainmnighead .i. abull ut dicitur clithar boascille .i. elit glet quert .i. aball.





‘The letter Q is from a tree named Quert, that is to say, an apple tree. As the saying is: “Quert is the shelter of the wild hind” – meaning that the apple tree is so.’ An interesting poetic gloss on ‘shelter of the wild hind’ occurs in the same book:
「字母 Q 来自一棵名为奎尔特的树，即苹果树。如谚语所说：『奎尔特是野牝鹿的庇护所』——即苹果树。」同一本书中有一个有趣的诗性注释「野牝鹿的庇护所」：

.i. boscell .i. gelt basceall .i. is and tic a ciall do in tan degas a bas





‘that is to say, of the boscell, lunatic, the word being derived from basceall, “death-sense”, for a lunatic’s wits come to him when he goes to his death.’
「即是说，boscell，疯子，该词源自 basceall，『死感』，因为疯子的智慧在他赴死之时才来到。」

The comment means that love of the Goddess makes the poet mad: he goes to his death and in death is made wise.
注释的意思是对女神的爱使诗人疯狂：他赴死，在死亡中获得智慧。

Quert is not only one of the ‘seven noble sacred trees of the grove’ but is recorded in the Trials of Ireland as being, with Coll, the Hazel, one of the only two sacred trees for the wanton felling of which death is exacted. The apple in European literature and folklore is the symbol of consummation, as the egg is of initiation. The 112 days of the Lion flight of months in the Beth-Luis-Nion run ab ovo usque ad malum, from egg to apple, from the end of Saille, the nesting month, to the end of Quert, the apple month. Thus when the Biblical legend of Adam and Eve reached North-Western Europe, the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil was understood as an apple – not as a fig, despite the fig-leaf context. Adam had eaten from the forbidden tree of intelligence given him by Eve, ‘the Mother of All Living’, and the bards therefore translated ‘fruit’ as ‘apple’.
奎尔特不仅是「树林中七棵高贵神圣之树」之一，而且在《爱尔兰审判》中被记录为与科尔（Coll，榛树）并列的仅有的两棵因擅自砍伐而被处死的神圣树。苹果在欧洲文学和民间传说中是圆满的象征，如同蛋是入教的象征。贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中狮子组月份的 112 天从蛋到苹果——ab ovo usque ad malum——从赛尔（筑巢月）结束到奎尔特（苹果月）结束。因此当亚当和夏娃的《圣经》传说传到西北欧时，善恶知识树的果实被理解为苹果——而非无花果，尽管有无花果叶的上下文。亚当吃了「众生之母」夏娃给他的被禁的智慧之树上的果实，因此吟游诗人将「果实」译为「苹果」。

The seven noble sacred trees of the grove particularized in a seventh-century poem appended to the ancient Irish Law Crith Gablach were: birch, alder, willow, oak, holly, hazel, apple. Except that Beth, the birch, the lucky tree of the birth-month, takes the place of Huath, the unlucky whitethorn, the trees run in a clear sequence from the Spring equinox to the end of the apple harvest. The Birch is mentioned as ‘very noble’ in Gwion’s Câd Goddeu, but the apple-tree was the noblest tree of all, being the tree of immortality. The poets of Wales have always been aware of its spiritual pre-eminence, and the lovely mediaeval Afalleneu:
附在古爱尔兰法《克里特·加布拉赫》之后的七世纪诗歌中列举的树林七棵高贵神圣之树是：白桦、桤木、柳树、橡树、冬青、榛树、苹果。除了贝斯（白桦，诞生月的幸运之树）取代了厄阿斯（Huath，不祥的山楂）之外，这些树从春分到苹果收获结束构成了一个清晰的序列。白桦在格维翁的《树木之战》中被提及为「极高贵」，但苹果树是最高贵的树——不朽之树。威尔士诗人一直意识到它的精神至高地位，而可爱的中世纪《阿法莱纽》诗：

Sweet apple-tree crimson in hue
Sweet apple-tree crimson in hue（甘美苹果树，色如丹霞）



Which grows concealed in Forest Celyddon….
Which grows concealed in Forest Celyddon….（隐于凯利顿森林之中……）





is not a poem about the orchard apple-tree but about the apple-tree of the sacred thicket, the tree that is the harbourage of the hind. As Gwion writes: ‘I fled as a roe to the entangled thicket.’
不是一首关于果园苹果树的诗，而是关于神圣灌丛中的苹果树——那是牝鹿的栖息之树。如格维翁所写：「我曾以獐鹿之身逃入纠缠的灌丛。」

Where did King Arthur go to be healed of his grievous wounds? To the Isle of Avalon, the secret ‘island of apple-trees’. With what talisman was Bran summoned by the White Goddess to enter the Land of Youth? With ‘a silver white-blossomed apple branch from Emain in which the bloom and branch were one’. The island of Emain, the Goidelic Elysium, is described thus in a poem by Ragnall, son of Godfrey, King of the Isles:
亚瑟王去哪里治愈他的重伤？去阿瓦隆岛——秘密的「苹果树之岛」。白女神用什么信物召唤布兰进入青春之地？「一根来自埃曼的银色白花苹果枝，花与枝合为一体」。埃曼岛——戈伊德尔语的极乐世界——在群岛之王戈弗雷之子拉格纳尔的诗中如此描述：

An amaranthine place is faery Emain:
An amaranthine place is faery Emain:（仙岛埃曼是不朽之地：）



Beauteous is the land where it is found,
Beauteous is the land where it is found,（其所在之地美不胜收，）



Lovely its rath above all other raths.
Lovely its rath above all other raths.（其环形堡垒胜过一切堡垒。）



Plentiful apple-trees grow from that ground.
Plentiful apple-trees grow from that ground.（那片土地上苹果树茂盛生长。）





Oisin, when taken to the same Land of Youth by Niamh of the Golden Hair, sees his weird first as a hornless fawn pursued by a red-eared white hound, but then in his own shape royally dressed and mounted on a white horse in pursuit of a beautiful girl on a dark horse; in her hand is a golden apple. Both apparitions are skimming over the calm sea; he does not recognize their meaning and Niamh gently evades his questions about them. It has been suggested in a footnote to Chapter Twelve that the Goddess of the sepulchral island of Alyscamps, in the Rhône, was named Alys and that the alder, aliso in Spanish, was named after her. Dauzat in his Dictionnaire Étymologique connects alisier, the service-tree, with aliso, the alder which screened these sepulchral islands. The same resemblance is found between the Scandinavian and North-German els or elze (service-tree) and else (alder); and the name Alys seems to be recorded in the Ilse, the stream that runs from the Brocken to the Oker, where a princess Ilse was once drowned. Since the fruit of the service-tree (both the Mediterranean and Northern varieties) is a sort of sorb-apple, it is likely that this was the apple of immortality in pre-Christian France, Spain and Scandinavia. If so, the Elysian Fields, or Alyscamps, would have the same meaning as Avalon: apple-orchards. The sorb emblemizes ‘from corruption, sweetness’: it cannot be eaten until it has rotted to a corpse-like purple-brown. Perhaps this is why the tree is mentioned in The Hearings of the Scholars as a euphemism for yew, the death-tree; though the explanation there given is that both bore the name ‘oldest of woods’; ‘oldest’, as applied to the service-tree, could mean only ‘of most ancient fame’, because it is not particularly long-lived.
莪辛被金发尼芙带到同一青春之地时，首先看到他的异象为一只被红耳白犬追逐的无角幼鹿，然后是他自己的形象——身着华服骑白马追逐一位骑黑马的美丽少女；她手中持一枚金苹果。两个异象都在平静的海面上掠过；他不认识其含义，尼芙温柔地回避了他关于这些的问题。在第十二章脚注中曾建议，罗讷河上墓葬岛阿利斯康普的女神名为阿利斯（Alys），而桤木——西班牙语 aliso——以她命名。多扎在其《词源词典》中将花楸树（alisier）与屏蔽这些墓葬岛的桤木（aliso）联系起来。斯堪的纳维亚和北德的 els 或 elze（花楸树）与 else（桤木）之间也有同样的相似；阿利斯之名似乎记录在伊尔泽——从布罗肯山流向奥克河的溪流——中，一位伊尔泽公主曾在那里溺亡。由于花楸树（地中海和北方品种皆是）的果实是一种 sorb-apple（山楸果），很可能这就是前基督教时代法国、西班牙和斯堪的纳维亚的不朽之苹果。如果是这样，极乐世界即阿利斯康普将与阿瓦隆有相同含义：苹果园。山楸果象征「从腐朽中，甜蜜」：它必须腐烂成尸体般的紫褐色才能食用。也许这就是为什么在《学者听闻录》中该树被用作紫杉——死亡之树——的委婉说法；尽管那里给出的解释是两者都被称为「最古老的木材」；「最古老」用于花楸树只能意为「最古老的名望」，因为它并不特别长寿。

Mr. Kenneth Dutfield in a recent letter to the Times Literary Supplement plausibly suggests that Avernus, the abode of the dead, which the Latins incorrectly derived from the Greek a-ornis, ‘birdless’, is the same word as Avalon; which would identify the Elysian Fields with Avernus. Lake Avernus near Cumae apparently won on its nickname from the unhealthy airs of the surrounding marshes and from the near-by shrine of the Cumaean Sybil who conjured up the spirits of the dead.
肯尼思·达特菲尔德先生在最近致《泰晤士报文学增刊》的信中合理地建议，阿佛纳斯——死者居所，拉丁人错误地从希腊语 a-ornis（「无鸟的」）推导——与 Avalon 是同一个词；这将把极乐世界与阿佛纳斯等同。库迈附近的阿佛纳斯湖显然因其周围沼泽的不健康空气和附近库迈女巫召唤死者灵魂的神殿而得名。

On August 13th, the pre-Christian feast of the Mother Goddess Diana, or Vesta, was once celebrated with cyder, a roasted kid spitted on hazel-twigs and apples hanging in clusters from a bough. Another name of this Goddess was Nemesis (from the Greek nemos, ‘grove’) which in Classical Greek connotes divine vengeance for breaches of taboo. In her statues she carries an apple-bough in one hand, and the fifth-century Christian poet Commodianus identifies her with Diana Nemorensis (‘of the grove’) whose followers ‘worship a cut branch and call a log Diana’. But both Nemesis and Diana Nemorensis are associated with the deer, not the goat, cult. Nemesis carries a wheel in her other hand to show that she is the goddess of the turning year, like Egyptian Isis and Latin Fortuna, but this has been generally understood as meaning that the wheel will one day come full circle and vengeance be exacted on the sinner.1 In Gaul she was Diana Nemetona, nemeton being a sacred grove; and was represented with an apple-bough, a cyder-bowl with Aethiopians on it, and a lion-eagle griffin to denote the season of her feast. This feast was converted in the Middle Ages into that of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin (August 15th) which, because of the seventeenth-century calendar changes (referred to in the hawthorn context), means August 6th, the beginning of Quert. The Virgin is believed to have died on August 13th, to have risen again and ascended to Heaven on the third day. Since the Virgin was closely associated by the early Church with Wisdom – with the Saint ‘Sophia’, or Holy Wisdom, of the Cathedral Church at Constantinople – the choice of this feast for the passing of Wisdom into Immortality was a happy one.
八月十三日，前基督教时代的母女神戴安娜即维斯塔的节日，曾以苹果酒、用榛枝串烤的山羊羔和成串挂在树枝上的苹果来庆祝。这位女神的另一个名字是涅墨西斯（源自希腊语 nemos，「树林」），在古典希腊语中指对违反禁忌的神圣报复。在她的雕像中，她一手持苹果枝，五世纪基督教诗人科莫迪安努斯将她等同于戴安娜·内莫伦西斯（「林中之」戴安娜），其追随者「崇拜一根砍下的树枝，称一块木头为戴安娜」。但涅墨西斯和戴安娜·内莫伦西斯都与鹿崇拜而非山羊崇拜相关。涅墨西斯另一手持一只轮，表示她是流转之年的女神，如同埃及伊西斯和拉丁福尔图娜，但这通常被理解为轮子终将转满一圈，罪人将受报复。¹ 在高卢她是戴安娜·内梅托纳，nemeton 意为神圣树林；以苹果枝、绘有埃塞俄比亚人的苹果酒碗和狮鹫为标志，表示她的节日季节。这个节日在中世纪被转化为圣母升天节（八月十五日），由于十七世纪的历法变更（在山楂上下文中提及），实际为八月六日即奎尔特之始。圣母据信于八月十三日去世，第三日复活升天。由于圣母在早期教会中与智慧——君士坦丁堡大教堂的「圣索菲亚」即圣智——密切相关，选择此节日作为智慧进入不朽的时机是恰当的。

The Litany of the Blessed Virgin contains the prayer Sedes sapientiae, ora pro nobis, ‘Seat of Wisdom, pray for us!’ For St. Peter Chrysologos in his Sermon on the Annunciation had represented the Virgin as the seven-pillared temple which Wisdom (according to Proverbs, IX, 10) had built for herself. So the meaning of the mediaeval allegory about the milk-white unicorn which could be captured only with the assistance of a pure virgin is now easily read. The Unicorn is the Roe in the Thicket. It lodges under an apple-tree, the tree of immortality-through-wisdom. It can be captured only by a pure virgin – Wisdom herself. The purity of the virgin stands for spiritual integrity. The unicorn lays its head on her lap and weeps for joy. But the Provençal version of the story is that the beast nuzzles to her breasts and attempts other familiarities, whereupon the virgin gently grasps him by the horn and leads him away to the hunters: here he is, in fact, a type of profane love rejected by spiritual love.
圣母连祷包含祈祷 Sedes sapientiae, ora pro nobis——「智慧之座，为我等祈！」因为圣彼得·克里索洛古斯在《圣母领报讲道》中将圣母表现为智慧（据《箴言》IX, 10）为自己建造的七柱殿堂。因此，关于乳白独角兽只有在纯贞女协助下才能被捕获的中世纪寓言，其含义现在容易读懂了。独角兽就是灌丛中的獐鹿。它栖息在苹果树下——通过智慧获得不朽之树。它只能被一位纯贞女——智慧本身——捕获。贞女的纯洁代表精神完整。独角兽将头放在她膝上，喜极而泣。但普罗旺斯版本的故事说，野兽蹭向她的乳房并试图其他亲昵，于是贞女轻轻握住它的角，将它引向猎人：在这里它实际上是凡俗之爱被精神之爱拒绝的类型。

The unicorn’s wildness and untameability had become proverbial in early Christian times because of the text in Job, XXXIX, 9:
独角兽的野性和不可驯服在早期基督教时代已成为谚语，因为《约伯记》XXXIX, 9 的经文：

Will the unicorn be able to serve thee or abide by thy crib?
Will the unicorn be able to serve thee or abide by thy crib?（独角兽岂肯服事你？岂肯住在你的槽旁？）





and this Biblical unicorn, (a mistranslation by the Septuagint1 of rem, the Judaean aurochs or wild ox) became identified with the goat-stag, the hirco-cervus of Dionysian mysteries, which was another wild untameable animal. Charles Doughty in his Arabia Deserta suggests that the rem is not the aurochs but a large, very dangerous antelope called wothyhi or ‘wild ox’ by the Arabs. He is likely to be right; and I take the wothyhi to be the boubalis or boibalis, ‘an oryx the size of an ox’, mentioned by Herodotus (Melpomene, 192), and also by Martial, as a fierce beast used in the Roman amphitheatre. Doughty writes: ‘Her horns are such slender rods as from our childhood we have seen pictured “the horns of the unicorn”. We read in Balaam’s parable: “El brought them out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the reem”; and in Moses’s blessing of the tribes Joseph’s horns are the two horns of reems.’ Doughty illustrates this with a sketch of a wothyhi’s horn, nearly two feet long and somewhat curved, with raised rings at the base. He adds: ‘It was a monkish darkness in natural knowledge to ascribe a single horn to a double forehead.’ This is unfair on the monks: it was the pre-Christian Septuagint who had first given the rem a single horn. And it is possible that they translated rem as ‘unicorn’ from a misunderstanding of an icon in the margin of an illustrated Hebrew Pentateuch – such there were. In the context of Moses’s blessing, Joseph ‘with the horns of a rem’ would naturally have been depicted in the persons of his two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, jointly called ‘Joseph’, as twin rems with only one horn apiece. The single horn, emphasized by its double occurrence, would suggest to the translators the beast described by Ctesias in his Indica. The horn was a cure-all and especially good against poison.
而《圣经》中的这只独角兽（七十士译本¹对 re'em——犹地亚原牛即野牛的误译）后来与山羊-鹿即狄俄尼索斯密仪中的 hirco-cervus——另一种野性不可驯服的动物——等同。查尔斯·道蒂在其《阿拉伯沙漠》中建议 re'em 不是原牛而是一种大型、非常危险的羚羊，阿拉伯人称之为 wothyhi 即「野牛」。他可能是对的；我认为 wothyhi 就是希罗多德（《梅尔波梅涅》192）提到的 boubalis 或 boibalis——「一种牛大的角马」，马夏尔也提到它作为罗马角斗场中使用的猛兽。道蒂写道：「她的角如此细长，正如我们自幼在图画中看到的『独角兽的角』。我们在巴兰的比喻中读到：『El 将他们从埃及带出；他有如 re'em 的力量』；在摩西对各支派的祝福中，约瑟的角是 re'm 的两只角。」道蒂以 wothyhi 角的素描加以说明——近两英尺长，略弯曲，基部有突起环纹。他补充道：「将一只角归于双额是修道士在自然知识方面的黑暗。」这对修道士不公平：是前基督教的七十士译本首先给了 re'm 一只角。他们可能从对一部插图版希伯来五经页边图标的误解中将 re'm 译为「独角兽」——这样的五经是存在的。在摩西祝福的上下文中，「有 re'm 之角的约瑟」自然被描绘为其二子以法莲和玛拿西——合称「约瑟」——各自只有一角的孪生 re'm。被双重出现所强调的单角，会使译者想到克特西亚斯在《印度志》中描述的野兽。那角是万灵药，尤善解毒。

The connexion of the apple-tree with immortality is ancient and widespread in Europe. What does ‘apple’ mean? According to the Oxford English Dictionary its etymology is unknown, but the word runs Northwestward across Europe all the way from the Balkans to Ireland in a form approximating in most languages to Apol.
苹果树与不朽的联系在欧洲古老而广泛。「苹果」是什么意思？据《牛津英语词典》，其词源不明，但该词从巴尔干到爱尔兰横跨欧洲西北方向，在大多数语言中以近似 Apol 的形式出现。

It is clear that the ancient icon of the Three Goddesses, the apple and the young shepherd of Ida, which has been iconotropically interpreted by some early enemy of women in the story of the ‘Apple of Discord’ (how Paris adjudicated the apple to the Love-goddess) had an entirely different meaning. To award an apple to the Love-goddess would have been an impertinence on the Shepherd’s part. All apples were hers. Did Merddin present Olwen with the apple orchard? Did Adam give the Mother of All Living an apple?1 Obviously the three Goddesses are, as usual, the three persons of the ancient Triple Goddess, not jealous rivals, and obviously the Love-goddess is giving the apple to the Shepherd (or goatherd), not receiving it from him. It is the apple of immortality and he is the young Dionysus – the god commemorated by the kid stuffed with apples; for according to Hesychius and Stephanus of Byzantium one of Dionysus’s titles was Eriphos, ‘the Kid’. Virgil has expressed the wrong notion in his Georgics: he says that the kid spitted on hazel is sacrificed to Dionysus because the goat and the hazel-tree are both inimical to the vine. Whether the word Apol is a chance approximation to Apollo, who is the immortal part of Dionysus, or whether the apple is named after him, is a doubtful point. But it is remarkable that in Greece the words for ‘goat’ (or sheep) and ‘apple’ are identical (mēlŏn) – the Latin is mãlum. Hercules, who combined Dionysus and Apollo in a single person, was called Mēlon because apples were offered to him by his worshippers; and because he was given the bough with the golden apples by the Three Daughters of the West – the Triple Goddess again; it was these apples that made him immortal. The conclusion of the story of the Apple of Discord, that the Shepherd won Helen as a reward for his judgement, evidently derives from a companion icon to the ‘Judgement’, showing a young Shepherd hand in hand with Helen. But Helen was not a mortal woman; she was Helle, or Persephone, a Goddess of Death and Resurrection. Hercules, Theseus, Castor and Pollux, were all depicted in her company in archaic works of art.
显然，三位女神、苹果和伊达的年轻牧羊人——这一古代圣像被某个早期厌女敌人以圣像倒置法解释为「不和之苹果」的故事（帕里斯如何将苹果判给爱神）——具有完全不同的含义。将苹果判给爱神对牧羊人而言是僭越。所有苹果都是她的。默丁丁是否将苹果园赠予了奥尔温？亚当是否将苹果给了「众生之母」？¹ 显然，三位女神一如既往是古代三重女神的三位一体，而非嫉妒的竞争者；显然，爱神是在将苹果赐予牧羊人（或牧羊人），而非从他手中接收。这是不朽之苹果，而他是年轻的狄俄尼索斯——那只塞满苹果的山羊羔所纪念的神；因为据赫西基乌斯和拜占庭的斯蒂芬努斯记载，狄俄尼索斯的称号之一是 Eriphos，「山羊羔」。维吉尔在《农事诗》中表达了错误的观念：他说用榛枝串烤的山羊羔献祭给狄俄尼索斯是因为山羊和榛树都与葡萄藤为敌。Apol 这个词是否碰巧近似阿波罗——他是狄俄尼索斯的不朽部分——还是苹果以他命名，是一个可疑的问题。但值得注意的是，在希腊语中「山羊」（或羊）和「苹果」是同一个词（mēlŏn）——拉丁语是 mãlum。赫拉克勒斯——将狄俄尼索斯和阿波罗合为一体——被称为 Mēlon，因为他的崇拜者向他献苹果；也因为他从西方三女——又是三重女神——那里获得了金苹果枝；正是这些苹果使他不朽。不和之苹果故事的结局——牧羊人因裁判获得海伦为奖赏——显然来自与「裁判」配套的另一幅圣像，画中年轻牧羊人与海伦手牵手。但海伦并非凡人女子；她是赫勒（Helle）即珀耳塞福涅，死亡与复活的女神。赫拉克勒斯、忒修斯、卡斯托尔和波鲁克斯都在古代艺术作品中被描绘为与她同行。

Though the apple was the most palatable of wild fruits growing on trees, why should it have been given such immense mythic importance? The clue is to be found in the legend of Curoi’s soul that was hidden in an apple; when the apple was cut across by Cuchulain’s sword ‘night fell upon Curoi’. For if an apple is halved cross-wise each half shows a five-pointed star in the centre, emblem of immortality, which represents the Goddess in her five stations from birth to death and back to birth again. It also represents the planet of Venus – Venus to whom the apple was sacred – adored as Hesper the evening star on one half of the apple, and as Lucifer Son of the Morning on the other.
虽然苹果是生长在树上的最美味的野果，但为何被赋予如此巨大的神话重要性？线索在库罗伊的灵魂藏在一颗苹果中的传说中：当库丘林的剑横切那颗苹果时，「黑夜降临在库罗伊身上」。因为如果将苹果横切，每半都会在中心显示一个五角星——不朽的象征，代表女神从诞生到死亡再到诞生的五个站点。它也代表金星——苹果 sacred 于金星——在苹果的一半上被崇拜为赫斯珀即昏星，在另一半上被崇拜为路西法即晨星之子。

The apple of the Thracian Orphic cult seems to have been the sorb rather than the quince, the crab, or the true apple, because Orpheus, whose name and singing head identify him with Bran the alder-god, is called the son of Oeagrius; Oea Agria means ‘the wild service-tree’.
色雷斯俄耳甫斯崇拜的苹果似乎不是榅桲、野苹果或真正的苹果，而是山楸果，因为俄耳甫斯——其名字和歌唱的头颅将他等同于桤木之神布兰——被称为俄阿格里乌斯之子；Oea Agria 意为「野花楸树」。

1 The obsession of the Orphic mystics, from whom the Pythagoreans derived their main doctrines, with sacred numbers is remarked upon by Iamblichus in his life of Pythagoras: ‘Orpheus said that the eternal essence of number is the most providential principle of the universe, of heaven, of earth, and of the nature intermediate to these; and more, that it is the basis of the permanency of divine natures, gods and demons.’ The Pythagoreans had a proverb ‘all things are assimilated to number’, and Pythagoras is quoted by Iamblichus as having laid down in his Sacred Discourse that ‘number is the ruler of forms and ideas, and the cause of gods and demons’. The numbers 8 and 9 were favourite objects of Pythagorean adoration.
¹ 俄耳甫斯密仪信徒——毕达哥拉斯派的主要教义即源自他们——对神圣数字的痴迷，扬布里科斯在其《毕达哥拉斯传》中有所论述：「俄耳甫斯说，数字的永恒本质是宇宙、天、地及其间一切自然的最具先见之明的原则；更重要的是，它是神圣本性、神和魔之永恒性的基础。」毕达哥拉斯派有一句谚语「万物皆归于数」，扬布里科斯引述毕达哥拉斯在《神圣论》中的规定：「数字是形式和理念的统治者，是神和魔的原因。」数字 8 和 9 是毕达哥拉斯派崇拜的首选对象。



1 The oracular Wheels of Fortune, worked by a rope, still found in a few early Continental churches, derive from the golden iynges (literally ‘wrynecks’) which were oracular wheels, originally sacred to the White Goddess, that decorated, among others, the temple of Apollo at Delphi. Philostratus in his Life of Apollonius connects them with similar wheels used by the Mages of Babylon, and they also occurred in Egyptian temples of the 3rd century BC. The celebrated Irish Druid Mogh Ruith of Kerry (according to the Cóir Anmann) ‘derived his name, which signifies Magis Rotarum, “the wizard of the wheels”, from the wheels by which he used to make his magic observations’. In O’Grady’s Silva Gadelica there is an account of Mogh Ruith’s daughter who went with him to the East to learn magic, and there made a ‘rowing wheel’.
¹ 由绳索操纵的神谕命运之轮——在少数早期大陆教堂中仍有发现——源自金色的 iynges（字面意为「歪脖鸟」），即最初 sacred 于白女神的神谕之轮，曾装饰德尔斐阿波罗神庙等地。斐洛斯特拉图斯在《阿波罗尼乌斯传》中将它们与巴比伦魔法师使用的类似轮子联系起来，它们也出现在公元前三世纪的埃及神庙中。据《科伊尔·安曼》（Cóir Anmann）记载，著名的爱尔兰德鲁伊莫格·鲁伊斯（Mogh Ruith，来自克里郡）「其名意为 Magis Rotarum，『轮之巫师』，源于他用以进行魔法观测的轮子」。在奥格雷迪的《希尔瓦·加德利卡》中有一段关于莫格·鲁伊斯之女的记述，她随父亲前往东方学习魔法，在那里制作了一个「划桨轮」。



1 Seventy-two (not seventy) Alexandrian Jews.
¹ 七十二（而非七十）名亚历山大犹太人。



1 In the Genesis story of Adam and Eve the iconotropic distortion is, nevertheless, very thorough. Clearly, Jehovah did not figure in the original myth. It is the Mother of all Living, conversing in triad, who casts Adam out of her fertile riverine dominions because he has usurped some prerogative of hers – whether caprifying fig-trees or planting grain is not clear – lest he should also usurp her prerogative of dispensing justice and uttering oracles. He is sent off to till the soil in some less bountiful region. This recalls what seems to be an intermediate version of the same myth: Triptolemus, a favourite of the Barley-goddess Demeter, is sent off from Eleusis in Attica with a bag of seed, to teach the whole world agriculture, and departs in a car drawn by serpents. The curse in Genesis on the woman, that she should be at enmity with the serpent, is obviously misplaced: it must refer to the ancient rivalry decreed between the sacred king Adam and the Serpent for the favours of the Goddess; Adam is fated to bruise the Serpent’s head, but the Serpent will sting Adam’s sacred heel, each in turn bringing the other to his annual death. That Eve, ‘the Mother of All Living’ was formed by God from Adam’s rib seems an anecdote based on a picture of the naked goddess Anatha of Ugarit watching while Aleyn, alias Baal, drives a curved knife under the fifth rib of his twin Mot: this murder has been iconotropically misread as Jehovah’s removal of a sixth rib, which turns into Eve. The twins, who fought for her favours, were gods of the Waxing and the Waning Year.
¹ 然而在《创世记》中亚当和夏娃的故事里，圣像倒置法的扭曲非常彻底。显然，耶和华并未出现在原始神话中。是「众生之母」以三联体形式对话，将亚当逐出她肥沃的河流域领地，因为他篡夺了她的某些特权——无论是为无花果树授粉还是种植谷物，不得而知——以免他也篡夺她施行公正和发布神谕的特权。他被送去在某个不那么丰饶的地区耕种土地。这让人想起似乎是同一神话的中间版本：大麦女神得墨忒耳的宠儿特里普托勒摩斯，带着一袋种子从阿提卡的厄琉西斯被派出，去教导全世界农业，乘坐蛇拉的车离去。《创世记》中对女人的诅咒——她应与蛇为敌——显然放错了位置：它必定指神圣国王亚当与蛇之间为争夺女神恩宠而规定的古老竞争；亚当注定要伤蛇的头，但蛇将咬伤亚当的神圣脚跟，各自轮流将对方带到年度之死。夏娃——「众生之母」——由上帝用亚当的肋骨造成，这似乎是一个轶事，基于乌加里特裸体女神阿纳特注视阿莱恩（Aleyn，即巴力）用弯刀刺入其孪生兄弟莫特第五肋下方的图画：这场谋杀被以圣像倒置法误读为耶和华取走第六根肋骨，肋骨变成了夏娃。为她恩宠而争斗的孪生兄弟是渐年和渐年之神。





Chapter Fifteen

title: 第十五章
content:
THE SEVEN PILLARS
七柱





Since the seven pillars of Wisdom are identified by Hebrew mystics with the seven days of Creation and with the seven days of the week, one suspects that the astrological system which links each day of the week to one of the heavenly bodies has an arboreal counterpart. The astrological system is so ancient, widespread and consistent in its values that it is worth noting in its various forms. Its origin is probably, but not necessarily, Babylonian. The second list shown here is that of the Sabians of Harran, who took part in the Sea-people’s invasion of Northern Syria about 1200 BC; it makes the connexion between the Babylonian and the Western lists.
既然智慧七柱被希伯来神秘主义者等同于创世七日和一周七日，人们怀疑将一周每天与一天体相关联的占星系统有一个树木对应的版本。这个占星系统如此古老、广泛且价值一致，值得以各种形式加以注意。它的起源可能但未必是巴比伦的。此处第二份列表是哈兰的萨比安人的，他们约在公元前1200年参与了海上民族对北叙利亚的入侵；它在巴比伦列表和西方列表之间建立了联系。

Planet Babylonian Sabian Latin French German English
Planet　Babylonian　Sabian　Latin　French　German　English（行星　巴比伦　萨比安　拉丁　法语　德语　英语）

Sun Samas Samas Sol Dominus Sun Sun
Sun　Samas　Samas　Sol　Dominus　Sun　Sun（太阳　沙玛什　沙玛什　索尔　主日　太阳　太阳）

Moon Sin Sin Luna Luna Moon Moon
Moon　Sin　Sin　Luna　Luna　Moon　Moon（月亮　辛　辛　露娜　月　月　月　月）

Mars Nergal Nergal Mars Mars Zivis Zio
Mars　Nergal　Nergal　Mars　Mars　Zivis　Zio（火星　涅伽尔　涅伽尔　玛尔斯　玛尔斯　齐维斯　齐奥）

Mercury Nabu Mercurius Mercurius Mercurius Wotan Woden
Mercury　Nabu　Mercurius　Mercurius　Mercurius　Wotan　Woden（水星　纳布　墨丘利　墨丘利　墨丘利　沃坦　沃登）

Jupiter Marduk Bel Jupiter Jupiter Thor Thor
Jupiter　Marduk　Bel　Jupiter　Jupiter　Thor　Thor（木星　马尔杜克　贝尔　朱庇特　朱庇特　索尔　索尔）

Venus Ishtar Beltis Venus Venus Freia Frigg
Venus　Ishtar　Beltis　Venus　Venus　Freia　Frigg（金星　伊什塔尔　贝尔蒂斯　维纳斯　维纳斯　弗莱亚　弗丽嘉）

Saturn Ninib Cronos Saturnus Saturn Saturn Saturn
Saturn　Ninib　Cronos　Saturnus　Saturn　Saturn　Saturn（土星　尼尼布　克洛诺斯　萨图尔努斯　萨图恩　萨图恩　萨图恩）





In Aristotle’s list, Wednesday’s planet is ascribed alternatively to Hermes or Apollo, Apollo having by that time exceeded Hermes in his reputation for wisdom; Tuesday’s alternatively to Hercules or Ares (Mars), Hercules being a deity of better omen than Ares; Friday’s alternatively to Aphrodite or Hera, Hera corresponding more closely than Aphrodite with the Babylonian Queen of Heaven, Ishtar.
在亚里士多德的列表中，周三的行星或归于赫尔墨斯或归于阿波罗——阿波罗此时在智慧方面的声望已超过赫尔墨斯；周二或归于赫拉克勒斯或归于阿瑞斯（玛尔斯）——赫拉克勒斯是比阿瑞斯更吉利的神祇；周五或归于阿佛洛狄忒或归于赫拉——赫拉比阿佛洛狄忒更接近巴比伦天后伊什塔尔。

The seven sacred trees of the Irish grove were, as has already been mentioned: birch, willow, holly, hazel, oak, apple and alder. This sequence also holds good for the days of the week, since we can confidently assign the alder to Saturn (Bran); the apple to the Love-goddess Venus or Freia; the oak to the Thunder-god Jupiter or Thor; the willow to the Moon (Circe or Hecate); the holly to Mars, the scarlet-faced War-god; and the birch naturally begins the week as it begins the solar year.1 The tree of Wednesday, sacred to the God of Eloquence, one would expect to be Woden’s ash; but with the ancient Irish the tree of eloquence and wisdom was the hazel, not the ash, the Belgic god Odin or Woden having been a latecomer to Ireland. So these are the seven trees, with their planets, days and letters:
爱尔兰圣林的七棵神圣之树如前所述是：白桦、柳树、冬青、榛树、橡树、苹果和桤木。这个序列也适用于一周的日子，因为我们可以自信地将桤木归于土星（布兰）；苹果归于爱神维纳斯或弗莱亚；橡树归于雷神朱庇特或索尔；柳树归于月亮（喀耳刻或赫卡忒）；冬青归于玛尔斯即赤面战神；白桦自然地如同开始太阳年一样开始一周。¹ 周三的树 sacred 于雄辩之神，人们会期望是沃登的梣树；但对古爱尔兰人来说，雄辩和智慧之树是榛树而非梣树，因为比利时人的神奥丁或沃登是晚到爱尔兰的。因此这七棵树及其行星、日子和字母是：

Sun Sunday Birch B
Sun　Sunday　Birch　B（太阳　周日　白桦　B）

Moon Monday Willow S
Moon　Monday　Willow　S（月亮　周一　柳树　S）

Mars Tuesday Holly T
Mars　Tuesday　Holly　T（火星　周二　冬青　T）

Mercury Wednesday Hazel (or ash) C
Mercury　Wednesday　Hazel (or ash)　C（水星　周三　榛树[或梣树]　C）

Jupiter Thursday Oak D
Jupiter　Thursday　Oak　D（木星　周四　橡树　D）

Venus Friday Apple Q
Venus　Friday　Apple　Q（金星　周五　苹果　Q）

Saturn Saturday Alder F
Saturn　Saturday　Alder　F（土星　周六　桤木　F）





It is easy to reconstruct the appropriate formula in Classical Latin for the daily dedication to the Lord of the Heavens of the devotee’s heart:
可以很容易地用古典拉丁语重构出信徒每日向天主献心的套语：

Benignissime, Solo Tibi Cordis Devotionem Quotidianam Facio.



(‘Most Gracious One to Thee alone I make a daily devotion of my heart.’)
（「至仁者，唯独向你，我每日献上心的虔诚。」）





And the Greek, which had lost its Q.(Koppa) and F (Digamma) must content itself with a second C (Kappa) and a Ph (Phi):
希腊语失去了 Q（Koppa）和 F（Digamma），只能以第二个 C（Kappa）和 Ph（Phi）来替代：

Beltiste Soi Tēn Cardiān Didōmi Cathēmeriōs Phylaxomenēn.



(‘Best One, every day I give my heart into Thy Keeping.’)
（「至善者，我每日将心交于你守护。」）





So the poetic answer to Job’s poetic question: ‘Where shall wisdom be found and where is the place of understanding?’ which his respect for Jehovah the All-wise prevented him from facing is: ‘Under an apple-tree, by pure meditation, on a Friday evening, in the season of apples, when the moon is full.’ But the finder will be Wednesday’s child.
因此，对约伯那诗意之问——「智慧从何处寻得？聪明之处在哪里？」——他因敬畏全智的耶和华而未敢面对的问题，诗意的回答是：「在一棵苹果树下，通过纯粹的冥想，在一个周五傍晚，在苹果的季节，当月圆之时。」但找到它的人将是星期三之子。

The sacred grove is perhaps referred to in Ezekiel, XLVII (a passage quoted in the Gnostic Epistle to Barnabas, XI, 10). Ezekiel in a vision sees the holy waters of a river issuing eastward from under the threshold of the House of God, full of fish, with trees on both sides of the river ‘whose leaves shall not fade nor their fruit be consumed. Each shall bring forth new fruit according to their months, the fruit for meat and the leaves for medicine: and this shall be the border whereby you shall inherit the land according to the tribes of Israel, and Joseph shall have two portions.’ The reference to thirteen tribes, not twelve, and to the ‘months’ of the trees, suggests that the same calendar is being used. Moreover, the theme of roe and apple-tree occurs in the Canticles.
神圣之林或许在《以西结书》XLVII中被提及（该段被引用于诺斯底派《巴拿巴书》XI, 10）。以西结在异象中看见圣水从神殿门槛下向东流出，水中满是鱼，河两岸有树，「叶子不枯萎，果子不断绝。每月各结新果，果子为食物，叶子为医药：这将是你们承受土地为业的边界，按以色列各支派，约瑟得两份。」提到十三个支派而非十二个，以及树木的「月份」，暗示使用的是同一历法。此外，獐鹿和苹果树的主题也出现在《雅歌》中。

The Canticles, though apparently no more than a collection of village love-songs, were officially interpreted by the Pharisee sages of Jesus’s day as the mystical essence of King Solomon’s wisdom, and as referring to the love of Jehovah for Israel; which is why in the Anglican Bible they are interpreted as ‘Christ’s love for his Church’. The fact is that originally they celebrated the mysteries of an annual sacred marriage between Salmaah the King of the year and the Flower Queen, and their Hellenistic influence is patent.
《雅歌》虽然表面不过是一组村庄情歌，但在耶稣时代的法利赛人学者那里被正式解释为所罗门王智慧的神秘精髓，并指涉耶和华对以色列的爱；因此英国国教圣经将其解释为「基督对其教会的爱」。事实是它们最初庆祝的是年之王萨尔玛与花后之间年度神圣婚姻的密仪，其希腊化影响是显而易见的。

The second chapter of the Canticles runs:
《雅歌》第二章如下：

I am the rose of Sharon, the lily of the valleys.
I am the rose of Sharon, the lily of the valleys.（我是沙仑的玫瑰花，是谷中的百合。）



As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.（如荆棘中的百合，我的爱在女子中也是如此。）



As the apple tree among the trees of the grove, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
As the apple tree among the trees of the grove, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight and his fruit was sweet to my taste.（如苹果树在林中树木中，我的良人在男子中也是如此。我欢然坐于其荫下，其果甘甜于我口。）



He brought me to the banquet-house and his banner over me was love. Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples, for I am sick of love.
He brought me to the banquet-house and his banner over me was love. Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples, for I am sick of love.（他带我入筵宴所，以爱为旗在我以上。求你们以葡萄饼给我增力，以苹果畅快我心，因我思爱成病。）



His left hand is under my head, his right hand doth embrace me.
His left hand is under my head, his right hand doth embrace me.（他的左手在我头下，他的右手将我抱住。）



I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem by the roes and by the hinds of the field that ye stir not up, nor wake my love till he please.
I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem by the roes and by the hinds of the field that ye stir not up, nor wake my love till he please.（耶路撒冷的女子啊，我指着田野的母鹿和雌鹿嘱咐你们，不要惊动，不要叫醒我所爱的，等他自己情愿。）



The voice of my beloved! Behold he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
The voice of my beloved! Behold he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.（听啊，是我良人的声音！看哪，他蹿山越岭而来。）



My beloved is like a roe or a wild hart….
My beloved is like a roe or a wild hart….（我的良人好像獐鹿或小鹿……）



My beloved is mine, I am his, he feedeth among the lilies.
My beloved is mine, I am his, he feedeth among the lilies.（我的良人属我，我属他，他在百合花中牧放。）





The ‘lilies’ are the red anemones that sprang up from the drops of blood which fell from Adonis’s side when the wild boar killed him. The apple is the Sidonian (i.e. Cretan) apple, or quince, sacred to Aphrodite the Love-goddess, and first cultivated in Europe by the Cretans. The true apple was not known in Biblical Palestine and it is only recently that varieties have been introduced there that yield marketable fruit. But the apple grew wild in ancient times on the Southern shores of the Black Sea, the provenience of the other trees of the series, and around Trebizond still occasionally forms small woods. It also occurred in Macedonia – the original home of the Muses – and in Euboea where Hercules received the injury that sent him to the pyre on Mount Oeta; but in both these cases may have been an early importation.
「百合花」是红色银莲花，由野猪杀死阿多尼斯时从他侧腹滴下的血滴中长出。苹果是西顿式（即克里特式）苹果或榅桲，sacred 于爱神阿佛洛狄忒，由克里特人最早在欧洲栽培。真正的苹果在《圣经》时代的巴勒斯坦并不为人所知，直到最近才在那里引进了能产出可销售果实的品种。但苹果在古代生长在黑海南岸——该系列其他树木的来源地——在特拉比松附近至今偶尔形成小树林。它也出现在马其顿——缪斯的最初故乡——和优卑亚，赫拉克勒斯在那里受了导致他前往奥伊塔山火葬堆的伤；但在这两处可能是早期引进的。

There seems to be a strong connexion between the tree-calendar and the ritual at the Feast of the Tabernacles at Jerusalem, already mentioned in connexion with the willow and alder. The worshippers carried in their right hand an ethrog, a sort of citron, and in their left a lulab, or thyrsus, consisting of the intertwined boughs of palm, willow and myrtle. The ethrog was not the original fruit, having been introduced from India after the Captivity, and is thought to have displaced the quince because of the quince’s erotic connotations. In the reformation of religion which took place during the Exile the Jews broke as far as possible all the ties which bound them to orgiastic religion. The ritual of Tabernacles was taken over by the Hebrews with other rites in honour of the Moon-goddess, and the ordinances for its observance were fathered on Moses, as part of the great recension of the Law ascribed to King Josiah but probably made during the Exile. I have already mentioned the disparaging Haggadah on the willow; the meaning of the myrtle was also changed from the shadow of death to the pleasant shade of summer, on the authority of Isaiah who had praised the tree (Isaiah, XLI, 19; LV, 13).
树木历法与耶路撒冷住棚节仪式之间似乎有密切联系，此前在论及柳树和桤木时已提及。崇拜者右手持一个 etrog（一种香橼），左手持一个 lulab 即酒神杖，由棕榈、柳树和桃金娘的枝条编成。香橼并非原始果实，是流放后从印度引进的，据说因其色情含义而取代了榅桲。在流放期间发生的宗教改革中，犹太人尽可能切断了将他们与狂欢宗教联系在一起的一切纽带。住棚节仪式是希伯来人连同其他敬奉月女神的仪式一起接管的，其遵守条例被归于摩西，作为归于约西亚王但可能制定于流放期间的律法大修订的一部分。我已提及对柳树的贬低性哈加达；桃金娘的含义也从死亡的阴影改为夏日宜人的荫蔽，依据是以赛亚对该树的赞颂（《以赛亚书》XLI, 19; LV, 13）。

The feast began on the first new moon of the year, and in the quince season. Both willow and apple have 5 – the number especially sacred to the Moon-goddess – as the number of their letter-strokes in the Ogham finger-alphabet. The myrtle does not occur in the Beth-Luis-Nion, but may well be the Greek equivalent of the remaining consonant in the Beth-Luis-Nion that has 5 as its number of strokes – the elder. The myrtle was sacred to the Love-goddess Aphrodite all over the Mediterranean, partly because it grows best near the sea shore, partly because of its fragrance; nevertheless, it was the tree of death. Myrto, or Myrtea, or Myrtoessa was a title of hers and the pictures of her sitting with Adonis in the myrtle-shade were deliberately misunderstood by the Classical poets. She was not vulgarly courting him, as they pretended, but was promising him Life-in-Death; for myrtle was evergreen and was a token of the resurrection of the dead King of the year. The myrtle is connected in Greek myth with the death of kings: Myrtilus, son of Hermes (Mercury) who was charioteer to Oenomaus the King of Elis, pulled the linch-pins from the wheels of his master’s chariot and so caused his death. Pelops, who then married Oenomaus’s widow, ungratefully threw Myrtilus into the sea. Myrtilus cursed the House of Pelops with his dying breath and thereafter every Pelopid monarch was dogged by his ghost. The ‘wheel’ was the life of the King; R, the last consonant of the alphabet ‘pulls out the pin’ at the last month of his reign. Pelops’s dynasty obtained the throne of Elis, but all his successors similarly met their end in the R month. (Myrtilus became the northern constellation Auriga, the charioteer.) The myrtle resembles the elder in the medicinal qualities attributed to its leaves and berries; the berries are ripe in December, the R month. Myrtle boughs were carried by Greek emigrants when they intended to found a new colony, as if to say: ‘The old cycle is ended; we hope to start a new one with the favour of the Love-goddess, who rules the sea.’
这个节日在一年的第一个新月、即榅桲季节开始。柳树和苹果在欧甘手指字母表中的笔画数都是 5——这是特别 sacred 于月女神的数字。桃金娘不在贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中，但很可能是贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中笔画数同样为 5 的剩余辅音——接骨木——的希腊对应物。桃金娘在整个地中海地区 sacred 于爱神阿佛洛狄忒，部分因为它在海滨生长最佳，部分因为其芳香；然而它是死亡之树。Myrto、Myrtea 或 Myrtoessa 是她的称号，她与阿多尼斯坐在桃金娘荫下的画面被古典诗人故意误解了。她并非如他们所假装的那样在庸俗地追求他，而是在向他承诺「死中之生」；因为桃金娘是常绿的，是年之王死而复生的信物。桃金娘在希腊神话中与国王之死相关：赫尔墨斯（墨丘利）之子米尔提卢斯是厄利斯国王俄诺玛俄斯的御车手，他从主人战车的轮上拔出轮销，导致其死亡。珀罗普斯随后娶了俄诺玛俄斯的遗孀，却忘恩负义地将米尔提卢斯抛入海中。米尔提卢斯临终前诅咒了珀罗普斯家族，此后每位珀罗普斯君主都被他的鬼魂所困扰。「轮子」是国王的生命；R，字母表的最后一个辅音，在他统治的最后一个月「拔出销子」。珀罗普斯王朝获得了厄利斯王位，但他的所有继承者都在 R 月同样迎来了结局。（米尔提卢斯成为北方星座御夫座[Auriga]。）桃金娘在叶和浆果的药用特性上类似于接骨木；浆果在十二月即 R 月成熟。希腊移民在打算建立新殖民地时携带桃金娘枝，仿佛在说：「旧的循环已经结束；我们希望在爱神——她主宰海洋——的恩宠下开始新的循环。」

Thus the thyrsus contained three trees, each representing a flight of five calendar letters, or one-third of the year; besides the palm which represented the extra day (or period of five days) on which the Sun-god was born. The number fifteen was therefore of prime importance in the Festival: the Levites sang the fifteen Songs of Ascent (attributed to King David) as they stood on the fifteen steps leading up from the Women’s Court to the Court of Israel. The number also figures in the architecture of Solomon’s ‘house of the Forest of Lebanon’ which was more than twice the size of the House of the Lord. It was built on three rows of cedar pillars, fifteen to a row, and was 50 cubits long by 30 high and wide; with an adjoining porch 30 cubits wide, 50 long, height not given – probably 10 cubits.
因此酒神杖包含三种树，各代表一组五个历法字母即一年的三分之一；此外棕榈代表额外之日（或五天时期），太阳神在此日诞生。因此数字十五在节中至关重要：利未人站在从女院通往以色列院的十五级台阶上，唱十五首上行之歌（归于大卫王）。这个数字也出现在所罗门「黎巴嫩林宫」的建筑中——该宫比圣殿大一倍有余。它建在三排雪松柱上，每排十五根，长五十肘、高宽各三十肘；另有一个相连的门廊宽三十肘、长五十肘，高度未给出——可能为十肘。

The Hebrew canon of the trees of the week, the seven pillars of Wisdom, is not difficult to establish. For the birch, which was not a Palestinian tree, the most likely substitute is the retem or wild broom, which was the tree under which the prophet Elijah rested on Mount Horeb (‘the mountain of glowing heat’) and seems to have been sacred to the Sun. Like the birch, it was used as a besom for the expulsion of evil spirits. Willow remains the same. For the holly, the kerm-oak, already mentioned in Chapter Ten as the tree from which the ancients obtained their royal scarlet dye. This ascription of the kerm-oak to Nergal or Mars, is confirmed by a characteristic passage in Frazer’s Golden Bough:
希伯来一周之树——智慧七柱——的准则不难建立。白桦不是巴勒斯坦树木，最可能的替代者是 retem 即野金雀花，先知以利亚在何烈山（「灼热之山」）上曾在其下休息，似乎 sacred 于太阳。与白桦一样，它被用作驱邪的扫帚。柳树不变。冬青的替代者是 kerm-oak（胭脂虫橡树），在第十章已提及，古人从其中获取皇家猩红染料。将胭脂虫橡树归于涅伽尔或玛尔斯，由弗雷泽《金枝》中的一段特征性文字所证实：

The heathen of Harran offered to the sun, moon and planets human victims who were chosen on the ground of their supposed resemblance to the heavenly bodies to which they were sacrificed; for example, the priests, clothed in red and smeared with blood, offered a red-haired, red-cheeked man to ‘the red planet Mars’ in a temple which was painted red and draped with red hangings.
哈兰的异教徒向太阳、月亮和行星献祭人牲，牺牲者因其被认为与所祭天体相似而被选中；例如，祭司身穿红衣、涂满鲜血，在一座漆成红色、挂满红色帷幔的神庙中，将一名红发红颊男子献给「红色行星玛尔斯」。





The substitute for the hazel was the almond: this was the tree from which Aaron took his magic rod, and the Menorah the seven-branched candlestick in the Temple Sanctuary at Jerusalem had its sconces in the form of almonds and represented Aaron’s rod when it budded. It was this branch that Jeremiah (Jeremiah I, 11) was shown as a visionary token that God had granted him prophetic wisdom. The sconces stood for the seven heavenly bodies of the week, and the central sconce was the fourth, namely that dedicated to Wisdom, which gives its name to all the rest; its branch formed the shaft of the candlestick. For the oak, the terebinth sacred to Abraham. For the apple, the quince. For the alder, since we know that the alder was banned in Temple worship, the pomegranate which supplies a red dye as the alder does. The pomegranate was Saul’s sacred tree, and sacred to Rimmon, a name for Adonis from whose blood it is said to have sprung. Also, the Paschal victim was traditionally spitted on pomegranate wood. The pomegranate was the only fruit allowed to be brought inside the Holy of Holies – miniature pomegranates were sewn on the High Priest’s robes when he made his yearly entry. Since the seventh day was sacred to Jehovah and Jehovah was a form of Bran, or Saturn, or Ninib,1 everything points to the pomegranate as the tree of the seventh day. So:
榛树的替代者是杏仁：这是亚伦取其魔杖的树，耶路撒冷圣殿圣所中的七分支烛台（Menorah）的灯盏呈杏仁形，代表亚伦发芽的杖。正是这根枝条，耶利米（《耶利米书》I, 11）在异象中被展示，作为上帝赐予他预言智慧的标记。灯盏代表一周的七天体，中央灯盏是第四个，即 dedicated 于智慧的那个——它为其余一切命名；其枝条构成烛台的干。橡树的替代者是 sacred 于亚伯拉的笃耨香（terebinth）。苹果的替代者是榅桲。桤木的替代者——因为我们知道桤木在圣殿崇拜中被禁止——是石榴，它与桤木一样提供红色染料。石榴是扫罗的神圣之树，sacred 于里蒙（Rimmon）——阿多尼斯的一个名字，据说石榴从他血中长出。此外，逾越节的羔羊传统上用石榴木串烤。石榴是唯一允许带入至圣所的果实——大祭司每年进入时袍子上缝有微型石榴。既然第七日 sacred 于耶和华，而耶和华是布兰或萨图恩或尼尼布的一种形式，¹ 一切都指向石榴为第七日之树。因此：

Sun – Broom
Sun – Broom（太阳——金雀花）

Moon – Willow
Moon – Willow（月亮——柳树）

Mars – Kerm
Mars – Kerm（火星——胭脂虫橡树）

Mercury – Almond
Mercury – Almond（水星——杏仁）

Jupiter – Terebinth
Jupiter – Terebinth（木星——笃耨香）

Venus – Quince
Venus – Quince（金星——榅桲）

Saturn – Pomegranate.
Saturn – Pomegranate.（土星——石榴。）





The one doubtful tree here is the broom, or its Irish counterpart, the birch. The seven trees of the Irish grove all belong to the summer months except B, the birch, which has taken the place of H, the hawthorn: and has apparently been chosen because it is the leading letter of the first flight of five trees, as H is of the second. But, as will be shown in the next chapter, B was used as the cypher equivalent of H not only in Hyginus’s Fable 271 but in the third century AD Ogham inscription on the Callen Stone. So it seems that Sunday’s original letter was not B, but H, of which the Hebrew tree, corresponding with the hawthorn, was the Sant, or wild acacia, the sort with golden flowers and sharp thorns, better known to readers of the Bible as ‘shittim’-wood, i.e. from Cyprus. It was from its water-proof timber that the arks of the Sun-hero Osiris and his counterparts Noah and Armenian Xisuthros were built; also the Ark of the Covenant, the recorded measurements of which proved it sacred to the Sun. This is a host-tree of the mistletoe-like loranthus, Jehovah’s oracular ‘burning bush’, and the source of manna.
这里唯一可疑的树是金雀花，或其爱尔兰对应物白桦。爱尔兰圣林的七棵树都属于夏季月份，除了 B 即白桦——它取代了 H 即山楂——显然被选中是因为它是第一组五棵树的领字母，如同 H 是第二组的。但如下一章将展示的，B 被用作 H 的密码等价物不仅见于希吉努斯寓言271，也见于公元三世纪卡伦石上的欧甘铭文。因此似乎周日最初的字母不是 B 而是 H，其希伯来树木对应于山楂的是 Sant 即野相思树——开金花、长尖刺的那种，《圣经》读者更熟悉的名字是「shittim」（什亭木），即来自塞浦路斯的木材。日之神英雄奥西里斯以及他的对应者挪亚和亚美尼亚的西苏特罗斯的方舟，还有约柜，都是用其防水木材建造的——约柜的记录尺寸证明它 sacred 于太阳。这是槲寄生般的桑寄生的寄主树——耶和华的神谕「燃烧荆棘」——也是吗哪的来源。

The use of H for Sunday’s letter explains Lucan’s puzzling account of the sacred grove at Marseilles which Julius Caesar felled because it interfered with his fortification of the city. Marseilles was a Greek city, a centre of Pythagoreanism, and Caesar had to use an axe himself on one of the oaks before he could persuade anyone to begin the work of desecration. The grove, according to Lucan, contained holly-oak, Dodonian oak, and alder – T, D and F. He specifies none of the remaining trees except the cypress, which the Massiliots had brought from their parent state of Phocis where it was sacred to Artemis. One would not have expected the cypress in the grove; but elsewhere in Greece, particularly at Corinth and Messene, it was sacred to Artemis Cranaë or Carnasia; which makes it an H tree, an evergreen substitute for the hawthorn also sacred to Cranaë or Carnea. Thus as the tree of Sunday, succeeding the alder of Saturday, it symbolized resurrection in the Orphic mysteries, the escape of the Sun-hero from Calypso’s alder-girt island, and became attached to the cult of Celestial Hercules. Cypress is still the prime resurrection symbol in Mediterranean church-yards.1
用 H 作为周日的字母解释了卢坎对马赛神圣树林的令人困惑的描述——尤利乌斯·凯撒因它妨碍城市防御而砍伐了它。马赛是一座希腊城市，毕达哥拉斯主义的中心，凯撒不得不亲自用斧头砍伐一棵橡树才能说服任何人开始亵渎工程。据卢坎所述，该树林包含冬青橡、多多纳橡和桤木——T、D 和 F。他除柏树外未指明其他树木，马赛人从其母邦福基斯带来柏树，在那里它 sacred 于阿尔忒弥斯。人们不会期望柏树出现在树林中；但在希腊其他地方，尤其在科林斯和梅塞涅，它 sacred 于阿尔忒弥斯·克拉奈（Cranaë）或卡尔纳西亚（Carnasia）；这使它成为一棵 H 树——山楂的常绿替代物，同样 sacred 于克拉奈或卡尔内亚（Carnea）。因此作为周日之树，继周六的桤木之后，它在俄耳甫斯密仪中象征复活——太阳神从卡吕普索的桤木环绕之岛逃脱——并附属于天界赫拉克勒斯崇拜。柏树至今仍是地中海墓园中首要的复活象征。¹

There is a clear correspondence between this canon and that of the seven days of Creation as characterized in the first chapter of Genesis.
这一准则与《创世记》第一章所描述的创世七日之间有明确的对应关系。

Sun – Light
Sun – Light（太阳——光）

Moon – Division of Waters
Moon – Division of Waters（月亮——分水）

Mars – Dry Land, Pasture and Trees
Mars – Dry Land, Pasture and Trees（火星——旱地、牧场和树木）

Mercury – Heavenly Bodies and the Seasons
Mercury – Heavenly Bodies and the Seasons（水星——天体和季节）

Jupiter – Sea-beasts and Birds
Jupiter – Sea-beasts and Birds（木星——海兽和鸟类）

Venus – Land-beasts, Man and Woman
Venus – Land-beasts, Man and Woman（金星——走兽、男人和女人）

Saturn – Repose.
Saturn – Repose.（土星——安息。）





The apparent illogic of the creation of Light, and even of Pasture and Trees, before that of the Heavenly Bodies and Seasons – though here it has been ingeniously suggested by Mr. Ernst Schiff that the Heavenly Bodies were not visible until the fourth day because of the ‘damp haze’ mentioned in verse 9 of the Creation story, and therefore not created in the sense of not being manifested – is accounted for by the powers proper to the deities who rule over the planetary days of the week. The Sun-god rules over Light, the Moon over Water, Mars over Pasture and Trees, and Mercury is the God of Astronomy. Clearly the Genesis legend is subsequent to the fixing of the canon of planets, days and gods. The allocation of Sea-beasts and Birds to the fifth day is natural, because the god of the oak or terebinth cult is, in general, the son of a Sea-goddess to whom the Dove, the Eagle and all other birds are sacred, and himself takes the form of a sea-beast. The order to man and woman to couple and produce their kind, like the creatures over which they have dominion, is appropriate to the day of Venus. The pleasant sloth of Saturn – in whose golden day, according to the Classical poets, men ate honey and acorns in a Terrestrial Paradise and did not trouble to till the soil, or even to hunt, since the earth brought forth abundantly of her own bounty – explains the seventh day as one of repose. The Jewish apocalyptic prophecy (which Jesus took literally) of the Heavenly Kingdom of Jehovah referred to a restoration of this same golden age if only man would cease to busy himself with wars and labours; for Jehovah required rest on the seventh day. As has been already explained, the geographical situation of the former Terrestrial Paradise was variously given. The Babylonians placed it in the Delta of the Euphrates; the Greeks in Crete; the pre-Exilic Hebrews at Hebron in Southern Judaea.
光的创造甚至牧场和树木的创造在天体和季节之前——尽管恩斯特·席夫先生巧妙地建议天体直到第四日才因创世故事第九节提到的「潮湿雾气」而可见，因此就「未显现」的意义而言未被创造——这种表面的不合逻辑，由主宰一周行星之日的神祇所特有的权能来解释。太阳神主宰光，月亮主宰水，玛尔斯主宰牧场和树木，墨丘利是天文学之神。显然《创世记》传说晚于行星、日子和神祇准则的确立。将海兽和鸟类分配给第五日是自然的，因为橡树或笃耨香崇拜之神通常是海女神之子，鸽、鹰和所有其他鸟类都 sacred 于她，他自己也化为海兽之形。命男女交合繁衍如同他们所管辖的活物，适合金星之日。萨图恩的愉快懒散——据古典诗人所言，在他的黄金时代，人在尘世乐园中食蜂蜜和橡子，不劳耕种甚至不猎，因为大地自行丰盛产出——解释了第七日为安息之日。犹太启示预言（耶稣按字面理解）中耶和华天国指的是对同一黄金时代的恢复——只要人停止战争和劳作；因为耶和华在第七日要求安息。如前所述，前尘世乐园的地理位置众说纷纭。巴比伦人将其放在幼发拉底河三角洲；希腊人放在克里特；流放前的希伯来人放在犹大南部的希伯仑。

It is of the highest theological importance that Jehovah announced himself to Moses as ‘I am that I am’ or (more literally) ‘I am whoever I choose to be’ from the acacia rather than from any other tree; because this constituted a definition of his godhead. Had he announced himself from the terebinth, as the earlier Jehovah had done at Hebron, this would have been to reveal himself as Bel, or Marduk, the god of Thursday and of the seventh month, the Aramaean Jupiter, the Paeonian Apollo. But from the acacia, the tree of the first day of the week, he revealed himself as the God of the Menorah, the transcendental Celestial God, the God who presently said: ‘Thou shalt have none other Gods but me…for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God.’ The acacia is, indeed, a thorny, jealous, self-sufficient tree, needs very little water and, like Odin’s ash, strangles with its roots all other trees growing near it. Uath, the month dedicated to the acacia, was the one in which the annual Hebron Fair took place, and so holy that (as has been mentioned in Chapter Ten) all sexual congress and self-beautification was tabooed during it: it was the month of the annual purification of the temples in Greece, Italy and the Near East.
耶和华从相思树而非其他任何树向摩西宣布「我是我所是」或（更字面地）「我是我所选择成为的」，这在神学上至为重要；因为这构成对其神格的定义。如果他如更早的耶和华在希伯仑所做的那样从笃耨香中宣布自己，那将揭示自己为贝尔或马尔杜克——星期四和第七个月之神，阿拉米亚的朱庇特，佩昂的阿波罗。但从相思树——一周第一日之树——中，他揭示自己为烛台之神，超越性的天界之神，随后说：「除我之外你不可有别的神……因为我耶和华你的神是忌邪的神。」相思树确实是一种多刺、嫉妒、自给自足的树，只需极少的水，如奥丁的梣树一样用根勒死附近生长的一切其他树。厄阿斯（Uath），dedicated 于相思树的月份，是年度希伯仑集市举行的月份，如此神圣以至于（如第十章所述）在此期间一切性交和修饰都被禁止：这是希腊、意大利和近东各神殿年度净化的月份。

The not yet completed Ages of the World, quoted from Nennius by Gwion, are based on the same planetary canon:
格维翁引用的、来自南尼乌斯的尚未完成的世界纪元，基于同一行星准则：

[Sunday] ‘The first Age of the World is from Adam to Noah.’
[周日]「第一纪元从亚当到挪亚。」



Adam’s was the first human eye to see the light of the sun, or the Glory of God. Sunday is the day of light.
亚当是第一只看见太阳之光即上帝荣耀的人眼。周日是光之日。





[Monday] ‘The second Age is from Noah to Abraham.’
[周一]「第二纪元从挪亚到亚伯拉罕。」



Noah’s Age was introduced by the Deluge. Monday is the day of Water.
挪亚的纪元由大洪水引入。周一是水之日。





[Tuesday] ‘The third Age is from Abraham to David.’
[周二]「第三纪元从亚伯拉罕到大卫。」



Abraham was famous for his flocks and herds and for having the fertile Land of Canaan promised to his descendants. Tuesday is the day of Trees and Pasture.
亚伯拉罕以他的羊群牛群和获赐肥沃的迦南地给予其后裔而闻名。周二是树木和牧场之日。





[Wednesday] ‘The fourth Age is from David to Daniel.’
[周三]「第四纪元从大卫到但以理。」



The third Age should really run from Abraham to Solomon and the fourth from Solomon to Daniel – the change was apparently made in honour of St. David – since in the introductory paragraph Nennius gives the number of years, 1048, from Abraham to the building of Solomon’s Temple, which David was to have built if he had not sinned. Solomon’s wisdom was embodied in the Temple. Wednesday is the day of Wisdom.
第三纪元实际上应从亚伯拉罕到所罗门，第四纪元从所罗门到但以理——这一更改显然是为圣大卫而作——因为在导言段落中南尼乌斯给出从亚伯拉罕到建造所罗门圣殿的年数为 1048 年，大卫本应建造圣殿若他未曾犯罪。所罗门的智慧体现在圣殿中。周三是智慧之日。





[Thursday] ‘The fifth Age is from Daniel to John the Baptist.’
[周四]「第五纪元从但以理到施洗约翰。」



In the introductory paragraph Nennius gives the number of years, 612, ‘from Solomon to the rebuilding of the Temple which was accomplished under Darius King of the Persians.’ Here Daniel has been substituted for Darius (who put him in the lions’ den at Babylon) as being under the particular guidance of God; but in the myth of Jonah the power of Babylon was symbolized by the whale which swallowed and then spewed out the chosen people when they cried out from its belly. Thursday is the day of Sea-beasts and Fishes.
在导言段落中南尼乌斯给出年数：「从所罗门到波斯王大流士统治下重建圣殿为 612 年。」此处但以理取代了大流士（大流士曾将但以理投入巴比伦的狮坑），因但以理在上帝特别的引导之下；但在约拿的神话中，巴比伦的力量由吞咽后又吐出选民的鲸鱼所象征——当他们在其腹中呼喊时。周四是海兽和鱼类之日。





[Friday] ‘The sixth Age is from John the Baptist to the Judgement Day.’
[周五]「第六纪元从施洗约翰到审判日。」



Nennius gives the number of years: 548, from Darius to the Ministry of Jesus Christ; so John the Baptist figures here as having assisted at Jesus’s Baptism. The object of the Ministry was to preach the Gospel of Love; to separate the sheep from the goats; to make the lion lie down with the ox; to persuade man to be born again – the Second Adam redeeming the First Adam. Friday is the day of Land-beasts, Man and Love.
南尼乌斯给出年数：从大流士到耶稣基督传道为 548 年；因此施洗约翰在此作为协助耶稣受洗之人出现。传道的目的是宣讲爱的福音；将绵羊从山羊中分开；使狮子与牛犊同卧；劝人重生——第二亚当救赎第一亚当。周五是走兽、人和爱之日。





[Saturday] ‘In the seventh Age our Lord Jesus Christ will come to judge the living and the dead, and the world by fire.’
[周六]「在第七纪元我们的主耶稣基督将再来审判活人与死人，以火审判世界。」



In the present Age, the sixth, of which 973 years had passed when Nennius wrote, man must look hopefully forward to the seventh Age for eventual repose of soul. Saturday is the day of Repose.1
在当前纪元即第六纪元中，南尼乌斯写作时已过了 973 年，人必须怀着希望期待第七纪元的灵魂最终安息。周六是安息之日。¹





The Rabbinical explanation of the Menorah, in terms of the creation of the world in seven days, is obviously faulty: the ascription of the central light to the Sabbath contradicts the ‘Let there be Lights’ text of the fourth day. The more ancient tradition preserved in the Zohar: ‘These lamps, like the seven planets above, receive their light from the Sun’, goes back to the pre-exilic Sun-cult. The Menorah was placed in the Sanctuary to face W.S.W., towards On-Heliopolis, as the original home of the Sun-god to whom Moses was priest.
拉比对烛台（Menorah）以创世七日来解释显然有误：将中央灯归于安息日与第四日「要有光」的经文矛盾。《光辉之书》中保存的更古老传统——「这些灯如同上方七行星一样，从太阳接受光」——可追溯到流放前的太阳崇拜。烛台被放在圣所中面朝西南，朝向昂-赫利奥波利斯，即摩西为其祭司的太阳神的最初家园。

Josephus (Antiquities v. 5; 5) writes of the three wonders of the Sanctuary, namely the lamps, the table of shew-bread, and the altar of incense:
约瑟夫斯（《犹太古事记》V, 5; 5）写到圣所的三件奇迹，即灯、陈设饼桌子和香坛：

‘Now, the seven lamps signified the seven planets, for so many there were springing out of the candlestick; the twelve loaves that were upon the table signified the circle of the Zodiac and the year; and the altar of incense by its thirteen kinds of sweet-smelling spices with which the sea replenished it, signified that God is the lord of all things in both the uninhabitable and the habitable parts of the earth, and that they are all to be dedicated to his use.’
「七盏灯代表七行星，因为烛台上有这么多盏；桌上的十二块饼代表黄道十二宫和一年；香坛以海所充盈的十三种香料代表上帝是大地不宜居和宜居部分万物之主，一切都应 dedicated 于他用。」





These thirteen (rather than four) spices must belong to an early secret tradition not mentioned in the Law, coeval with the instructions in Numbers XXIX, 13 for the sacrifice of thirteen bullocks on the first day of the Feast of Tabernacles. (Incidentally, the total number of bullocks to be sacrificed from the inauguration of the critical seventh month to the end of the seven days of the Feast was the sacred seventy-two again. The sacrifice of a single bullock on the eighth day was a separate matter.) Josephus is hinting that the number thirteen refers to Rahab, the prophetic Goddess of the Sea, Guardian of Sheol (‘the uninhabitable parts of the world’) where God also, however, claims suzerainty.
这十三种（而非四种）香料必属一种早期秘密传统，律法中未提及，与《民数记》XXIX, 13 中住棚节第一日献祭十三头公牛的指示同时。附带说，从关键第七月开始到住棚节七日结束，应献祭的公牛总数恰好又是神圣的七十二。第八日献祭一头公牛是另一回事。）约瑟夫斯暗示数字十三指涉拉哈布——预言性的海之女神，阴间（「世界不宜居之处」）的守护者——在那里上帝也声称拥有主权。

What appears to have been a jewel-sequence corresponding with Ezekiel’s tree-sequence was arrayed in three rows on the golden breast-plate worn by the High Priest, called in Greek the logion or ‘little word-giver’ (Exodus XXVIII, 15). It was made by Egyptian craftsmen; and the King of Tyre wore a similar one in honour of Hercules Melkarth (Ezekiel XXVIII, 13). The jewels, which gave oracular responses by lighting up in the dark of the Sanctuary, were probably hollow-cut with a revolving drum behind them on which was a small strip of phosphorus: when the drum was revolved the message was spelt out in ouija style as the strip of phosphorus came to rest behind different letters in turn.
似乎有一套与以西结的树木序列相对应的宝石序列，排成三行镶嵌在大祭司佩戴的金胸牌上——希腊语称为 logion 即「小言赐者」（《出埃及记》XXVIII, 15）。它由埃及工匠制作；提尔王佩戴类似之物以敬奉赫拉克勒斯·梅尔卡什（《以西结书》XXVIII, 13）。这些宝石在圣所的黑暗中发光以给出神谕回应，可能是空心切割的，后面有一个旋转鼓，鼓上有小条磷光物质：旋转鼓时，磷光条依次停在不同字母后面，以灵应盘方式拼出信息。

The account of the breastplate given in Exodus mentions twelve precious stones, inscribed with the names of the Twelve Tribes, set in a gold plaque eight inches square. But there is a thirteenth stone which is given such importance elsewhere in the Bible, for example in Isaiah, LIV, 12, that we may assume it to have been part of the original series. This is the kadkod, mistranslated in the Authorised Version as ‘agate’, probably the red carbuncle, and we may assign it to the tribe of Gad which disappeared early in Israelite history. All the jewels are mistranslated in the Authorised Version, and a slightly different set appears, in Revelation, XXI, 19, as forming the foundations of the New Jerusalem. The breastplate was still in existence in the time of Josephus, though it no longer lighted up, and probably contained all the original stones except the kadkod. We can build up our jewel-sequence from it, relying on J. I. Myers’ solid scholarship to identify the jewels and then re-arranging them in a likely seasonal order. For we may assume that the order given in the Bible, like the order of the elements in the Song of Amergin, has been purposely confused for reasons of security.
《出埃及记》中对胸牌的描述提到十二颗宝石，刻有十二支派的名字，镶嵌在一块八英寸见方的金板上。但还有第十三颗宝石在《圣经》其他地方被赋予重要地位，例如《以赛亚书》LIV, 12，我们可以假设它是原始序列的一部分。这是 kadkod，在钦定本中被误译为「玛瑙」，可能是红色石榴石（carbuncle），我们可以将其归于早期消失于以色列历史中的迦得支派。钦定本中所有宝石都被误译，《启示录》XXI, 19 中出现了一组略有不同的宝石，作为新耶路撒冷的根基。胸牌在约瑟夫斯时代仍然存在，尽管不再发光，可能包含除 kadkod 外的所有原始宝石。我们可以从中重建宝石序列，依靠 J. I. 迈尔斯的扎实学问来鉴别宝石，然后按可能的季节顺序重新排列。因为我们可以假设《圣经》中给出的顺序，如同阿默金之歌中元素的顺序一样，出于安全考虑被故意打乱了。

We know that amethyst, ahlamah, is the wine stone – its Greek name means ‘charm against drunkenness’ – and can be assigned to M, the vine month. Similarly, yellow serpentine, tarsis, naturally belongs to G, the yellow-berried ivy month. The banded red agate, sebo, belongs to C, the month before the vintage, when the grapes are still red. The white carnelian, yahalem, and the yellow cairngorm, lesem, may belong to the glaring hot D and T months; the blood-red carbuncle, kadkod, to S, the month of the razzia or raiding party; and the lapis lazuli, sappur, to H, the first month of summer, since it typifies the dark blue sky. Sappur is translated ‘sapphire’ in the Authorised Version, and Ezekiel mentions it as the colour of the Throne of God. The light green jasper, yàsepheh, and the dark green malachite, soham, suit NG and R, the winter rain-months of Palestine. Nophek, the bright red fire-garnet, or pyrope, is likely to be F, the month of the Spring equinox. The rusty-red Edomite sard, odem, comes first in the year in honour of Adam, the red man – for ‘Edom’, ‘Adam’ and ‘Odem’ are all variants of the same word meaning rust-red: odem belongs to the month B. The remaining two stones corresponding with L, the month of Hercules’s golden cup, and N, the month of his sea-voyage, are pitdan, clear yellow chrysolite, and bareketh, green beryl – the name beryl meaning, in Greek, the sea-jewel.
我们知道紫水晶 ahlamah 是酒之石——其希腊名意为「防醉之符」——可归于 M 即葡萄藤月。同样，黄色蛇纹石 tarsis 自然属于 G 即黄浆果常春藤月。带状红玛瑙 sebo 属于 C 即葡萄收获前葡萄仍红的月份。白色玉髓 yahalem 和黄色黄水晶 lesem 可能属于酷热的 D 和 T 月；血红石榴石 kadkod 属于 S 即劫掠队或袭击之月；青金石 sappur 属于 H 即夏季第一个月，因为它象征深蓝天。sappur 在钦定本中译为「蓝宝石」，以西结提到它为上帝宝座之色。浅绿碧玉 yàsepheh 和深绿孔雀石 soham 适合 NG 和 R 即巴勒斯坦的冬雨月。nophek 即明红色火石榴石或 pyrope 可能是 F 即春分月。锈红色的以东红玛瑙 odem 在年中居首以纪念亚当即红色之人——因为「以东」、「亚当」和「odem」都是同一词的变体，意为锈红色：odem 属于 B 月。与 L 即赫拉克勒斯金杯之月和 N 即他航海之月相对应的剩余两颗宝石是 pitdan（透黄色橄榄石）和 bareketh（绿绿柱石）——绿柱石在希腊语中意为「海之宝石」。



We can go further: with the help of the names given to the tribes by their mothers in Genesis XXIX and XXX, and of the prophetic blessings or curses bestowed on them by Jacob in Genesis XLVIII and XLIX, we can assign a letter and month to each tribe. To Ephraim (‘fruitful’) and Manasseh (‘forgetfulness’), the two sons of Joseph who was a ‘fruitful vine’ we can assign the months C and M; and B to Reuben the first-born, who had Edomite connections. To Reuben’s four full-brothers, Gad (‘a robber band’) Levi (‘set apart’) Asher (‘royal dainties are on his plate’) and Simeon (‘the bloody brother whose anger is fierce’), the months of S, H, D and T. Gad has the month of the razzia when the corn is invitingly ripe; Levi has the H month because it is the month of peculiar holiness; Asher has the important royal D month because his name is connected with the Ashera, the terebinth groves of the midsummer sacrifice; Simeon has T, the murderous month when the sun is at its fiercest. To Issachar, ‘the strong ass between two burdens’, we can assign L, the month of rest between sowing and harvest. To Zebulon, ‘among the ships’, belongs the sea-voyage month of N; to Judah (‘lion’s whelp’), the Spring solstice month of F; to Naphta’i, ‘he strove’, the ploughing month, R. And to ‘Little Benjamin their ruler’ belongs New Year’s Day, the day of the Divine Child. When we have assigned to Dan, ‘like a serpent’, the serpentine month of G, we naturally fill the Ng month, which alone remains vacant, with the tribe of Dinah: for Dinah, the female twin of Dan, was another tribe that disappeared early (see Genesis XXXIV), and since the Ng month marks the beginning of the rains and the resumption of the seasonal cycle of growth, a woman naturally belongs there.
我们可以更进一步：借助《创世记》XXIX 和 XXX 中母亲们给各支派起的名字，以及《创世记》XLVIII 和 XLIX 中雅各对各支派的预言性祝福或诅咒，我们可以为每个支派分配一个字母和月份。以法莲（「多结果子」）和玛拿西（「忘记」）是约瑟的两个儿子——约瑟是「多结果子的葡萄藤」——我们可以将 C 和 M 月分配给他们；B 分配给有以东联系的长子流便。流便的四个同母兄弟——迦得（「掠夺之徒」）、利未（「分别出来」）、亚设（「王之佳肴在他的盘中」）和西缅（「血腥之兄，其怒凶猛」）——分别分配 S、H、D 和 T 月。迦得得到谷物诱人成熟时的劫掠月；利未得到 H 月因为它是特殊神圣之月；亚设得到重要的皇家 D 月因为他的名字与阿舍拉（Ashera）——仲夏献祭的笃耨香树林——相关；西缅得到 T 即太阳最凶猛的凶杀之月。以萨迦是「两担之间的强驴」，可以分配 L 即播种与收获之间的休息月。西布伦「在船只中」，属于航海之月 N；犹大（「狮子之崽」）属于春分之月 F；拿弗他利「他 wrestling」，属于犁田之月 R。「小便雅悯他们的统治者」属于新年之日即圣婴之日。将「如蛇一般」的但归于蛇纹石之月 G 后，我们自然将唯一空缺的 Ng 月填入底拿支派：因为底拿——但的女性孪生——是另一个早期消失的支派（见《创世记》XXXIV），既然 Ng 月标志着降雨开始和季节性生长循环的恢复，一个女性自然属于那里。

It combines the words of the Blessing with the traditional meanings of the tribal names and begins with Hercules swaying to and fro in his golden cup.
