For the extra day, Dec. 23rd, which belongs to Benjamin ‘Son of My Right Hand’, that is to say ‘The Ruler of the South’, (since the Sun reaches its most southerly stage in mid-winter) the jewel is amber, which Ezekiel makes the colour of the upper half of Jehovah’s body; the lower half being fire. Benjamin’s tree was either the hyssop, or wild caper, which grows green in walls and crannies and was the prime lustral tree in Hebrew use, or the holy loranthus, which preys on desert tamarisks.
至于额外日12月23日，属于便雅悯即「我右手之子」，也就是「南方统治者」（因为太阳在仲冬达到其最南点），其宝石为琥珀——以西结使之为耶和华上半身之色；下半身为火。便雅悯之树或是牛膝草即野金雀花，它在墙壁和缝隙中常绿，是希伯来用法中首要的净化之树；或是神圣的桑寄生，寄生在沙漠柽柳上。

1 In the North Country ballad of The Wife of Usher’s Well, the dead sons who return in the dead of winter to visit their mother, wear birch leaves in their hats. The author remarks that the tree from which they plucked the leaves grew at the entrance of the Paradise where their souls were housed, which is what one would expect. Presumably they wore birch as a token that they were not earth-bound evil spirits but blessed souls on compassionate leave.
¹ 在北方民谣《厄舍井之妻》中，隆冬时节回来探望母亲的亡子们，帽上插着白桦叶。作者提到他们采摘叶子的树长在他们灵魂栖息的乐园入口处——正如人们所期望的。大概他们佩戴白桦是作为信物，表示他们不是被困在尘世的恶灵，而是蒙恩获假归来的蒙福之魂。



1 Ninib, the Assyrian Saturn, was the god of the South, and therefore of the noon-day Sun, and also of mid-Winter when the Sun attains its most southerly point and halts for a day. In both these capacities he was the god of Repose, for noon is the time for rest in hot climates. That Jehovah was openly identified with Saturn-Ninib in Bethel before the Northern captivity is proved in Amos, V, 26 where the image and star of ‘Succoth-Chiun’ are mentioned as having been brought to the shrine; and that the same was done in Jerusalem before the Southern Captivity is proved by the vision of Ezekiel, VIII, 3, 5 where his image, ‘the image of jealousy’ was set up at the north gate of the Temple, so that devotees would face southwards while adoring him; and close by (verse 14) women were wailing for Adonis.
¹ 尼尼布即亚述的萨图恩，是南方之神，因此也是正午太阳之神，也是仲冬太阳达到最南点并停驻一日时之神。在这两种身份中他都是安息之神，因为在炎热气候中正午是休息之时。耶和华在北方流放前于伯特利被公开等同于萨图恩-尼尼布，证据见《阿摩司书》V, 26，其中提到「苏古特-基云」的像和星被带到神殿；同样在南方流放前耶路撒冷也是如此，证据见《以西结书》VIII, 3, 5 的异象，他的像即「嫉妒之像」被竖立在圣殿北门，使崇拜者面向南方敬拜他；旁边（第14节）有妇女为阿多尼斯哀哭。



1 The cypress occurs in the riddling list of Ecclesiasticus XXIV, 13–17, (I quote the text as restored by Edersheim) where Wisdom describes herself as follows:
¹ 柏树出现在《便西拉智训》XXIV, 13–17 的谜语列表中（我引用埃德沙姆[Edersheim]复原的文本），其中智慧如此描述自己：

I was exalted like a cedar in Lebanon and like a cypress-tree on Mount Hermon.
I was exalted like a cedar in Lebanon and like a cypress-tree on Mount Hermon.（我如黎巴嫩的雪松被高举，如黑门山上的柏树。）



I was exalted like a palm-tree in Engedi and as a rose-tree in Jericho, as an olive in the field, and as a plane-tree.
I was exalted like a palm-tree in Engedi and as a rose-tree in Jericho, as an olive in the field, and as a plane-tree.（我如隐基底棕榈被高举，如耶利哥的玫瑰，如田野的橄榄，如梧桐。）



I exhaled sweet smell like cinnamon and aromatic asphalathus, I diffused a pleasant odour like the best myrrh, like galbanum, onyx and sweet storax, and like the fumes of frankincense.
I exhaled sweet smell like cinnamon and aromatic asphalathus, I diffused a pleasant odour like the best myrrh, like galbanum, onyx and sweet storax, and like the fumes of frankincense.（我散发馨香如肉桂和芳香的甘松，我播散悦人气息如上等没药，如白松香、缟玛瑙和甘苏合香，如乳香的烟。）



Like an oleander [‘turpentine-tree’ in A.V.] I stretched out my branches which are branches of glory and beauty.
Like an oleander [「turpentine-tree」 in A.V.] I stretched out my branches which are branches of glory and beauty.（如夹竹桃[钦定本作「笃耨香树」]我伸展枝条，那是荣耀与美丽的枝条。）



Like a vine I budded forth beauty and my flowers ripen into glory and riches.
Like a vine I budded forth beauty and my flowers ripen into glory and riches.（如葡萄藤我萌发美丽，我的花成熟为荣耀与丰盛。）





Ecclesiasticus has mixed alphabetic trees with aphrodisiac perfumes and trees of another category; but H for cypress and M for vine suggests that the last-mentioned, or only, trees in verses 13, 14, 16 and 17, spell out Chokmah, the Hebrew word for Wisdom: Ched, Kaf, Mem, He. (In Hebrew, vowels are not written.) If this is so, the oleander is CH; and the plane is a surrogate for the almond, K, which as the tree of Wisdom herself cannot figure as a part of the tree-riddle of which it is the answer; in the time of Ecclesiasticus the plane had long been associated by the Greeks with the pursuit of wisdom. The four other trees, cedar, palm, rose and sweet olive, represent respectively sovereignty, motherhood, beauty and fruitfulness – Wisdom’s characteristics as a quasi-goddess.
《便西拉智训》将字母树与催情香料和另一类树木混杂在一起；但 H 代表柏树、M 代表葡萄藤暗示第13、14、16和17节中最后提到的或唯一的树木拼出 Chokmah——希伯来语「智慧」一词：Ched、Kaf、Mem、He。（希伯来语中不写元音。）如果确实如此，夹竹桃是 CH；梧桐是杏仁 K 的替身——因为作为智慧之树本身的杏仁不能作为其答案的树谜的一部分出现；在《便西拉智训》时代，梧桐早已被希腊人与追求智慧联系在一起。其他四种树——雪松、棕榈、玫瑰和甜橄榄——分别代表主权、母性、美丽和丰产——智慧作为准女神的特征。



1 The tradition of Nennius’s Seven Ages has survived in an English folk-saying which runs:
¹ 南尼乌斯七纪元的传统保存在一句英国民间谚语中：

The lives of three wattles, the life of a hound;
The lives of three wattles, the life of a hound;（三道篱笆之寿，一猎犬之寿；）



The lives of three hounds, the life of a steed;
The lives of three hounds, the life of a steed;（三猎犬之寿，一骏马之寿；）



The lives of three steeds, the life of a man;
The lives of three steeds, the life of a man;（三骏马之寿，一人之寿；）



The lives of three men, the life of an eagle;
The lives of three men, the life of an eagle;（三人之寿，一鹰之寿；）



The lives of three eagles, the life of a yew;
The lives of three eagles, the life of a yew;（三鹰之寿，一紫杉之寿；）



The life of a yew, the length of a ridge;
The life of a yew, the length of a ridge;（一紫杉之寿，一山脊之长；）



Seven ridges from Creation to Doom.
Seven ridges from Creation to Doom.（七山脊从创世到末日。）





A wattle (hurdle) lasts for three years: therefore a hound for 9, a horse for 27, a man for 81, an eagle for 243 and a yew for 729. ‘The length of a ridge’ is evidently a mistake, the saying being translated from monkish Latin aevum, age, miscopied as arvum, ridge. With the length of an Age averaging 729 years, the total length of the seven Ages is 5103, which corresponds well enough with Nennius’s account.
一道篱笆（hurdle）能用三年：因此猎犬9年、马27年、人81年、鹰243年、紫杉729年。「一山脊之长」显然是误传，这句谚语译自修士拉丁语 aevum（纪元），被误抄为 arvum（山脊）。以每纪元平均729年计，七纪元总长5103年，与南尼乌斯的记述足够吻合。





Chapter Sixteen

title: 第十六章
content:
THE HOLY UNSPEAKABLE NAME OF GOD
上帝的神圣不可名之名





The Ogham Craobh, which is printed in Ledwich’s Antiquities of Ireland and attested by an alphabetic inscription at Callen, County Clare, Ireland, ascribed to 295 AD, runs as follows:
欧甘·克劳（Ogham Craobh）载于莱德维奇的《爱尔兰古物志》，并由爱尔兰克莱尔郡卡伦的一处公元295年的字母铭文所证实，其排列如下：

B L N T S

B D T C Q

M G Ng Z R





This is the ordinary Ogham alphabet as given by Macalister; except that where one would expect F and H it has T and B – the very consonants which occur mysteriously in Hyginus’s account of the seven original letters invented by the Three Fates. There was evidently a taboo at Callen on the F and H – T and B had to be used instead; and it looks as if just the same thing had happened in the 15-consonant Greek alphabet known to Hyginus, and that he refrained from specifying Palamedes’s contribution of eleven consonants because he did not wish to call attention to the recurrence of B and T.
这是马卡利斯特给出的普通欧甘字母表；只是在本应有 F 和 H 的位置上却是 T 和 B——恰好是希吉努斯记述的命运三女神所发明的七个原始字母中神秘出现的辅音。卡伦显然对 F 和 H 存在禁忌——必须用 T 和 B 代替；希吉努斯所知的十五辅音希腊字母表似乎也发生了同样的事情，他避免具体说明帕拉墨得斯贡献的十一个辅音，因为他不想引起人们对 B 和 T 再次出现的注意。

If so, the Palamedes alphabet can be reconstructed as follows in the Ogham order:
如果如此，帕拉墨得斯字母表可以按欧甘顺序重构如下：

B L N F S

H D T C

M G [Ng] R





There is no warrant for Ng in Greek, so I have enclosed it in square brackets, but it must be remembered that the original Pelasgians talked a non-Greek Language. This had nearly died out by the fifth century BC but, according to Herodotus, survived in at least one of the oracles of Apollo, that of Apollo Ptous, which was in Boeotian territory. He records that a certain Mys, sent by the son-in-law of King Darius of Persia to consult the Greek oracles, was attended by three Boeotian priests with triangular writing tablets. The priestess made her reply in a barbarous tongue which Mys, snatching a tablet from one of the priests, copied down. It proved to be in the Carian dialect, which Mys understood, being a ‘European’, that is to say of Cretan extraction – Europë, daughter of Agenor, having ridden to Crete from Phoenicia on the back of a bull. If Cretan was, as is probable, a Hamitic language it may well have had Ng at place 14. Ng is not part of the Greek alphabet and Dr. Macalister points out that even in Old Goidelic no word began with Ng, and that such words as ngomair, and ngetal which occur in the Ogham alphabets as the names of the Ng letter are wholly artificial forms of gomair and getal. But in Hamitic languages the initial Ng is common, as a glance at the map of Africa will show.
希腊语中没有 Ng 的依据，因此我用方括号标出，但必须记住原始的佩拉斯吉人说的是一种非希腊语。这种语言到公元前五世纪已近消亡，但据希罗多德记载，它至少在阿波罗的一个神谕——彼奥提亚境内的阿波罗·普托斯（Ptous）神谕——中存续。他记录说波斯大流士王的女婿派来咨询希腊神谕的密司由三名彼奥提亚祭司陪同，携带着三角书写板。女祭司以一种蛮语作出回答，密司从一名祭司手中夺过书写板记下。结果证明是卡里亚方言——密司能懂，因为他是「欧罗巴人」，即克里特血统——欧罗巴，阿革诺耳之女，骑牛从腓尼基到了克里特。如果克里特语如推测那样是含语系语言，很可能在第14位有 Ng。Ng 不是希腊字母表的一部分，马卡利斯特博士指出即使在古戈伊德尔语中也没有以 Ng 开头的词，欧甘字母表中作为 Ng 字母名出现的 ngomair 和 ngetal 等完全是 gomair 和 getal 的人造形式。但在含语系语言中，词首 Ng 很常见，看一眼非洲地图便知。

The existence of this dubious Pelasgian letter Ng, which had not been borrowed by the makers of the Cadmean alphabet, may explain the uncertainty of ‘twelve, or some say thirteen letters’ ascribed by Diodorus Siculus to the Pelasgian alphabet; and may also explain why Ng in the middle of a word was in Greek spelt GG, as Aggelos for Angelos, G being the letter which immediately precedes Ng in the Beth-Luis-Nion. Yet from the analogy of the Beth-Luis-Nion it may be suspected that the Palamedes alphabet contained two secret letters which brought the number up to fifteen. The Latin alphabet at any rate was originally a 15-consonant one, with 5 vowels, and was probably arranged by ‘Carmenta’ as follows:
这个可疑的佩拉斯吉字母 Ng 的存在——卡德摩斯字母表的制造者未曾借用——可能解释了狄奥多鲁斯·西库鲁斯归给佩拉斯吉字母表的「十二个，或有人说十三个字母」的不确定性；也可能解释为什么希腊语中词中的 Ng 拼为 GG，如 Aggelos 代替 Angelos——G 是贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中紧接在 Ng 之前的字母。然而从贝斯-路易斯-尼恩的类比可以推测，帕拉墨得斯字母表包含两个秘密字母，使总数达到十五。拉丁字母表无论如何最初是十五辅音加五元音的，可能由「卡门塔」如此排列：

B L F S N

H D T C Q

M G Ng P R





For the Romans continued to use the Ng sound at the beginning of words in Republican times – they even spelt natus as gnatus, and navus (‘diligent’) as gnavus – and probably pronounced it like the gn in the middle of such French words as Catalogne and seigneur.
因为罗马人在共和时期继续在词首使用 Ng 音——他们甚至将 natus 拼作 gnatus，navus（「勤勉的」）拼作 gnavus——可能发音类似法语 Catalogne 和 seigneur 中间的 gn。

It looks as if Epicharmus was the Greek who invented the early form of the Cadmean alphabet mentioned by Diodorus as consisting of sixteen consonants, namely the thirteen of the Palamedes alphabet as given above, less the Ng; plus Zeta, and Pi as a substitute for Koppa (Q); plus Chi and Theta. But only two letters are ascribed to Epicharmus by Hyginus; and these are given in the most reputable MSS. as Chi and Theta. So Pi (or Koppa) and Zeta are likely to have been concealed letters of the Palamedes alphabet, as Quert and Straif are concealed letters of the Beth-Luis-Nion; not mentioned by Hyginus because they were merely doubled C and S.
看起来厄皮卡穆斯是发明了狄奥多鲁斯所提到的早期卡德摩斯字母表形式的希腊人——该表由十六个辅音组成，即上述帕拉墨得斯字母表的十三个减去 Ng；加上 Zeta 和 Pi（替代 Koppa[Q]）；再加上 Chi 和 Theta。但希吉努斯只将两个字母归于厄皮卡穆斯；在最可靠的抄本中它们是 Chi 和 Theta。因此 Pi（或 Koppa）和 Zeta 很可能是帕拉墨得斯字母表中的隐匿字母，如同奎尔特和斯特拉伊夫是贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中的隐匿字母；希吉努斯未提及它们，因为它们不过是加倍的 C 和 S。

We know that Simonides then removed the H aspirate and also the F, Digamma, which was replaced by Phi, and added Psi and Xi and two vowels – long E, Eta, to which he assigned the character of H aspirate, and long O, Omega; which brought the total number of letters up to twenty-four.
我们知道西摩尼德斯随后移除了 H 送气音以及 F（Digamma）——后者被 Phi 取代——并添加了 Psi 和 Xi 以及两个元音：长 E 即 Eta（他赋予其 H 送气音的字符）和长 O 即 Omega；这使得总字母数达到二十四个。



All these alphabets seem to be carefully designed sacred alphabets, not selective Greek transcriptions of the commercial Phoenician alphabet of twenty-six letters as scratched on the Formello-Cervetri vases. One virtue of the Epicharmian alphabet lay in its having sixteen consonants – sixteen being the number of increase – and twenty-one letters in all, twenty-one being a number sacred to the Sun since the time of the Pharaoh Akhenaton who introduced into Egypt about the year 1415 BC the monotheistic cult of the sun’s disc. Epicharmus, as an Asclepiad, was descended from the Sun.
所有这些字母表似乎都是精心设计的神圣字母表，而非从福尔梅洛-切尔韦特里陶器上刻的二十六字母商业腓尼基字母表中选择性转录的希腊版本。厄皮卡穆斯字母表的一个优点在于它有十六个辅音——十六是增长之数——总共二十一个字母，二十一是自法老阿肯纳顿约公元前1415年在埃及引入太阳盘一神崇拜以来 sacred 于太阳的数字。厄皮卡穆斯作为阿斯克勒庇亚德家族成员，是太阳的后裔。

It must be noted that Simonides’s new consonants were artificial ones – previously Xi had been spelt chi-sigma and Psi, pi-sigma – and that there was no real need for them compared, for instance, with the need of new letters to distinguish long from short A, and long from short I. I suspect Simonides of having composed a secret alphabetical charm consisting of the familiar letter-names of the Greek alphabet arranged with the vowels and consonants together, in three eight-letter parts, each letter suggesting a word of the charm; for example xi, psi might stand for xiphon psilon, ‘a naked sword’. Unfortunately the abbreviations of most of the Greek letter names are too short for this guess to be substantiated; it is only an occasional letter, like lambda, which seems to stand for lampada (‘torches’) and sigma, which seems to stand for sigmos (‘a hissing for silence’), that hints at the secret.
必须注意，西摩尼德斯的新辅音是人为的——此前 Xi 拼作 chi-sigma，Psi 拼作 pi-sigma——与区分长 A 和短 A、长 I 和短 I 的新字母的需求相比，并无真正的需要。我怀疑西摩尼德斯编了一首秘密字母咒语，由希腊字母表中人们熟悉的字母名排列而成，元音和辅音放在一起，分为三个八字部分，每个字母暗示咒语中的一个词；例如 xi、psi 可能代表 xiphon psilon，「一把裸剑」。可惜大多数希腊字母名的缩写太短，无法证实这一猜测；只有偶尔的字母如 lambda 似乎代表 lampada（「火炬」），sigma 似乎代表 sigmos（「嘶声示静」），暗示着这个秘密。

But can we guess why Simonides removed F and H from the alphabet? And why Hyginus the Spaniard and the author of the Irish Callen inscription used B and T as cipher disguises for these same two letters? We can begin by noting that the Etruscan calendar, which the Romans adopted during the Republic, was arranged in nundina, or eight-day periods, in Greek called ‘ogdoads’ and that the Roman Goddess of Wisdom, Minerva, had 5 (written V) as her sacred numeral. We can identify Minerva with Carmenta, because she was generally credited at Rome with the invention of the arts and sciences and because flower-decorated boats, probably made of alder wood, were sailed on her festival, the Quinquatria. ‘Quinquatrid’ means ‘the five halls’, presumably five seasons of the year, and was celebrated five days after the Spring New Year feast of the Calendar Goddess Anna Perenna; this suggests that the five days were those left over when the year had been divided into five seasons of 72 days each, the sanctity of the five and the seventy-two having been similarly established in the Beth-Luis-Nion system.
但我们能否猜到西摩尼德斯为何从字母表中移除 F 和 H？以及为何西班牙人希吉努斯和爱尔兰卡伦铭文的作者使用 B 和 T 作为这两个字母的密码伪装？我们可以先注意到罗马人采用伊特鲁里亚历法——在共和国期间——以 nundina 即八天周期排列，希腊语称为「ogdoads」；而罗马智慧女神密涅瓦以 5（写作 V）为神圣数字。我们可以将密涅瓦等同于卡门塔，因为她在罗马通常被认为发明了各种艺术和科学，而且在她节日昆夸特里亚上行驶着装饰花卉的船——可能是桤木制的。「Quinquatrid」意为「五厅」，大概是五个季节，在历法女神安娜·佩伦娜的春季新年节后五天庆祝；这暗示这五天是将一年分为五个各72天的季节后剩余的天数，五和七十二的神圣性在贝斯-路易斯-尼恩系统中同样被确立。

An alphabet-calendar arranged on this principle, with the vowels kept apart from the consonants, implies a 360-day year of five vowel-seasons, each of 72 days, with five days left over; each season being divided into three periods each consisting of twenty-four days. The 360-day year can also be divided, in honour of the Triple Goddess, into three 120-day seasons each containing five periods of equal length, namely twenty-four days – with the same five days over; and this is the year that was in public use in Egypt. The Egyptians said that the five days were those which the God Thoth (Hermes or Mercury) won at draughts from the Moon-goddess Isis, composed of the seventy-second parts of every day in the year; and the birthdays of Osiris, Horus, Set, Isis and Nephthys were celebrated on them in this order. The mythic sense of the legend is that a change of religion necessitated a change of calendar: that the old Moon-goddess year of 364 days with one day over was succeeded by a year of 360 days with five over, and that in the new system the first three periods of the year were allotted to Osiris, Horus and Set, and the last two to Isis and Nephthys. Though, under Assyrian influence, each of the three Egyptian seasons was divided into four periods of 30 days, not five of 24, the 72-day season occurs in the Egypto-Byblian myth that the Goddess Isis hid her child Horus, or Harpocrates, from the rage of the ass-eared Sun-god Set during the 72 hottest days of the year, namely the third of the five seasons, which was astronomically ruled by the Dog Sirius and the two Asses. (The hiding of the Child Horus seems to have been assisted by the Lapwing, a bird much used in the Etruscan science of augury which the Romans borrowed; at any rate, Pliny twice mentions in his Natural History that the Lapwing disappears completely between the rising of Sirius and its setting.) But here the argument must be held up by a discussion of Set and his worship.
按此原则排列的字母-历法——元音与辅音分开——意味着一个360天年，由五个各72天的元音季节组成，余五天；每个季节分为三个各二十四天的时期。360天年也可按三重女神之意分为三个各120天的季节，每季包含五个等长时期即二十四天——同样余五天；这是埃及公开使用的年。埃及人说这五天是托特神（赫尔墨斯或墨丘利）在骰子游戏中从月女神伊西斯那里赢来的，由一年每一天的七十二分之一组成；奥西里斯、荷鲁斯、塞特、伊西斯和涅芙蒂斯的生日依次在这五天中庆祝。这个传说的神话意义是：宗教的变更 necessitated 历法的变更：旧的月女神364天年余一天的体系被360天年余五天的体系取代，在新体系中年的前三个时期分配给奥西里斯、荷鲁斯和塞特，后两个分配给伊西斯和涅芙蒂斯。虽然在亚述影响下，埃及三个季节各分为四个30天时期而非五个24天时期，但72天季节出现在埃及-比布洛斯神话中——女神伊西斯在一年最热的72天中即五个季节中的第三个（天文上由天狼星和两头驴主宰）将孩子荷鲁斯即哈波克拉忒斯藏在驴耳太阳神塞特的暴怒之外。（藏匿婴儿荷鲁斯似乎得到了凤头麦鸡的协助，这种鸟在罗马人借用的伊特鲁里亚占卜术中被大量使用；至少老普林尼在《博物志》中两次提到凤头麦鸡在天狼星升起和落下之间完全消失。）但这里的论证必须暂停，先讨论塞特及其崇拜。

The Greek legend that the God Dionysus placed the Asses in the Sign of Cancer (‘the Crab’) suggests that the Dionysus who visited Egypt and was entertained by Proteus King of Pharos was Osiris, brother of the Hyksos god Typhon, alias Set. The Hyksos people, non-Semitic pastoralists, coming from Armenia or beyond, pressed down through Cappadocia, Syria and Palestine into Egypt about the year 1780 BC. That they managed so easily to establish themselves in Northern Egypt with their capital at Pelusium, on the Canopic arm of the Nile Delta, can be accounted for only by an alliance with the Byblians of Phoenicia. Byblos, a protectorate of Egypt from very early times, was the ‘Land of Negu’ (‘Trees’) from which the Egyptians imported timber, and a cylinder seal of the Old Empire shows Adonis, the God of Byblos, in company with the horned Moon-goddess Isis, or Hathor, or Astarte. The Byblians who, with the Cretans, managed the Egyptian carrying-trade – the Egyptians hated the sea – had trading stations at Pelusium and elsewhere in Lower Egypt from very early times. To judge from the Homeric legend of King Proteus, the earliest Pelasgian settlers in the Delta used Pharos, the lighthouse island off what afterwards became Alexandria, as their sacred oracular island. Proteus, the oracular Old Man of the Sea, who was King of Pharos and lived in a cave – where Menelaus consulted him – had the power of changing his shape, like Merddin, Dionysus, Atabyrius, Llew Llaw, Periclymenus and all Sun-heroes of the same sort. Evidently Pharos was his Isle of Avalon. That Apuleius connects the sistrum of Osiris, used to frighten away the God Set, with Pharos suggests that Proteus and Osiris were there regarded as the same person. Proteus, according to Virgil, had another sacred island, Carpathus, between Crete and Rhodes; but that was the Thessalian Proteus. Another Proteus, spelt Proetus, was an Arcadian.
希腊传说中狄俄尼索斯神将驴置于巨蟹宫（「螃蟹」）的星座中，暗示访问埃及并被法罗斯岛国王普罗透斯款待的狄俄尼索斯就是奥西里斯——喜克索斯神提丰即塞特的兄弟。喜克索斯人——非闪族牧民——来自亚美尼亚或更远的地方，约公元前1780年经卡帕多西亚、叙利亚和巴勒斯坦南下进入埃及。他们能如此轻易地在北埃及以培琉喜阿姆（尼罗河三角洲卡诺皮克支流上）为都建立统治，只能以与腓尼基比布洛斯人的联盟来解释。比布洛斯很早以来就是埃及的保护国，是埃及人进口木材的「树木之地」（Negu），一件古王国的圆柱印章上描绘了比布洛斯之神阿多尼斯与角月女神伊西斯即哈托尔或阿斯塔尔特在一起。比布洛斯人与克里特人一起经营埃及的运输贸易——埃及人厌恶海洋——很早就在培琉喜阿姆和下埃及其他地方设有贸易站。从荷马的普罗透斯王传说来看，最早在三角洲定居的佩拉斯吉人将法罗斯——后来的亚历山大港附近的灯塔岛——用作他们的神圣神谕岛。普罗透斯即海中神谕老人，是法罗斯之王，住在一个洞穴中——墨涅拉俄斯曾向他咨询——有变形之力，如默丁丁、狄俄尼索斯、阿塔比里乌斯、卢·劳及佩里克吕墨诺斯等所有同类太阳英雄。显然法罗斯是他的阿瓦隆岛。阿普列尤斯将用来驱赶塞特神的奥西里斯摇铃（sistrum）与法罗斯联系起来，暗示普罗透斯和奥西里斯在那里被视为同一人。据维吉尔说，普罗透斯还有另一个神圣岛屿——克里特和罗得岛之间的卡尔帕索斯；但那是色萨利的普罗透斯。另一个拼作 Proetus 的普罗透斯是阿卡迪亚人。

It would be a great mistake to think of Pharos as a secluded sacred island inhabited only by the attendants of the oracle: when Menelaus came there with his ships he was entering the largest port in the Mediterranean.1 Gaston Jondet in his Les ports submergés de l’ancienne Île de Pharos (1916) has established the existence here even in pre-Hellenic times of a vast system of harbour-works, now submerged, exceeding in extent the island itself. They consisted of an inner basin covering 150 acres and an outer basin of about half that area, the massive sea-walls, jetties and quays being constructed of enormous stones, some of them weighing six tons. The work seems to have been carried out towards the end of the third millennium BC by Egyptian labour according to plans submitted to the local authorities by Cretan or Phoenician marine architects. The wide landing-quay at the entrance to the port consisted of rough blocks, some of them sixteen feet long, deeply grooved with a chequer-work of pentagons. Since pentagons are inconvenient figures for a chequer, compared with squares and hexagons, the number five must have had some important religious significance. Was Pharos the centre of a five-season calendar system?
将法罗斯想象为一个仅有神谕侍者居住的僻静神圣之岛将是大错：墨涅拉俄斯率船队来到这里时，他进入的是地中海最大的港口。¹ 加斯东·容代在其《古代法罗斯岛沉没的港口》（1916）中确证了即使在希腊化之前的时代，这里就存在一个如今已沉没的庞大港口工程系统，规模超过岛屿本身。它由一个150英亩的内港和约一半面积的外港组成，巨大的防波堤、栈桥和码头由巨石构筑，其中一些重达六吨。这项工程似乎在公元前三千年末期由埃及劳动力按照克里特或腓尼基海军建筑师提交给当地当局的方案完成。港口入口处宽阔的登陆栈桥由粗石块组成，其中一些长达十六英尺，深深刻有五边形棋盘格纹。既然五边形与方形和六边形相比不适合做棋盘格，数字五必有其重要的宗教意义。法罗斯是否是一个五季节历法系统的中心？

The island was oddly connected with the numbers five and seventy-two at the beginning of the Christian era: the Jews of Alexandria used to visit the island for an annual (five-day?) festival, the excuse for which was that the Five Books of Moses had been miraculously translated there into Greek by seventy-two doctors of the Law (‘the Septuagint’) who had worked for seventy-two days on them, each apart from the rest, and agreed exactly in their renderings at the conclusion of their task. There is something behind this myth. All similar festivals in the ancient world commemorated some ancient tribal treaty or act of confederacy. What the occasion here was remains obscure, unless the Pharaoh who married Sarah, the goddess mother of the ‘Abraham’ tribe that visited Egypt at the close of the third millennium, was the priest-king of Pharos. If so, the festival would be a record of the sacred marriage by which the ancestors of the Hebrews joined the great confederacy of the Peoples of the Sea, whose strongest base was Pharos. Hebrews seem to have been in continuous residence in Lower Egypt for the next two millennia, and the meaning of the festival would have been forgotten by the time that the Pentateuch was translated into Greek.
在公元初，法罗斯岛与数字五和七十二有奇特的联系：亚历山大犹太人每年到岛上进行一次（五天？）节日活动，借口是摩西五经曾在此奇迹般地被七十二位律法博士译为希腊文（「七十士译本」），他们各自独立工作了七十二天，结束时译文完全一致。这个神话背后有隐情。古代世界所有类似节日都纪念某种古老的部落条约或结盟行为。这里的场合是什么仍然模糊，除非娶撒拉——在公元前三千年末访问埃及的「亚伯拉罕」部落的女神母亲——的法老就是法罗斯的祭司王。如果是这样，节日将是神圣婚姻的记录，希伯来人的祖先由此加入了海上民族大联盟，其最强大的基地就是法罗斯。此后两千年中希伯来人似乎持续居住在下埃及，节日的含义在五经被译为希腊文时早已被遗忘。

In the Odyssey, which is a popular romance not at all to be depended on for mythical detail, Proteus’s transformations are described as lion, serpent, panther, boar, water, fire and leafy tree. This is a mixed list,1 reminding one of Gwion’s deliberately muddled ‘I have been’s’. The boar is the symbol of the G month; lion and serpent are seasonal symbols; the panther is a mythical beast half-leopard, half-lion, sacred to Dionysus. It is a pity that Homer does not particularize the leafy tree; its association here with water and fire suggests the alder, or cornel-tree, as sacred to Proteus, a god of the Bran type – though in the story Proteus is degraded to a mere herdsman of seals in the service of the Ash-god Poseidon.
在《奥德赛》——一部通俗传奇，完全不能依赖其神话细节——中，普罗透斯的变形被描述为狮子、蛇、豹、野猪、水、火和茂盛的树。这是一个混杂的列表，¹ 让人想起格维翁故意搅混的「我曾为」序列。野猪是 G 月的象征；狮子和蛇是季节象征；豹是半豹半狮的神话之兽，sacred 于狄俄尼索斯。可惜荷马没有具体说明那棵茂盛的树；它与水和火的关联暗示桤木或山茱萸，sacred 于普罗透斯——一个布兰类型的神——尽管在故事中普罗透斯被降格为梣神波塞冬麾下的海豹牧人。

The Nile is called Ogygian by Aeschylus, and Eustathius the Byzantine grammarian says that Ogygia was the earliest name for Egypt. This suggests that the Island of Ogygia ruled over by Calypso daughter of Atlas, was really Pharos where Proteus, alias Atlas or ‘The Sufferer’, had an oracular shrine. Pharos commanded the mouth of the Nile, and Greek sailors would talk of ‘sailing to Ogygia’ rather than ‘sailing to Egypt’; it often happens that a small island used as a trading depot gives its name to a whole province – Bombay is a useful example. The waters of Styx are also called Ogygian by Hesiod; not (as Liddell and Scott suggest) because Ogygian meant vaguely ‘primeval’, but because the head-waters were at Lusi, the seat of the three oracular daughters of Proetus, who is apparently the same cult-character as Proteus.
埃斯库罗斯称尼罗河为奥吉吉安（Ogygian），拜占庭语法学家尤斯塔修斯说奥吉吉亚是埃及最早的名字。这暗示由阿特拉斯之女卡吕普索统治的奥吉吉亚岛实际上就是法罗斯——普罗透斯即阿特拉斯或「受苦者」在那里有神谕神殿。法罗斯控制着尼罗河河口，希腊水手会说「驶向奥吉吉亚」而非「驶向埃及」；一个用作贸易站的小岛给整个省份命名的情况并不罕见——孟买就是一个有用的例子。赫西俄德也称斯堤克斯之水为奥吉吉安；并非（如利德尔和斯科特所建议的）因为奥吉吉安含糊地意为「原始的」，而是因为源头在卢西——普罗透斯三个神谕女儿所在地——普罗透斯显然与普罗透斯是同一崇拜角色。

When the Byblians first brought their Syrian Tempest-god to Egypt, the one who, disguised as a boar, yearly killed his brother Adonis, the god always born under a fir-tree, they identified him with Set, the ancient Egyptian god of the desert whose sacred beast was the wild ass, and who yearly destroyed his brother Osiris, the god of the Nile vegetation. This must be what Sanchthoniatho the Phoenician, in a fragment preserved by Philo, means when he says that the mysteries of Phoenicia were brought to Egypt. He reports that the two first inventors of the human race, Upsouranios and his brother Ousous consecrated two pillars, to fire and wind – presumably the Jachin and Boaz pillars representing Adonis, god of the waxing year and the new-born sun, and Typhon, god of the waning year and of destructive winds. The Hyksos Kings under Byblian influence, similarly converted their Tempest-god into Set, and his new brother, the Hyksos Osiris, alias Adonis, alias Dionysus, paid a courtesy call on his Pelasgian counterpart, Proteus King of Pharos.
当比布洛斯人首次将他们的叙利亚暴风神带到埃及时——那位化身为野猪每年杀死兄弟阿多尼斯、在冷杉树下诞生的神——他们将他等同于塞特，即古老的埃及沙漠之神，其神圣之兽是野驴，每年毁灭他的兄弟奥西里斯即尼罗河植被之神。这必定是腓尼基人桑乔尼亚松在斐洛保存的残篇中所说的腓尼基密仪被带到埃及的含义。他报告说人类最初的两位发明家乌苏拉尼奥斯及其兄弟乌苏斯竖立了两根柱子——献给火和风——大概是代表阿多尼斯（渐年之神和新生的太阳）和提丰（渐年之神和毁灭之风）的雅斤和波阿斯柱。喜克索斯王在比布洛斯影响下，同样将他们的暴风神转化为塞特，而他的新兄弟——喜克索斯的奥西里斯即阿多尼斯即狄俄尼索斯——礼节性地拜访了他在佩拉斯吉的对应者法罗斯王普罗透斯。

In pre-dynastic times Set must have been the chief of all the gods of Egypt, since the sign of royalty which all the dynastic gods carried was Set’s ass-eared reed sceptre. But he had declined in importance before the Hyksos revived his worship at Pelusium, and reverted to obscurity after they were thrown out of Egypt about two hundred years later by the Pharaohs of the 18th Dynasty.1 The Egyptians identified him with the long-eared constellation Orion, ‘Lord of the Chambers of the South’, and ‘the Breath of Set’ was the South wind from the deserts which, then as now, caused a wave of criminal violence in Egypt, Libya and Southern Europe whenever it blew. The cult of ass-eared Set in Southern Judaea is proved by Apion’s account of the golden ass-mask of Edomite Dora, captured by King Alexander Jannaeus and cleverly stolen back again from Jerusalem by one Zabidus. The ass occurs in many of the more obviously iconotropic anecdotes of Genesis and the early historical books of the Bible: Saul chosen as king when in search of Kish’s lost asses; the ass that was with Abraham when he was about to sacrifice Isaac; the ass whose jawbone Samson used against the Philistines; the ass of Balaam with its human voice. Moreover, Jacob’s uncle Ishmael son of Hagar with his twelve sons is described in Genesis, XVI, 12 as a wild ass among men: this suggests a religious confederacy of thirteen goddess-worshipping tribes of the Southern desert, under the leadership of a tribe dedicated to Set. Ishmael perhaps means ‘the beloved man’, the Goddess’s favourite.
在前王朝时代，塞特必定曾是埃及所有神的首领，因为所有王朝神祇所持的王权标志是塞特的驴耳芦苇权杖。但在喜克索斯人在培琉喜阿姆复兴其崇拜之前，他已衰落，在约两百年后被第十八王朝法老逐出埃及后重归湮没无闻。¹ 埃及人将他等同于长耳星座猎户座——「南方诸室之主」，「塞特之息」是从沙漠吹来的南风，当时如同现在一样，每当它吹起就在埃及、利比亚和南欧引发犯罪暴力浪潮。驴耳塞特在南犹大的崇拜由阿皮翁关于以东人多拉的黄金驴面具的记述所证实——该面具被亚历山大·詹纳乌斯王夺取，又被一个叫扎比杜斯的人巧妙地从耶路撒冷偷回。驴出现在《创世记》和《圣经》早期历史书许多更明显的圣像倒置轶事中：扫罗在寻找基士丢失的驴时被选为王；亚伯拉罕即将献祭以撒时身旁的驴；参孙用来对付非利士人的驴颚骨；巴兰的驴开口说人话。此外，雅各的叔叔以实玛利——夏甲之子——及其十二子在《创世记》XVI, 12 中被描述为「人群中如野驴一般」：这暗示南沙漠中十三个崇拜女神的部落的宗教联盟，以一个 dedicated 于塞特的部落为首。以实玛利大概意为「被爱的人」，即女神的宠儿。

The legend of Midas the Phrygian and the ass’s ears confirms this association of Dionysus and Set, for Midas, son of the Mother Goddess, was a devotee of Dionysus. The legend is plainly an iconotropic one and Midas has been confidently identified with Mita, King of the Moschians, or Mushki, a people from Thrace – originally from Pontus – who broke the power of the Hittites about the year 1200 BC when they captured Pteria the Hittite capital. Mita was a dynastic name and is said to have meant ‘seed’ in the Orphic language; Herodotus mentions certain rose-gardens of Midas on Mount Bermios in Macedonia, planted before the Moschian invasion of Asia Minor. It is likely that their Greek name Moschoi, ‘calf-men’, refers to their cult of the Spirit of the Year as a bull-calf: a golden calf like that which the Israelites claimed to have brought them safely out of Egypt.
弗里吉亚的弥达斯和驴耳的传说证实了狄俄尼索斯与塞特的关联，因为弥达斯——母女神之子——是狄俄尼索斯的信徒。这个传说明显是圣像倒置的，弥达斯已被确认为摩斯奇人（或穆什基人）之王米塔——一个来自色雷斯（最初来自本都）的民族，约公元前1200年攻占赫梯都城普特里亚时击碎了赫梯的力量。米塔是王朝名，据说在俄耳甫斯语中意为「种子」；希罗多德提到弥达斯在马其顿贝尔米奥斯山上的玫瑰园——种植于摩斯奇人入侵小亚细亚之前。他们的希腊名字 Moschoi，「犊人」，可能指他们对年之灵作为牛犊的崇拜：一头金牛犊，如以色列人声称将他们安全带出埃及的那头。

That no record has survived in Egypt of a five-season year concurrent with the three-season one, is no proof that it was not in popular use among the devotees of Osiris. For that matter absolutely no official Pharaonic record has been found in Egypt of the construction, or even the existence, of the port of Pharos though it commanded the mouths of the Nile, controlled the South-Eastern terminus of the Mediterranean sea-routes, and was in active use for at least a thousand years. Osiris worship was the popular religion in the Delta from pre-dynastic times, but it had no official standing. Egyptian texts and pictorial records are notorious for their suppression or distortion of popular beliefs. Even the Book of the Dead, which passes for popular, seldom expresses the true beliefs of the Osirian masses: the aristocratic priests of the Established Church had begun to tamper with the popular myth as early as 2800 BC. One of the most important elements in Osirianism, tree-worship, was not officialized until about 300 BC, under the Macedonian Ptolemies. In the Book of the Dead many primitive beliefs have been iconotropically suppressed. For instance, at the close of the Twelfth Hour of Darkness, when Osiris’ sun-boat approaches the last gateway of the Otherworld before its reemergence into the light of day, the god is pictured bent backwards in the form of a hoop with his hands raised and his toes touching the back of his head. This is explained as ‘Osiris whose circuit is the Otherworld’: which means that by adopting this acrobatic posture he is defining the Otherworld as a circular region behind the ring of mountains that surround the ordinary world, and thus making the Twelve Hours analogous with the Twelve Signs of the Zodiac. Here an ingenious priestly notion has clearly been superimposed on an earlier popular icon: Osiris captured by his rival Set and tied, like Ixion or Cuchulain, in the five-fold bond that joined wrists, neck and ankles together. ‘Osiris whose circuit is the Otherworld’ is also the economical way of identifying the god with the snake Ophion, coiled around the habitable earth, a symbol of universal fertility out of death.
埃及没有五季节年与三季节年并存的记录，这并不能证明五季节年未在奥西里斯信徒中民间使用。就此而言，虽然法罗斯港控制着尼罗河口、掌握地中海航线的东南终点、活跃使用了至少一千年，但埃及方面完全没有关于其建造甚至存在的官方法老记录。奥西里斯崇拜从前王朝时代起就是三角洲的大众宗教，但没有官方地位。埃及文献和图像记录因压制或扭曲民间信仰而臭名昭著。即使是《死者之书》——被视为大众之作——也很少表达奥西里斯信众的真实信仰：国教的贵族祭司早在公元前2800年就开始篡改民间神话了。奥西里斯崇拜中最重要的元素之一——树木崇拜——直到约公元前300年才在马其顿托勒密王朝治下被官方化。在《死者之书》中许多原始信仰被以圣像倒置法压制。例如，在黑暗第十二时之末，当奥西里斯的太阳船接近冥界最后一个门即将重新出现在日光中时，神被描绘为向后弯曲成环形，双手举起，脚趾触及后脑。这被解释为「奥西里斯其巡回即冥界」：意为通过采取这种杂技姿态，他将冥界定义为环绕普通世界的山脉圈背后的圆形区域，从而使十二时类比于黄道十二宫。这里一个巧妙的祭司概念明显被叠加在更早的民间圣像之上：奥西里斯被对手塞特俘虏并如伊克西翁或库丘林一样被五花大绑——将手腕、脖颈和脚踝连在一起的五重束缚。「巡回即冥界的奥西里斯」也是将该神等同于盘绕人居世界的蛇奥菲翁的经济方式——死亡中孕育普遍丰产的象征。

Gwion’s ‘Ercwlf’ (Hercules) evidently used the three-season year when he laid his ‘four pillars of equal height’, the Boibel-Loth, in order [see overleaf]. The vowels represent the five extra days, the entrance to the year, and the lintel and two pillars each represent 120 days. But Q and Z have no months of their own in the Beth-Luis-Nion and their occurrence as twenty-four day periods in the second part of the Boibel-Loth year makes Tinne, not Duir as in the Beth-Luis-Nion, the central, that is the ruling, letter. Tinnus, or Tannus, becomes the chief god, as in Etruria and Druidic Gaul. From this figure the transition to the disc arrangement is simple:
格维翁的「埃克尔夫」（Ercwlf，赫拉克勒斯）在使用三季节年时放置他的「四根等高柱」即博伊贝尔-洛斯，排列如下[见下页]。元音代表五个额外日即年的入口，门楣和两根柱各代表120天。但 Q 和 Z 在贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中没有自己的月份，它们在博伊贝尔-洛斯年的第二部分中作为二十四天时期出现，使丁内而非贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中的杜尔成为中央即统治字母。丁努斯或坦努斯成为主神，如在伊特鲁里亚和德鲁伊高卢。从这个图形过渡到圆盘排列很简单：





As 8 is the sacred numeral of Tinne’s month – and in the Imperial Roman Calendar also the ruling month was the eighth, called Sebastos (‘Holy’) or Augustus – so the eight-day period rules the calendar. In fact, Tannus displaces his oak-twin Durus and seems to be doing him a great kindness – the same kindness celestial Hercules did for Atlas – in relieving him of his traditional burden. The twins were already connected with the numeral 8 because of their eight-year reign, which was fixed (as we have seen) by the approximation at every hundredth lunation of lunar and solar time. That a calendar of this sort was in use in ancient Ireland is suggested by numerous ancient Circles of the Sun, consisting of five stones surrounding a central altar; and by the ancient division of the land into five provinces – Ulster, the two Munsters, Leinster and Connaught – meeting at a central point in what is now West Meath, marked by a Stone of Divisions. (The two Munsters had already coalesced by the time of King Tuathal the Acceptable, who reigned from 130–160 AD; he took off a piece of all four provinces to form his central demesne of Meath.) And there is a clear reference to this calendar system in the tenth-century AD Irish Saltair na Rann where a Heavenly City is described, with fifteen ramparts, eight gates, and seventy-two different kinds of fruit in the gardens enclosed.
既然8是丁内月的神圣数字——在罗马帝国历法中，统治月份也是第八个，称为 Sebastos（「神圣的」）即 Augustus——那么八天周期就主宰着历法。事实上，坦努斯取代了他的橡树孪生兄弟杜鲁斯，似乎在对他施大恩——与天界赫拉克勒斯替阿特拉斯所做的一样——解除他的传统负担。孪生兄弟早已因八年统治期与数字8联系在一起，这一周期由第一百次朔望月时太阴与太阳时间的近似重合所确定。古代爱尔兰使用此类历法的线索包括：许多由五块石头环绕中央祭坛的古代太阳圆环；以及古代将土地分为五个省份——阿尔斯特、两个明斯特、伦斯特和康诺特——在今西米斯郡的一个中心点会合，以一块「分割石」为标志。（两个明斯特在可接受的图阿塔尔王——公元130-160年在位——之前已经合并；他从四个省份各取一块，形成他的中央领地米斯。）在十世纪爱尔兰《盐air na Rann》中有对此历法系统的明确指涉，其中描述了一座天城，有十五道城墙、八道城门和园中七十二种不同的果实。

Now, it has been shown that the God Bran possessed an alphabetic secret before Gwydion, with Amathaon’s help, stole it from him at the Battle of the Trees in the course of the first Belgic invasion of Britain; that close religious ties existed between Pelasgia and Bronze Age Britain; and that the Pelasgians used an alphabet of the same sort as the British tree-alphabet, the trees of which came from the north of Asia Minor.
现在已经证明，布兰神在格维敦于第一次比利时人入侵不列颠时的树木之战中在阿马松协助下从他那里偷走字母秘密之前，就拥有一个字母秘密；佩拉斯吉与青铜时代不列颠之间存在密切的宗教联系；佩拉斯吉人使用与不列颠树木字母表同类的字母表，其树木来自小亚细亚北部。

As might be expected, the myth connecting Cronos, Bran’s counterpart, with an alphabetic secret survives in many versions. It concerns the Dactyls (fingers), five beings created by the White Goddess Rhea, ‘while Zeus was still an infant in the Dictaean Cave’, as attendants on her lover Cronos. Cronos became the first king of Elis, where the Dactyls were worshipped, according to Pausanias, under the names of Heracles, Paeonius, Epimedes, Jasius and Idas, or Aces-Idas. They were also worshipped in Phrygia, Samothrace, Cyprus, Crete and at Ephesus. Diodorus quotes Cretan historians to the effect that the Dactyls made magical incantations which caused a great stir in Samothrace, and that Orpheus (who used the Pelasgian alphabet) was their disciple. They are called the fathers of the Cabeiroi of Samothrace, and their original seat is said to have been either Phrygia or Crete. They are also associated with the mysteries of smith-craft, and Diodorus identifies them with the Curetes, tutors of the infant Zeus and founders of Cnossos. Their names at Elis correspond exactly with the fingers. Heracles is the phallic thumb; Paeonius (‘deliverer from evil’) is the lucky fore-finger; Epimedes (‘he who thinks too late’) is the middle, or fool’s, finger; Jasius (‘healer’) is the physic finger; Idas (‘he of Mount Ida’ – Rhea’s seat) is the oracular little finger. The syllable Aces means that he averted ill-luck, and the Orphic willow tree, the tree belonging to the little finger-tip, grew just outside the Dictaean Cave which was, perhaps for that reason, also called the Idaean Cave.
不出所料，将布兰的对应者克洛诺斯与字母秘密联系起来的神话以多种版本存续。它涉及达克提尔（Dactyls，意为「手指」）——白女神瑞亚「当宙斯还是迪克特洞穴中的婴儿时」创造的五个存在，作为她的情人克洛诺斯的侍从。克洛诺斯成为厄利斯的第一代国王，据保萨尼亚斯记载，达克提尔在那里以赫拉克勒斯、派奥尼乌斯、厄皮墨得斯、雅西乌斯和伊达斯（或阿刻斯-伊达斯）之名受崇拜。他们也在弗里吉亚、萨摩色雷斯、塞浦路斯、克里特和以弗所受崇拜。狄奥多鲁斯引述克里特史学家的说法，达克提尔创作的魔法咒语在萨摩色雷斯引起轰动，俄耳甫斯（使用佩拉斯吉字母表）是他们的弟子。他们被称为萨摩色雷斯卡贝罗伊之父，其最初所在地据说是弗里吉亚或克里特。他们还与锻造秘术相关，狄奥多鲁斯将他们等同于库雷忒斯——幼年宙斯的导师和克诺索斯的创建者。他们在厄利斯的名字恰好对应手指：赫拉克勒斯是阳具拇指；派奥尼乌斯（「驱邪者」）是幸运的食指；厄皮墨得斯（「想得太晚者」）是中指即愚者之指；雅西乌斯（「治愈者」）是药指；伊达斯（「伊达山之人」——瑞亚的居所）是神谕的小指。音节 Aces 意为他驱避厄运，而俄耳甫斯的柳树——属于小指尖的树——就长在迪克特洞穴外面，也许正因如此该洞也称为伊达安洞。

The Alexandrian scholiast on Apollonius Rhodius gives the names of three of the Dactyls as Acmon (‘anvil’) Damnameneus (‘hammer’) and Celmis (‘smelter’). These are probably names of the thumb and first two fingers, used in the Phrygian (or ‘Latin’) blessing: for walnuts are cracked between thumb and forefinger; and the middle finger based on U, the vowel of sexuality, still retains its ancient obscene reputation as the smelter of female passion. In mediaeval times it was called digitus impudicus or obscenus because, according to the seventeenth-century physician Isbrand de Diemerbroek, it used to be ‘pointed at men in infamy or derision’ – as a sign that they had failed to keep their wives’ affection. Apollonius had mentioned only two Dactyls by name: Titias and Cyllenius. I have shown that Cyllen (or Cyllenius) was son of Elate, ‘Artemis of the fir tree’; so the Dactyl Cyllenius must have been the thumb, which is based on the fir-letter A. And Titias was king of Mariandynë in Bithynia, from where Hercules stole the Dog, and was killed by Hercules at a funeral games. Some mythographers make Titias the father of Mariandynus, founder of the town. Since Hercules was the god of the waxing year which begins with A, the thumb, it follows that Titias was the god of the waning year, which begins with U, the fool’s finger – the fool killed by Hercules at the winter-solstice. The name ‘Titias’ is apparently a reduplication of the letter T, which belongs to the fool’s finger, and identical with the Giant Tityus whom Zeus killed and consigned to Tartarus.
亚历山大里亚的阿波罗尼乌斯·罗狄乌斯注释者给出三名达克提尔的名字为阿克蒙（Acmon，「铁砧」）、达姆纳墨涅乌斯（Damnameneus，「锤子」）和凯尔弥斯（Celmis，「熔炼者」）。这些大概是拇指和前两指的名字，用于弗里吉亚（或「拉丁」）祝福：因为核桃用拇指和食指夹裂；中指基于 U——性的元音——至今仍保留其作为女性情欲之熔炼者的古老猥亵名声。中世纪时它被称为 digitus impudicus 或 obscenus，因为据十七世纪医生伊施布兰德·迪默布洛克所言，它曾被「以耻辱或嘲弄指向男人」——作为他们未能保持妻子爱意的标志。阿波罗尼乌斯只提到两个达克提尔的名字：提提阿斯和库勒尼乌斯。我已表明库伦（Cyllen，或 Cyllenius）是埃拉忒（Elate，「冷杉树的阿尔忒弥斯」）之子；因此达克提尔库勒尼乌斯必定是拇指，它基于冷杉字母 A。提提阿斯是比提尼亚马里安迪涅的王，赫拉克勒斯从那里偷走了狗，并在一次葬礼竞技会上杀死了他。一些神话编撰者使提提阿斯成为马里安迪努斯——该城创建者——之父。既然赫拉克勒斯是以 A 即拇指开始的渐年之神，那么提提阿斯就是以 U 即愚者之指开始的渐年之神——在冬至被赫拉克勒斯杀死的愚者。提提阿斯之名显然是字母 T 的重复——T 属于愚者之指——与宙斯所杀并投入塔耳塔洛斯的巨人提提俄斯相同。

Here is a neat problem in poetic logic: if the Dactyl Cyllenius is an alias of Hercules, and Hercules is the thumb, and Titias is the fool’s finger, it should be possible to find in the myth of Hercules and Titias the name of the intervening finger, the forefinger, to complete the triad used in the Phrygian blessing. Since the numerical sequence Heis, Duo, Treis, ‘one, two, three’, corresponds in Greek, Latin and Old Goidelic with the H.D.T. letter sequence represented by the top-joints of the Dactyls used in this blessing, it is likely that the missing name begins with D and has a reference to the use or religious associations of the finger. The answer seems to be ‘Dascylus’. According to Apollonius he was king of the Mariandynians, and presided at the games at which Hercules killed Titias. For the forefinger is the index-finger and Dascylus means ‘the little pointer’ Greek didasco, Latin disco. Presidents at athletic contests use it for solemn warnings against foul play. The root Da- from which Dascylus is derived is also the root of the Indo-Germanic word for thunder, appropriate to D as the letter of the oak-and-thunder god. Dascylus was both father and son of Lycus (wolf); the wolf is closely connected with the oak-cult.
这里有一个诗性逻辑的精巧问题：如果达克提尔库勒尼乌斯是赫拉克勒斯的别名，赫拉克勒斯是拇指，提提阿斯是愚者之指，那么在赫拉克勒斯和提提阿斯的神话中应该能找到中间的手指即食指的名字，以完成弗里吉亚祝福所用的三联。既然数字序列 Heis、Duo、Treis（「一、二、三」）在希腊语、拉丁语和古戈伊德尔语中对应于该祝福所用达克提尔上关节代表的 H.D.T. 字母序列，缺失的名字很可能以 D 开头并涉及该手指的用途或宗教关联。答案似乎是「达斯库卢斯」（Dascylus）。据阿波罗尼乌斯记载，他是马里安迪尼人的国王，在赫拉克勒斯杀死提提阿斯的竞技会上担任主持人。因为食指是指示指，达斯库卢斯意为「小指示者」——希腊语 didasco，拉丁语 disco。竞技会主持人用它发出对犯规行为的庄严警告。Da- 这个词根既是达斯库卢斯的词源，也是印欧语中「雷」的词根，适合 D 作为橡树雷神的字母。达斯库卢斯既是吕科斯（Lycus，狼）之父又是其子；狼与橡树崇拜密切相关。

The argument can be taken farther. It has been mentioned in Chapter Four that Pythagoras was a Pelasgian from Samos who developed his doctrine of the Transmigration of Souls as the result of foreign travel. According to his biographer Porphyrius he went to Crete, the seat of the purest Orphic doctrine, for initiation by the Idaean Dactyls. They ritually purified him with a thunderbolt, that is to say they made a pretence of killing him with either a meteoric stone or a neolithic axe popularly mistaken for a thunderbolt; after which he lay face-downwards on the sea shore all night covered with black lamb’s wool; then spent ‘three times nine hallowed days and nights in the Idaean Cave’; finally emerged for his initiation. Presumably he then drank the customary Orphic cup of goat’s milk and honey at dawn (the drink of Cretan Zeus who had been born in that very cave) and was garlanded with white flowers. Porphyrius does not record exactly when all this took place except that Pythagoras saw the throne annually decorated with flowers for Zeus; which suggests that the twenty-eight days that intervened between his thunderbolt death and his revival with milk and honey were the twenty-eight-day month R, the death-month ruled by the elder or myrtle; and that Pythagoras was reborn at the winter solstice festival as an incarnation of Zeus – a sort of Orphic Pope or Aga Khan – and went through the usual mimetic transformation: bull, hawk, woman, lion, fish, serpent, etc. This would account for the divine honours subsequently paid him at Crotona, where the Orphic cult was strongly established; and also for those paid to his successor Empedocles, who claimed to have been through these ritual transformations. The Dactyls here are plainly the Curetes, the dancing priests of the Rhea and Cronos cult, tutoring the infant Zeus in the Pelasgian calendar-alphabet, the Beth-Luis-Nion; the tree-sequence of which had been brought to Greece and the Aegean islands from Paphlagonia, by way of Bithynian Mariandynë and Phrygia, and there harmonized with the alphabetic principle originated in Crete by ‘Palamedes’. For climatic reasons the canon of trees taught by the Cretan Dactyls must have differed from that of Phrygia, Samothrace and Magnesia – Magnesia where the five Dactyls were remembered as a single character, and where the Pelasgian Cheiron (‘the Hand’) son of Cronos and Philyra (Rhea), successively tutored Hercules, Achilles, Jason the Orphic hero, with numerous other sacred kings.
论证可以更进一步。第四章已提及毕达哥拉斯是来自萨摩斯的佩拉斯吉人，他通过游历外国发展了灵魂转世学说。据其传记作者波菲利乌斯记载，他前往克里特——最纯粹的俄耳甫斯教义所在地——接受伊达安达克提尔的入教。他们以雷霆仪式净化了他，即假装用陨石或新石器时代的石斧（民间误认为雷石）杀死他；之后他面朝下躺在海滩上整夜，身上覆盖黑色羔羊毛；然后在伊达安洞中度过了「三九个神圣的日夜」；最终出来接受入教。大概他随后在黎明时饮用了惯常的俄耳甫斯山羊奶蜂蜜杯（克里特宙斯的饮品——宙斯就诞生在那个洞中），并被戴上白花花环。波菲利乌斯没有确切记录这一切发生在何时，只说毕达哥拉斯看到了为宙斯每年装饰花环的宝座；这暗示从他雷霆之死到以奶蜜复活之间间隔的二十八天是 R 月即长者或桃金娘主宰的死亡之月；毕达哥拉斯在冬至节作为宙斯的化身重生——一种俄耳甫斯教皇或阿迦汗——经历了惯常的拟态变形：公牛、鹰、女人、狮子、鱼、蛇等。这可以解释他随后在克罗顿受到的神圣崇拜——那里俄耳甫斯崇拜根深蒂固；也解释了他的继承者恩培多克勒受到的崇拜——后者声称经历过这些仪式变形。此处的达克提尔显然就是库雷忒斯——瑞亚和克洛诺斯崇拜的舞蹈祭司——在佩拉斯吉历法字母表贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中教导幼年宙斯；其树木序列从帕夫拉戈尼亚经比提尼亚马里安迪涅和弗里吉亚带到希腊和爱琴海岛屿，在那里与克里特「帕拉墨得斯」创始的字母原则相协调。因气候原因，克里特达克提尔传授的树木准则必定与弗里吉亚、萨摩色雷斯和马格尼西亚的不同——在马格尼西亚，五个达克提尔被记为单一角色，佩拉斯吉的喀戎（Cheiron，「手」）——克洛诺斯和菲吕拉（瑞亚）之子——先后教导了赫拉克勒斯、阿喀琉斯、俄耳甫斯英雄伊阿宋及众多其他神圣国王。

It seems however that Pythagoras,1 after mastering the Cretan Beth-Luis-Nion, found that the Boibel-Loth calendar, based on a year of 360 + 5 days, not on the Beth-Luis-Nion year of 364 + 1 days, was far better suited than the Beth-Luis-Nion to his deep philosophic speculations about the holy tetractys, the five senses and elements, the musical octave, and the Ogdoad.
然而毕达哥拉斯¹在掌握克里特贝斯-路易斯-尼恩之后，发现基于360+5天年的博伊贝尔-洛斯历法比基于364+1天年的贝斯-路易斯-尼恩更适合他关于神圣四三角形、五种感官和元素、音乐八度及八元组的深刻哲学思辨。

But why was it necessary to alter the alphabet and calendar in order to make eight the important number, rather than seven? Simonides’s alphabet, it has been seen, was expanded to 3 × 8 letters; perhaps this was to fulfil the dark prophecy current in Classical Greece that Apollo was fated to castrate his father Zeus with the same sickle with which Zeus had castrated his father Cronos and which was laid up in a temple on the sickle-shaped island of Drepane (‘sickle’), now Corfu. In so far as the supreme god of the Druids was a Sun-god, the fulfilment of this prophecy was demonstrated every year at their ritual emasculation of the sacred oak by the lopping of the mistletoe, the procreative principle, with a golden sickle – gold being the metal sacred to the Sun. Seven was the sacred number of the week, governed by the Sun, the Moon and the five planets. But eight was sacred to the Sun in Babylonia, Egypt and Arabia, because 8 is the symbol of reduplication – 2 × 2 × 2. Hence the widely distributed royal sun-disc with an eight-armed cross on it, like a simplified version of Britannia’s shield; and hence the sacrificial barley-cakes baked in the same pattern.

Hecateus apparently credited the pre-Belgic Hyperboreans with a knowledge of the 19-year cycle for equating solar and lunar time; which involves an intercalation of 7 months at the close. This cycle was not publicly adopted in Greece until about a century after Hecateus’s time. As a ‘golden number’, reconciling solar and lunar time, 19 can be deduced from the thirteen-month Beth-Luis-Nion calendar which contains fourteen solar stations (namely the first day of each month and the extra day) and five lunar stations. Probably it was in honour of this Apollo (Beli) that the major stone circles of the Penzance area in Cornwall consisted of 19 posts, and that Cornwall was called Belerium. There is evidently some basis for the story that Abaris the Hyperborean instructed Pythagoras in philosophy. It looks as if the Bronze Age people (who imported the Egyptian beads into Salisbury Plain from Akhenaton’s short-lived capital, the City of the Sun, at Tell Amarna about 1350 BC) had refined their astronomy on Salisbury Plain and even anticipated the invention of the telescope. Since, according to Pliny, the Celtic year began in his day in July (as the Athenian also did) the statement about the country producing two harvests, one at the beginning and one at the end of the year, is understandable. The hay harvest would fall in the old year, the corn harvest in the new.

JIEVOAŌ, the earlier seven-letter form, recalls the many guesses at the ‘blessed Name of the Holy One of Israel’ made by scholars, priests and magicians in the old days. This was a name which only the High Priest was allowed to utter, once a year and under his breath, when he visited the Holy of Holies, and which might not be committed to writing. Then how in the world was the Name conveyed from one High Priest to another? Obviously by a description of the alphabetical process which yielded it. Josephus claimed to know the Name, though he could never have heard it spoken or seen it written. The Heads of the Pharisaic academies also claimed to know it. Clement of Alexandria did not know it, but he guessed an original IAOOUE – which is found in Jewish-Egyptian magical papyri, ‘Zeus, Thunderer, King Adonai, Lord Iaooue’ – also expanded to IAOUAI and IAOOUAI. The Samaritans wrote it IAHW and pronounced it IABE. Clement’s guess is, of course, a very plausible one because I.A.O.OU.E is the name spelt out by the vowels of the five-season year if one begins in the early winter, the opening of the agricultural year.1 The Name taught in the Academies is likely to have been a complicated one of either 42 or 72 letters. Was Stonehenge the temple of Apollo the Hyperborean? The ground plan of Stonehenge suggests a round mirror with a handle – a round earthwork, entered by an avenue, with a circular stone temple enclosed. The outer ring of stones in the temple once formed a continuous circle of thirty arches, built of enormous dressed stones: thirty posts and thirty lintels. This circle enclosed an ellipse, broken at one end so that it resembled a horseshoe, consisting of five separate dolmens, each of two posts and a lintel, built of the same enormous stones. Sandwiched between the circle and the horseshoe stood a ring of thirty much smaller posts; and within the horseshoe, again, stood another horseshoe of fifteen similar small posts, arranged in five sets of three to correspond with the five dolmens.

We know from other sources that he fetched back the white poplar, not the olive which had been cultivated in Greece centuries before his time and which is not native to the upper Danube; the connexion of poplar with amber, which came from the Baltic by way of the Danube and Istria, and which was sacred to Apollo, has already been noted. Pindar’s mistake derives from a confusion of the Hercules who fetched the poplar from Epirus with the earlier Hercules who fetched the olive from Libya to Crete. He writes in the Tenth Pythian Ode:
品达在其《第三奥林匹亚颂》中让赫拉克勒斯前往伊斯特河源头从阿波罗的仆人极北人那里带回野生橄榄到奥林匹亚，这显然是错误的。我们从其他来源知道他带回的是白杨而非橄榄——橄榄在他之前几个世纪就在希腊栽培了，且非多瑙河上游原产；白杨与琥珀的联系——琥珀经多瑙河和伊斯特里亚从波罗的海运来，sacred 于阿波罗——此前已提及。品达的错误源于将两位赫拉克勒斯混淆：从伊庇鲁斯取回白杨的赫拉克勒斯与更早的从利比亚取回橄榄到克里特的赫拉克勒斯。他在《第十皮托颂》中写道：

Neither by ships nor by land can you find the wonderful road to the trysting-place of the Hyperboreans.
Neither by ships nor by land can you find the wonderful road to the trysting-place of the Hyperboreans.（你既不能乘船也不能走陆路找到通往极北人会面之所的奇妙道路。）



Yet in times past, Perseus the leader of his people partook of their banquet when he entered their homes and found them sacrificing glorious hecatombs of asses in honour of the God. In the banquets and hymns of that people Apollo chiefly rejoices and laughs as he looks upon the brute beasts in their ramping lewdness. Yet such are their ways that the Muse is not banished, but on every side the dances of the girls, the twanging of lyres and sound of flutes are continually circling, and with their hair crowned with golden bay-leaves they make merry…yet avoid divine jealousy by living aloof from labour and war. To that home of happy folk, then, went Danaë’s son [Perseus] of old, breathing courage, with Athena as his guide. And he slew the Gorgon and returned with her head.
