In the banquets and hymns of that people Apollo chiefly rejoices and laughs as he looks upon the brute beasts in their ramping lewdness. Yet such are their ways that the Muse is not banished, but on every side the dances of the girls, the twanging of lyres and sound of flutes are continually circling, and with their hair crowned with golden bay-leaves they make merry…yet avoid divine jealousy by living aloof from labour and war. To that home of happy folk, then, went Danaë's son [Perseus] of old, breathing courage, with Athena as his guide. And he slew the Gorgon and returned with her head.（然而在往昔，人民领袖珀耳修斯曾赴他们的盛宴，当他进入他们的家园时，发现他们正为敬神而献祭壮观的驴牲百头。在那些人的宴会和赞美诗中，阿波罗最为欢欣，他看着那些野兽放荡不羁而发笑。然而他们的生活方式并未驱逐缪斯，四面八方少女的舞蹈、竖琴的鸣响和笛声不断环绕，他们头戴金桂冠欢宴……却因远离劳作与战争而避开神的嫉妒。达那厄之子[珀耳修斯]昔日曾赴那幸福民族的家园，勇气勃发，雅典娜为引导。他杀了戈耳工，带着她的头颅归来。）





Pindar seems to be wrong about the Gorgon and about the bay-leaves, sacred to Apollo only in the South; and since he does not tell us at what season the sacrifice took place we cannot tell what leaves they were. If at mid-winter, they may have been elder-leaves; at any rate, asses are connected in European folk-lore, especially French, with the mid-winter Saturnalia, which took place in the elder month, and at the conclusion of which the ass-eared god, later the Christmas Fool, was killed by his rival. This explains the otherwise unaccountable connexion of asses and fools in Italy as well as in Northern Europe: for asses are more intelligent animals than horses. That there was an ass-cult in Italy in early times is suggested by the distinguished Roman clan-names Asina and Asellus, which were plebeian, not patrician; the patricians were an immigrant horse-worshipping aristocracy from the East who enslaved the plebeians. The use of holly at the Italian Saturnalia supports this theory: holly was the tree of the ass-god, as the oak was the tree of his wild-ox twin who became paramount in patrician Rome.
品达关于戈耳工和桂冠——桂冠仅在南国 sacred 于阿波罗——的说法似乎有误；既然他没有告诉我们献祭发生在什么季节，我们无法知道那些叶子是什么。如果是仲冬，可能是接骨木叶；至少在欧洲民间传说中——尤其是法国——驴与仲冬农神节相关联，农神节在接骨木月举行，结束时驴耳之神——后来的圣诞愚人——被其对手杀死。这解释了意大利和北欧驴与愚人之间原本无法解释的联系：因为驴比马更聪明。早期意大利存在驴崇拜的线索是显赫的罗马氏族名 Asina 和 Asellus——它们是平民而非贵族的；贵族是从东方来的崇马贵族，他们奴役了平民。意大利农神节使用冬青支持了这一理论：冬青是驴神之树，如同橡树是其野牛孪生兄弟之树——后者在贵族罗马占主导地位。

Plutarch in his Isis and Osiris writes: ‘Every now and then at certain festivities they (the Egyptians) humiliate the broken power of Set, treating it despitefully, to the point of rolling men of Typhonic colouring in the mud and driving asses over a precipice.’ By ‘certain festivities’ he must mean the celebration of the divine child Harpocrates’s victory over Set, at the Egyptian Saturnalia. So Set, the red-haired ass, came to mean the bodily lusts, given full rein at the Saturnalia, which the purified initiate repudiated; indeed, the spirit as rider, and the body as ass, are now legitimate Christian concepts. The metamorphosis of Lucius Apuleius into an ass must be understood in this sense: it was his punishment for rejecting the good advice of his well-bred kinswoman Byrrhaena and deliberately meddling with the erotic witch cult of Thessaly. It was only after uttering his de profundis prayer to the White Goddess (quoted at the close of Chapter Four) that he was released from his shameful condition and accepted as an initiate of her pure Orphic mysteries. So also, when Charitë (‘Spiritual Love’) was riding home in chaste triumph on ass-back from the robbers’ den, Lucius had joked at this as an extraordinary event: namely, that a girl should triumph over her physical desires, despite all dangers and assaults. The Orphic degradation of the ass explains a passage in Aristophanes’s Frogs, which, as J. E. Harrison points out, is staged in a thoroughly Orphic Hell. Charon shouts out ‘Anyone here for the Plains of Lethe? Anyone here for the Ass Clippings? For Cerberus Park? Taenarus? Crow Station?’ Crow Station was evidently Set-Cronos’s infernal seat to which Greeks consigned their enemies in the imprecation ‘To the Crows with you!’; and the Ass Clippings was the place where criminals shaggy with sin were shorn to the quick. The horse was a pure animal for the Orphics, as the ass was impure, and the continuance of this tradition in Europe is shown most clearly in Spain where caballero ‘horseman’, means gentleman and where no gentleman’s son is allowed to ride an ass, even in an emergency, lest he lose caste. The ancient reverence of unchivalrous Spaniards for the ass appears perversely in the word carajo, the great mainstay of their swearing, which is used indiscriminately as noun, adjective, verb or adverb; its purpose is to avert the evil eye, or ill-luck, and the more often it can be introduced into an oath, the better. Touching the phallus, or an amulet in phallus form, is an established means of averting the evil eye, and carajo means ‘ass’s phallus’; the appeal is to the baleful God Set, whose starry phallus appears in the Constellation Orion, to restrain his anger.
普鲁塔克在《伊西斯与奥西里斯》中写道：「每隔一段时间在某些节日里他们（埃及人）会羞辱塞特已被击碎的力量，虐待他，甚至将提丰肤色的男人在泥里滚、把驴赶下悬崖。」所谓「某些节日」他必定指神圣婴儿哈波克拉忒斯战胜塞特的庆祝——即埃及农神节。因此塞特——红毛驴——开始意味着肉欲，在农神节上被充分放纵，而净化后的入教者则弃绝之；事实上，灵为骑者、身为驴如今已是合法的基督教概念。阿普列尤斯化身驴必须在此意义上理解：这是对他拒绝其有教养的亲戚比尔莱娜的好意忠告、故意涉足色萨利色情巫术崇拜的惩罚。只有在向白女神发出 de profundis 祈祷（引用于第四章末尾）之后，他才从耻辱的状态中被释放，被接受为她纯洁的俄耳甫斯密仪的入教者。同样，当卡里忒（Charitë，「精神之爱」）从强盗巢穴骑驴凯旋回家时，卢基乌斯对此开了玩笑——认为这是非同寻常的事：一个少女竟在一切危险和侵犯之下战胜了自己的肉体欲望。俄耳甫斯对驴的贬低解释了阿里斯托芬《蛙》中的一段——如 J. E. 哈里森所指出的，该剧在彻底的俄耳甫斯冥界中上演。卡戎喊道：「有人去忘川平原吗？有人去驴剪毛处吗？刻耳柏洛斯园？塔伊纳隆？乌鸦站？」乌鸦站显然是塞特-克洛诺斯的冥界座位——希腊人用诅咒「你去乌鸦那里吧！」将敌人送去之处；驴剪毛处是罪孽丛生的罪犯被剪到毛根的地方。对俄耳甫斯派来说马是纯洁的动物，驴是不洁的，这一传统在欧洲的延续在西班牙最为明显——caballero「骑马者」意为绅士，绅士之子即使在紧急情况下也不被允许骑驴，以免丧失身份。不尚骑士精神的西班牙人对驴的古老崇敬以一种扭曲方式体现在 carajo 一词中——这是他们骂人的主要支柱，不分名词、形容词、动词或副词地使用；其目的是驱避邪眼或厄运，越频繁地引入誓词中越好。触摸阳具或阳具形状的护身符是驱避邪眼的既定手段，carajo 意为「驴的阳具」；这是对凶恶的塞特神的祈求——他那星光闪烁的阳具出现在猎户座中——请他克制怒火。

The great dolmens of Stonehenge, all of local stone, look as if they were erected to give importance to the smaller stones, which were placed in position shortly after they themselves were, and to the massive altar stone lying in the centre. It has been suggested that the smaller ones, which are known to have been transported all the way from the Prescelly Mountains in Pembrokeshire, were originally disposed in another order there and rearranged by the people who erected the larger ones. This is likely, and it is remarkable that these imported stones were not dressed until they were re-erected at Stonehenge itself. The altar stone has also been transported from the same region, probably from Milford Haven. Since this transportation was done over a thousand years before the Belgic invasion it is clear at least that Gwydion was not responsible for the building.
巨石阵的大型支石墓全部由当地石材建成，看起来似乎是为了衬托较小的石头——它们在支石墓之后不久被安放——以及中央巨大的祭坛石。有人建议那些较小的石头——已知从彭布罗克郡的普雷塞利山运来——最初在那里以另一种排列方式布置，后来被竖立大型石头的人重新排列。这很可能，值得注意的是这些进口石头直到在巨石阵重新竖立时才被加工。祭坛石也从同一地区运来，可能来自米尔福德港。既然这一运输发生在比利时人入侵之前一千多年，至少可以肯定格维敦不负责建造。

The plan of the five dolmens corresponds exactly with the disc alphabet, since there is a broad gap between the two standing nearest to the avenue (like the gap which contains the five holy days of the Egyptian, or Etruscan, year) and between the gap and the avenue stood a group of four smaller undressed stones, corresponding with the groups of three stones in the inner horseshoe, but with a gap in the middle; and far back, in the avenue itself, the huge undressed ‘Heel’ stone made a fifth and central one. This is not to assume that Stonehenge was built to conform with the disc-alphabet. The calendar may have anteceded the alphabet by some centuries. All that seems clear is that the Greek alphabetic formula which gives the Boibel-Loth its letter-names is at least a century or two earlier than 400 BC when the Battle of the Trees was fought in Britain.
五座支石墓的布局与圆盘字母表完全对应，因为最靠近大道的两座之间有一个大缺口（如同包含埃及或伊特鲁里亚年五天的缺口），缺口与大道之间立着一组四块较小的未加工石头，与内部马蹄中的三石组对应但中间有缺口；在大道深处，巨大的未加工「踵石」构成第五块也是中央的一块。这并非假设巨石阵是按照圆盘字母表建造的。历法可能比字母表早数世纪。看起来清楚的是，赋予博伊贝尔-洛斯字母名的希腊字母公式至少比公元前400年——即不列颠发生树木之战时——早一两个世纪。

The formula is plain. The Sun-god of Stonehenge was the Lord of Days, and the thirty arches of the outer circle and the thirty posts of the inner circle stood for the days of the ordinary Egyptian month; but the secret enclosed by these circles was that the solar year was divided into five seasons, each in turn divided into three twenty-four-day periods, represented by the three stones of the dolmens, and each of these again into three ogdoads, represented by the three smaller posts in front of the dolmens. For the circle was so sited that at dawn of the summer solstice the sun rose exactly at the end of the avenue in dead line with the altar and the Heel stone; while, of the surviving pair of the four undressed stones, one marks the sun’s rising at the winter solstice, the other its setting at the summer solstice.
公式很清楚。巨石阵的太阳神是日之主，外圆环的三十个拱和内圆环的三十根柱代表普通埃及月份的天数；但这些圆环所围住的秘密是太阳年分为五个季节，每季再分为三个各二十四天的时期——由支石墓的三块石头代表——每期又分为三个八天周期——由支石墓前方三根小柱代表。因为圆环的选址使得在夏至黎明时太阳恰好从大道尽头与祭坛和踵石成一直线的位置升起；而在四块未加工石头中幸存的一对里，一块标记冬至日出，另一块标记夏至日落。

But why were the altar stone and the uprights transported all the way from South Wales? Presumably to break the religious power of the Pembrokeshire Death-goddess – the pre-Celtic Annwm, as we have seen, was in Pembroke – by removing her most sacred undressed stones and reerecting them, dressed, on the Plain. According to Geoffrey of Monmouth, this was done by Merlin. Geoffrey, who mistakenly dates the event to the time of Hengist and Horsa, says that Merlin obtained the stones from Ireland, but the tradition perhaps refers to the Land of Erin – Erin, or Eire or Eriu, being a pre-Celtic Fate-goddess who gave her name to Ireland. ‘Erin’, usually explained as the dative case of Eriu’s name, may be the Greek Triple Fate-goddess ‘Erinnys’ whom we know as the Three Furies. The amber found in the barrows near Stonehenge is for the most part red, not golden; like that found on the Phoenician coast.
但为何祭坛石和立柱要从南威尔士远道运来？大概是为了打破彭布罗克郡死亡女神——如我们所见，前凯尔特的安温在彭布罗克——的宗教力量，通过移走她最神圣的未加工石头并在平原上加工后重新竖立。据蒙茅斯的杰弗里记载，这是梅林所为。杰弗里错误地将事件定于亨吉斯特和霍萨时代，说梅林从爱尔兰获得了石头，但这一传统可能指「艾琳之地」——Erin 即 Eire 或 Eriu 是一位前凯尔特命运女神，爱尔兰以她命名。「Erin」通常被解释为 Eriu 之名与格，但可能是希腊三重命运女神「Erinnys」——即我们所知的三复仇女神。巨石阵附近墓冢中发现的琥珀多为红色而非金色；如同腓尼基海岸所发现的那样。

Seventy-two will have been the main canonical number at Stonehenge: the seventy-two days of the midsummer season. Seventy-two was the Sun’s grandest number; eight, multiplied ninefold by the fertile Moon. The Moon was Latona, Hyperborean Apollo’s mother, and she determined the length of the sacred king’s reign. The approximate concurrence of solar and lunar time once every nineteen years – 19 revolutions of the Sun, 235 lunations of the Moon – ruled that Apollo should be newly married and crowned every nineteenth year at the Spring solstice, when he kept a seven months’ holiday in the Moon’s honour. The number 19 is commemorated at Stonehenge in nineteen socket-holes arranged in a semicircle on the South-east of the arched circle.1 The fate of the old king was perhaps the hill-top fate of Aaron and of Moses, darkly hinted at in Exodus, and the fate of Dionysus at Delphi: to be disrobed and dismembered by his successor and, when the pieces were gathered together, to be secretly buried in a chest with the promise of an eventual glorious resurrection.
七十二可能是巨石阵的主要规范数字：仲夏季节的七十二天。七十二是太阳最宏伟的数字；八，被丰产的月亮乘以九。月亮是勒托——极北阿波罗之母——她决定了神圣国王的统治长度。太阳和太阴时间每十九年一次的近似重合——19个太阳公转、235个太阴朔望——规定阿波罗每隔十九年在春分时重新成婚加冕，此时他为月亮庆祝七个月的假期。数字19在巨石阵中以拱圆东南侧排列成半圆的十九个插座孔来纪念。¹ 老国王的命运也许是亚伦和摩西的山顶命运——《出埃及记》中暗示的——以及狄俄尼索斯在德尔斐的命运：被继任者脱衣肢解，当碎片被收拢后，秘密地埋葬在一个箱中，并承诺最终光荣复活。

Stonehenge is now generally dated between 1700 and 1500 BC and regarded as the work of broad-skulled Bronze-Age invaders. The stones are so neatly cut and jointed that one responsible archaeologist, G. F. Kendrick of the British Museum, suggests that they were not placed in position until Belgic times; but the more probable explanation is that the architects had studied in Egypt or Syria.
巨石阵现在通常被定年为公元前1700至1500年，被视为宽头青铜时代入侵者的作品。石头切割和接合如此整齐，以至于一位负责任的考古学家——大英博物馆的 G. F. 肯德里克——建议它们直到比利时时代才被安放；但更可能的解释是建筑师曾在埃及或叙利亚学习过。

If then the God of Stonehenge was cousin to Jehovah of Tabor and Zion, one would expect to find the same taboos on the eating or killing of certain animals observed in Palestine and ancient Britain, taboos being far more easily observable than dogma. This proposition is simply tested by inquiring whether the edible but tabooed beasts in Leviticus which are native to both countries were ever tabooed in Britain. There are only two such beasts, the pig and the hare; for the ‘coney’ of Leviticus is not the British coney, or rabbit, but the hyrax, an animal peculiar to Syria and sacred to the Triple Goddess because of its triangular teeth and its litters of three. Both hare and pig were tabooed in ancient Britain: we know of the hare-taboo from Pliny; and that the hare was a royal animal is proved by the story of the hare taken by Boadicea into battle. The Kerry peasants still abominate hare-meat: they say that to eat it is to eat one’s grandmother. The hare was sacred, I suppose, because it is very swift, very prolific – even conceives, Herodotus notes, when already pregnant – and mates openly without embarrassment like the turtle-dove, the dog, the cat or the tattooed Pict. The position of the Hare constellation at the feet of Orion suggests that it was sacred in Pelasgian Greece too. The pig was also sacred in Britain, and the pig-taboo survived until recently in Wales and Scotland; but as in Egypt, and according to Isaiah among the Canaanites of Jerusalem, this taboo was broken once a year at mid-winter with a Pig-feast, the feast of the Boar’s Head. The fish-taboo, partial in Leviticus, was total in Britain and among the Egyptian priesthood and must have been most inconvenient. It survived in parts of Scotland until recent times. The bird-taboos, already mentioned in the lapwing context as common to Britain and Canaan, are numerous. The porpoise (mistranslated ‘badger’) whose skins made the covering for the Ark of the Covenant has always been one of the three royal ‘fish’ of Britain, the others being the whale – the first living thing created by Jehovah, and ‘whale’ includes the narwhal – and the sturgeon, which does not occur in the Jordan but was sacred in Pelasgian Greece and Scythia. According to Aelian, fishermen who caught a sturgeon garlanded themselves and their boats; according to Macrobius it was brought to table crowned with flowers and preceded by a piper.
如果巨石阵之神是他泊山和锡安山耶和华的表亲，那么人们会期望在巴勒斯坦和古不列颠观察到同样的食用或宰杀某些动物的禁忌——禁忌比教义更容易观察。这一命题只需查询《利未记》中两国都有原产的、可食用但被禁忌的动物即可验证。这样的动物只有两种：猪和兔；因为《利未记》中的「沙番」不是不列颠的沙番即兔子，而是岩蹄兔——叙利亚特有的动物，因其三角形牙齿和每胎三仔而 sacred 于三重女神。兔和猪在古不列颠都被禁忌：兔的禁忌我们从普林尼处得知；兔是皇家动物的证据是布狄卡带兔上阵的故事。克里郡农民至今厌恶兔肉：他们说吃兔肉就是吃自己的祖母。兔之所以神圣，我想是因为它非常迅速、非常 prolific——甚至在怀孕时还能受孕，希罗多德指出——且像斑鸠、狗、猫或纹身的皮克特人一样公开交配不以为耻。天兔座位于猎户座脚下，暗示它在佩拉斯吉希腊也是神圣的。猪在不列颠也是神圣的，猪的禁忌在威尔士和苏格兰存续到近代；但如在埃及以及据以赛亚在耶路撒冷的迦南人中一样，这一禁忌每年仲冬被猪宴——即野猪头宴——打破一次。鱼禁忌在《利未记》中是部分的，在不列颠和埃及祭司阶层中则是全面的，必定极不方便。它在苏格兰部分地区存续到近代。鸟禁忌——此前在凤头麦鸡上下文中已提及为不列颠和迦南所共有——数量众多。海豚（钦定本误译为「獾」）的皮制作了约柜的罩子，海豚一直是不列颠三种皇家「鱼」之一，另外两种是鲸——耶和华创造的第一种生物，「鲸」包括独角鲸——和鲟鱼——鲟鱼不出现在约旦河中，但在佩拉斯吉希腊和西徐亚是神圣的。据埃利安记载，捕获鲟鱼的渔夫为自己和船戴上花环；据马克罗比乌斯记载，鲟鱼被戴上花冠、由吹笛者引导送上餐桌。



The Hebrews seem to have derived their Aegean culture, which they shared with the descendants of the Bronze Age invaders of Britain, partly from the Danaans of Tyre and the Sabians of Harran, but mostly (as has already been suggested in Chapter Four) from the Philistines whose vassals they were for some generations; the Philistines, or Puresati, being immigrants from Asia Minor mixed with Greek-speaking Cretans. Those of Gaza brought with them the cult of Zeus Marnas (said to mean ‘virgin-born’ in Cretan) which was also found at Ephesus, and used Aegean writing for some time after the Byblians had adopted Babylonian cuneiform. The Philistine city of Ascalon was said by Xanthus, an early Lydian historian, to have been founded by one Ascalos, uncle to Pelops of Enete on the Southern Black Sea Coast, whose king was Aciamus, a native of the same region. Among the Philistines mentioned in the Bible are Piram and Achish, identifiable with the Trojan and Dardanian names Priam and Anchises; the Dardanians were among the tribes under Hittite leadership that Rameses II defeated at the Battle of Kadesh in 1335 BC. It is probable that the Levitical list of tabooed beasts and birds was taken over by the Israelites from the Philistines: and perhaps written down in the ninth century BC, which is when the Lycian tale of Proetus, Anteia and Bellerophon was inappropriately incorporated in the story of Joseph – Anteia becoming Potiphar’s wife.
希伯来人似乎从推罗的达南人和哈兰的萨比安人那里部分获得了他们的爱琴海文化——这些文化与青铜时代不列颠入侵者的后代共享——但主要来自（如第四章已建议）非利士人，后者曾是他们的宗主数代之久；非利士人即 Puresati，是从小亚细亚来的移民与说希腊语的克里特人混合而成。加沙的非利士人带来了宙斯·马尔纳斯崇拜（据说在克里特语中意为「处女所生」），该崇拜也见于以弗所，并在比布洛斯人采用巴比伦楔形文字后很长一段时间内仍使用爱琴海文字。据早期吕底亚史学家克桑图斯记载，非利士城市阿什凯隆由阿什卡洛斯创建——他是黑海南岸恩忒的珀罗普斯的叔叔，那里的国王阿基亚穆斯也是同一地区的人。《圣经》中提到的非利士人中有皮兰和阿基什，可与特洛伊和达达尼亚名字普里阿摩斯和安喀塞斯对应；达达尼亚人是拉美西斯二世公元前1335年在卡叠石战役中击败的赫梯领导下各部落之一。利未记中被禁忌动物的清单很可能由以色列人从非利士人那里接管：也许在公元前九世纪写下——当时吕基亚的普罗透斯、安忒亚和柏勒洛丰的故事被不当融入约瑟的故事——安忒亚变成波提乏之妻。

Avebury undoubtedly dates from the end of the third millennium BC. It is a circular earthwork enclosing a ring of one hundred posts and these again enclosing two separate temples, all the stones being unhewn and very massive. The temples consist of circles of posts, of which the exact numbers are not known because so many have been removed and because the irregular size of the remainder makes calculation difficult: but there seem to have been about thirty in each case. Within each of these circles was an inner circle of twelve posts: one of them containing a single altar post, the other three.
埃夫伯里无疑可追溯到公元前三千年末。它是一个圆形土方工程，围着一圈一百根柱，柱内又有两座独立的神庙，所有石头都未加工且非常巨大。神庙由柱圈组成，确切数量不得而知，因为许多已被移走且剩余的尺寸不规则使计算困难：但每座似乎约有三十根。每个柱圈内有一个十二根柱的内圈：其中一个包含单根祭坛柱，另一个三根。

One hundred months was the number of lunations in the Pelasgian Great Year, which ended with an approximation of lunar and solar time, though a much rougher one than at the close of the nineteen-year cycle. The twin kings each reigned for fifty of these months; which may account for the two temples. If in one temple the posts of the outer circle numbered twenty-nine, and in the other thirty, this would represent months of alternately twenty-nine and thirty days, as in the Athenian calendar – a lunation lasting for 29½ days. On the analogy of the story in Exodus, XXIV, 4 we may assume that the inner circles represented the king and his twelve clan-chieftains, though in one case the central altar has been enlarged to three, perhaps in honour of the king as three-bodied Geryon.
一百个月是佩拉斯吉大年的朔望月数，以太阴和太阳时间的近似重合结束——尽管比十九年周期末的重合粗糙得多。孪生国王各统治其中五十个月；这可能解释了两座神庙。如果一座神庙外圈柱数为二十九，另一座为三十，这将代表交替的二十九天和三十天月份——如雅典历法——一个朔望月持续29½天。类比《出埃及记》XXIV, 4 的故事，我们可以假设内圈代表国王和他的十二位氏族首领，尽管在一个案例中中央祭坛扩大为三，也许是为了将国王尊为三体革律翁。

A serpentine avenue enters the Avebury earthwork from the south-east and south-west and encloses two barrows, one of them heaped in the shape of a phallus and the other in the shape of a scrotum. To the south, beyond these, rises Silbury Hill, the largest artificial mound in Europe, covering over five acres, with a flat top of the same diameter as that of New Grange but thirty feet higher. I take Silbury to be the original Spiral Castle of Britain, as New Grange is of Ireland; the oracular shrine of Bran, as New Grange was of The Dagda. Avebury itself was not used for burials.
一条蛇形大道从东南和西南进入埃夫伯里土方工程，围着两个墓冢——一个堆成阳具形状，另一个阴囊形状。南面更远处矗立着锡尔伯里山——欧洲最大的人工土丘，覆盖五英亩以上，平顶直径与纽格兰奇相同但高三十英尺。我认为锡尔伯里是不列颠最初的螺旋城堡，如同纽格兰奇是爱尔兰的；布兰的神谕神殿，如同纽格兰奇是大达格达的。埃夫伯里本身未用于墓葬。

An interesting subject of poetic speculation is: why the Beth-Luis-Nion order of vowels, A.O.U.E.I., which is an order phonetically expressive of the progress and retreat of the year, with U as its climax, was altered in the Cadmean and Latin alphabets to A.E.I.O.U. The clue lies perhaps in the numerical values known to have been assigned in mediaeval Irish literature to the vowels, namely A, one; E, two; I, three; O, four. The numerical value five was assigned to B, the first consonant of the alphabet, which suggests that it originally belonged to U, the remaining vowel, which had no numerical value in this system, but which is the character that expresses the Roman numeral 5. If the vowels are regarded as a seasonal sequence, with A for New Year, O for Spring, U for Summer, E for Autumn and I for Winter, the original numerical values make poetic sense. A had One, as the New Year Goddess of origin; E had Two, as the Autumn Goddess of rutting and combat; I had Three, as the Winter Goddess of Death, pictured as the Three Fates, or the Three Furies, or the three Graeae, or the three-headed Bitch; O had Four, as the Spring Goddess of increase; U had Five, as the Summer Goddess, the leafy centre of the year, the Queen of the whole Pentad. It follows speculatively that the original numerical value of the Pelasgian vowels – A, One; E, Two; I, Three; O, Four; U, Five – suggested to the makers of the Cadmean alphabet that the vowels should be logically arranged in simple arithmetical progression from One to Five.
一个有趣的诗性思辨主题是：为什么贝斯-路易斯-尼恩的元音顺序 A.O.U.E.I.——一个在语音上表达年的进展与退却、以 U 为高潮的顺序——在卡德摩斯和拉丁字母表中被改为 A.E.I.O.U.。线索也许在于中世纪爱尔兰文献中已知的元音数值，即 A 为一、E 为二、I 为三、O 为四。数值五被分配给 B——字母表的第一个辅音——这暗示它原本属于 U，即该系统中没有数值的剩余元音，但 U 是表达罗马数字5的字符。如果将元音视为季节序列——A 为新年、O 为春季、U 为夏季、E 为秋季、I 为冬季——原始数值就有诗意。A 为一，作为起源的新年女神；E 为二，作为发情与战斗的秋之女神；I 为三，作为死亡之冬女神，被描绘为命运三女神、复仇三女神、格雷埃三姐妹或三头母犬；O 为四，作为增长的春之女神；U 为五，作为夏之女神——一年绿叶茂盛的中心，整个五联体的女王。推测可知，佩拉斯吉元音的原始数值——A 为一、E 为二、I 为三、O 为四、U 为五——启发了卡德摩斯字母表的制造者将元音按从一到五的简单算术级数逻辑排列。

The numerical values given by the Irish to the remaining letters of the 13-consonant Beth-Luis-Nion are as follows:
爱尔兰人给贝斯-路易斯-尼恩十三个辅音中其余字母的数值如下：

B Beth Five
B Beth Five（贝斯　5）

L Luis Fourteen
L Luis Fourteen（路易斯　14）

N Nion Thirteen
N Nion Thirteen（尼恩　13）

F Fearn Eight
F Fearn Eight（费恩　8）

S Saille Sixteen
S Saille Sixteen（赛尔　16）

H Uath No value
H Uath No value（厄阿斯　无数值）

D Duir Twelve
D Duir Twelve（杜尔　12）

T Tinne Eleven
T Tinne Eleven（丁内　11）

C Coll Nine
C Coll Nine（科尔　9）

M Min Six
M Min Six（明　6）

G Gort Ten
G Gort Ten（戈特　10）

P Peth Seven
P Peth Seven（佩斯　7）

R Ruis Fifteen
R Ruis Fifteen（路易斯　15）





Exactly why each of these values was assigned to its consonant may De debated at length; but obvious poetic reasons appear in several cases. For example, Nine is the number traditionally associated with Coll, the Hazel, the tree of Wisdom; Twelve is the number traditionally associated with the Oak – the Oak-king has twelve merry men; Fifteen is the number of Ruis, the last month, because it is the fifteenth consonant in the complete alphabet. The numbers Eight and Sixteen for the consonants F and S which follow on the Spring vowel O, or Four, make obvious sense in the context of increase. That H and U are denied numerical values suggests that they were kept out of the sequence for religious reasons. For U was the vowel of the Goddess of Death-in-Life, whom the Sun-god deposed; H was the consonant of Uath, the unlucky, or too holy, May month.
每个数值为何如此分配可以长篇辩论；但在几种情况下有明显的诗性原因。例如，九传统上与科尔——榛树即智慧之树——相关联；十二传统上与橡树相关——橡树王有十二个快乐侍从；十五是路易斯即最后一个月的数字，因为它是完整字母表中的第十五个辅音。春季元音 O 即四之后的辅音 F 和 S 分别为八和十六，在增长的语境中意义明显。H 和 U 被拒绝赋予数值暗示它们因宗教原因被排除在序列之外。因为 U 是死中之生女神的元音——她被太阳神废黜；H 是厄阿斯——不祥或过于神圣的五月——的辅音。

If this number system is of Apollonian origin and belongs to the period when the Irish had come under Greek influence, it is likely that P has been given seven, and L fourteen, and N thirteen as their values, in honour of Apollo. For the assignment of these values to the consonants of his seven-lettered Greek name turns it into a miniature calendar: P, the seven days of the week; LL, the twenty-eight days of a common-law month; N, the thirteen common-law months of the year. The vowel values complete the table: A, the single extra day; O, the four weeks of the common-law month; long O, the two halves of the year: APOLLŌN.
如果这个数字系统起源于阿波罗崇拜，属于爱尔兰人受希腊影响的时期，那么 P 被赋予七、L 被赋予十四、N 被赋予十三很可能是为了纪念阿波罗。因为这些数值分配给他的七字母希腊名的辅音，使之成为一个微缩历法：P 为一周七天；LL 为习惯法月份的二十八天；N 为一年的十三个习惯法月份。元音数值完善了表格：A 为单个额外日；O 为习惯法月份的四周；长 O 为一年的两半：APOLLŌN。

This sort of ingenious play with letters and numerals was characteristic of the Celtic poets. What fun they must have had in their forest colleges! And such restorations of their lore as can still be made from surviving records are more than quaint historical curiosities; they illustrate a poetic method of thought which has not yet outlasted its usefulness, however grossly abused by mystical quacks of the intervening centuries.
这种字母与数字的精巧游戏是凯尔特诗人的特征。他们在森林学院里一定玩得很开心！而从现存记录中仍可恢复的那些知识不仅仅是古怪的历史奇珍；它们展示了一种诗性思维方式——其用途尚未过时，尽管在中间几个世纪中被神秘主义骗子严重滥用。

Consider, for instance, the Bird-ogham and Colour-ogham in the Book of Ballymote. The composers of these two cyphers had to bear in mind not only the initial of every word but its poetic relation to the already established letter-month. Thus no migratory bird appears in the list of winter months, and samad (sorrel) is not applied to the S-month, as one might have expected, because the sorrel plant goes sorrel-colour only in the late summer. The lists could have been made more nearly poetic if the initials had allowed; thus the Robin would doubtless have led in the year, had he begun with a B, not an S (spidéog), and there was no word for Owl that could be used for the Ng-month when owls are most vocal.
例如，考虑《巴利莫特书》中的鸟欧甘和颜色欧甘。这两种密码的编写者不仅要记住每个词的首字母，还要记住它与已确立的字母-月份之间的诗性关系。因此候鸟不出现在冬季月份的列表中，samad（酸模）不用于 S 月——人们也许会期望如此——因为酸模要到夏末才变成酸模色。如果首字母允许，这些列表可以更具诗意；例如知更鸟无疑会引领新年，如果它以 B 而非 S（spidéog）开头，而且没有猫头鹰的词可以用于猫头鹰最为活跃的 Ng 月。

I can best make my point by glossing the cyphers in imitation of the style used in the Book of Ballymote itself, drawing on bardic lore in every case.
我能最好地阐明我的观点的方式是模仿《巴利莫特书》本身的风格来注释这些密码，每种情况都借鉴吟游传说。

*



Day of the Winter Solstice – A – aidhircleóg, lapwing; alad, piebald. Why is the lapwing at the head of the vowels?
冬至日——A——aidhircleóg，凤头麦鸡；alad，花斑色。为何凤头麦鸡居于元音之首？

Not hard to answer. It is a reminder that the secrets of the Beth-Luis Nion must be hidden by deception and equivocation, as the lapwing hides her eggs. And Piebald is the colour of this mid-winter season when wise men keep to their chimney-corners, which are black with soot inside and outside white with snow; and of the Goddess of Life-in-Death and Death-in-Life, whose prophetic bird is the piebald magpie.
不难回答。这是提醒人们贝斯-路易斯-尼恩的秘密必须以欺骗和含糊来隐藏，如同凤头麦鸡隐藏她的蛋。花斑色是这个仲冬季节的颜色——智者蜷缩在烟囱角落里，里面被煤烟熏黑、外面被白雪覆盖；也是死中之生和生中之死女神的颜色——她的预言鸟是花斑喜鹊。

Day of the Spring Equinox – O – odorscrach, cormorant; odhar, dun.
春分日——O——odorscrach，鸬鹚；odhar，暗褐色。

Why is the Cormorant next?
为何鸬鹚排在下一个？

Not hard. This is the season of Lent when, because of the Church’s ban on the eating of meat and the scarcity of other foods, men become Cormorants in their greed for fish. And Dun is the colour of the newly ploughed fields.
不难回答。这是四旬斋的季节，由于教会禁止食肉且其他食物匮乏，人们因对鱼的贪婪而变成鸬鹚。暗褐色是新耕土地的颜色。

Day of the Summer Solstice – U – uiseóg, lark; usgdha, resin-coloured.
夏至日——U——uiseóg，云雀；usgdha，树脂色。

Why is the Lark in the central place?
为何云雀居于中央？

Not hard. At this season the Sun is at his highest point, and the Lark flies singing up to adore him. Because of the heat the trees split and ooze resin, and Resin-coloured is the honey that the heather yields.
不难回答。此季节太阳到达最高点，云雀高飞歌唱以崇拜他。因炎热树木裂开渗出树脂，树脂色就是石楠花所产的蜜色。

Day of the Autumn Equinox – E – ela, whistling swan; erc, rufous-red.
秋分日——E——ela，啸天鹅；erc，赤红色。

Why is the Whistling Swan in the next place?
为何啸天鹅排在下一个？

Not hard. At this season the Swan and her young prepare for flight. And Rufous-red is the colour of the bracken, and of the Swan’s neck.
不难回答。此季节天鹅带着幼鸟准备飞翔。赤红色是蕨叶的颜色，也是天鹅颈部的颜色。

Day of the Winter Solstice – I – illait, eaglet; irfind, very white.
冬至日——I——illait，幼鹰；irfind，极白。

Why is the Eaglet in the next place?
为何幼鹰排在下一个？

Not hard. The Eaglet’s maw is insatiable, like that of Death, whose season this is. And Very White are the bones in his nest, and the snow on the cliff-ledge.
不难回答。幼鹰的胃口贪得无厌，如同死亡——此即死亡之季。极白是它巢中的骨头之色，也是悬崖岩架上的积雪之色。

* * *



Dec. 24-Jan. 21 – B – besan, pheasant; bàn, white.
12月24日—1月21日——B——besan，雉鸡；bàn，白色。

Why is the Pheasant at the head of the consonants?
为何雉鸡居于辅音之首？

Not hard. This is the month of which Amergin sang: ‘I am the Stag of Seven Tines’; and as venison is the best flesh that runs, so Pheasant is the best that flies. And White is the colour of this Stag and of this Pheasant.
不难回答。这是阿默金所唱之月：「我是七叉雄鹿」；正如鹿肉是奔跑之兽中最佳者，雉鸡也是飞翔之禽中最佳者。白色是此雄鹿与此雉鸡的颜色。

Jan. 22-Feb. 18 – L – lachu, duck; liath, grey.
1月22日—2月18日——L——lachu，鸭；liath，灰色。

Why is the Duck in the next place?
为何鸭排在下一个？

Not hard. This is the month of floods, when Ducks swim over the meadows. And Grey is the colour of flood-water and of rainy skies.
不难回答。这是洪水的月份，鸭子游过草地。灰色是洪水和雨天天空的颜色。

Feb. 19-Mar. 18 – N – naescu, snipe; necht, clear.
2月19日—3月18日——N——naescu，鹬；necht，清澈。

Why is the Snipe in the next place?
为何鹬排在下一个？

Not hard. This is the month of the mad March Wind that whirls like a Snipe. And Clear is the colour of Wind.
不难回答。这是疯狂三月风的月份，风如鹬般旋转。清澈是风的颜色。

Mar. 19-Apr. 15 – F – faelinn, gull; flann, crimson.
3月19日—4月15日——F——faelinn，鸥；flann，深红。

Why is the Gull in the next place?
为何鸥排在下一个？

Not hard. In this month Gulls congregate on the ploughed fields. And Crimson is the colour of the glain, the magical egg which is found in this month, and of alder-dye, and of the Young Sun struggling through the haze.
不难回答。此月鸥群聚集在耕过的田地上。深红是 glain 即此月所见的魔法蛋之色，是桤木染料之色，也是年轻太阳在薄雾中挣扎而出之色。

Apr. 16-May 13 – S – seg, hawk; sodath, fine-coloured.
4月16日—5月13日——S——seg，鹰；sodath，美色。

Why is the Hawk in the next place?
为何鹰排在下一个？

Not hard. Amergin sang of this month: ‘I am a Hawk on a Cliff.’ And Fine-coloured are its meadows.
不难回答。阿默金唱过此月：「我是悬崖上的一只鹰」。美色是此月草地的颜色。

The same – SS – stmolach, thrush; sorcha, bright-coloured.
同月——SS——stmolach，鸫；sorcha，明色。

Why is the Thrush joined with the Hawk?
为何鸫与鹰并列？

Not hard. The Thrush sings his sweetest in this month. And Bright-coloured are the new leaves.
不难回答。鸫在此月唱得最甜美。明色是新叶的颜色。

May 14-Jun. 10. - H – hadaig, night-crow; huath, terrible.
5月14日—6月10日——H——hadaig，夜鸦；huath，可怖。

Why is the Night-crow in the next place?
为何夜鸦排在下一个？

Not hard. This is the month when we refrain from carnal pleasures because of terror, which in Irish is uath, and the Night-crow brings terror. Terrible is its colour.
不难回答。此月因恐惧而禁绝肉体之欲——爱尔兰语中恐惧即 uath，夜鸦带来恐惧。可怖是其颜色。

Jun. 11-July 8 – D – droen, wren; dub, black.
6月11日—7月8日——D——droen，鹪鹩；dub，黑色。

Why is the Wren in the central place?
为何鹪鹩居于中央？

Not hard. The Oak is the tree of Druids and the king of trees, and the Wren, Drui-én, is the bird of the Druids and the King of all birds. And the Wren is the soul of the Oak. Black is the colour of the Oak when the lightning blasts it, and black the faces of those who leap between the Midsummer fires.
不难回答。橡树是德鲁伊之树、万树之王，鹪鹩 Drui-én 是德鲁伊之鸟、百鸟之王。鹪鹩是橡树的灵魂。黑色是闪电击中橡树时的颜色，也是仲夏篝火间跳跃者面孔的颜色。

July 9-Aug. 5 – T – truith, starling; temen, dark-grey.
7月9日—8月5日——T——truith，椋鸟；temen，深灰。

Why is the Starling in the next place?
为何椋鸟排在下一个？

Not hard. Amergin sang of this month: ‘I am a Spear that roars for blood.’ It is the warrior’s month, and the Starlings’ well-trained army will wheel swiftly and smoothly on a pivot, to the left or to the right, without a word of command or exhortation; thus battles are won, not by single feats and broken ranks. And Dark-grey is the colour of Iron, the warriors’ metal.
不难回答。阿默金唱过此月：「我是嗜血长啸的矛。」这是战士之月，椋鸟训练有素的军队会敏捷而流畅地绕轴左右旋转，无需口令或激励；战斗的胜利不靠个人英雄和散乱的队列。深灰是铁的颜色——战士的金属。

Aug. 6-Sept. 2 – C – [corr, crane]; cron, brown.
8月6日—9月2日——C——[corr，鹤]；cron，棕色。

Why is the Crane in the next place?
为何鹤排在下一个？

Not hard. This is the month of wisdom, and the wisdom of Manannan Mac Lir, namely the Beth-Luis-Nion, was wrapped in Crane-skin. And Brown are the nuts of the Hazel, tree of wisdom.
不难回答。此为智慧之月，马南南·麦克利尔（Manannan Mac Lir）的智慧——即贝斯-路易斯-尼恩——包裹在鹤皮之中。棕色是榛树即智慧之树的坚果之色。

The same – Q – querc, hen; quiar, mouse-coloured.
同月——Q——querc，母鸡；quiar，鼠灰。

Why is the Hen joined with the Crane?
为何母鸡与鹤并列？

Not hard. When the harvest is carted, and the gleaners have gone, the Hen is turned into the cornfields to fatten on what she can find. And a Mouse-coloured little rival creeps around with her.
不难回答。收割完毕、拾穗者离去后，母鸡被放入麦田觅食肥育。一只鼠灰色的小竞争者在她周围偷偷摸摸地跟着。

Sept. 2-Sept. 30 – M – mintan, titmouse; mbracht, variegated.
9月2日—9月30日——M——mintan，山雀；mbracht，斑斓。

Why is the Titmouse in the next place?
为何山雀排在下一个？

Not hard. Amergin sang of this month: ‘I am a Hill of Poetry’; and this is the month of the poet, who is the least easily abashed of men, as the Titmouse is the least easily abashed of birds. Both band together in companies in this month, and go on circuit in search of a liberal hand; and as the Titmouse climbs spirally up a tree, so the Poet also spirals to immortality. And Variegated is the colour of the Titmouse, and of the Master-poet’s dress.
不难回答。阿默金唱过此月：「我是诗歌之丘」；这是诗人之月，诗人是最不易窘迫之人，如同山雀是最不易窘迫之鸟。二者在此月结伴成群，巡回寻找慷慨之手；山雀螺旋攀树而上，诗人亦螺旋升向不朽。斑斓是山雀的颜色，也是大师诗人的服饰之色。

Oct. 1-Oct. 29 – G – géis, mute swan; gorm, blue.
10月1日—10月29日——G——géis，哑天鹅；gorm，蓝色。

Why is the Mute Swan in the next place?
为何哑天鹅排在下一个？

Not hard. In this month he prepares to follow his companion the Whistling Swan. And Blue is the haze on the hills, Blue the smoke of the burning weed, Blue the skies before the November rain.
不难回答。此月他准备追随他的伙伴啸天鹅而去。蓝色是山间的薄雾，蓝色是焚烧杂草的烟，蓝色是十一月雨前的天空。

Oct. 29-Nov. 25 – Ng – ngéigh, goose; nglas, glass-green. Why is the Goose in the next place?
10月29日—11月25日——Ng——ngéigh，鹅；nglas，玻绿色。为何鹅排在下一个？

Not hard. In this month the tame goose is brought in from misty pasture to be cooped and fattened for the mid-winter feast; and the wild goose mourns for him in the misty meadows. And Glassy-green is the wave that thuds against the cliff, a warning that the year must end.
不难回答。此月家鹅从雾蒙蒙的牧场被赶入笼中肥育以备仲冬宴席；野鹅在雾蒙蒙的草地上为它哀鸣。玻绿色是撞击悬崖的浪涛之色，预示一年将尽。

Nov. 26-Dec. 22 ;– R – rócnar, rook; ruadh, blood-red. Why is the Rook in the last place?
11月26日—12月22日——R——rócnar，秃鼻鸦；ruadh，血红。为何秃鼻鸦排在最后？

Not hard. He wears mourning for the year that dies in this month. And Blood-red are the rags of leaves on the elder-trees, a token of the slaughter.
不难回答。它为此月死去的一年佩戴丧服。血红是接骨木树上残叶的碎布之色，是屠戮的标记。

The Pheasant was the best available bird for the B-month, bran the raven and bunnan the bittern being better suited to later months of the year. The author of the article on pheasants in the Encyclopaedia Britannica states that pheasants (sacred birds in Greece) are likely to have been indigenous to the British Isles and that the white, or ‘Bohemian’, variety often appears among pheasants of ordinary plumage.
雉鸡是 B 月能用的最佳鸟类，bran 即乌鸦和 bunnan 即麻鹭更适合一年中后面的月份。《大英百科全书》雉鸡条目的作者称雉鸡（在希腊是神圣之鸟）很可能原产于不列颠群岛，白色即「波希米亚」变种经常出现在普通羽毛的雉鸡群中。

It is possible that the original S-colour was serind, primrose, but that the primrose’s erotic reputation led to its replacement by the euphemism, sodath.
S 月原来的颜色可能是 serind 即樱草色，但樱草的色情名声导致它被委婉语 sodath 取代。

The omission of corr, the Crane, for the C-month is intentional; the contents of the Crane-bag were a close secret and all reference to it was discouraged. And what of Dec. 23rd, the extra day of the year, on which the young King, or Spirit of the Year, was crowned and given eagle’s wings, and which was expressed by the semi-vowel J, written as double I? Its bird was naturally the Eagle, iolar in Irish, which has the right initial. The Irish poets were so chary of mentioning this day that we do not even know what its tree was; yet that they regarded the Eagle as its bird is proved by the use of the diminutive illait, Eaglet, for the letter I: that is to say that if the extra day, double-I, had not been secretly given the cypher-equivalent iolar, there would be no need to express the preceding day, that of the Winter Solstice, namely single I, by illait, Eaglet – for E is not expressed by Cygnet, nor A by Lapwing-chick.
C 月省略 corr 即鹤是有意的；鹤袋的内容是严密的秘密，一切涉及它的引用都不被鼓励。那么12月23日——年的额外日——年轻的国王即年之精灵在此日加冕并被赋予鹰翼、以半元音 J 表示、写作双 I——又如何？它的鸟自然是鹰，爱尔兰语 iolar，有正确的首字母。爱尔兰诗人对提及此日如此谨慎，以至于我们甚至不知道它的树是什么；然而他们视鹰为此日之鸟的证据在于用 illait 即幼鹰来表示字母 I：也就是说，如果额外日即双 I 没有被秘密赋予密码等价物 iolar，那就没有必要用 illait 即幼鹰来表示前一天即冬至日即单 I——因为 E 不是用小天鹅表示的，A 也不是用小凤头麦鸡表示的。

These cyphers were used to mystify and deceive all ordinary people who were not in the secret. For example, if one poet asked another in public: ‘When shall we two meet again?’ he would expect an answer in which elements of several cypher alphabets were used, and which was further disguised by being spelt backwards or put in a foreign language, or both. He might, for instance, be answered in a sentence built up from the Colour, Bird, Tree and Fortress oghams:
这些密码用来迷惑和欺骗所有不在秘密中的普通人。例如，如果一位诗人在公开场合问另一位：「我们两人何时再相见？」他会期望得到一个使用了多种密码字母表元素的回答，并进一步通过倒拼或使用外语或两者兼用加以伪装。例如，他可能得到一个由颜色、鸟、树和堡垒欧甘组成的句子：

When a brown-plumaged rook perches on the fir below the Fortress of Seolae.
当一只棕羽秃鼻鸦栖于冷杉之下塞奥莱堡垒旁。





That would spell out the Latin CRAS – ‘tomorrow’.
这就拼出了拉丁文 CRAS——「明天」。

Besides the one hundred and fifty regular cypher-alphabets that the candidate for the ollaveship had to learn, there were countless other tricks for putting the uninitiated off the scent; for example, the use of the letter after, or before, the desired one. Often a synonym was used for the tree-cypher word – ‘the chief overseer of Nimrod’s Tower’ for Beth, birch; ‘activity of bees’ for Saille, willow; ‘pack of wolves’ for Straif, blackthorn, and so on.
除了奥拉夫学位候选人必须学习的一百五十种正规密码字母表外，还有无数让门外汉摸不着头脑的诡计；例如使用目标字母的前一个或后一个字母。树密码词常用同义词替代——贝斯即桦树用「宁录塔的首席监督者」；赛尔即柳树用「蜂之劳作」；斯特莱夫即黑刺李用「狼群」等等。

In one of the cypher-alphabets, Luis is given as elm, not rowan, because the Irish word for elm, lemh, begins with an L; Tinne is given as elder because the Irish word for elder, trom, begins with a T; similarly, Quert is given as quulend, holly. This trick may account for Ngetal, reed, being so frequently read as broom, the Irish of which is n’gilcach; but there is also a practical poetic reason for the change. The Book of Ballymote gives broom the poetic name of ‘Physicians’ Strength’, presumably because its bitter shoots, being diuretic, were prized as ‘a remedy for surfeits and to all diseases arising therefrom’. (A decoction of broom-flowers was Henry VIII’s favourite medicine.) A medical tree suited the month of November, when the year was dying and the cold winds kept well-to-do people indoors with little diversion but eating and drinking.
在一种密码字母表中，路易斯被记为榆树而非花楸，因为爱尔兰语中榆树 lemh 以 L 开头；丁内被记为接骨木，因为爱尔兰语中接骨木 trom 以 T 开头；同样，奎尔特被记为 quulend 即冬青。这一诡计也许解释了为何恩盖塔尔即芦苇经常被读作金雀花，其爱尔兰语为 n'gilcach；但也有实际的诗性理由。 《巴利莫特书》给金雀花起的诗名为「医者之力」，大概是因为其苦芽有利尿作用，被视为「治疗暴食及由此引发的一切疾病的良药」。（金雀花煎剂是亨利八世最爱的药物。）一棵药用树适合十一月——此时一年将尽，寒风使富裕之人困居室内，除饮食外别无消遣。

This has been absurdly taken to mean from the Nile; it can only mean from the River of Egypt (Joshua, XV, 4) the southern boundary of Palestine, a stream well known to Achaean raiders of the thirteenth and twelfth centuries BC.
¹ 荷马说法罗斯岛距埃及河有整整一天航程。这被荒谬地理解为距尼罗河；它只能指距「埃及河」（约书亚记 XV, 4）——巴勒斯坦的南界——公元前十三和十二世纪的阿卡亚劫掠者熟知的一条河流。

The absence of prehistoric remains on the island itself suggests that all except the shore was a tree-planted sanctuary of Proteus, oracular hero and giver of winds.
《凯布拉·纳加斯特》——埃塞俄比亚圣经——的一位中世纪编者犯了同样的错误。他将从耶路撒冷偷走约柜之人的逃亡描述为奇迹般的，因为他们在一天之内就走了从加沙到埃及河的距离，而商队时刻表将其算作十三天的旅程。岛上本身缺乏史前遗迹，表明除海岸外全境是普罗透斯——神谕英雄和赐风者——的一座植树圣所。



1 Compare the equally mixed list given by Nonnus of Zagreus’s transformations: ‘Zeus in his goat-skin coat, Cronos making rain, an inspired youth, a lion, a horse, a horned snake, a tiger, a bull’. The transformations of Thetis before her marriage with Peleus were, according to various authors from Pindar to Tzetzes, fire, water, wind, a tree, a bird, a tiger, a lion, a serpent, a cuttlefish. The transformations of Tam Lin in the Scottish ballad were snake or newt, bear, lion, red-hot iron and a coal to be quenched in running water. The zoological elements common to these four versions of an original story, namely snake, lion, some other fierce beast (bear, bull, panther, or tiger) suggest a calendar sequence of three seasons corresponding with the Lion, Goat and Serpent of the Carian Chimaera; or the Bull, Lion and Serpent of the Babylonian Sir-rush. If this is so, fire and water would stand for the sun and moon which between them rule the year. It is possible, however, that the animals in Nonnus’s list, bull, lion, tiger, horse and snake, form a Thraco-Libyan calendar of five, not three, seasons.
¹ 可对比农诺斯给出的同样混合的扎格柔斯变形列表：「披山羊皮的宙斯、降雨的克洛诺斯、一个受启青年、狮子、马、角蛇、虎、公牛。」据从品达到策泽斯的各作者所述，忒提斯在嫁给佩琉斯之前的变形为火、水、风、树、鸟、虎、狮、蛇、乌贼。苏格兰民谣中塔姆·林的变形为蛇或蝾螈、熊、狮、烧红的铁和一块需要在流水中淬熄的炭。这四个版本同一原始故事的共同动物学元素——即蛇、狮、某种其他猛兽（熊、公牛、豹或虎）——暗示一个三季节的历法序列，对应卡里亚奇美拉的狮、羊、蛇；或巴比伦 Sir-rush 的公牛、狮、蛇。若如此，火和水则代表共同主宰一年的太阳和月亮。然而，农诺斯列表中的动物——公牛、狮、虎、马和蛇——也可能构成一个五季节而非三季节的色雷斯-利比亚历法。

1 Clement is very nearly right in another sense, which derives from the suppression in the Phoenician and early Hebrew alphabets of all the vowels, except aleph, occurring in the Greek alphabet with which they are linked. The introduction into Hebrew script of pure vowel signs in the form of dots is ascribed to Ezra who, with Nehemiah, established the New Law about the year 430. It is likely that the vowels had been suppressed at a time when the Holy Name of the deity who presided over the year consisted of vowels only; and the proof that Ezra did not invent them but merely established an inoffensive notation for a sacred series long fixed in oral tradition lies in the order which he used, namely I.Ē.E.U.O.A.OU.Ō. This is the Palamedan I.E.U.O.A. with the addition of three extra vowels to bring the number up to eight, the mystic numeral of increase. Since the dots with which he chose to represent them were not part of the alphabet and had no validity except when attached to consonants, they could be used without offence. Nevertheless, it is remarkable that the consonants which compose the Tetragrammaton, namely yod, he and vav may cease to carry consonantal force when they have vowel signs attached to them; so that JHWH could be sounded IAŌOUĀ. This is a peculiarity that no other Hebrew consonant has, except ain, and ain not in all dialects of Hebrew. Clement got the last vowel wrong, E for Ā, perhaps because he knew that the letter H is known as He in Hebrew.
¹ 克莱门特在另一种意义上也几乎正确，这源于腓尼基和早期希伯来字母表中除了 aleph 之外所有在与之关联的希腊字母表中出现的元音都被压制。将纯元音符号以点的形式引入希伯来文字被归于以斯拉——他与尼希米约在公元前430年确立了新律法。元音很可能在主宰一年之神的神圣之名仅由元音组成时被压制；以斯拉并非发明它们而只是为长期固定在口传传统中的神圣序列确立一种无害记法的证据在于他使用的顺序，即 I.Ē.E.U.O.A.OU.Ō。这是帕拉墨得斯的 I.E.U.O.A. 加上三个额外元音以将数目增至八——增长的神秘数字。既然他选择用来代表元音的点不是字母表的一部分、只有附着于辅音时才有效力，使用它们不会造成冒犯。然而值得注意的是，组成四字母神名即 yod、he 和 vav 的辅音在附有元音符号时可能不再具有辅音力；因此 JHWH 可以发音为 IAŌOUĀ。这是除 ain 之外没有其他希伯来辅音所具有的特性——而 ain 也并非在所有希伯来方言中都如此。克莱门特把最后一个元音弄错了，用 E 代替了 Ā，也许因为他知道字母 H 在希伯来语中称为 He。

2 42 is the number of the children devoured by Elisha’s she-bears. This is apparently an iconotropic myth derived from a sacred picture of the Libyo-Thraco-Pelasgian ‘Brauronia’ ritual. The two she-bears were girls dressed in yellow dresses who pretended to be bears and rushed savagely at the boys who attended the festival. The ritual was in honour of Artemis Callisto, the Moon as Bear-Goddess, and since a goat was sacrificed seems to belong to the Midsummer festivities. 42 is the number of days from the beginning of the H month, which is the preparation for the midsummer marriage and death-orgy, to Midsummer Day. 42 is also the number of infernal jurymen who judged Osiris: the days between his midsummer death and the end of the T month, when he reached Calypso’s isle, though this is obscured in the priestly Book of the Dead. According to Clement of Alexandria there were forty-two books of Hermetic mysteries.
² 42是以利沙的母熊所吞食的儿童数目。这显然是一个源于利比亚-色雷斯-佩拉斯吉「布劳罗尼亚」仪式圣画的偶像置换神话。两头母熊是穿黄色衣裙的少女，假装成熊，凶猛地扑向参加节日的男孩。仪式敬奉的是阿耳忒弥斯·卡利斯托——作为熊女神的月亮——既然献祭了一头山羊，它似乎属于仲夏庆典。42是从 H 月初——即仲夏婚配与死亡狂欢的准备——到仲夏日之间的天数。42也是审判奥西里斯的冥界陪审员数目：从他仲夏之死到 T 月末——他抵达卡吕普索之岛——之间的天数，尽管这在祭司的《死者之书》中被模糊了。据亚历山大里亚的克莱门特记载，赫尔墨斯密仪典籍有四十二卷。



1 The number occurs also in two royal brooches – ‘king’s wheels’ – found in 1945 in a Bronze Age ‘Iberian’ burial at Lluch in Majorca, the seat of a Black Virgin cult, and dated about 1500 BC. The first is a disc of seven inches in diameter, made for pinning on a cloak and embossed with a nineteen-rayed sun. This sun is enclosed by two bands, the outer one containing thirteen separated leaves, of five different kinds, perhaps representing wild olive, alder, prickly-oak, ivy and rosemary, some turned clockwise, some counter-clockwise, and all but two of them with buds or rudimentary flowers joined to them half-way up their stalks. The inner band contains five roundels at regular intervals, the spaces between the roundels filled up with pairs of leaves of the same sort as those in the outer ring, except that the alder is not represented. The formula is: thirteen months, a pentad of goddesses-of-the-year, a nineteen-year reign.
¹ 这一数字也出现在1945年在马略卡岛柳奇一座青铜时代「伊比利亚」墓葬中出土的两枚皇家胸针——「王之轮」——中，该地是黑圣母崇拜的所在地，定年约公元前1500年。第一枚是直径七英寸的圆盘，用于别在斗篷上，浮雕有十九道光芒的太阳。太阳被两道带环绕，外带包含十三片分离的叶子，分五种，可能代表野橄榄、桤木、胭脂虫橡、常春藤和迷迭香，一些顺时针、一些逆时针，除两片外都在茎的中途附有花蕾或初级花朵。内带以等距排列五个圆饰，圆饰之间的空隙填以与外环同类成对叶子，但桤木未在其中。公式是：十三个月，一个年之女神五联体，一个十九年统治期。

The other, slightly smaller, royal disc found in the same burial has a border of nineteen semi-circles, a central sun with twenty-one detached rays and, between the sun and the border two intervening bands – the inner one containing forty-five small bosses, the outer twenty hearts. The head of the pin is shaped like a swan’s; as that of the other, which has perished, may have also been. Here the formula is: a nineteen-year reign, with a fresh victim (the twenty hearts) offered at the beginning of every year, the king himself being the twentieth. The White Swan, his Mother, will carry him off to her Hyperborean paradise. Twenty-one is the number of rays on Akhenaton’s sun. Forty-five is the pentad of goddesses-of-the-year, multiplied by the number nine to show that each is an aspect of the Moon-goddess.
在同一墓葬中发现的另一枚略小的皇家圆盘有十九个半圆组成的边框、中央有二十一道分离光芒的太阳，太阳与边框之间有两道带——内带含四十五个小凸点，外带含二十颗心形。针头呈天鹅头形；另一枚已损毁的针头可能也是如此。此处的公式是：一个十九年统治期，每年初献祭一名新 victim（二十颗心形），国王本人是第二十名。白天鹅——他的母亲——将把他带往她的极北乐园。二十一是阿肯纳顿太阳的光芒数。四十五是年之女神五联体乘以九，以表明每一位都是月女神的一个面向。

So far as I know, the Bronze Age and early Iron Age smiths who, like the poets and physicians, came under the direct patronage of the Muse, never embellished their work with meaningless decoration. Every object they made – sword, spear-head, shield, dagger, scabbard, brooch, jug, harness-ring, tankard, bucket, mirror, or what not – had magical properties to which the shape and number of its various decorations testified. Few archaeologists lay any emphasis on magic, and this makes most museum-guides pretty dull reading. For example, in the British Museum Guide to the Antiquities of the Early Iron Age (1905), fig. 140 shows a beaded bronze collar from Lochar Moss, Dumfriesshire. The editorial comment is only on the melon-like shape of the beads which has, it is said, affinities with that of turquoise-coloured glass beads common on sites in Roman Britain. What needed to be pointed out was that there are thirteen of these beads in the collar, each with seven ribs, and that the design on the rigid crescent-shaped part is an interlace of nine S’s: a collar replete with lunar fate. Similarly, the open-work bronze disc (fig. 122) found in the Thames at Hammersmith is interesting because the sun which forms its centre has eight rays and is pierced with a Maltese cross; but the editor’s only comment is on its stylistic relation with open-work bronze horse-poitrels from a Gaulish chariot-burial at Somme Bionne (Plate III), one of which contains pierced crosses. This is irrelevant, unless attention is paid to the three swastikas in the poitrel and to the numbers nine and thirteen which characterize the horse head-stall ornaments shown in the same plate.
据我所知，青铜时代和早期铁器时代的铁匠——与诗人和医师一样受缪斯直接庇护——从不用无意义的装饰来点缀他们的作品。他们制作的每一件物品——剑、矛头、盾、匕首、剑鞘、胸针、壶、马具环、大杯、桶、镜或其它——都具有魔法属性，其各种装饰的形状和数目即为见证。很少有考古学家强调魔法，这使得大多数博物馆指南读起来相当乏味。例如，在《大英博物馆早期铁器时代文物指南》（1905年）中，图140展示了一条来自邓弗里斯郡洛查沼泽的珠饰青铜项圈。编者只评论了珠子的瓜状形状，据说与罗马不列颠遗址常见的绿松石色玻璃珠有亲缘关系。需要指出的是项圈上有十三颗这样的珠子，每颗有七道棱，硬质新月形部分上的图案是九个 S 的交错编织：一条充满太阴命运的项圈。同样，在泰晤士河哈默史密斯段发现的透雕青铜圆盘（图122）也很有趣，因为作为其中心的太阳有八道光芒并有一个马耳他十字穿孔；但编者只评论了它与索姆比奥讷的高卢战车葬（图版III）出土的透雕青铜马胸甲的风格关系，其中一件有穿孔十字。这与主题无关，除非注意到马胸甲上的三个万字符以及同一图版中马笼头饰物的特征数字九和十三。





Chapter Seventeen

title: 第十七章
content:
THE LION WITH THE STEADY HAND
稳手之狮





Llew Llaw Gyffes (‘the Lion with the Steady Hand’), a type of Dionysus or Celestial Hercules worshipped in ancient Britain, is generally identified with Lugh, the Goidelic Sun-god, who has given his name to the towns of Laon, Leyden, Lyons and Carlisle (Caer Lugubalion). The name ‘Lugh’ may be connected with the Latin lux (light) or lucus (a grove); it may even be derived from the Sumerian lug meaning ‘son’. ‘Llew’ is a different word, connected with leo (lion), an appellation of Lugh’s. In Ireland he was called ‘Lugh the Long-handed’, defeater of the Africans, the earliest settlers in Ireland; he possessed a magic spear which thirsted for blood and flashed fire or roared aloud in battle; and he was the first to use the horse in warfare. When he approached from the West, at the Battle of Moytura, Breas (Boreas?) Balor, the one-eyed King of the old Gods and later styled Lugh’s grandfather, cried out: ‘I wonder that the Sun has risen in the West today rather than in the East.’ His druids answered: ‘Would that it were no more than the Sun! It is the glowing face of Lugh the Long-handed’ – which nobody could gaze upon without being dazzled. Another account of his parentage quoted by H. d’Arbois de Joubainville in his monumental Cycle Mythologique Irlandaise makes him the son not of Balor’s daughter Ethne by one Cian, but of Clothru (who is apparently a single form of the Triple Goddess Eire, Fodhla and Banbha) by Balor’s three grandsons Brian, Iuchar and Iuchurba; a row of red circles on his neck and belly marking off the parts of his body that each father had begotten. His death on the first Sunday in August – called Lugh nasadh (‘Commemoration of Lugh’), later altered to ‘Lugh-mass’ or ‘Lammas’ – was until recently observed in Ireland with Good Friday-like mourning and kept as a feast of dead kinsfolk, the mourning procession being always led by a young man carrying a hooped wreath. Lammas was also observed as a mourning feast in most parts of England in mediaeval times; which accounts for the extraordinary popular demonstrations when William Rufus’s body was brought up from the New Forest for burial. The peasants were bewailing a mythical Lugh when along came the body of their own red-headed king laid on a harvest cart. Nowadays the only English Lammas celebrated is the Lancashire Wakes Week, the dismal meaning of which has been forgotten among the holiday distractions of Blackpool.
卢·劳·吉弗斯（Llew Llaw Gyffes，「稳手之狮」），一种古不列颠崇拜的狄俄尼索斯或天界赫拉克勒斯型神祇，通常被等同于戈伊德尔太阳神卢格（Lugh），他把自己的名字给了拉昂、莱顿、里昂和卡莱尔（Caer Lugubalion）等城市。「Lugh」之名可能与拉丁语 lux（光）或 lucus（圣林）有关；甚至可能源自苏美尔语 lug，意为「儿子」。「Llew」是另一个词，与 leo（狮）有关，是卢格的称号。在爱尔兰他被称为「长手卢格」，击败了爱尔兰最早的定居者非洲人；他拥有一支渴望鲜血、在战斗中闪烁火焰或大声咆哮的魔法长矛；他是最早在战争中使用马的人。当他从西方接近莫伊图拉战场时，布雷阿斯（Breas，即玻瑞阿斯？）巴洛尔——老一代众神的独眼王、后来被称为卢格的祖父——喊道：「我奇怪今天太阳为何从西方而非东方升起。」他的德鲁伊们回答：「但愿那不过是太阳！那是长手卢格的发光面容」——无人能凝视它而不被晃眼。H. 达布瓦·德·茹班维尔在其巨著《爱尔兰神话循环》中引用的另一种出身说法称他不是巴洛尔之女埃斯妮与某个基安之子，而是克洛特鲁（显然是三重女神埃里、福德拉和班巴的单一体）与巴洛尔的三个孙子布莱恩、伊乌查和伊乌查尔巴之子；他颈和腹部的一排红色圆圈标出了每个父亲所生身体的部分。他在八月的第一个星期日死亡——称为 Lugh nasadh（「卢格纪念」），后改为「Lugh-mass」或「收获节」（Lammas）——直到最近在爱尔兰仍以类似耶稣受难日的哀悼方式纪念，并作为亡亲的节日，哀悼队伍始终由一个手持环状花冠的年轻人领队。中世纪时英格兰大部分地区也将收获节作为哀悼节日来纪念；这解释了威廉·鲁弗斯的遗体从新森林运来安葬时异乎寻常的民众示威。农民们正在哀悼一个神话中的卢格，此时他们自己的红发国王的遗体乘着收割车经过。如今英格兰唯一庆祝的收获节是兰开夏的守夜周，其阴郁的含义已在布莱克浦的假日消遣中被遗忘。

The famous Tailltean Games of Ireland, originally funeral games in the Etruscan style, with chariot races and sword-play, take place at Lammas. The Irish tradition that they were held in memory of one Tailte, Lugh’s dead foster-mother, is late and misleading. The games, which in early mediaeval times were so well-frequented that the chariots occupied six miles of road, were marked by Tailtean (or Teltown) marriages in honour of Lugh and his capricious bride. These were trial marriages and lasted ‘for a year and a day’, that is, for 365 days, and could be dissolved only by an act of divorce performed in the place where they had been celebrated. Then the man and woman stood back to back in the centre of the Black Rath and walked apart, one to the north, the other to the south. Lugh was incarnate in the famous Ulster hero Cuchulain: he flew in at the mouth of Cuchulain’s mother Dechtire in the form of a may-fly. Cuchulain was so much of a sun-god that when he plunged into a cold bath the water hissed and began to boil. That Lugh’s magical weapon was a spear suggests that he belongs to the earlier Bronze Age invaders of Ireland; the later ones were armed with swords. He may be identified with Geryon, King of the West, ‘with three bodies in one’, whom Hercules despoiled of his red cattle, guarded by a two-headed dog, and killed in Erytheia (red island).
爱尔兰著名的泰尔滕运动会最初是伊特鲁里亚风格的葬礼竞技会，有战车赛和剑术比赛，在收获节举行。爱尔兰传统说它们是为纪念卢格的亡养母泰尔特而举行，这是晚出且误导性的。这些运动会——在中世纪早期如此盛行使战车占据了六英里的道路——以泰尔滕（或特尔敦）婚姻为标志，以纪念卢格和他善变的新娘。这些是试婚婚姻，持续「一年零一天」即365天，只能在举行地通过离婚手续解除。然后男女在黑土堡中央背对背站立，各向南北走去。卢格化身为著名的阿尔斯特英雄库丘林：他以蚋虫之形飞入库丘林之母德克提蕾口中。库丘林是如此太阳化的神，以至于当他跳入冷水浴时水会嘶嘶作响开始沸腾。卢格的魔法武器是矛而非剑，暗示他属于爱尔兰更早的青铜时代入侵者；后来的入侵者使用剑。他可与革律翁——西方之王，「三体合一」——等同，赫拉克勒斯夺走了他的红牛群（由一头双头犬守卫）并在厄律忒亚（红色岛屿）杀死了他。

According to the mythographers, Hercules sailed to the West from Greece, with ships from Crete, and went by way of North Africa, the Straits of Gibraltar, Tartessus, and Gaul (where he fathered the Celts). This is the same course as the Milesians took, and the Tenth Labour of Hercules reads like one more account of the defeat of the New Stone Age invaders – Partholan’s and Nemed’s peoples – by Bronze Age men from Spain; but Erytheia is perhaps Devonshire, famous for its bright red soil and red cattle, which the Bronze Age men also conquered from New Stone Age people. It was during this Labour that Hercules borrowed the golden cup from the Sun, and became lotus-borne. Geryon appears to have been a Western version of the Vedic god Agni, the earliest Indian trinity, who had three births and three bodies. As born of water, Agni was a calf who yearly grew to ‘a bull that sharpens his horns’; as born of two sticks (the fire-drill), he was a glutton with a fiery tongue; as born in the highest heaven, he was an eagle. The Vedic hymns also celebrate him as a supporter of the sky, namely the pillar of cloud that rises up when fires are lighted in his honour, and as an omniscient immortal who has taken up his abode among mortals. Thus when Hercules killed Geryon and carried off his cattle he was, in fact, gaining a victory over one of his own selves.
据神话编撰者说，赫拉克勒斯从希腊乘克里特船只向西航行，经由北非、直布罗陀海峡、塔特苏斯和高卢（他在那里繁衍了凯尔特人）。这与米利西人走的路线相同，赫拉克勒斯的第十项劳动读起来像是又一段关于青铜时代的人从西班牙击败新石器时代入侵者——帕索兰和内梅德的人民——的记述；但厄律忒亚也许是德文郡——以鲜红土壤和红牛闻名——青铜时代的人也从新石器时代人手中征服了它。正是在这项劳动中，赫拉克勒斯向太阳借了金杯，乘莲花漂流。革律翁似乎是吠陀神阿耆尼——最早的印度三位一体，有三次诞生和三个身体——的西方版本。生于水时，阿耆尼是一头每年长成「磨利双角的公牛」的牛犊；生于两根木棍（取火钻）时，他是有一条火舌的饕餮；生于最高天时，他是一只鹰。吠陀赞美诗还赞颂他为天的支撑者——即为他点火时升起的烟柱——以及一位已栖身于凡人之中全知不朽的神。因此当赫拉克勒斯杀死革律翁并夺走其牛群时，事实上是战胜了他自己的一个化身。

In some parts of Wales Lammas is still kept as a fair. Sir John Rhys records that in the 1850’s the hills of Fan Fach and South Barrule in Carmarthenshire were crowded with mourners for Llew Llaw on the first Sunday in August, their excuse being that they were ‘going up to bewail Jephthah’s daughter on the mountain’. This, oddly enough, was the very same excuse that the post-Exilic Jewish girls had used, after the Deuteronomic reforms, to disguise their mourning for Tammuz, Llew Llaw’s Palestinian counterpart. But with the Welsh Revival the practice was denounced as pagan and discontinued.
威尔士一些地区至今仍将收获节作为集市日。约翰·里斯爵士记载，1850年代卡马森郡的法恩法赫山和南巴鲁勒山在八月第一个星期日挤满了哀悼卢·劳的人，他们的借口是「上山为耶弗他的女儿哀哭」。奇巧的是，这正是被掳后的犹太女孩在申命记改革之后用来掩饰她们哀悼坦木兹——卢·劳在巴勒斯坦的对应者——的同一个借口。但随着威尔士大复兴，这一习俗被谴责为异教而终止。

Here is Llew Llaw’s own story (translated by Lady Charlotte Guest) which forms the second part of the Romance of Math the Son of Mathonwy. Though not a saga in the grand style, like that of Cuchulain, and in part falsified by the intrusion of the God Woden (Gwydion) into territory not originally his, it is one of the best summaries extant of the single poetic Theme.
以下是卢·劳·吉弗斯的故事（夏洛特·格斯特女士译），构成《马思之子马索诺伊的传奇》的第二部分。虽不如库丘林传奇那般宏大，且部分因沃登神（格维敦）闯入本不属他的领地而失真，但它是现存对单一诗性主题最好的概述之一。

The first part of this romance relates to Gwydion’s stealing of the sacred pigs from Pryderi the King of the Pembrokeshire Annwm, on behalf of Math the son of Mathonwy, King of North Wales. Math is pictured as a sacred King of the ancient type whose virtue was resident in the feet. Except when his kingdom was attacked and he was obliged to ride into battle, Math was bound by convention to keep his foot in the lap of a priestess. The office of royal foot-holder survived in the Welsh princely courts until early mediaeval times, but was then assigned to a man, not a woman. Math’s was a matrilinear kingdom, his heirs being his sister’s sons; that is to say the husbands of his sister-in-law’s daughters. One of them, Gilvaethwy, attempts to usurp the throne by seducing the reigning queen, Math’s foot-holder, while Math is away on campaign. Math counters with all his magical resources, eliminates his rival, and then decides to marry his niece Arianrhod. The holding of the foot was doubtless protective, the heel being the one vulnerable point of sacred kings: witness the heel of Achilles pierced by Paris’s arrow; the heel of Talus pierced by Medea’s pin; the heel of Diarmuid pierced by the bristle of the Benn Gulban Boar; the heel of Harpocrates stung by the scorpion; the heel of Balder (in the Danish version of the myth) pierced by the mistletoe flung by the god Holder at the instigation of Loki; the heel of Ra stung by the magic snake sent by Isis; the heel of Mopsus the Lapith stung by the black snake of Libya, the heel of Krishna in the Mahabharata, pierced by an arrow which his brother Jara the Hunter shot. Talus is closely related to Achilles in Apollodorus’s version of the myth, where the cause of his death is given as a wound in the foot from an arrow shot by Hercules’s heir, Poeas.
此传奇的第一部分讲述格维敦代表北威尔士之王马思之子马索诺伊，从彭布罗克郡安温之王普里德里那里偷走神圣猪群的故事。马思被描绘为古代类型的神圣国王，其德行寄于双足。除非王国遭到攻击而必须骑马出战，马思按惯例须将一只脚放在一位女祭司的膝上。王室持足之职在威尔士亲王宫廷中存续至中世纪早期，但此后改由男子而非女子担任。马思的王国是母系继承制，继承人是他姐妹的儿子；即他嫂子之女的丈夫。其中之一吉尔瓦埃斯乌趁马思外出征战时企图勾引在位王后——马思的持足女祭司——以篡夺王位。马思以全部魔法资源回击，消除了对手，然后决定娶外甥女埃里安罗德。持足无疑具有保护性质，因为脚踵是神圣国王唯一的致命弱点：阿喀琉斯之踵被帕里斯的箭刺穿；塔洛斯之踵被美狄亚的钉刺穿；迪尔米德之踵被本恩古尔班野猪的刚毛刺穿；哈波克拉忒斯之踵被蝎子螫伤；巴尔德尔之踵（在丹麦版神话中）被洛基唆使霍尔德神投掷的槲寄生刺穿；拉之踵被伊西斯派出的魔法蛇咬伤；拉庇泰人摩普索斯之踵被利比亚黑蛇咬伤；《摩诃婆罗多》中黑天之踵被兄弟猎人贾拉的箭射穿。在阿波罗多鲁斯的版本中，塔洛斯与阿喀琉斯关系密切，死因是被赫拉克勒斯的继承人波阿斯射出的箭伤及足部。

Since recently I had the ill-luck to tread on a Pyrenean viper – a variety stated to be eight times more lethal than the English – I can take the argument further and assert confidently that ‘Silver Island’ or ‘White Island’, or ‘Revolving Island’, to which the sacred king goes at his death, is prophetically seen by him when his heel is bitten by the serpent or scorpion, or pricked with the (presumably) poisoned arrow. Soon after the first pain and vomiting my eyesight began to fail. A small silver spot appeared in the centre of my field of vision, which gradually enlarged into an island with sharply defined bastions; the shores spread wider and wider, as though I were nearing it across a sea. When I started to walk home, I could not see where I was going; and then the island began slowly to revolve in a clockwise direction. I cannot say whether it would have revolved the canonical four times if the poison had been more virulent or if I had been obsessed by the sense of coming death as these kings were; the illusion had faded long before I was given an anti-toxin. I was thankful that, unlike my youngest son whom I was carrying on my shoulder at the time, I had not been born on the day of the winter solstice. My foot remained so swollen for a couple of months that I could only hobble. Finally a Catalan doctor prescribed hot fomentations of wild-olive leaves, which reduced the swelling within three days. This traditional remedy has mythological sense as well as practical value: the wild-olive was the timber of Hercules’s club, and therefore a prime expulsive of lingering venom.
由于近日我不幸踩到了一条比利牛斯蝮蛇——据说毒性是英国蝮蛇的八倍——我可以将论证推进，自信地断言：神圣国王死后前往的「银岛」或「白岛」或「旋转岛」，是在他的脚踵被蛇或蝎子咬伤、或被（可能涂毒的）箭刺中时预见性地看到的。最初的疼痛和呕吐之后不久，我的视力开始衰退。视野中央出现一个银色小点，逐渐扩大为一座棱堡分明的岛屿；海岸越展越宽，仿佛我在海上向它靠近。当我起身走回家时，已看不见路；然后那岛屿开始缓慢地顺时针旋转。我无法说清如果毒性更烈或我像那些国王一样被将死之感所萦绕，它是否会旋转那经典的四圈；在我被注射抗毒素之前幻象早已消退。我庆幸自己——不像当时扛在肩上的小儿子——不是在冬至日出生的。我的脚肿胀了两个月，只能跛行。最后一位加泰罗尼亚医生开了野橄榄叶热敷剂，三天内就消了肿。这一传统疗法既有实用价值也有神话意义：野橄榄是赫拉克勒斯棍棒的木材，因此是驱除残余蛇毒的首选药物。

I should, of course, have remembered the Emperor Claudius’s special edict recorded in Suetonius, ‘how there is nothing better for the bite of a viper than the juice of yew’. This was the correct homoeopathic treatment; as wild-olive was the allopathic. I find that Topsell in his Serpents (1658), recommends the juice of the periwinkle; this is another homoeopathic remedy, the periwinkle being ‘the flower of death’.
我当然应该记得苏埃托尼乌斯所记克劳狄皇帝的特别敕令：「治疗蝮蛇咬伤，没有比紫杉汁更好的了。」这是正确的顺势疗法；野橄榄则是对抗疗法。我发现托普塞尔在《蛇类》（1658年）中推荐长春花汁；这是另一种顺势疗法，因为长春花是「死亡之花」。
