Apollodorus and Diodorus Siculus make Perdix feminine, the mother of Talus, but this is as much as to say that Talus was virgin-born; because, according to Aristotle, Pliny and Aelian the hen-partridge can be impregnated by the sound of the cock-partridge’s voice or by his scent blown down the wind. Pliny says ‘in no other animal is there any such susceptibility in the sexual feelings’, and that when the female is sitting on her eggs the cocks relieve their emotions by practising sodomy – an observation which may have inspired the organized sodomy in the temples of the Syrian Moon-goddess, though dogs and doves, also associated with her worship, are credited with the same habit. The Aegean island most famous for its partridges was Anaphe, the Argonauts’ first landfall on their homeward voyage from Crete after Medea had killed Talus; where Radiant Apollo was worshipped with rites closely paralleling those of the Hebrew Tabernacles, though of an erotic cast. This Apollo was a Sun-god, not an Underworld one.
神话编撰者希吉努斯和奥维德将英雄佩耳迪克斯（Perdix，「鹧鸪」）等同于塔洛斯，证实了瘸行鹧鸪与瘸腿国王之间的联系。阿波罗多鲁斯和狄奥多鲁斯·西库鲁斯将佩耳迪克斯定为女性，塔洛斯之母，但这等于说塔洛斯是处女所生；因为据亚里士多德、老普林尼和埃利安记载，母鹧鸪可通过雄鹧鸪的声音或风吹来的气味受孕。老普林尼说「没有其他动物的性感受力如此之强」，当雌鸟孵蛋时雄鸟通过练习鸡奸来发泄情绪——这一观察可能启发了叙利亚月神庙宇中的有组织鸡奸，尽管狗和鸽子也与其崇拜相关并被认为有同样习惯。以鹧鸪最闻名的爱琴海岛屿是阿纳菲——阿尔戈英雄从克里特返航途中美狄亚杀死塔洛斯后的第一个登陆地——在那里光辉的阿波罗以与希伯来住棚节极为平行但带有色情色彩的仪式受崇拜。此阿波罗是太阳神而非冥界神。

Partridges become so deeply absorbed in their dance that even if a man comes up close and kills some of the dancers the rest continue undeterred; a habit of which the ancients took full advantage. In the mating-season they used to put a decoy cock-partridge in a cage at the end of a long narrow winding brushwood tunnel and gave it corn to eat. Its lonely cry, combining the call to love with the call to food, attracted the hens along the tunnel, and when they reached the cage and it uttered its usual challenge call, other cocks would come running up, only to be knocked on the head with sticks by the waiting hunters as soon as they emerged from the tunnel. Thus in I Samuel, XXVI, 20 Saul is taunted for his unkingly behaviour in hunting David, who is not only as insignificant as a flea but as easily caught as a mountain partridge. The decoy partridge was one that had dislocated its leg in trying to escape from the horse-hair slip-knot in which it was snared. This lame, and therefore easily tamed, decoy was fattened in a cage like a sacred king in his palace – both honoured prisoners – and the more numerous its victims, the more gleeful its cry. In Ecclesiasticus (XI, 30) the caged partridge is an allegory of the proud man who rejoices at the disasters into which he has decoyed his neighbours. This form of sport is still practised in Mediterranean countries as far west as Majorca.
鹧鸪如此专注于它们的舞蹈，即使有人走近杀死一些舞者，其余的也不为所动地继续跳；古人充分利用了这一习性。在交配季节，他们通常把一只诱饵雄鹧鸪放在长而窄的弯曲柴枝隧道尽头的笼中喂以谷物。它孤独的叫声将爱的呼唤与食物的呼唤合为一体，吸引雌鸟沿隧道走来，当她们到达笼子它发出通常的挑战叫声时，其他雄鸟会跑来，刚从隧道出来就被等候的猎人用棍棒打昏。因此《撒母耳记上》XXVI, 20 中扫罗因猎捕大卫不像国王的行为而被嘲讽——大卫不仅像跳蚤一样微不足道，还像山鹧鸪一样容易被捉。诱饵鹧鸪是在试图挣脱马尾活套时脱臼了腿的。这只瘸了因而容易驯服的诱饵像神圣国王在宫中一样被关在笼中肥育——两者都是受尊崇的囚徒——它的牺牲品越多叫声越欢快。《便西拉智训》XI, 30 中笼中鹧鸪是骄傲者的寓言——他因诱使邻人陷入灾祸而欢欣。这种运动至今仍在远至马略卡的 Mediterranean 国家 practiced。

It seems, then, that in the pesach a bull-cult had been superimposed on a partridge cult; and that the Minotaur to whom youths and maidens (from Athens and elsewhere) were sacrificed had once represented the decoy partridge in the middle of a brushwood maze, towards which the others were lured for their death dance. He was, in fact, the centre of a ritual performance, originally honouring the Moon-goddess, the lascivious hen-partridge, who at Athens and in parts of Crete was the mother and lover of the Sun-hero Talus. But the dance of the hobbling cock-partridge was later transformed into one honouring the Moon-goddess Pasiphaë, the cow in heat, mother and lover of the Sun-hero, the bull-headed Minos. Thus the spirally-danced Troy-game (called the ‘Crane Dance’ in Delos because it was adapted there to the cult of the Moon-goddess as Crane) had the same origin as the pesach. The case is proved by Homer who wrote:
看来在 pesach 中牛崇拜叠加在了鹧鸪崇拜之上；而弥诺陶洛斯——雅典等地青年男女被献祭的对象——曾代表柴枝迷宫中央的诱饵鹧鸪，其他鹧鸪被引向它做死亡之舞。事实上他是一个仪式表演的中心，最初敬奉月女神——好色的母鹧鸪——在雅典和克里特部分地区她是太阳英雄塔洛斯的母亲和情人。但瘸行雄鹧鸪之舞后来被改造为敬奉月女神帕西法厄——发情的母牛——太阳英雄牛头弥诺斯之母和情人。因此螺旋舞动的特洛伊游戏（在提洛斯被称为「鹤舞」，因为在那里被改编为鹤之女神的崇拜）与 pesach 同源。荷马写道，此案可证：

Daedalas in Cnossos once contrived
Daedalas in Cnossos once contrived（代达罗斯在克诺索斯曾造）



A dancing-floor for fair-haired Ariadne
A dancing-floor for fair-haired Ariadne（为金发的阿里阿德涅一座舞场）





– a verse which the scholiast explains as referring to the Labyrinth dance; and by Lucian who in his Concerning the Dance, a mine of mythological tradition, gives as the subjects of Cretan dances: ‘the myths of Europë, Pasiphaë, the two Bulls, the Labyrinth, Ariadne, Phaedra [daughter of Pasiphaë], Androgeus [son of Minos], Icarus, Glaucus [raised by Aesculapius from the dead], the magic of Polyidus, and of Talus the bronze man who did his sentry round in Crete.’ Polyidus means ‘the many-shaped’ and since the Corinthian hero of that name had no connexion with Crete, the dance was probably the shape-shifting dance of Zagreus at the Cretan Lenaea.
——注释者解释这句诗指迷宫之舞；琉善在其《论舞蹈》——神话传统宝库——中列出克里特舞蹈的主题：「欧罗巴、帕西法厄、两头公牛、迷宫、阿里阿德涅、费德拉 [帕西法厄之女]、安德罗格奥斯 [弥诺斯之子]、伊卡洛斯、格劳科斯 [被阿斯克勒庇俄斯从死者中复活]、波吕伊多斯的魔法、以及青铜人塔洛斯在克里特巡逻的故事。」波吕伊多斯意为「多变者」，既然同名科林斯英雄与克里特无关，此舞大概是克里特列纳亚节上扎格柔斯的变形之舞。

Here some loose ends can be tied up. The maze pattern has been shown to represent ‘Spiral Castle’ or ‘Troy Town’, where the sacred Sun-king goes after death and from which, if lucky, he returns. The whole myth is plainly presented on an Etruscan wine-jar from Tragliatella, dated from the late seventh century BC. Two mounted heroes are shown; the leader carries a shield with a partridge device, and an ape-like demon perches behind him; his companion carries a spear and a shield with a duck device. They are riding away from a maze marked ‘TRUIA’ (‘Troy’). Apparently the sacred king, though due to die like the partridge in the brushwood maze, and be succeeded by his tanist, has escaped. How he escaped, another picture on the same vase shows: an unarmed king leads a sunwise procession, escorted by seven footmen each carrying three javelins and a huge shield with a boar device; the spear-armed tanist, whose badge this is, brings up the rear. These seven footmen evidently represent the tanist’s seven winter months which fall between the apple harvest and Easter. The king is being warned of his ritual death. The Moon-priestess has come to meet him: a terrible robed figure with one arm menacingly akimbo, as she offers an apple, his passport to Paradise. The javelins threaten death. Yet a diminutive female figure, robed like the priestess, guides the king – if the hero is Theseus, we may call her Ariadne – who has helped him to escape from the maze. And he boldly displays a counter-charm – namely an Easter-egg, the egg of resurrection. Easter was the season when Troy Town dances were performed on the turf-cut mazes of Britain; and of Etruria, too, where the famous Lars Porsena of Clusium built a labyrinth for his own tomb. (Similar labyrinth tombs existed in pre-Hellenic Greece: near Nauplia, on Samos, and on Lemnos.) An Etruscan egg of polished black trachite, found at Perugia, with an arrow in relief running around it, is the same holy egg. Against the spearmen on the vase is written MAIM; against the king, EKRAUN; against the priestess, MITHES. LUEI. If, as seems probable, these words are Western Greek, they mean respectively: ‘Winter’, ‘He reigned’, and ‘Having pronounced, she sets free’. The letters written against Ariadne are indecipherable.
这里可以系上几条散落的线。迷宫图案已被证明代表「螺旋城堡」或「特洛伊城」，神圣太阳王死后去那里，如果幸运还能返回。整个神话在一尊公元前七世纪晚期的伊特鲁里亚特拉利亚特拉酒罐上有清晰的呈现。两位骑马英雄被描绘出来；领头者持一面有鹧鸪纹饰的盾，一个猿猴般的恶魔伏在他身后；他的同伴持矛和一面有鸭纹饰的盾。他们正骑离一座标记为「TRUIA」（「特洛伊」）的迷宫。显然神圣国王——本应像柴枝迷宫中的鹧鸪一样死去并被替补者继任——逃走了。他如何逃走，同一花瓶上的另一幅画展示了：一位 unarmed 国王引导一个顺时针行进的队列，由七名步兵护卫，每人持三支标枪和一面野猪纹大盾；持矛的替补者——此纹章为其标志——殿后。这七名步兵显然代表替补者的七个冬季月份，从苹果收获到复活节之间。国王正被警告他即将 ritual 死亡。月女祭司来迎接他：一个可怕的身影，一手威胁性地叉腰，同时递上一个苹果——他通往乐园的通行证。标枪威胁着死亡。然而一个矮小的女性身影——穿着如女祭司——引导着国王——如果英雄是忒修斯，我们可以称她为阿里阿德涅——她帮助他逃出了迷宫。他大胆地展示了一个反护符——即一枚复活节彩蛋，复活之蛋。复活节是不列颠草皮迷宫上表演特洛伊城舞蹈的季节；也是伊特鲁里亚的季节，克鲁西乌姆著名的拉尔斯·波塞纳为自己陵墓建了一座迷宫。（类似迷宫陵墓在前希腊化时期的希腊也有：纳夫普利亚附近、萨摩斯岛和利姆诺斯岛。）在佩鲁贾发现的一枚抛光黑粗安岩伊特鲁里亚蛋，上面有浮雕箭头环绕，就是同一枚圣蛋。花瓶上对着持矛者写着 MAIM；对着国王写着 EKRAUN；对着女祭司写着 MITHES. LUEI。如果如似乎可能的那样这些词是西希腊语，它们分别意为：「冬天」、「他统治过」、「宣判后她释放」。对着阿里阿德涅写的字母无法辨认。

The lame King is frequently connected with the mysteries of smithcraft. Jacob was connected with the cult of the Kenite Smith-god; Talus in one account was son, or maternal nephew, to Smith Daedalus, in another was forged in the furnace of Smith Hephaestus. Dionysus, because of his titles pyrigenes and ignigena (‘engendered by fire’) – a reference to the autumnal Toadstool-Dionysus engendered by lightning – may have been equated with Talus in this sense. Wieland, the Scandinavian Smith-god, was lamed by a woman.
瘸腿国王常与锻造秘术之谜联系在一起。雅各与基尼铁匠神崇拜有关；塔洛斯在一种记载中是铁匠代达罗斯之子或母方外甥，在另一种记载中在铁匠赫淮斯托斯的炉中锻造。狄俄尼索斯因其称号 pyrigenes 和 ignigena（「火所生」）——指秋季毒菌狄俄尼索斯由闪电所生——可能在此意义上被等同于塔洛斯。斯堪的纳维亚铁匠神维兰被一个女人弄瘸。

But what evidence is there for any lameness in Dionysus? Why should the buskins not have been worn merely to add to his height, rather than as surgical boots to compensate for his deformity? The best evidence is his name, Dio-nysus, usually translated as ‘The Light God of Mount Nyse’ but more likely to mean ‘The Lame God of Light’. Nysos was a Syracusan word for ‘lame’ and therefore probably of Corinthian origin, for Syracuse was a colony of Corinth. Yet, as Mr. E. M. Parr has pointed out to me, Dionysus may really have taken his name from Nysë, Nyssa or Nysia, a name attached to various shrines in the area where the sacred lameness was cultivated. There are three Nyssas in Asia Minor, three Nysias in Thrace, a Nyza near Mosul, and a Nysia in Arabia where, according to Diodorus the Goddess Isis was born. This suggests that Nyse was a title of Isis, and that since Dionysus was a title of the Libyo-Thracian Harpocrates, her lame son, the Corinthian Greeks read Nysus, which was really his matronymic, as meaning ‘lame’. Mr. Parr writes: ‘There seem to be confusing results when an established divine title is retained in a new tongue. For instance: Apollo Agieueis of Athens is described as the leader of colonies, but is more likely to have been the Cyprian Apollo who wore a wreath (aga, agu).’ Dionysus, who was regarded by the Greeks of the Classical age as a Thracian God, is said to have come there from Crete, as his counterpart, King Proteus, is said to have come from Pharos. In Crete he was not lame, neither was Velchanos, a Cretan Cock-demon who became Vulcan when his worship was introduced into Italy. But in Italy Vulcan was said to be lame and to walk with the help of high-heeled gold shoes, because he was identified with Hephaestus,1 a Pelasgian deity from Lemnos, who like Talus was hurled down from a height – the tradition of sacred lameness seems to have been Danaan, not early Cretan. And, according to Homer, Hephaestus’s wife was Charis, whom he elsewhere calls Aphrodite. The Three Graces are thus explained as the Love-goddess Aphrodite in triad; and when they invoke Dionysus at Elis they are calling their lame buskined husband to perform the act of love with them.
但有什么证据表明狄俄尼索斯是瘸腿的？半统靴难道不能仅为增加身高而穿，而非作为矫正畸形的医用靴？最好的证据是他的名字 Dio-nysus，通常译为「尼塞山的光之神」，但更可能意为「瘸腿的光之神」。Nysos 是叙拉古语中的「瘸腿」，因此可能源于科林多，因为叙拉古是科林多的殖民地。然而，如 E. M. 帕尔先生向我指出的，狄俄尼索斯的名字可能确实取自 Nysë、Nyssa 或 Nysia——一个附属于神圣瘸腿崇拜区域内多处圣所的名称。小亚细亚有三个 Nyssa，色雷斯有三个 Nysia，摩苏尔附近有一个 Nyza，阿拉伯有一个 Nysia——据狄奥多鲁斯记载女神伊西斯生于此。这暗示 Nyse 是伊西斯的一个称号，既然狄俄尼索斯是利比亚-色雷斯哈波克拉忒斯——她的瘸腿儿子——的称号，科林多希腊人将 Nysus——实为其母名——读作「瘸腿」。帕尔先生写道：「当一个既定神称号在新语言中保留时似乎会产生混乱结果。例如：雅典的阿波罗 Agieueis 被描述为殖民地领导者，但更可能是戴花环 (aga, agu) 的塞浦路斯阿波罗。」被古典时代希腊人视为色雷斯神的狄俄尼索斯据说从克里特来到色雷斯，如同他的对应者普罗透斯王据说从法罗斯来。在克里特他不瘸，韦尔卡诺斯——一个克里特公鸡魔——也不瘸，后者传入意大利后成为武尔坎。但在意大利武尔坎据说瘸腿并穿高跟金鞋行走，因为他被等同于赫淮斯托斯¹——一个来自利姆诺斯的佩拉斯吉神，如塔洛斯一样从高处被摔下——神圣瘸腿传统似乎是达南人的，而非早期克里特的。据荷马记载赫淮斯托斯之妻是卡里斯，他在别处称之为阿佛洛狄忒。三美神由此被解释为爱神阿佛洛狄忒的三联体；当她们在伊利斯召唤狄俄尼索斯时，是在召唤她们瘸腿的穿靴丈夫来与她们行房。

Here we may reconsider another of Dionysus’s titles, ‘Merotraphes’, which is usually translated ‘thigh-nursling’ because of a silly Olympian fable about Dionysus having been sewn up in Jove’s thigh, while an infant, to hide him from the jealous anger of Hera; the simpler meaning is ‘one whose thigh is taken very good care of’. And what of Mercury’s winged sandals, and those of Theseus and Perseus? Mercury, or Hermes, is commonly represented as standing on tiptoe: was this because he could not put his heel to the ground? It is likely that the eagle-wings on his sandals were originally not a symbol of swiftness but a sign of the holiness of the heel, and so, paradoxically, a symbol of lameness. In the Hittite cylinder-seal reproduced as an illustration to my King Jesus, the king who is about to be crowned after mounting three steps of a throne has his sacred heel protected by a dog-demon. In Latin those sandals were called talaria from the word talus, meaning a heel: and dice were called tali because they were made from the heel-bones of the sheep or goats sacred to Hermes or Mercury, though those of the boibalis, the Libyan antelope, were more highly prized by the illuminated.
这里我们可以重新审视狄俄尼索斯的另一个称号「Merotraphes」，通常译为「大腿养子」，源于一个荒谬的奥林匹克神话——说婴儿狄俄尼索斯被缝在朱庇特的大腿中以躲避赫拉的嫉妒；更简单的含义是「其大腿受到精心照顾之人」。那么墨丘利的飞鞋、以及忒修斯和珀耳修斯的呢？墨丘利或赫尔墨斯通常被描绘为踮脚站立：这是因为他不能将脚跟着地吗？很可能他鞋上的鹰翼最初不是快速的象征而是脚踴神圣性的标志，因此矛盾地成为瘸腿的象征。在我《耶稣王》中作为插图的赫梯圆柱印章中，即将登上王座三级台阶加冕的国王，其神圣脚踴由一只犬魔守护。拉丁语中这些鞋被称为 talaria，源自 talus，意为脚踵；骰子被称为 tali，因为它们用 sacred 于赫尔墨斯或墨丘利的绵羊或山羊的距骨制成，尽管开悟者更珍视 boibalis 即利比亚羚羊的距骨。

Mercury was not only patron of dice-players but prophesied from dice. He used five dice with four markings on each, in honour of his Mother, precisely like those given an Indian King at his coronation in honour of the Mother; and if, as I suppose, he used them for alphabetic divination he had his own alphabet of fifteen consonants and five vowels. The game of hucklebones is still played in Great Britain with the traditional set of five. In the case of six-sided dice, however, three made a set in ancient times; these would provide the diviner with eighteen letters of the alphabet, as in the thirteen-consonant Beth-Luis-Nion.
墨丘利不仅是骰子游戏者的守护神，还用骰子占卜。他使用五颗各有四面标记的骰子，以纪念他的母亲，正如印度国王加冕时获赐五颗骰子以纪念母亲；如果如我所猜想他将其用于字母占卜，那他有自己的十五辅音五元音字母表。拋距骨游戏至今仍在不列颠以传统五颗一组进行。然而六面骰子在古代三颗为一组；这将为占卜者提供十八个字母，如十三辅音的贝斯-路易斯-尼恩。

But was the sacred king chosen because he had accidentally suffered this injury, or was the injury inflicted on him after he had been chosen for better reasons? The answer is to be found in the otherwise meaningless story of Llew Llaw’s balancing between the rim of his sacred cauldron and the back of a buck. Llew was to become a sacred king by marriage with Blodeuwedd, the May Bride, a king of the delicately-treading golden-shoed or purple-buskined sort; but he was not properly equipped for his office until he had sustained Jacob’s injury which would prevent him from ever again putting his sacred heel on the ground, even by mistake. This injury was artificially produced by an ingenious incident in the coronation ritual. His bride made him stand with one foot on the rim of the bath, the other on the haunch of a sacred beast with his hair tied to an oak-branch above his head. And then a cruel trick was played on him. Messrs. Romanis and Mitchener in their Surgery put it in these words: ‘Such inward or anterior dislocations of the hip, produced by wide abduction of the thighs, may result when a person embarking in a boat remains undecided whether to get in or remain on land.’ As with quay and boat, so with cauldron and buck. The buck moved suddenly away from the cauldron. Llew could not save himself by throwing himself forward, because his head was fixed by the hair. The result was this anterior dislocation, but when he fell, his sacred heel did not touch the ground: because his hair held him up, which is exactly what happened to Absalom (‘Father Salm’) when the beast moved from under him in the oak-wood of Ephraim. I postulate as a main source of the anecdotal parts of the early books of the Bible a set of icons, captured by the Israelites at Hebron, illustrating the ritual fate of the sacred king; one part of the series becomes iconotropically reinterpreted as the story of Saul, another as that of Samson, another as that of Absalom, another as that of Samuel. A restoration of the icons is attempted in the King Adam chapter of my King Jesus.
但神圣国王是因意外受此伤而被选中，还是因更好的理由被选中后再被施以此伤？答案在卢·劳在神圣锅沿和公羊背之间保持平衡这段本来看似无意义的故事中。卢·劳通过与五月新娘布洛杜埃德结婚成为神圣国王——那种穿着金鞋或紫靴轻轻踏步的国王；但在他遭受雅各式脱位——使他永远不会再将神圣脚踵着地——之前，他并未完全胜任其职。这一脱位在加冕仪式中通过一个巧妙的插曲人工造成。他的新娘让他一只脚踩在浴池边沿，另一只脚踩在一头神圣野兽的臀上，他的头发绑在头顶的橡树枝上。然后一个残忍的诡计被施加于他。罗曼尼斯和米切纳先生在《外科学》中写道：「大腿的这种内脱位或前脱位，由大腿过度外展造成，可能在一个登船时犹豫不决不知该上船还是留在岸上的人身上发生。」如同码头与船，锅与公羊亦然。公羊突然从锅旁移开。卢·劳无法向前扑倒自救，因为他的头被头发固定住了。结果是前脱位，但他倒下时神圣脚踴没有触地：因为他的头发吊住了他——这正是押沙龙（Absalom，「父萨尔姆」）在以法莲橡树林中坐骑从他身下移开时所发生的事。我假定《圣经》早期各卷轶事部分的主要来源是一套以色列人在希伯仑缴获的圣像——描绘神圣国王的仪式命运；系列的一部分被偶像置换性地重新诠释为扫罗的故事，另一部分为参孙，另一部分为押沙龙，另一部分为撒母耳。在我的《耶稣王》「亚当王」一章中尝试了圣像的复原。

It will be noticed that all these names look like corrupt forms of the same word Salma, or Salmon, a royal title among the Kenites, who were King David’s ancestors, among the Phoenicians (Selim), among the Assyrians (Salman), among the Danaans of Greece and late Minoan Crete (Salmoneus). Solomon adopted the title too. His original name seems to have been Jedidiah (2 Samuel XII, 25); if not, he would have had a less convincing right to the throne than Adonijah. Absalom’s original name is unknown, but that he was David’s favourite, not his son except by courtesy, is shown in 2 Samuel XII‚ 11, where he is described as David’s neighbour. The discrepancy between the account of his parentage in 2 Samuel III, 3 and 2 Samuel XIII, 37 suggests that his real name was Talmai, son of Ammihud, King of Geshur and one of David’s allies, and that he became Absalom only when he seized David’s throne and married the royal harem of heiresses at Hebron. As a god, Salma is identified with Reseph the Canaanite Osiris. Among these icons there may have been one showing Absalom with his hair tied to an oak-branch – really an incident in the marriage of the King. The assassination of the king on such an occasion was easy, but sanctification, not death, was the object of the trick; and if we can accept A. M. Hocart’s conclusion that the coronation ceremony throughout the ancient world typified the marriage of the Sun King to the Earth Queen, his death as a member of his former tribe and his re-birth with a new name into that of his Queen, then the ritual on which all these myths are based must have included a mock-assassination of the king in the course of the bath-ceremony; which is proved by the victims offered in the king’s stead in many forms of the ritual known to us. The confused elements in the myth of Hephaestus, who was married to the Love-goddess and deceived by her, and lamed by suddenly being thrown down from Olympus by the Goddess Hera, and mocked by the whole company of Heaven, compose another variant of the same ritual. Originally the king died violently as soon as he had coupled with the queen; as the drone dies after coupling with the queen-bee. Later, emasculation and laming were substituted for death; later still, circumcision was substituted for emasculation and the wearing of buskins for laming.
值得注意的是所有这些名字看起来都像同一个词 Salma 或 Salmon 的讹变形式——一个基尼人的王家称号，基尼人是大卫王的祖先，腓尼基人 (Selim)、亚述人 (Salman)、希腊和晚期米诺斯克里特的达南人 (Salmoneus) 也有此称号。所罗门也采用了这个称号。他原名似乎叫耶底底亚（《撒母耳记下》XII, 25）；否则他对王位的资格不如亚多尼雅。押沙龙原名不详，但他是大卫的宠臣而非真正意义上的儿子，这在《撒母耳记下》XII, 11 中有显示——他被描述为大卫的邻人。关于他身世的《撒母耳记下》III, 3 与 XIII, 37 之间的差异暗示他的真名是达买——基述王亚米忽之子、大卫的盟友之一——他只有在夺取大卫王位并在希伯仑娶了继承人的后宫之后才成为押沙龙。作为神，Salma 被等同于迦南的奥西里斯——雷谢夫。在这些圣像中可能有一幅展示押沙龙头发被绑在橡树枝上——实为国王婚礼中的一个插曲。在此场合弑君容易，但圣化而非死亡才是诡计的目的；如果我们接受 A. M. 霍卡特关于加冕仪式在整个古代世界象征太阳王与大地王后婚配的结论——他作为前一部落成员死去并以新名字重生为王后部落的成员——那么所有这些神话所基于的仪式必定包括在浴礼中对国王的模拟弑杀；这由我们所知的多种仪式形式中代替国王献祭的牺牲品所证明。赫淮斯托斯神话中的混乱元素——与爱神结婚被她欺骗、被女神赫拉从奥林匹斯摔下而瘸腿、被天庭众神嘲弄——构成了同一仪式的另一个变体。最初国王一旦与王后交媾即被暴力处死；如同雄蜂与蜂后交配后即死。后来阉割和瘸腿取代了死亡；再后来割礼取代阉割，穿半统靴取代瘸腿。

Once we know that the sacred king was ritually lamed in a way that obliged him to swagger or lurch on high heels, we understand at last two or three hitherto mysterious ancient icons. Tantalus, suspended over the water with a fruit-branch above his head and the water always slipping away is evidently being lamed in Llew Llaw fashion: originally his hair is tied to the branch, one foot is on the bank, the other rests on something in the water – perhaps a large boat-shaped basin – that slips away. Tantalus is a perfect type of Dionysus: he was married to Euryanassa (another form of Eurynome) a Moon-goddess; he was thrown down from Mount Sipylus, in Pelasgian Lydia, where he was afterwards buried and had a hero shrine; he was Pelops’s cannibalistic father; he helped to steal a Dog from a Cretan cave; and from his name derive three other Greek words meaning, like saleuein, from which saleuma is formed, ‘to swagger or lurch in one’s gait’: tantaloein, tantaleuein and, by a metathesis, talantoein.
一旦我们知道神圣国王被仪式性地弄瘸，以致必须穿高跟鞋摇摆或踉跄行走，我们终于理解了两三幅至今仍神秘的古代圣像。坦塔罗斯悬在水面上方，头上有果树枝，水总是退去——显然正以卢·劳的方式被弄瘸：最初他的头发绑在树枝上，一只脚在岸上，另一只脚踩在水中某物——也许一个大船形盆——那东西滑走了。坦塔罗斯是狄俄尼索斯的完美典型：他与月女神欧律阿纳萨（欧律诺墨的另一种形式）结婚；他被从佩拉斯吉吕底亚的西皮卢斯山摔下，死后葬于该处并有英雄圣龛；他是佩洛普斯的食人父亲；他帮助从克里特洞穴偷走狗；从他的名字衍生出另外三个如同 saleuein（saleuma 由此构成）意为「摇摆或踉跄行走」的希腊词：tantaloein、tantaleuein 以及通过音位转换的 talantoein。

Like Ixion and Salmoneus, Tantalus belonged to the old religion superseded by Olympianism, and the Olympian priests have deliberately misinterpreted the icons in favour of Father Zeus by presenting him as an odious criminal. Tantalus’s crime, the mythographers explain, was that, having been privileged to eat ambrosia, the food of the gods, with the Olympians, he later invited commoners to try it. Ambrosia was the name of Dionysus’s autumnal feast in which, I suggest, the intoxicant toadstool once supplied his votaries with a divine frenzy; and in my What Food the Centaurs Ate, I show that the ingredients given by Classical grammarians for ambrosia, nectar, and kekyon (Demeter’s drink at Eleusis) represent a food-ogham – their initial letters all spell out forms of a Greek word for ‘mushroom’. The story of Tantalus’s crime may have been told when wine displaced toadstools at the Maenad revels, and a toadstool – perhaps not amanita muscaria, but the milder, more entrancing panaeolus papilionaceus – was eaten by adepts at the Eleusinian, Samothracian and Cretan Mysteries, who became as gods by virtue of the transcendental visions it supplied.
如同伊克西翁和萨尔摩纽斯，坦塔罗斯属于被奥林匹克主义取代的旧宗教，奥林匹克祭司故意曲解圣像以维护天父宙斯，将他呈现为一个可憎的罪犯。神话编撰者解释坦塔罗斯的罪行为：他曾有幸与奥林匹斯众神共食安布罗西亚——神之食——后来却邀请平民来品尝。安布罗西亚是狄俄尼索斯秋季宴会的名称，我推测在宴会上毒菌曾以神圣狂喜供奉其信徒；在我的《半人马吃什么》一书中我指出古典语文学家给出的安布罗西亚、花蜜和 kekyon（得墨忒耳在厄琉西斯的饮料）的成分代表一种食物欧甘——它们的首字母拼出一个意为「蘑菇」的希腊词的各种形式。坦塔罗斯犯罪的故事可能是在酒取代毒菌成为迈纳德斯狂欢饮品之后讲述的，而毒菌——也许不是蝇蕈 (amanita muscaria)，而是更温和更迷幻的蝶形斑褶菇 (panaeolus papilionaceus)——在厄琉西斯、萨摩色雷斯和克里特密仪中由入门者食用，他们凭借其所提供的超验幻象而成为神。

However the dislocation may have been produced – and it is likely that still another method was practised on a hill-top, not beside a river – there was a taboo in Canaan on eating the flesh around the thigh-bone, as is expressly stated in Genesis in the story of Jacob’s wrestling at Peniel. Robertson-Smith rightly connects this taboo with the practice, common to all Mediterranean countries, of dedicating the thigh-bones of all sacrificial beasts, and the parts about them, to the gods: they were burned first and then the rest of the beast was eaten by the worshippers. But the anthropological rule ‘No taboo without its relaxation’ applies here. In primitive times the flesh-covered thighbone of the dead king must have been eaten by his comrades. This practice was until recently followed, as Mgr. Terhoorst, a Roman Catholic missionary records, by the younger warriors of the Central African Bantu tribe of Bagiushu among whom he worked. The flesh was eaten on the death of their Old Man, or when the chief of an enemy tribe was killed in battle. Mgr. Terhoorst states that this was done to inherit the courage of the dead man which was held to reside in the thigh, and that the rest of the body was not touched. The Bagiushu, who file their front teeth into a triangular shape, are not cannibalistic on other occasions.
无论脱位如何造成——很可能在山顶而非河边还有另一种方法——迦南有禁忌食用大腿骨周围肉的规定，如《创世记》中雅各在毗努伊勒摔跤故事所明确陈述。罗伯逊-史密斯正确地将此禁忌与地中海各国共有的做法联系起来：将所有祭牲的大腿骨及其周围部分献给神——先烧大腿骨然后其余部分由崇拜者食用。但人类学规则「没有不被放松的禁忌」在此适用。在原始时代死去的国王带肉大腿骨必定被他的同伴食用。这一做法直到最近仍被中非巴吉舒部落的年轻战士遵循——罗马天主教传教士特霍斯特主教记录了他在该部落工作时的见闻。肉在他们的「老人」死去或敌对部落酋长在战斗中被杀时被食用。特霍斯特主教指出这样做是为了继承死者的勇气——据信寄存于大腿中——身体其余部分不动。巴吉舒人将门牙锉成三角形，在其他场合不行食人俗。

In my King Jesus I suggest that the Hebrew tradition found in the Talmud Babli Sanhedrin and the Tol’ Doth Yeshu, that Jesus was lamed while attempting to fly, refers to a secret Coronation ceremony on Mount Tabor, where he became the new Israel after being ritually lamed in a wrestling match. This tradition is supported by Gospel evidence which I adduce, and by a remark of Jerome’s that Jesus was deformed. Mount Tabor was one of Jehovah’s chief shrines. Tabor is named after Atabyrius, the son of Eurynome and grandson of Proteus, as the Septuagint recognized, and we know a good deal about this god, who also had a shrine built to him on Mount Atabyria in Rhodes by one ‘Althaeamenes the Cretan’. Althaeamenes means ‘Mindful of the Goddess Althaea’ and Althaea (‘she who makes grow’) was another name for Atabyrius’s mother Eurynome, the Moon-goddess of the Orphics. The marshmallow – in Welsh hocys bendigaid the holy mallow – was Althaea’s flower, and she loved Dionysus the Vine-god. She became the mother by him of Deianeira, the same Deianeira who played the part of Blodeuwedd to Hercules of Oeta. Atabyrius, being one of the Cretan Telchines, had the power, like Dionysus or Proteus, to transform himself into any shape; and in his Rhodian shrine brazen bulls were dedicated to him which bellowed whenever anything extraordinary was about to happen – the same sort of brazen bull that was made by Daedalus for King Minos of Crete. And we know that Atabyrius was the god, worshipped as a golden calf, whom Israel credited with having brought them out of Egypt. But the byrius termination occurs in the royal title of Burna-buriash, one of the Third Dynasty Kassite (Indo-European) Kings of Babylon who reigned from 1750 to 1173 BC; Atabyrius was clearly not a native Cretan, nor a Semite, but a Kassite god who entered Syria early in the second millennium. How and when his cult was carried to Thrace, Rhodes and Crete is not clear; but he is likely to have gone into Egypt with the Hyksos. He was also called Tesup.
在我的《耶稣王》中我提出犹太传统——见于《塔木德·巴布里·公会篇》和《托尔多特·耶舒》——说耶稣在试图飞翔时瘸了，指的是在塔博尔山上的秘密加冕仪式，他在摔跤比赛中被仪式性地弄瘸后成为新的以色列。这一传统有我所引述的福音书证据支持，以及哲罗姆说耶稣畸形的一句话佐证。塔博尔山是耶和华的主要圣所之一。塔博尔以阿塔比里乌斯命名——欧律诺墨之子、普罗透斯之孙——七十士译本如此认定，我们对此神知之甚详，他在罗德岛阿塔比里亚山上也有一座由「克里特人阿尔泰美涅斯」建造的圣所。阿尔泰美涅斯意为「铭记女神阿尔泰亚」，阿尔泰亚（「使之生长者」）是阿塔比里乌斯之母欧律诺墨——俄耳甫斯教月女神——的另一个名字。药蜀葵——威尔士语 hocys bendigaid 即神圣蜀葵——是阿尔泰亚的花，她爱葡萄藤之神狄俄尼索斯。她为他生了得伊阿尼拉——就是那个在俄塔山的赫拉克勒斯故事中扮演布洛杜埃德角色的得伊阿尼拉。阿塔比里乌斯作为克里特特尔基涅斯之一，有如狄俄尼索斯或普罗透斯般的变形能力；他在罗德岛的圣所中供奉着铜牛，每当异常事件即将发生时铜牛就咆哮——与代达罗斯为克里特弥诺斯王制作的铜牛相同。我们知道阿塔比里乌斯就是以色列人认为带他们出埃及的那个被当作金牛犊崇拜的神。但 byrius 这一结尾出现在布尔纳-布里亚什——巴比伦第三王朝卡塞特（印欧语系）诸王之一，公元前1750至1173年统治——的王家称号中；阿塔比里乌斯显然不是克里特本土神或闪族神，而是一个在公元前二千年初进入叙利亚的卡塞特神。他的崇拜如何以及何时传到色雷斯、罗德岛和克里特尚不清楚；但他很可能与喜克索斯人一起进入埃及。他也被称为 Tesup。

This mythological rigmarole adds up to an identification of the Israelite Jehovah of Tabor, or Atabyrius, with Dionysus the Danaan White Bull-god: an identification which rests on respectable Classical authority. In Plutarch’s Convivial Questions one of the guests claims to be able to prove that the God of the Jews is really Dionysus Sabazius, the Barley-god of Thrace and Phrygia; and Tacitus similarly records in his History (v. 5) that ‘some maintain that the rites of the Jews were founded in honour of Dionysus’. Also, the historian Valerius Maximus records that about the year 139 BC the Praetor of Foreigners, C. Cornelius Hispallus, expelled from Rome certain Jews who were ‘trying to corrupt Roman morals by a pretended cult of Sabazian Jove’. The inference is that the Praetor did not expel them for a legitimate worship of this god, but because they foisted novelties on the Thracian cult – probably circumcision, which was regarded by the Romans as self-mutilation and a corruption of morals – for they admitted aliens to their Sabbaths. According to Leclercq’s Manual of Christian Archaeology, burials in the cemetery of Praetextatus at Rome confirm this cult of a Jewish Sabazius. That the Jews of the Dispersion may have used false etymology to equate ‘Sabazius’ with ‘Sabaoth’ – Jehovah was the Lord of the Sabbath, and also of Sabaoth, ‘of hosts’ – does not disprove the original identity of the two gods.
这些神话学繁复论证总结为：以色列人的塔博尔耶和华即阿塔比里乌斯，等同于达南白牛神狄俄尼索斯——这一认同有可尊敬的古典权威支持。在普鲁塔克的《会饮问题》中一位宾客声称能证明犹太人的神实际上就是色雷斯和弗里吉亚的大麦神狄俄尼索斯·萨巴齐奥斯；塔西佗也在《历史》(v. 5) 中类似地记载「有人认为犹太人的仪式是为纪念狄俄尼索斯而设立的」。此外历史学家瓦莱里乌斯·马克西穆斯记载约公元前139年外侨裁判官 C. 科尔内利乌斯·希斯帕卢斯将某些犹太人逐出罗马，因为他们「试图以伪装的萨巴齐奥斯朱庇特崇拜腐蚀罗马风俗」。推论是裁判官驱逐他们不是因为合法崇拜此神，而是因为他们向色雷斯崇拜中塞入新事物——可能是割礼，被罗马人视为自残和道德败坏——因为他们允许外人参加他们的安息日。据勒克莱尔的《基督教考古学手册》，罗马普雷泰克斯塔图斯墓地的墓葬证实了这种犹太萨巴齐奥斯崇拜。散居犹太人可能用错误词源将「Sabazius」等同于「Sabaoth」——耶和华是安息日之主，也是万军之主 (Sabaoth)——但这并不否定两神最初同一。

Sabazian Zeus and Sabazian Dionysus were different names of the same character, the Son of Rhea; which means that he was of Cretan origin. The Phrygians called him Attis and made him the son of Cybele, but this amounted to the same thing; and an inscription of Jewish origin has been found in Rome: ‘To Attis the Most High God who holds the Universe together.’ The serpent was sacred to Sabazius; and this recalls the Brazen Seraph Ne-esthan or Nehushtan, which Moses used as a standard and which is said to have been destroyed as idolatrous by Good King Hezekiah because incense was burned to it as to a god.1 But the Jewish sect of Ophites, centred in Phrygia, revered the Serpent in early Christian times, holding that the post-exilic Jehovah was a mere demon who had usurped the Kingdom of the Wise Serpent, the Anointed One. Sabazian Dionysus was represented with bull’s horns because, as Diodorus Siculus records, he was the first to yoke oxen to the plough for agriculture: in other words to plant barley. Since Jehovah was pre-eminently a protector of barley – the Passover was a barley harvest-festival – Plutarch’s convivial guest would have had little trouble in proving his contention, especially since, according to the legend, Sabazius was torn by the Titans into seven pieces. Seven was Jehovah’s mystical number; so also was 42, the number of letters in his enlarged Name, and according to Cretan tradition, the number of pieces into which the Titans tore the bull-god Zagreus.
萨巴齐奥斯宙斯和萨巴齐奥斯狄俄尼索斯是同一角色的不同名字——瑞亚之子；这意味着他源于克里特。弗里吉亚人称他为阿提斯并使他成为库柏勒之子，但这实际上是一回事；在罗马发现了一座犹太渊源的铭文：「致维系宇宙的至高神阿提斯。」蛇 sacred 于萨巴齐奥斯；这让人想起铜蛇 Ne-esthan 或 Nehushtan——摩西用作旗帜的铜蛇，据说被好王希西家因偶像崇拜而毁掉，因为人们像对神一样向它烧香。¹但犹太教蛇派——以弗里吉亚为中心——在早期基督教时代崇拜蛇，认为被掳后的耶和华只是一个篡夺了智慧之蛇即受膏者王国的恶魔。萨巴齐奥斯狄俄尼索斯被描绘为有牛角，因为据狄奥多鲁斯·西库鲁斯记载他是最早用牛耕田的人：换言之种植大麦的人。既然耶和华首要地是大麦保护者——逾越节是大麦收获节——普鲁塔克的宾客要证明其论点并不困难，尤其据传说萨巴齐奥斯被泰坦撕成七块。七是耶和华的神秘数字；42 也是——他的扩展名的字母数——据克里特传说也是泰坦撕碎牛神扎格柔斯的碎片数。

Dionysus Sabazius was the original Jehovah of the Passover; and Plutarch also identifies the Jehovah of the Feast of Tabernacles with Dionysus Liber, or Lusios (‘he who frees from guilt’), the Wine-god, by suggesting that the word ‘Levite’ is formed from Lusios; and he says that the Jews abstain from swine’s flesh because their Dionysus is also Adonis, who was killed by a boar. The rituals of Jehovah and Dionysus, as Plutarch pointed out, corresponded closely: mysteries of barley-sheaves and new wine, torch dances until cock-crow, libations, animal sacrifices, religious ecstasy. It also appears that the promiscuous love-making of the Canaanite rites, though severely punished at Jerusalem in post-exilic times, still survived among the peasantry who came up for the Tabernacles. The Temple priests in the time of Jesus admitted the original nature of the Feast, while declaring that its nature had changed, by announcing at the close: ‘Our forefathers in this place turned their backs on the Sanctuary of God and their faces to the East, adoring the Sun; but we turn to God.’ For the Sun represented the immortal part of Dionysus; the barley and the vine his mortal part.
狄俄尼索斯·萨巴齐奥斯是逾越节耶和华的原型；普鲁塔克还将住棚节的耶和华等同于狄俄尼索斯·利贝尔或卢西奥斯（Lusios，「免除罪咎者」）——酒神——暗示「利未人」(Levite) 一词源自 Lusios；他说犹太人不吃猪肉是因为他们的狄俄尼索斯也是阿多尼斯——被野猪所杀。如普鲁塔克所指出的，耶和华和狄俄尼索斯的仪式密切对应：大麦捆和新酒的秘仪、火炬舞到鸡鸣、奠酒、动物献祭、宗教狂喜。此外迦南仪式中的混杂性交虽在被掻后的耶路撒冷受到严惩，但在前来住棚节的农民中仍然存续。耶稣时代的圣殿祭司承认住棚节的原始性质，同时宣布其性质已改变，在结束时宣布：「我们的祖先在此地背对神的圣所面向东方崇拜太阳；但我们转向神。」因为太阳代表狄俄尼索斯的不朽部分；大麦和葡萄藤是他必死的部分。

There is even numismatic evidence for the identification of Jehovah and Dionysus: a silver coin of the fifth century BC, (which appears in G. F. Hill’s Catalogue of the Greek Coins of Palestine) found near Gaza with on the obverse a bearded head of Dionysus type and on the reverse a bearded figure in a winged chariot, designated in Hebrew characters JHWH – Jehovah. This is not, of course, by any means the whole story of Jehovah, whose affinity with other gods, especially Cronos (Bran), has already been mentioned. It is easiest perhaps to write about him in terms of days of the week. His first pictorial appearance is at the copper-workings of Ras-Shamra in Sinai in a carving of about the sixteenth century BC. He is then Elath-Iahu a Kenite Smith-god, the God of Wednesday, presumably the lover of Baalith the local Aphrodite and Goddess of Friday. Later in his theophanies at Moreh, Hebron and Ophrah he is the terebinth-god Bel, the God of Thursday. The story of his defeat of the prophets of Carmel concerns the conquest of his Bel aspect by Cronos the God of Saturday in the person of Elijah. Bel and Cronos are always appearing in opposition, Bel being Beli and Cronos, Bran; as has been shown. ‘When Israel was in Egypt’, Jehovah was Set, the God of Sunday. At the Jerusalem feast of Tabernacles, on the Day of Willows, he was the God of Monday. His name El, connected with the scarlet oak, proves him to have been also the God of Tuesday. Thus the universality claimed for him by the Pharisees and typified by the Menorah, the seven-branched candlestick, rests on a solid enough mythological basis.
甚至有钱币证据支持耶和华与狄俄尼索斯的认同：一枚公元前五世纪的银币（见于 G. F. 希尔的《巴勒斯坦希腊钱币目录》）在加沙附近发现，正面是狄俄尼索斯型的大胡须头像，背面是一个大胡须人物乘有翼战车，以希伯来字母标为 JHWH——耶和华。当然这绝非耶和华的全部故事，他与其他神祇尤其是克洛诺斯（布兰）的亲缘关系前已提及。也许用星期几来描述他最为方便。他最早的图像出现在西奈拉什什拉铜矿场约公元前十六世纪的雕刻中。当时他是 Elath-Iahu——一个基尼铁匠神，星期三之神，大概是当地阿佛洛狄忒即星期五女神巴力特的情人。后来在摩利、希伯仑和俄弗拉显现时，他是笃耨香树脂神贝尔——星期四之神。他击败迦密山先知的故事涉及贝尔面向被星期六之神克洛诺斯——以利亚——征服。贝尔和克洛诺斯总是对立出现，贝尔即贝利，克洛诺斯即布兰；如前所示。「当以色列在埃及时」耶和华是塞特——星期日之神。在耶路撒冷住棚节的柳树日他是星期一之神。他的名字 El 与胭脂虫橡联系，证明他也是星期二之神。因此法利赛人为他主张的普遍性——以七灯烛台为象征——有足够坚实的神话基础。

Further, the name Iahu is far older than the sixteenth century BC and of wide distribution. It occurs in Egypt during the Sixth Dynasty (middle of the third millennium BC) as a title of the God Set: and is recorded in Deimel’s Akkadian-Sumerian Glossary as a name for Isis. It also seems to be the origin of the Greek name Iacchus, a title of the shape-shifting Dionysus Lusios in the Cretan mysteries. Thus although I.A.U. are the vowels of the three-season year of Birth, Consummation and Death – with Death put first because in the Eastern Mediterranean the agricultural year begins in the I season – they seem to be derived from a name that was in existence long before any alphabet was formed, the components of which are IA and HU. ‘la’ means ‘Exalted’ in Sumerian and ‘Hu’ means ‘Dove’; the Egyptian hieroglyph ‘Hu’ is also a dove. The Moon-goddess of Asianic Palestine was worshipped with doves, like her counterparts of Egyptian Thebes, Dodona, Hierapolis, Crete and Cyprus. But she was also worshipped as a long-horned cow; Hathor, or Isis, or Ashtaroth Karnaim. Isis is an onomatopoeic Asianic word, Ish-ish, meaning ‘She who weeps’, because the Moon was held to scatter dew and because Isis, the pre-Christian original of the Mater Dolorosa, mourned for Osiris when Set killed him. She was said to be the white, or, according to Moschus, the golden Moon-cow Io who had settled down in Egypt after long wanderings from Argos. The o in Io’s name is an omega, which is a common Greek variant of alpha.
此外 Iahu 之名远早于公元前十六世纪且分布广泛。它在埃及第六王朝（公元前三千纪中叶）作为塞特神的称号出现；在迪梅尔的《阿卡德-苏美尔词汇表》中被记录为伊西斯之名。它似乎也是希腊名伊阿科斯——克里特密仪中变形狄俄尼索斯·卢西奥斯的称号——的来源。因此虽然 I.A.U. 是诞生、完成和死亡三季节年的元音——死亡放在前面因为在地中海东部农业年始于 I 季——它们似乎源于一个远在任何字母表形成之前就存在的名字，其组成部分为 IA 和 HU。IA 在苏美尔语中意为「崇高的」，HU 意为「鸽子」；埃及象形文字中 HU 也是鸽子。亚细亚巴勒斯坦的月女神以鸽子崇拜，如同埃及底比斯、多多纳、希拉波利斯、克里特和塞浦路斯的对应者。但她也以长角母牛之形受崇拜；哈托尔，或伊西斯，或 Ashtaroth Karnaim。伊西斯是一个拟声的亚细亚词 Ish-ish，意为「哭泣者」，因为月亮被认为散播露水，而伊西斯——圣母 dolorosa 的前基督教原型——在塞特杀死奥西里斯时为他哀悼。据说她就是白色或据莫斯库斯所言金色的月母牛伊俄——从阿尔戈斯长途漂泊后在埃及安顿。伊俄名字中的 O 是 omega，这是 alpha 的常见希腊变体。

Ia-Hu therefore seems to be a combination of Ia, ‘the Exalted One’, the Moon-goddess as Cow, and Hu, the same goddess as Dove. We know from Plutarch that at the mid-winter solstice mysteries Isis, as the golden Moon-cow, circled the coffin of Osiris seven times in commemoration of the seven months from solstice to solstice; and we know also that the climax of the orgiastic oak-cult with which the Dove-goddess was concerned came at the summer solstice. Thus Ia-Hu stands for the Moon-goddess as ruler of the whole course of the solar year. This was a proud title and Set seems to have claimed it for himself when his ass-eared sceptre became the Egyptian symbol of royalty. But the Child Horus, the reincarnation of Osiris, overcomes Set yearly and it is a commonplace that conquering kings their titles take from the foes they captive make. Thus Horus was Iahu also, and his counterparts the Cretan Dionysus and Canaanite Bel became respectively IACCHUS and (in an Egyptian record) IAHU-BEL. The Welsh god Hu Gadarn and the Guernsey god Hou, or Har Hou, are likely to be the same deity: that Hou was an Oak-god is suggested by the same formula having been used in his mediaeval rites as in those of the Basque Oak-god Janicot, who is Janus.
因此 Ia-Hu 似乎是 Ia「崇高者」——母牛形态的月女神——与 Hu——鸽子形态的同一位女神——的组合。我们从普鲁塔克处得知，在冬至密仪中伊西斯作为金色月母牛绕奥西里斯的棺椁七圈以纪念冬至到夏至的七个月；我们还知道与鸽女神相关的狂欢橡树崇拜的高潮在夏至。因此 Ia-Hu 代表作为太阳年全程统治者的月女神。这是一个骄傲的称号，塞特似乎在他驴耳权杖成为埃及王权象征时据为己有。但孩子荷鲁斯——奥西里斯的转世——每年战胜塞特，而征服国王从被征服者夺取称号是常事。因此荷鲁斯也是 Iahu，他的对应者克里特狄俄尼索斯和迦南贝尔分别成为伊阿科斯和（在一份埃及记录中）IAHU-BEL。威尔士神胡加达恩和根西岛神 Hou 或 Har Hou 可能是同一神祇：Hou 是橡树神的暗示在于其中世纪仪式中使用的套语与巴斯克橡树神 Janicot——即雅努斯——的相同。

Iahu as a title of Jehovah similarly marks him out as a ruler of the solar year, probably a transcendental combination of Set, Osiris and Horus (alias Egli-Iahu, the Calf Iahu). But the Hu syllable of his name has come to have great importance in Christianity: for when at Jesus’s lustration by John the Baptist the Coronation Psalm was chanted and a Dove descended, this must be read as the ka, or royal double, that descended on him in a stream of light from his father Iahu – as it descended on the Pharaohs at their coronation from their father the Sun-god Ra, in the form of a hawk.
Iahu 作为耶和华的称号同样标示他为太阳年的统治者，可能是塞特、奥西里斯和荷鲁斯（别名 Egli-Iahu 即牛犊 Iahu）的超越性组合。但他名字中的 Hu 音节在基督教中变得极为重要：因为在耶稣接受施洗约翰洗礼时加冕诗篇被吟唱、一只鸽子降临时，这应被解读为从他父亲 Iahu——以光流形式降临的 ka 即王家替身——降下的，如同法老加冕时从其父太阳神拉处以鹰形降下的 ka。

No mention has been made so far of the religious meaning of the cedar, which figures so prominently in the Old Testament as the loftiest and grandest of all trees: ‘even the cedars of Libanus which Thou hast planted.’ It was used by Solomon with the ‘choice fir’ in the building of the three contiguous temples which he raised in honour of a Trinity consisting of Jehovah and two Goddesses. The identity of the second of these temples is disguised by Pharisee editors as ‘the House of the Forest of Lebanon’, meaning the temple of the Mountain-goddess, the Love and Battle goddess of Midsummer; that of the third is disguised as ‘The House of Pharaoh’s daughter’, who is shown by the story of Moses to have been the Birth-goddess of the Winter Solstice. Since we know that the fir was sacred to the Birth-goddess and that the floor of the Temple was of fir planking, it follows that the cedar of the pillars and beams was sacred to the Love-and-Battle goddess of Mount Lebanon, Astarte or Anatha. Cedar stood, in fact, for the vowel U, of which the tree in Byblos and Western Europe was the Heather. The only other timber used in these Temples was olive, which as has been already mentioned in the context of Hercules and the Dactyls stood for the Spring Sun – Jehovah as Marduk, alias Paeonian Apollo.
至今尚未提及雪松的宗教意义，而它在《旧约》中作为最高大最宏伟的树木频繁出现：「就是你所栽种的黎巴嫩雪松。」所罗门用雪松和「精选冷杉」建造了三座相连的圣殿，以纪念由耶和华和两位女神组成的三位一体。第二座殿的身份被法利赛编者伪装为「黎巴嫩森林之殿」——意为山女神即仲夏的爱与战女神之殿；第三座被伪装为「法老之女的殿」——从摩西故事可知她是冬至的生育女神。既然我们知道冷杉 sacred 于生育女神、圣殿地板是冷杉木的，那么柱和梁的雪松就 sacred 于黎巴嫩山的爱与战女神阿斯塔特或阿纳塔。事实上雪松对应元音 U——在比布洛斯和西欧对应的树是石楠。这些殿中使用的唯一其他木材是橄榄——此前在赫拉克勒斯和达克提尔的上下文中已提及它代表春日太阳——耶和华即马杜克即派奥尼乌斯·阿波罗。

Cedar is also coupled with hyssop (probably the wild-caper tree which grows very green in the crannies of rocks or walls, in Egypt and Palestine) in the two most primitive sacrifices of the Old Testament: the red heifer sacrifice of Numbers, XIX, 6 and the ‘sparrow’ sacrifice of Leviticus, XIV, 4, both originally offered to a goddess not a god. The hyssop was evidently a Canaanite equivalent of the mistletoe, the tree of the Day of Liberation, which it resembles by growing sometimes in the fissures of old trees where there is leaf mould to keep it alive; so that the mythological conjunction of cedar and hyssop means the whole course of the sun from its infancy at the winter solstice to its prime at the summer solstice, and back again. Thus when it is recorded in I Kings, IV, 33:
雪松还与牛膝草（可能是野角豆树，在埃及和巴勒斯坦的岩缝或墙缝中生长茂盛）一起出现在《旧约》最原始的两种献祭中：《民数记》XIX, 6 的红母牛献祭和《利未记》XIV, 4 的「麻雀」献祭——两者最初都献给女神而非男神。牛膝草显然是槲寄生的迦南等价物——解脱日之树——它与槲寄生相似之处在于有时生长在老树的裂缝中有腐殖土维持其生命；因此雪松与牛膝草的神话结合意味着太阳从冬至幼年到夏至壮年再返回的全部历程。因此当《列王纪上》IV, 33 记载：

And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much…and he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that is upon the wall,
And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much…and he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that is upon the wall,（神赐给所罗门极大的智慧和聪明……他论及树木，从黎巴嫩的雪松直到墙上的牛膝草，）





this is as much as to say that he knew all the mystic lore of the tree-alphabet. But hyssop was the tree of the winter solstice, IA: and the cedar was the tree of the summer solstice, HU; so Solomon is credited with knowing the Divine Name of which IAHU was the permissible synonym.
这等于是说他通晓树木字母表的全部奥秘。但牛膝草是冬至的树，IA；雪松是夏至的树，HU；因此所罗门被归功于知道以 IAHU 为可容许同义词的神圣之名。

JHWH’s Massoretic title, supposedly the oldest, was Q’re Adonai (‘Lord Q’re’) – though some Hebrew scholars prefer to interpret the words as meaning: ‘Read Adonai’, i.e. ‘give the consonants of JHWH the same vowels as in “Adonai”.’ Q’re sounds Cretan. The Carians, Lydians and Mysians, who were of Cretan stock, had a common shrine of Zeus Carios at Mylassa in Caria, a god whom their cousins the Tyrrhenians took to Italy as Karu, and who is also Carys, the founder of Megara. The Quirites of Rome came from a Sabine town Qures, which apparently bore his name or that of his mother Juno Quiritis, mentioned by Plutarch; and the Curetes of Delos, Chalcis, Aetolia and Crete are perhaps also called after him, though to the Greeks, who could make nothing of the barbarous word Q’re, ‘Curetes’ meant boys who had sacrificed their hair-trimmings (Kourai) to the god. These Curetes are identified by Pausanias with the Children of Anax, the ten-cubit-high Son of Uranus. Anax was a Carian who ruled Miletus before its conquest by the Milesians of Crete, gave it the name of Anactoria, and was the father of the ten-cubit-high Asterius. Pausanias connects Anax with the Pelasgian mysteries of Samothrace. The Children of Anax appear in the Bible as the tall people of Hebron whom Caleb expelled and who subsequently lived in Gaza and neighbouring cities. In other words, they were Asianic ‘People of the Sea’ who worshipped the God Q’re, or (as he was called in Syria in the time of Thothmes, a Pharaoh of the Middle Kingdom) ‘the Great God Ker’. His chief Carian title was Panemerios (‘of the live-long day’) – at least this was the Greek version of a Carian original -and he seems to have been a god of the solar year who, like Samson of Tyre or Nisus of Nisa (Megara), was annually shorn of his hair and power by the Moon-goddess; his male adorants dedicating their forelocks to him in mourning, at a festival called the Comyria. That Jehovah as Q’re continued to have hair sacrificed to him, as to his Carian counterpart, until the reformation of his religion during the Exile is indicated by the Deuteronomic injunction ‘Ye shall not make a baldness between your eyes for the dead’. The radical letters of his name – Q, apple, or quince or ethrog, and R, myrtle – were represented in the lulab, or thyrsus, used at the Feast of Tabernacles as a reminder of his annual death and translation to Elysium. This moon-festival, indeed, initiated the season of the year which runs from Q to R.
JHWH 的马所拉称号——据说最古老——是 Q're Adonai（「Q're 主」）——尽管一些希伯来学者更愿将此词解释为「读 Adonai」，即「给 JHWH 的辅音以 Adonai 中的元音」。Q're 听起来像克里特语。卡里亚人、吕底亚人和密细亚人——克里特血统——在卡里亚的米拉萨有一座共同的宙斯·卡里奥斯圣所，他们的表亲第勒尼人将此神带到意大利称为 Karu，他也是 Carys——墨伽拉的创建者。罗马的奎里特斯人来自萨宾城镇 Qures，显然以他或其母朱诺·奎里提斯——普鲁塔克提及——命名；提洛斯、哈尔基斯、埃托利亚和克里特的库雷忒斯可能也以他命名，尽管对无法理解蛮族词 Q're 的希腊人来说「Curetes」意为献出理发 (Kourai) 给神的男孩。保萨尼亚斯将这些库雷忒斯等同于阿纳克斯之子们——天王之乌拉诺斯之子的十肘高之子。阿纳克斯是一个卡里亚人，在克里特米利都人征服米利都之前统治该地，将其命名为阿纳克托利亚，是十肘高阿斯忒里俄斯之父。保萨尼亚斯将阿纳克斯与萨摩色雷斯的佩拉斯吉密仪联系起来。阿纳克斯之子们出现在《圣经》中为希伯仑的高个子——迦勒驱逐了他们，他们后来住在加沙和邻近城市。换言之，他们是崇拜神 Q're 的亚细亚「海上民族」——在图特摩斯（中王国法老）时代他在叙利亚被称为「大神 Ker」。他的主要卡里亚称号是 Panemerios（「终日者」）——至少这是某个卡里亚原词的希腊版本——他似乎是一个太阳年之神，如同提尔的参孙或尼萨（墨伽拉）的尼索斯，每年被月女神剪去头发和力量；他的男性崇拜者在名为 Comyria 的节日中将额前头发献给他以示哀悼。耶和华作为 Q're 继续接受头发献祭——如同他的卡里亚对应者——直到被掳期间的宗教改革，这一点由申命记的禁令暗示：「不可为死人剃除额上之发。」他名字的词根字母——Q，苹果或榅桲或香橼，以及 R，桃金娘——在住棚节使用的 lulab 即酒神杖中有所体现，作为他每年死亡和升入乐土的提醒。这个月亮节日确实开启了从 Q 到 R 的一年时节。

But Q’re probably derived his title from his Moon mother – later, in Greece, his twin-sister – the White Goddess Artemis Caryatis (‘of the nut-tree’) whose most famous temple was at Caryae in Laconia. She was the goddess of healing and inspiration, served by Caryatid priestesses and is to be identified with the nymph Phyllis1 who, in the Thesean Age, was metamorphosed into an almond tree – Phyllis may be a Greek variant of Belili. At any rate, he became for a time Nabu the Wise God of Wednesday, represented by the almond-tree stem of the seven-branched Menorah; and it was particularly to him that Job referred his question, ‘Where shall Wisdom be found?’, on the ground that it was he who measured, weighed out and enunciated the powers controlled by his six fellow-deities; such as Sin, Monday’s Rain-god; Bel, Thursday’s god of Thunder and Lightning; and Ninib, Saturday’s god of Repose, controller of the Chthonian Winds. Artemis Caryatis may be identified with Carmenta, the Muse mother of Evander the Arcadian, who adapted the Pelasgian alphabet to the Latin. Her name, which Plutarch in his Roman Questions absurdly derives from carens mente, ‘out of her mind’ seems to be compounded of Car and Menta: the first syllable standing for Q’re, the second presumably for Mante ‘the revealer’. Pliny preserves the tradition that ‘Car, after whom Caria takes its name, invented augury’; this Car, evidently Thothmes’s Great God Ker, is mentioned by Herodotus as brother to Lydus and Mysus, the eponymous ancestors of the Lydians and Mysians. Another Car, the son of Phoroneus, and brother of Pelasgus, Europë and Agenor, is said by Pausanias to have been an early king of Megara after whom the acropolis of the city was named. Car’s sex seems to have been changed in both cases: for the Carians, Mysians and Lydians were matrilinear, and the Megarean acropolis must have been called after the White Goddess who ruled all important hills and mountains. The Goddess Car seems also to have given the river Inachus its original name, Carmanor, before Inachus the father of Phoroneus, as Plutarch reports, went mad and leapt into it.
但 Q're 可能从他的月亮母亲——后来在希腊成为他的双胞胎姐妹——白女神阿尔忒弥斯·卡里阿提斯（Caryatis，「坚果树之女神」）那里获得称号，她最著名的神殿在拉科尼亚的卡里埃。她是治愈和灵感女神，由卡里阿提德女祭司侍奉，可等同于宁菲利斯¹——她在忒修斯时代被变成杏仁树——菲利斯可能是贝利利的希腊变体。无论如何，他曾一度成为星期三的智慧神纳布，以七灯烛台的杏仁树干为代表；约伯尤其向他提出问题「智慧从何处寻得？」，理由是他测量、称量和宣布其六位同僚神祇所控制的力量；如辛——星期一的雨神；贝尔——星期四的雷电之神；尼尼布——星期六的安息之神，冥府之风的控制者。阿尔忒弥斯·卡里阿提斯可等同于卡门塔——阿尔卡迪亚人埃万德的缪斯母亲，她将佩拉斯吉字母表改编为拉丁字母。她的名字——普鲁塔克在《罗马问题》中荒谬地派生自 carens mente「失去理智」——似乎由 Car 和 Menta 组成：第一个音节代表 Q're，第二个推测代表 Mante「揭示者」。老普林尼保存了「卡里亚因其得名的卡发明了占卜」的传统；这位卡——显然是图特摩斯的大神 Ker——被希罗多德提及为吕杜斯和密苏斯——吕底亚人和密细亚人的同名祖先——的兄弟。另一位卡——弗罗纽斯之子、佩拉斯古斯、欧罗巴和阿革诺尔的兄弟——据保萨尼亚斯记载是墨伽拉的早期国王，城市卫城以他命名。卡在两种情况下的性别似乎都被改变了：因为卡里亚人、密细亚人和吕底亚人是母系继承的，而墨伽拉卫城必定以统治所有重要山丘的白女神命名。女神卡似乎也给了伊纳科斯河原名卡玛诺尔——在弗罗纽斯之父伊纳科斯据普鲁塔克所说发疯跳入其中之前。

At this point we can reconsider the Myvyrian account of the Battle of the Trees and suggest a textual emendation which makes better sense of it:
此时我们可以重新审视《米维里安》对树木之战的记述，并提出一个更有意义的文本校订：

There was a man in that battle who unless his name were known could not be overcome, and there was on the other side a woman called Achren (‘Trees’), and unless her name were known her party could not be overcome. And Gwydion ap Don, instructed by his brother Amathaon, guessed the name of the woman….
在那场战斗中有一人，除非他的名字被知道否则无法被战胜；另一边有一个叫阿克伦（Achren，「树木」）的女人，除非她的名字被知道否则她的一方无法被战胜。唐之子格维敦在其兄阿马松的指点下，猜到了那女人的名字……





For it has already been shown that the Battle of the Trees was fought between the White Goddess (‘the woman’) for whose love the god of the waxing year and of the waning year were rivals, and ‘the man’, Immortal Apollo, or Beli, who challenged her power. In other words, the sacred name IEVOA, or JIEVOAO its enlargement, revealed by Amathaon to Gwydion and used as a means of routing Bran, was the name of the Fivefold Goddess Danu. This was a name in which Bran could claim to speak oracularly from her kingdom of Dis, as one who had had intimate experience of each of her five persons – by being born to her, initiated by her, becoming her lover, being lulled to sleep by her, and finally killed by her. The new name of eight letters which replaced it was Beli-Apollo’s own, not shared with the White Goddess, and it was therefore conveniently forgotten by later mythographers that the original one belonged to Bran, or Q’re, or Iahu, only by virtue of his birth, marriage and death under female auspices. Professor Sturtevant, expert on the Hittites, translates Q’re as Karimni which means merely ‘to the god’; but, as Mr. E. M. Parr points out, El is both the common word for ‘god’ in Syria and a proper name for the oak-god El. He holds that other forms of this same word are Horus, or Qouros, a god of the island of Thera – the Semitic form of Horus is Churu. The identity of Q’re is confused by the Gods Nergal and Marduk having also assumed the name (Qaru): Marduk’s Amorites called him Gish Qaru, ‘Q’re of trees and herbs’, to identify him with Nergal, the God of Tuesday on which trees and herbs were first created.
因为已经证明树木之战是在白女神（「那个女人」）——渐年之神和衰年之神为她的爱而竞争——和「那个男人」不朽阿波罗即贝利——挑战她的力量——之间进行的。换言之，阿马松向格维敦揭示的、用来击溃布兰的神圣之名 IEVOA 或其扩展 JIEVOAO，是五重女神达努之名。布兰可以凭此名从她的迪斯王国中发言，作为一个经历了她五个面向中每一个的人——由她所生、由她入教、成为她的情人、被她哄睡、最终被她杀死。取代它的八字母新名是贝利-阿波罗自己的名字，不与白女神共享，因此后来的神话编撰者 conveniently 遗忘了原名只因出生、婚配和死亡均在女性赞助下才属于布兰或 Q're 或 Iahu。赫梯专家斯特蒂文特教授将 Q're 译为 Karimni，仅意为「致神」；但如 E. M. 帕尔先生所指出，El 既是叙利亚语中「神」的通称也是橡树神 El 的专名。他认为此词的其他形式还有荷鲁斯或 Qouros——锡拉岛的神——荷鲁斯的闪族形式是 Churu。Q're 的身份因内尔伽尔和马杜克也采用此名 (Qaru) 而混乱：马杜克的阿摩利人称他为 Gish Qaru，「草木之 Q're」，以将他等同于内尔伽尔——星期二之神，那天树木和草本最初被创造。

1 In the Egyptian Zodiac he is shown with a fish tail, which aligns him with the Water-carrier and the Fishes as a Sign of the three months of Flood. But the Egyptian floods come in the summer with the melting of the Abyssinian snows, so that the Zodiac must have been an importation from some other region.
¹ 在埃及黄道带中他被描绘为有鱼尾，这使他与水瓶座和双鱼座一起成为洪水三个月的星座。但埃及洪水在夏季阿比西尼亚积雪融化时到来，因此黄道带必定是从其他地区传入的。



1 Dr. Raphael Patai suggests in his Hebrew Installation Rites (Cincinnati, 1947), that the attempted murder by Saul of his son Jonathan (I Samuel, XIV, 15) which was avoided only by the provision of a surrogate, and the burning by fire from Heaven of two sons of Aaron on the day of his coronation (Leviticus, X, 1–2), were both ritual sacrifices. If he is right about Aaron, the story has been telescoped: one of his ‘sons’ must have been burned at the close of each year of office, not both at his first installation.
¹ 拉斐尔·帕塔伊博士在《希伯来就职仪式》（辛辛那提，1947）中提出，扫罗试图杀害其子约拿单（《撒母耳记上》XIV, 15）——仅因提供替代者而避免——以及亚伦加冕当天两个儿子被天火焚烧（《利未记》X, 1–2），都是仪式献祭。如果他对亚伦的看法正确，故事被压缩了：他的「儿子」之一必定在每年任职结束时被烧死，而非两人都在首次就职时被烧。



1 There may, however, have been an earlier introduction of the bullfight into Spain by the lberian settlers of the third millennium BC, who had cultural affinities with Thrace. Archaeological evidence from Crete suggests that the fiesta originated as an annual display of the bull’s domination by acrobatic Moon-goddesses after he had been allowed to tire himself by chasing and killing men; and that the bull was a surrogate for the sacred king. However, in no Minoan painting or sculpture is there any picture of the final episode of the fiesta, in which the bull is despatched with a sword, and this may have been omitted in Crete, as in the Provencal bullfight. Even in Spain, where the bull is always killed and where the fiesta is a royal institution, a glorification of man’s courage (supposed to be resident in his testicles) for the benefit of the ladies seated near the President’s box – especially for the Queen, and Isabella II was not ashamed to accept the most famous bullfighter of her day as her lover – the tradition of the woman bullfighter persists obstinately. When Prince Charles went to Madrid in 1623 to court the Infanta he saw a woman-fighter despatch her bull with skill and grace, and there are still two or three women in the profession.
¹ 然而，斗牛可能更早由公元前三千年的伊比利亚定居者引入西班牙，他们与色雷斯有文化亲缘关系。来自克里特的考古证据表明，斗牛节起源于一种年度表演：在公牛被允许追逐和杀死人以耗尽体力后，由杂技月女神展示对公牛的征服；而公牛是神圣国王的替代品。然而，在没有任何弥诺斯绘画或雕塑中，有斗牛节最后一幕——用剑处死公牛——的画面，这在克里特可能被省略了，如同在普罗旺斯斗牛中一样。即使在西班牙——公牛总是被杀死，斗牛节是一项王家制度，为坐在主席包厢附近的女士们——尤其是为王后——彰显男子气概（据说寄存于睾丸中）——伊莎贝拉二世并不羞于接受她那个时代最著名的斗牛士为情人——女斗牛士的传统仍然顽强地存续。当查理王子1623年去马德里追求公主时，他看到一位女斗牛士以技巧和优雅杀死了她的公牛，至今仍有两三位女性从事这一职业。



1 The quail, sacred to Delian Apollo and Hercules Melkarth, was decoyed in the same way and had a similar erotic reputation. The moral of the flock of migrating quails that invaded the Israelites’ camp in the Wilderness is carefully pointed in Numbers (XI, 33, 34). Whereas in Exodus (XVI, 13), the earlier version of the story, the Israelites apparently eat without evil consequences according to the Lord’s promise, the author of Numbers does not let them so much as chew a morsel; but records that God smote them with a great plague and that the place was called Kibroth-Hattavah, ‘the grave of lust’. He is allegorically warning his post-exilic audience against having anything to do with Melkarth worship.
¹ 鹌鹑——提洛斯阿波罗和赫拉克勒斯·梅尔卡什的神鸟——以同样方式被诱捕，也有类似的色情名声。成群迁徙的鹌鹑侵入以色列人在旷野中的营地这一事件的寓意，在《民数记》（XI, 33, 34）中被仔细点明。而在《出埃及记》（XVI, 13）——故事的较早版本——中，以色列人显然按照主的应许吃了而无恶果；《民数记》的作者却不让他们嚼一口，而是记录神用大瘟疫击打他们，那地方被称为基博罗·哈他瓦（Kibroth-Hattavah），即「贪欲之墓」。他在寓言性地警告被掳后的听众不要与梅尔卡什崇拜有任何瓜葛。



1 Hephaestus, according to Hesiod, was the parthogenous son of Hera – in other words, he belonged to the pre-Hellenic civilization – and not even Homer’s authority for the view that Zeus was his father carried any weight with subsequent Greek and Latin mythographers. Servius makes this clear in his comment on Aeneid, VIII, 454.
¹ 据赫西俄德记载，赫淮斯托斯是赫拉的单性生殖之子——换言之，他属于前希腊文明——即使是荷马关于宙斯为其父的权威观点，对后来的希腊和拉丁神话编撰者也没有任何分量。塞尔维乌斯在对《埃涅阿斯纪》VIII, 454的注释中清楚地说明了这一点。



1 J. N. Schofield in his Historical Background to the Bible suggests that he destroyed it for political reasons – the Serpent cult being Egyptian, and Hezekiah wishing to signalize his return to Assyrian vassalage.
¹ J. N. 斯科菲尔德在其《圣经的历史背景》中提出，他出于政治原因销毁了它——蛇崇拜是埃及的，而希西家希望以此表明他回归亚述藩属地位。



1 Gower derives the word ‘filbert’ from this Phyllis, though the orthodox explanation is that filberts are first ripe on St. Philebert’s Day (August 22nd, Old Style).
¹ 高沃尔（Gower）将「榛子」（filbert）一词派生自此菲利斯（Phyllis），尽管正统解释是榛子在圣菲尔伯特节（旧历8月22日）最先成熟。





Chapter Nineteen

title: 第十九章
content:
THE NUMBER OF THE BEAST
兽的数目





Little Gwion forced himself on me pleasantly but importunately, as children do, at a time when I was too busy with another book to think of anything else. He refused to be shaken off, though I protested that I had not the least intention of breaking into the field of bardic myth and no scholarly equipment for doing so. Despite my present appearance of easy familiarity with Celtic literature I could not at the time have answered a single question in the Hanes Taliesin puzzle (which at first sight recalled the ‘lovely riddle – all in poetry – all about fishes’ that the White Queen asked Alice at the final banquet in Looking-Glass Land) if I had not known most of the answers beforehand by poetic intuition. Really, all that I needed to do was to verify them textually; and though I had no more than one or two of the necessary books in my very small library the rest were soon sent, unasked for, by poet friends or tumbled down into my hands from the shelves of a second-hand sea-side bookshop. I drafted this whole volume at about one-half of its present length, in six weeks, then returned to the other book; but spent six years polishing the draft.
小格温趁我正忙于另一本书无暇他顾之际，愉快而纠缠不休地闯入我的世界——就像孩子们那样。他拒绝被甩掉，尽管我抗议说我完全没有闯入吟游诗人神话领域的意图，也没有这样做所需的学术装备。尽管我目前表面上对凯尔特文学轻车熟路，但当时即使面对《塔列辛传奇》（Hanes Taliesin）谜题中的一个简单问题，我也无法回答——它乍看之下令人想起白女王在《镜中世界》最后宴会上问爱丽丝的「可爱的谜语——全是诗——全是关于鱼的」——如果不是我已通过诗性直觉预先知道大部分答案的话。实际上，我需要做的只是在文本上验证它们；尽管在我那极小的藏书中只有一两本必要的书，其余的书很快便不求自来——诗人朋友们寄来的，或从一家海边二手书店的书架上滚落到我手中。我以约目前一半的篇幅在六周内起草了全书，然后回去写另一本书；但花了六年时间打磨草稿。

The train of coincidences that made my task possible was of a sort familiar to poets. What after all does ‘coincidence’ mean? What did it mean to Euclid? It meant, for example, that if in certain circumstances you applied the triangle Alpha-Beta-Gamma to the triangle Delta-Epsilon-Zeta then Gamma and Zeta would be more or less identically situated. Similarly, since I knew in advance the answers to Gwion’s riddles, this presupposed the necessary book-knowledge as extant and accessible and therefore the books subsequently coincided with my needs. Zeta and Gamma gently kissed, and I could dress up in reasonable form an arrangement of thought arrived at by unreason.
使我的任务成为可能的那一连串巧合，是诗人们所熟悉的那种。毕竟「巧合」意味着什么？它对欧几里得意味着什么？它意味着，例如，如果在特定条件下你将三角形 Alpha-Beta-Gamma 叠加到三角形 Delta-Epsilon-Zeta 上，那么 Gamma 和 Zeta 将大致处于同一位置。同样，既然我预先知道格温谜题的答案，这就预设了必要的书籍知识业已存在且可获取，因此这些书后来恰好与我的需求相合。Zeta 和 Gamma 温柔地吻合了，我得以用合理的形式将一个由非理性达成的思想编排呈现出来。

One day William Rowan Hamilton, whose portrait occurs on the centenary stamps of Eire issued in 1943, was crossing Phoenix Park in Dublin, when the foreknowledge came to him of an order of mathematics, which he called ‘quaternions’, so far in advance of contemporary mathematic development that the gap has only recently been bridged by a long succession of intervening mathematicians. All outstanding mathematicians have this power of making a prodigious mental leap into the dark and landing firmly on both feet. Clerk Maxwell is the best known case, and he gave away the secret of his unscientific methods of thought by being such a poor accountant: he could arrive at the correct formula but had to rely on his colleagues to justify the result by pedestrian calculation.
有一天，威廉·罗恩·哈密顿——其肖像出现在1943年发行的爱尔兰百年纪念邮票上——正在穿过都柏林凤凰公园时，一种他称为「四元数」的数学序列的先知突然降临他脑中，远超当时的数学发展水平，这一差距直到最近才被一长串中间的数学家弥合。所有杰出的数学家都有这种能力：做出惊人的精神跳跃进入黑暗中，然后稳稳地双脚着地。克拉克·麦克斯韦是最著名的例子，他因为是个如此糟糕的会计而泄露了自己非科学思维方法的秘密：他能得出正确的公式，但不得不依靠同事通过踏实的计算来验证结果。

Most outstanding physicians diagnose the nature of a disease by the same means, though afterwards they may justify their diagnoses by a logical examination of the symptoms. In fact, it is not too much to say that all original discoveries and inventions and musical and poetical compositions are the result of proleptic thought – the anticipation, by means of a suspension of time, of a result that could not have been arrived at by inductive reasoning – and of what may be called analeptic thought, the recovery of lost events by the same suspension.
大多数杰出的医生以同样的方式诊断疾病的性质，尽管之后他们可能通过对症状的逻辑检查来验证其诊断。事实上，毫不夸张地说，所有原创性的发现和发明以及音乐和诗歌创作，都是超前思维——通过悬置时间来预期一个归纳推理无法达成的结果——以及可称为回溯思维——以同样的悬置恢复已失事件——的产物。

This need mean no more than that time, though a most useful convention of thought, has no greater intrinsic value than, say, money. To think in temporal terms is a very complicated and unnatural way of thinking, too; many children master foreign languages and mathematic theory long before they have developed any sense of time or accepted the easily disproved thesis that cause precedes effect.
这无非意味着，时间虽然是一种极有用的思维约定，但并不比比如金钱有更大的内在价值。以时间术语来思考也是一种极其复杂而不自然的方式；许多孩子在发展出任何时间感或接受「因果先后」这一容易被驳倒的论点之前很久，就掌握了外语和数学理论。

I wrote about the Muse some years ago in a poem:
几年前我在一首诗中写过缪斯：

If strange things happen where she is
If strange things happen where she is（若她所到之处异事频生）



So that men say that graves open
So that men say that graves open（以至于人们说坟墓裂开）



And the dead walk, or that futurity
And the dead walk, or that futurity（死者行走，或说未来）



Becomes a womb, and the unborn are shed –
Becomes a womb, and the unborn are shed –（化为子宫，未生者坠落——）



Such portents are not to be wondered at
Such portents are not to be wondered at（此等异象不足为奇）



Being tourbillions in Time made
Being tourbillions in Time made（乃是时间中的漩涡，由）



By the strong pulling of her bladed mind
By the strong pulling of her bladed mind（她那刀锋般心智的强力牵引而成）



Through that ever-reluctant element.
Through that ever-reluctant element.（穿过那永远不情愿的元素。）





Poets will be able to confirm this from their own experience. And because since I wrote this poem J. W. Dunne’s Experiment with Time has prosaicized the notion that time is not the stable moving-staircase that prose men have for centuries pretended it to be, but an unaccountable wibble-wobble, the prose men too will easily see what I am driving at. In the poetic act, time is suspended and details of future experience often become incorporated in the poem, as they do in dreams. This explains why the first Muse of the Greek triad was named Mnemosyne, ‘Memory’: one can have memory of the future as well as of the past. Memory of the future is usually called instinct in animals, intuition in human beings.
诗人们能够从自己的经验中证实这一点。而因为自从我写下这首诗以来，J. W. 邓恩的《时间实验》已将时间并非散文家们几百年来假装的那种稳定的自动扶梯、而是一种莫名其妙的摇摆这一观念散文化了，散文家们也将容易理解我的用意。在诗歌行为中，时间被悬置，未来经验的细节常常被纳入诗中，正如在梦中一样。这解释了为何希腊三联体缪斯中的第一位被命名为谟涅摩绪涅（Mnemosyne），即「记忆」：人可以有对未来的记忆，也可以有对过去的记忆。对未来的记忆在动物中通常被称为本能，在人类中被称为直觉。

An obvious difference between poems and dreams is that in poems one is (or should be) in critical control of the situation; in dreams one is a paranoiac, a mere spectator of mythographic event. But in poems as in dreams there is a suspension of temporal criteria; and when the Irish poets wrote of enchanted islands where three hundred years went by as if they were a day, and put these islands under the sovereignty of the Muse, they were defining this suspension. The sudden shock of a return to the familiar temporal mode of thought is typified in the myths by the breaking of the saddle girth when the young hero rides back home on a visit from the Island. His foot touches the ground and the charm is broken: ‘then the troubles of old age and sickness fell suddenly upon him.’
诗歌与梦境的一个明显区别是：在诗歌中，人处于（或应该处于）对情境的批判性掌控之中；在梦境中，人是一个偏执狂，仅仅是神话事件的旁观者。但诗歌如梦境一样存在时间标准的悬置；当爱尔兰诗人写到魔岛——那里三百年如一日般逝去——并将这些岛屿置于缪斯的统治之下时，他们正是在定义这种悬置。突然回到熟悉的时间思维模式所受到的冲击，在神话中以年轻英雄从魔岛骑马回家探亲时马鞍带断裂来典型化。他的脚触地，魔法便被打破：「于是年老和疾病的困扰骤然降临于他。」

A sense of the equivocal nature of time is constantly with poets, rules out hope or anxiety about the future, concentrates interest detachedly in the present. I wrote about this with proleptic detail in 1934, in a poem ‘The Fallen Tower of Siloam’, which began:
对时间模棱两可之本质的感知始终伴随着诗人，排除了对未来的希望或焦虑，将兴趣超然地集中于当下。我在1934年的一首诗《西罗亚楼的坍塌》中以超前的细节写到了这一点，诗的开头是：

Should the building totter, spring for an archway!
Should the building totter, spring for an archway!（若大楼摇晃，冲向一道拱门！）



We were there already…
We were there already…（我们早已在那里……）





But an interesting feature of prolepsis and analepsis is that the coincidence of the concept and the reality is never quite exact: Gamma coincides with Zeta, but not so closely that either loses its identity. The coincidence is as close, you may say, as between the notes B natural and C flat which, for economy’s sake, are given only a single string on a pianoforte: they have slightly different vibration lengths, but only a remarkably true ear can distinguish one from the other. Or, as close as between the values 22/7 and pi: if you wish to calculate, say, how much binding you will need for the bottom of a bell-tent three yards in diameter, 22/7 will be an adequate formula.
但超前和回溯的一个有趣特征是，概念与现实的吻合从来不是完全精确的：Gamma 与 Zeta 吻合，但并非密切到任一方失去其同一性。这种吻合之密切，你可以说，如同还原 B 和降 C 两个音符——为了经济起见，钢琴上只给它们一根弦：它们的振动长度略有不同，但只有异常敏锐的耳朵才能将二者区分开来。或者说，如同 22/7 和 π 之间的差距：如果你想计算，比方说，直径三码的钟形帐篷底部需要多少镶边，22/7 就是一个足够的公式。

In September 1943, when I could not stop my mind from running all day and all night in chase of the Roebuck, so rapidly that my pen could not keep up with it, I tried to preserve a critical detachment. I said to myself: ‘I am not particularly enjoying this jaunt. I am not greatly interested in the strange country through which my broom-stick mind is flying me, and not at all sure whether I should trouble to chart it.’ Then I addressed myself schizophrenically: ‘I’ll tell you what, Robert. I’ll propound a simple, well-known, hitherto unsolved riddle and if you can make sense of that, very well, I’ll pay attention to your other discoveries.’
1943年9月，当我无法阻止自己的大脑日夜不停追逐狍鹿，速度快到笔都跟不上的，我试图保持一种批判性的超然。我对自己说：「我并不特别享受这次出游。我对我那扫帚柄般的心智正带我飞越的这片陌生乡野并不太感兴趣，也不太确定是否值得麻烦去绘制它的地图。」然后我以精神分裂般的口吻对自己说：「我跟你说，罗伯特。我来出一个简单、著名、迄今未解的谜语，如果你能解开它，好吧，我就注意你的其他发现。」

The riddle that I propounded was the last verse of the thirteenth chapter of the Apocalypse:
我提出的谜语是《启示录》第十三章最后一节：

Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the Beast: for it is the number of a man and his number is 666.
Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the Beast: for it is the number of a man and his number is 666.（在这里有智慧。凡有聪明的，可以算计兽的数目；因为这是人的数目，他的数目是六百六十六。）





I vaguely remembered, from my school days, the two traditional solutions of St. John’s cryptogram. They are both based on the assumption that, since letters of the alphabet were used to express numerals in Greek and Hebrew alike, 666 was a sum arrived at by adding together the letters that spelt out the Beast’s name. The earliest solution, that of the second-century bishop Irenaeus, is LATEINOS, meaning ‘The Latin One’ and so denoting the race of the Beast; the most widely accepted modern solution – I forgot whose – is NERON KESAR, namely the Emperor Nero regarded as Antichrist.1 Neither solution is quite satisfactory. ‘The Latin One’ is too vague a characterization of Beast 666, and KAISAR, not KESAR, was the ordinary Greek way of writing ‘Caesar’. Besides, the possible combinations of letter-values which add up to 666, and the possible anagrammatic arrangements of each of these sets of letter-values, are so numerous that the aggregate of possibility approaches as near to infinity as anyone could wish.
我从学生时代就模模糊糊地记得圣约翰密码的两个传统解答。两者都基于这样的假设：既然希腊语和希伯来语中字母都被用来表示数字，666 就是拼写兽名各字母数值之和。最早的解答来自二世纪主教爱任纽，是 LATEINOS，意为「拉丁人」，因此标示兽的种族；最广为接受的现代解答——我忘了是谁提出的——是 NERON KESAR，即被视为敌基督的尼禄皇帝。¹ 两个解答都不太令人满意。「拉丁人」对兽666来说太模糊了，而且 KAISAR 而非 KESAR 才是书写「恺撒」的普通希腊方式。此外，加起来等于666的字母数值组合，以及每组字母数值的变位排列，数量之多使可能性总和接近任何人所愿的无穷。

The Apocalypse was written in Greek, but my analeptic self, when thus addressed, stubbornly insisted on thinking in Latin; and I saw in a sort of vision the Roman numerals flashed across the wall of the room I was in. They made a placard:
《启示录》是用希腊语写的，但我的回溯自我在被如此召唤时，固执地坚持用拉丁语思考；我在一种幻象中看到罗马数字闪过我所住房间的墙壁。它们构成了一张告示：

D.C.L.X.



V.I.





When they steadied, I looked at them slantwise. Poets will know what I mean by slantwise: it is a way of looking through a difficult word or phrase to discover the meaning lurking behind the letters. I saw that the placard was a titulus, the Roman superscription nailed above the heads of criminals at the place of execution, explaining their crime. I found myself reading out:
当它们稳定下来后，我侧目而视。诗人们会知道我说的侧目而视是什么意思：那是一种透过难词或难句去看、以发现潜藏在字母背后的含义的方式。我看到那告示是一个 titulus——罗马人在刑场钉在罪犯头顶上方的超书，说明他们的罪行。我发现自己在读出：

DOMITIANUS CAESAR LEGATOS XTI



VILITER INTERFECIT





‘Domitian Caesar basely killed the Envoys of Christ.’ I.N.R.I. was the titulus of Christ; D.C.L.X. V.I. was the titulus of Antichrist.
「图密善·恺撒卑劣地杀害了基督的使者。」I.N.R.I. 是基督的 titulus；D.C.L.X. V.I. 是敌基督的 titulus。

The only word I stumbled at was VILITER; it had a blurred look.
我绊磕的唯一词是 VILITER；它看起来模糊。

The persecution of the Church under Nero and Domitian had never greatly interested me, and the test that I had set my mind was therefore a routine one – just as I might have tested myself with the routine formula: ‘The Leith police dismisseth us,’ if I had suspected myself of being drunk. No historical prejudice was involved, and my clinical observations on the case are therefore to be trusted.
我从未对尼禄和图密善迫害教会的历史有过太大兴趣，因此我给大脑设的测试是例行公事——就像如果我怀疑自己醉了，可能会用例行公式「利思警察驳回我们」来测试自己一样。不涉及任何历史偏见，因此我对这一案例的临床观察是可信的。

In the first place I had been aware that the Apocalypse was referred by most Biblical scholars to the reign of Nero (54–67 AD), not to that of Domitian (81–96 AD), the whole trend of the visions being anti-Neronic. And yet my eye read ‘Domitianus’. In the second, I was aware that viliter, in the Silver Age of Latin, means ‘cheaply,’ and that its derived sense of ‘basely’ implies worthlessness, not wickedness. And yet my eye read ‘viliter’.
首先，我知道《启示录》被大多数圣经学者归于尼禄统治时期（公元54-67年），而非图密善统治时期（公元81-96年），因为整个异象的倾向是反尼禄的。然而我的眼睛读出了「Domitianus」。其次，我知道 viliter 在拉丁语白银时代意为「廉价地」，其引申义「卑劣地」暗示无价值而非邪恶。然而我的眼睛读出了「viliter」。

It was some weeks before I began to understand this paradox. It seemed to me that the work which my analeptic self had done was sound enough: D.C.L.X.V.I, was the correct text, and the solution was correct. But my eye, under the influence of my reasonable self, had evidently been at fault: it had misread, as it frequently misreads letters and newspaper headings when I am not quite awake in the morning. The text had really been:
几周后我才开始理解这个悖论。在我看来，我的回溯自我所做的工作相当可靠：D.C.L.X.V.I. 是正确的文本，解答也是正确的。但我的眼睛在理性自我的影响下显然出了差错：它误读了——就像我早上还没完全醒时常常误读字母和报纸标题那样。文本实际上是：

DOMITIUS CAESAR LEGATOS XTI



VIOLENTER INTERFECIT





But since ‘Domitius Caesar’ meant nothing to my reasonable self – indeed, there was no person of that name – it had officiously corrected the mistake by reading ‘Domitianus’. Now I remembered that Domitius was Nero’s original name before the Emperor Claudius adopted him into the Imperial family and changed his name to Nero Claudius Caesar Drusus Germanicus, and that he hated to be reminded of his plebeian origin. (I think it is Suetonius who mentions this sensitivity of Nero’s.) Nero’s criminal father, Gnaeus Domitius Ahenobarbus, when congratulated on the child’s birth, replied coolly that any offspring of himself and his wife Agrippinilla could bring only ruin on the State. So ‘Domitius Caesar’ was a suitable taunt for the cryptogram – as anti-Hitlerians in 1933 made political capital out of ‘Chancellor Schickelgruber’. St. John the Divine would naturally not have respected Nero’s feelings when composing it, and the use of D.C. for N.C. would have served to protect the secret.
但由于「Domitius Caesar」对我的理性自我来说毫无意义——实际上没有叫这个名字的人——它便僭越地通过读成「Domitianus」来纠正这个「错误」。现在我记起来了，Domitius 是尼禄被皇帝克劳狄收养进皇室家族、改名为 Nero Claudius Caesar Drusus Germanicus 之前的原名，而他讨厌被提醒自己的平民出身。（我记得是苏维托尼乌斯提到了尼禄的这一敏感。）尼禄那罪犯父亲格奈乌斯·多米提乌斯·阿赫诺巴尔布斯，在孩子出生时被人道贺时冷冷地回答说，他和妻子阿格里皮尼娜的任何后代都只会给国家带来毁灭。因此「Domitius Caesar」是密码中一个恰当的嘲弄——如同1933年反希特勒者用「施克尔格鲁伯总理」来做政治文章。神学家圣约翰在编写它时自然不会尊重尼禄的感情，而用 D.C. 代替 N.C. 可以起到保护秘密的作用。

Violenter means something more than ‘roughly’ or ‘impetuously’: it contains the sense of sacrilegious fury and outrage. So it seemed that my amending eye had brought up the EN from VIOLENTER into the word written just above it, to form DOMITIENUS, which came near enough to ‘Domitianus’ to make no odds; and that the meaningless word VIOLTER which remained below was a blur which I stumblingly read as VILITER, recognizing it as a word of condemnation.
Violenter 意味着比「粗暴地」或「猛冲地」更多的东西：它包含亵渎的暴怒和残暴之意。因此似乎是我那纠正的眼睛将 VIOLENTER 中的 EN 提到了它上方写着的词中，组成了 DOMITIENUS，这与「Domitianus」足够接近而不成问题；而下方剩下的无意义词 VIOLTER 是一片模糊，我跌跌撞撞地读成了 VILITER，认出它是一个谴责词。

(I do not claim more for this reading than that it makes historical sense. Who can say whether the sense was put there by St. John, as it were for my benefit, or by myself, as it were for St. John’s benefit? All I know is that I read the words off just about as easily and unthinkingly as, say, the censor of soldiers’ mail reads the cryptogram at the close of a letter to a wife: ‘X.X.X – W.I.W.R.D.D.Y?’ as ‘Kiss-kiss-kiss – wish it was real, darling, don’t you?’) This is not all. When I came to scrutinize the Apocalypse text, I found in the margin a cross-reference to Chapter XV, verse 2, which runs:
（我对这一读法所声称的不过是它在历史上有意义。谁能说是圣约翰把这意义放进去的——好像是为了我——还是我自己放进去的——好像是为了圣约翰？我只知道我读出这些词大约就像，比方说，军人邮件的审查员读一封信末尾写给妻子的密码「X.X.X – W.I.W.R.D.D.Y?」为「亲亲亲——恨不得是真的，亲爱的，你说呢？」一样轻松而不假思索。）这还不是全部。当我仔细检查《启示录》文本时，我在页边发现一个交叉引用，指向第十五章第2节，内容如下：

And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire and them that had gotten the victory over the Beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire and them that had gotten the victory over the Beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.（我看见仿佛有玻璃海，其中有火搀杂。又看见那些胜了兽和兽的像，并他名字数目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴。）





The ‘image’ is the one mentioned in the previous context: apparently the meaning is that Christians were martyred who loyally refused to worship Nero’s statue. So ‘them that had gotten the victory over the Beast and over his image and over his mark and over the number of his name’ were the Envoys of Christ who refused to be terrorized into Emperor worship, and who when sacrilegiously slain were carried straight up into Paradise.
「像」是前文中提到的：含义显然是那些忠诚拒绝崇拜尼禄雕像的基督徒殉道了。因此「那些胜了兽和兽的像并他印记和他名字数目的人」就是拒绝被恐吓进行皇帝崇拜的基督使者，他们在被亵渎地杀害后直接被接升入乐园。

Now the question arose: why had my eye read ‘Domitianus’ when the text was ‘Domitius’? That had to be answered, for my eye had been convinced that Domitian, not Nero, was meant, and had rapidly amended the text to prove its point. Perhaps my eye had been a servant of my crazy analeptic self after all. Perhaps both Domitius and Domitian were meant. I mean, perhaps the Apocalypse was originally written in the time of Nero’s persecutions, but expanded and brought up-to-date in the reign of Domitian, who revived the Neronic persecutions and whose name means ‘of Domitius’s kind’. What about the verses:
现在问题来了：为何文本明明是「Domitius」，我的眼睛却读成了「Domitianus」？这必须回答，因为我的眼睛确信图密善而非尼禄才是所指之人，并迅速修改了文本来证明其观点。也许我的眼睛终究是我那疯狂的回溯自我的仆人。也许 Domitius 和 Domitian 都是被指的。我的意思是，也许《启示录》最初写于尼禄迫害时期，但在图密善统治时期——他恢复了尼禄式的迫害且其名字意为「属于多米提乌斯一类」——被扩充和更新了。那么以下经文怎么说：

I saw one of the Beast’s heads as it were wounded to death, and his deadly wound was healed and all the world wondered at the Beast.
I saw one of the Beast's heads as it were wounded to death, and his deadly wound was healed and all the world wondered at the Beast.（我看见兽的一个头似乎受了死伤，那死伤却医好了。全地的人都稀奇跟从那兽。）



And they…worshipped the Beast saying: ‘Who is like unto the Beast? Who is able to make war with him?’
And they…worshipped the Beast saying: 'Who is like unto the Beast? Who is able to make war with him?'（众人……拜那兽说：「谁能比这兽？谁能与他交战呢？」）



And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies and power was given unto him to continue forty-and-two months….
And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies and power was given unto him to continue forty-and-two months….（又赐给他说夸大亵渎话的口，又赐给他权柄可以持续四十二个月……）



And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.
And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.（又赐给他权柄与圣徒争战，并且得胜。）





The reference is clearly to the well-known contemporary belief that Nero would come again, surviving his deadly sword-wound, and to the natural Christian supposition that he was reincarnate in Domitian.
这明显指的是当时广为流传的信念——尼禄将卷土重来，带着他的致命剑伤幸存——以及基督徒自然的推测：他在图密善身上转世。

[Excellent: I now find that this is the conclusion of Dr. T. W. Crafer in his recent work on the Apocalypse.]
［精彩：我现在发现这正是 T. W. 克拉弗博士在其最近关于《启示录》的著作中得出的结论。］

Forty-two is the number of years (54–96 AD) between the accession of Nero the seventh Caesar and the death, by the sword, of Domitian the twelfth and last Caesar. In this sort of prophetic writing years are usually expressed as months, and months as days. The sentence ‘and power was given unto him to continue forty-and-two months’ seems to be an interpolated gloss on the original prophecy that Domitian, who blasphemously called himself Lord and God, would come to a violent end. The Church had a comparatively peaceful time under Domitian’s successor, Nerva. That some MSS. read 616, not 666, does not spoil my argument; it merely cuts out the L for legatos. DCXVI means that, in St. Paul’s words, the Beast ‘crucified the Son of God afresh’.
四十二是从第七位恺撒尼禄即位到第十二位也是最后一位恺撒图密善被剑刺死的年数（公元54-96年）。在这种预言性写作中，年通常以月表示，月以日表示。「又赐给他权柄可以持续四十二个月」这句话似乎是对原初预言——亵渎地自称主和神的图密善将死于非命——的一个插入注释。教会在图密善的继任者涅尔瓦统治下度过了相对和平的时期。某些抄本读作616而非666并不破坏我的论证；它只是去掉了代表 legatos（使者）的 L。DCXVI 意味着，用圣保罗的话说，兽「重新把上帝的儿子钉在十字架上」。

The result of the test satisfied me, and I hope will satisfy others, that I had not slid into certifiable paranoia.
测试的结果令我满意——我希望也令他人满意——证明我并未滑入可认证的偏执狂。

I should add, however, that since the eleventh chapter of the Apocalypse predicts the preservation of the Temple, the original version of the book must have been written after the death of Nero, but before the destruction of the Temple and at a time when rumours of his reappearance in the flesh were widely current. Also that the Hebrew letters TRJVN, which add up to 666 (Tav = 400; Resh = 200; Yod = 10; Vav = 6; Nun =50), form the common cypher-disguise in Talmudic literature for Nero (trijon means ‘little beast’) and that the authors of the Talmud are most unlikely to have borrowed from the Gentile Christians. It is possible, then, that the first version of the Apocalypse was a Jewish nationalist tract, written in Aramaic before AD 70, in which 666 was a cypher meaning ‘Little Beast’, which pointed to Nero; but that it was re-written in Greek and expanded for Christian readers at the close of the first century, by which time the Pauline converts, who knew no Hebrew, were at pains to prove that Jesus had rejected the Law of Moses and transferred Jehovah’s blessing from the Jews to themselves. And that in this second version, with its many interpolations and uncritical retention of out-of-date material, the cypher 666 was given a new solution, and one that any intelligent person could understand without recourse to Hebrew: namely DCLXVI. If this is so, the legend was never Domitius Caesar etc., yet my analeptic eye was right to recognize that since the original Hebrew meaning of the cypher was TRIJON; the beastly spirit of Domitius was latent in Domitianus.
