ANNA





on the strength of the Pelasgian Goddess Anna, sister of Belus, whom the Italians called Anna Perenna or ‘Perennial Anna’. Ovid in his Fasti says that this Anna was regarded by some as the Moon-goddess Minerva, by others as Themis, or Io of Argos. He also connects her with barley cakes. Her festival fell on March 15th, which is just where Onn occurs in the Beth-Luis-Nion calendar. Anna probably means ‘queen’, or ‘Goddess-mother’; Sappho uses Ana for Anassa (queen). She appears in Irish mythology as the Danaan goddess Ana or Anan, who had two different characters. The first was the beneficent Ana, a title of the Goddess Danu, mentioned in Cormac’s Glossary as equivalent to Buan-ann (glossed as ‘Good Mother’). She was the mother of the original three Danaan gods Brian, Iuchurba and Iuchar, and she suckled and nursed them so well that her name ‘Ana’ came to signify ‘plenty’; she was worshipped in Munster as a Goddess of Plenty. Two mountains in Kerry, ‘the Paps of Anu’, are named after her. She has also been identified by E. M. Hull with Aine of Knockaine, a Munster Moon-goddess who had charge of crops and cattle and is connected in legend with the meadow-sweet to which she gave its scent, and with the midsummer fire-festival. The maleficent Ana was the leading person of the Fate Trinity, Ana, Badb and Macha, together known as the Morrigan, or Great Queen. Badb, ‘boiling’, evidently refers to the Cauldron, and Macha is glossed in the Book of Lecan as meaning ‘raven’.
基于佩拉斯吉女神安娜——贝卢斯之妹——的名字，意大利人称之为安娜·佩伦娜（Anna Perenna）即「永恒安娜」。奥维德在《岁时记》中说，这位安娜被一些人视为月女神密涅瓦，另一些人视为忒弥斯，或阿尔戈斯的伊俄。他还将她与大麦饼联系起来。她的节日落在3月15日，恰好是 Onn 在贝斯-路易斯-尼恩历法中出现的位置。安娜可能意为「女王」或「女神之母」；萨福用 Ana 代替 Anassa（女王）。她出现在爱尔兰神话中为达南女神安娜或阿南，她有两个不同的面向。第一个是慈善的安娜，是女神达努的称号，在科马克的词汇表中被提及并等同于布安-安（Buan-ann，注释为「好母亲」）。她是原始三达南神布瑞安、伊乌尔古巴和伊乌哈尔之母，她哺乳和抚养他们如此之好，以至于她的名字「安娜」变成了「丰盛」之意；她在芒斯特作为丰盛女神受崇拜。凯里郡的两座山——「阿努的乳房」——以她命名。E. M. 赫尔还将她等同于诺克艾恩的艾恩——一位芒斯特月女神，掌管作物和牛群，在传说中与绣线菊有关——她赋予了绣线菊香气——并与仲夏火节有关。恶面的安娜是命运三联体的主要人物——安娜、巴德和马查——合称莫里根（Morrigan），即大女王。巴德（Badb，「沸腾」）显然指的是大锅，马查在《莱坎书》中被注释为意为「渡鸦」。

Ana occurs in British folklore as Black Annis of Leicester who had a bower in the Dane (Danaan?) Hills and used to devour children, whose skins she hung on an oak to dry. She was known as ‘Cat Anna’ but, according to E. M. Hull, Annis is a shortened form of Angness or Agnes, which would identify her with Yngona, ‘Anna of the Angles’, a well-known Danish goddess. Black Annis was concerned with a May-Eve hare-hunt, later transferred to Easter Monday, and must therefore have been nymph as well as hag. Yngona, certainly, was both Nanna (sharing her favours between Balder and his dark rival Holder) and Angurboda, the Hag of the Iron Wood, mother of Hel. But the chances are that the Hag had been in residence near Leicester long before the Danes occupied her part of Mercia, and that she was the Danaan Goddess Anu before she was Agnes. In Christian times she became a nun and there is a picture of her wearing nun’s habit in the vestry of the Swithland Church. She is the Blue Hag celebrated in Milton’s Paradise Lost and Comus as sucking children’s blood by night disguised as a scritch-owl. The Irish Hag of Beare also became a nun; it was easy to Christianize a Death-goddess because her face was already veiled. In Chapter Three I mentioned that Beli was reckoned as the son of Danu; and the identity of Ana and Danu is made quite clearly in a pedigree in Jesus College Manuscript 20, supposed to be of the thirteenth century, where Beli the Great is a son of Anna, absurdly said to be a daughter of the Emperor of Rome. Elsewhere, the pedigree of Prince Owen, son of Howel the Good, is traced back to Aballac filius Amalechi qui fuit Beli Magni filius, et Anna mater ejus.1 It is added, as absurdly, quam dicunt esse consobrinam Mariae Virginis, Matris Domini nostri Jhesu Christi.
安娜出现在英国民间传说中为莱斯特的黑安娜，她在戴恩（Dane，达南？）丘陵有一个窝棚，常吞食儿童，将他们的皮挂在橡树上晾干。她被称为「猫安娜」，但据 E. M. 赫尔说，安娜（Annis）是安格尼斯或阿格尼丝的缩写形式，这将她等同于英戈纳（Yngona，「盎格鲁人的安娜」）——一位著名的丹麦女神。黑安娜与五朔节前夕的猎兔活动有关，后来转移到复活节星期一，因此她必定既是少女又是老妪。英戈纳确实是南娜（在巴尔德尔和他的黑暗对手霍尔德之间分配恩泽）和安古尔波达——铁森林的老妪，赫尔的母亲。但很可能这位老妪在丹麦人占据她那部分麦西亚之前很久就已住在莱斯特附近了，她在成为阿格尼丝之前是达南女神阿努。在基督教时代她成了一个修女，在斯威斯兰教堂的法衣室里有一幅她穿修女服的画像。她就是弥尔顿在《失乐园》和《科马斯》中歌颂的蓝老妪——夜间伪装为尖啸鸮吸食儿童血液。贝拉的老妪也成了修女；将一位死亡女神基督教化很容易，因为她的脸已经蒙上了面纱。在第三章中我提到贝利被认为是达努之子；安娜与达努的同一性在耶稣学院手稿第20号——据称是十三世纪的——的一份谱系中表达得非常清楚，其中大贝利是安娜之子，而安娜被荒谬地说成是罗马皇帝之女。在另一处，好王豪厄尔之子欧文王子的谱系被追溯到阿巴拉奇·菲柳斯·阿马莱奇，后者是贝利·马格努斯之子，安娜为其母。¹文中还荒谬地补充道，他们称她为童贞玛利亚——我主耶稣基督之母——的表妹。

Ovid and Virgil knew their Goddess Anna Perenna to have been a sister of Belus, or Bel, who was a masculinization of the Sumerian Goddess Belili; so also the god Anu, of the Babylonian male trinity completed by Ea and Bel, was a masculinization of the Sumerian Goddess Anna-Nin, usually abbreviated to Nana.1 Bel’s wife was Belit, and Anu’s wife was Anatu. Ea’s wife, the third member of the Sumerian female trinity, was Dam-Kina; the first syllable of whose name shows her to have mothered the Danaans. Anna-Nin has further been identified by J. Przbuski in the Revue de l’Histoire des Religions (1933) with Ana-hita the Goddess of the Avesta, whom the Greeks called Anaitis and the Persians Ana-hid – the name that they gave to the planet Venus.
奥维德和维吉尔知道他们的女神安娜·佩伦娜曾是贝卢斯或贝尔之妹——贝尔是苏美尔女神贝利利的男性化；同样，巴比伦男性三联体（由埃阿和贝尔完成）中的神阿努是苏美尔女神安娜-宁（Anna-Nin，通常缩写为娜娜）的男性化。¹贝尔之妻是贝利特，阿努之妻是阿纳图。埃阿之妻——苏美尔女性三联体的第三位成员——是达姆-基纳；她名字的第一个音节表明她是达南人之母。安娜-宁还被 J. 普热布斯基在《宗教史评论》（1933）中认定为阿维斯塔的女神安娜希塔——希腊人称之为阿纳伊蒂斯，波斯人称之为安娜-希德——这是他们赋予金星的名字。

Mr. E. M. Parr writes to me that An is Sumerian for ‘Heaven’ and that in his view the Goddess Athene was another Anna, namely Ath-enna, an inversion of Anatha, alias Neith of Libya; also that Ma is a shortening of the Sumerian Ama, ‘mother’, and that Ma-ri means ‘the fruitful mother’ from rim, ‘to bear a child’. Mari was the name of the goddess on whose account the Egyptians of 1000 BC called Cyprus ‘Ay-mari’, and who ruled at Mari on the Euphrates (a city sacked by Hammurabi in 1800 BC) and at Amari in Minoan Crete. So Ma-ri-enna is ‘the fruitful mother of Heaven’, alias Miriam, Marian of Mariandyne, the ‘leaping Myrrhine’ of Troy, and Mariamne: a word of triple power. But the basic word is Anna, which confers divinity on mere parturition and which also seems to form part of Arianrhod’s name. Arianrhod in fact may not be a debasement of Argentum and rota ‘silver, wheel’ but Ar-ri-an, ‘High fruitful mother’ who turns the wheel of heaven; if so, Arianrhod’s Cretan counterpart Ariadne would be Ar-ri-an-de, the de meaning barley, as in Demeter. The simple form Ana, or Anah, occurs as a Horite clan name in Genesis, XXXVI; though masculinized in two out of the three mentions of her, she is principally celebrated as the mother of Aholibamah (‘tabernacle of the high place’), the heiress whom Esau married on his arrival in the Seir pastures. (Ana’s alleged discovery of mules in the wilderness is due to a scribal error.) James Joyce playfully celebrates Anna’s universality in his Anna Livia Plurabelle. And indeed if one needs a single, simple, inclusive name for the Great Goddess, Anna is the best choice. To Christian mystics she is ‘God’s Grandmother’.
E. M. 帕尔先生写信告诉我，An 在苏美尔语中意为「天」，在他看来女神雅典娜是另一位安娜，即 Ath-enna，是阿纳塔（即利比亚的奈斯）的倒置；他还说 Ma 是苏美尔语 Ama（「母亲」）的缩写，Ma-ri 意为「多子的母亲」，源自 rim（「生子」）。玛丽是公元前1000年埃及人因她而称塞浦路斯为「Ay-mari」的女神之名，她统治着幼发拉底河上的马里城（公元前1800年被汉谟拉比洗劫）和弥诺斯克里特的阿马里。因此 Ma-ri-enna 是「天之多子母亲」，又名米利暗、马里安迪内的玛丽安、特洛伊的「跳跃的米里涅」和玛丽安姆：一个三重力量的词。但基本词是安娜，它赋予单纯的生育以神性，似乎也构成了埃里安罗德之名的一部分。事实上，埃里安罗德可能不是 Argentum 和 rota（「银·轮」）的退化形式，而是 Ar-ri-an（「高大的多子母亲」），她转动天轮；如果如此，埃里安罗德的克里特对应者阿里阿德涅将是 Ar-ri-an-de，其中 de 意为大麦，如同在得墨忒耳中一样。简单的形式 Ana 或 Anah 作为何利特氏族名出现在《创世记》XXXVI 中；虽然在三次提及中有两次被男性化，但她主要被赞颂为阿霍利巴玛（Aholibamah，「高处之帐幕」）之母——以扫到达西珥牧场时娶的继承人。（安娜据称在旷野中发现骡子一事是由于抄写错误。）詹姆斯·乔伊斯在《安娜·利维娅·普卢拉贝尔》中戏谑地赞颂了安娜的普遍性。确实，如果需要一个单一、简单、包容的大女神之名，安娜是最佳选择。对基督教神秘主义者来说，她是「上帝的祖母」。

The next letter, Fearn, explains Perenna as a corruption of Fearina, the adjective formed from Fear or eär, Spring. In Latin the word has kept its Digamma and is written ver. From this it follows that Bran’s Greek name Phoroneus – of which we have already noted the variant forms Vron, Berng and Ephron – was a variation of Fearineus and that he was originally the Spirit of the Year in his lusty, though foredoomed, Spring aspect. The Latin form seems to have been Veranus; which would account for the plebeian family name Veranius; and for the verb vernare, ‘to renew oneself in Spring’, which is supposed to be irregularly formed from ver, veris, but may be an abbreviation of veranare.
下一个字母 Fearn 将 Perenna 解释为 Fearina 的讹变——由 Fear 或 eär（春天）构成的形容词。在拉丁语中该词保留了其 Digamma，写作 ver。由此可得，布兰的希腊名福罗纽斯——我们已经注意到其变体 Vron、Berng 和 Ephron——是 Fearineus 的变体，他最初是年之灵在其壮健但注定灭亡的春季面向。拉丁形式似乎是 Veranus；这解释了平民姓氏 Veranius；以及动词 vernare（「在春天自我更新」）——它被假定不规则地派生自 ver, veris，但可能是 veranare 的缩写。





ANNA FEARINA




‘Queen of the Spring’
「春季之女王」





The next letter is Saille. We have seen that Saille is connected in the Boibel-Loth with Salmoneus, Salmaah and Salmon, and this suggests that the corresponding word in the charm is Salmone, another title of the Goddess. So:
下一个字母是 Saille。我们已经看到 Saille 在博伊贝尔-洛斯中与萨尔摩纽斯、Salmaah 和 Salmon 有关，这表明咒语中对应的词是 Salmone——女神的另一个称号。因此：





There were several places named after her in the Eastern Mediterranean including Cape Salmone in Crete, the city of Salmone in Elis, and Salmone, a village near Lusi. The title is apparently compounded of Salma and Onë as in Hesi-onë. Hesionë is said to mean ‘Lady of Asia’, and the meaning of Salma can be deduced from its occurrence in geographical names. It is an Aegean word of extraordinarily wide distribution and seems always to be connected with the notion of easterliness.1 Salma was a tribe in Southern Judaea living east of the Minoan colony of Gaza; also a station in Central Arabia on the caravan route from the Mediterranean to the Persian Gulf. Salmalassus was a station in Lesser Armenia on the caravan route from Trebizond to the Far East; Salmydessus was the most easterly city of Thrace, fronting the Black Sea; Salmone was the most easterly cape of Crete; Salamis the most easterly city of Cyprus; the island of Salamis lay east of the Cretan city of Corinth, and the mountain sacred to Salamanes (in Assyrian Salmanu) lay east of the great river-plain behind Antioch. As has already been pointed out Salma became a divine name in Palestine and Solomon, Salmon and Absalom are all variants of it. Salma was the deity to whom the hill of Jerusalem was originally sacred; the place is mentioned in the Egyptian Tell Amarna letters (1370 BC) as Uru-Salim, and in Assyrian monuments as Ur-Salimu. In 1400 BC it was held by a chieftain with the Semite name of Abd-Khiba, a vassal of Egypt, who like Melchizedek of Salem – Uru-Salim? – claimed to rule neither by father-right nor mother-right, but by the will of the God. Professor Sayce translates Uru-Salim as ‘City of the God Salim’. Josephus records that the first name of the city was Solyma. Salma, or Salim, was evidently the Semite god of the rising or renewed sun; Salmaone was the Aegean goddess from whom he took his titles, as did Salmoneus the Aeolian who opposed the later Achaean invaders and insisted on inducing thunder by rattling a brazen chariot – thereby infringing the prerogative of Olympian Zeus. But it is probable that Salma took his title as the demi-god of the renewed Sun from his Moon-bride Circe, or Belili, the Willow Mother, Sal-Ma, in whose honour willow-branches were waved at this season, and that the meaning of easterliness is a secondary one.
东地中海有多个以她命名的地方，包括克里特的萨尔摩涅角、伊利斯萨尔摩涅城和卢西附近的一个叫萨尔摩涅的村庄。这个称号显然由 Salma 和 Onë 组合而成，如 Hesi-onë。赫西俄涅据说意为「亚细亚之女」，而 Salma 的含义可以从其在地名中的出现来推断。它是一个分布极其广泛的爱琴语词，似乎总是与东方性的概念有关。¹ Salma 是南犹大一个住在加沙的弥诺斯殖民地以东的部落；也是阿拉伯中部从地中海到波斯湾的商路上的一个驿站。Salmalassus 是小亚美尼亚从特拉比松到远东商路上的一个驿站；Salmydessus 是色雷斯最东端的城市，面向黑海；Salmone 是克里特最东端的海角；Salamis 是塞浦路斯最东端的城市；萨拉丁岛位于克里特城科林斯以东；而萨拉玛内斯（亚述语 Salmanu）的神圣之山位于安条克背后大河平原以东。如前所述，Salma 在巴勒斯坦成为一个神圣名字，所罗门、Salmon 和押沙龙都是其变体。Salma 是耶路撒冷山丘最初所献之神；该地在埃及阿马尔奈书信（公元前1370年）中被称为 Uru-Salim，在亚述纪念碑中为 Ur-Salimu。公元前1400年它由一位有闪族名的酋长阿卜杜-基巴——埃及的藩属——持有，他像撒冷的麦基洗德——Uru-Salim？——一样声称既非凭父权也非凭母权统治，而是凭神的意志。赛斯教授将 Uru-Salim 译为「神 Salim 之城」。约瑟夫斯记载该城最初的名字是 Solyma。Salma 或 Salim 显然是闪族的初升或更新太阳之神；Salmaone 是他从中取号的爱琴女神——如同埃俄利亚人萨尔摩纽斯，他反对后来的亚该亚入侵者并坚持用摇动铜战车来引雷——从而侵犯了奥林匹克宙斯的特权。但 Salma 很可能从他的月亮新娘喀耳刻或贝利利——柳树之母 Sal-Ma——那里取了更新太阳的半神之号，人们在此季节向她挥舞柳枝，而东方性是其引申义。





ANNA FEARINA SALMAONA




‘Queen of Spring, Mother of the Willow’
「春季之女王，柳树之母」





Straif is the next letter. A main verb is called for, to begin the second flight of letters. Strebloein, or strabloein, formed from the verbal root streph, ‘to twist’, means ‘to reeve with a windlass, to wrench, dislocate, put on the rack’, and gives Straif, the blackthorn, its necessarily cruel connotation.
Straif 是下一个字母。需要一个主动词来开始第二组字母。Strebloein 或 strabloein，由动词词根 streph（「扭转」）构成，意为「用绞盘拉、扭、脱位、上刑架」，赋予 Straif（黑刺李）以必然的残酷含义。

Next comes Huath. The u merely shows that the H is aspirated. We have no clue to the name of the person, or persons, whom the Goddess racks, presumably on Duir, the oak, but my guess is the Athaneatids, or Hathaneatids, members of one of the four original royal clans of Arcadia. It is likely that this word, like athanatoi, means ‘the not-mortal ones’, the Greek word thnētos (‘mortal’) being a shortened form of thaneãtos. The clan from which the sacred king, the victim of the story that is unfolding, was chosen would naturally be called ‘The Immortals’, because the king alone could win immortality by his sufferings, the lesser members of the nation being doomed to become twittering ghosts in Hell.
接下来是 Huath。u 仅表示 H 是送气的。我们没有线索知道被女神上刑架的人或人们是谁——大概是在 Duir（橡树）上——但我猜是 Athaneatids 或 Hathaneatids，阿卡迪亚四个原始王族之一的成员。这个词很可能像 athanatoi 一样意为「不死者」，希腊词 thnētos（「必死」）是 thanatos 的缩写形式。神圣国王——正在展开的故事中的牺牲品——所出的氏族自然被称为「不朽者」，因为只有国王能通过受苦赢得不朽，国家中较卑微的成员注定成为冥府中啁啾的幽灵。

STRABLOE [H]ATHANEATIDAS URA





For Ura is the next letter of the alphabet, the midsummer letter, the letter of Venus Urania, the most violent aspect of the Triple Goddess. As has already been pointed out, Ura means Summer; it also means the tail of a lion or bear, expressive of its fury, and the word ouraios (‘uraeus’), the royal serpent of Egypt, is formed from the same root. ‘Uranus’, the father of the Titans according to Greek Classical mythology, is likely to have originally been their Mother – Ura-ana, Queen Ura. But we should not look for only one or even two meanings of the syllable ur, the more numerous the poetic meanings that could be concentrated in a sacred name, the greater was its power. The authors of the Irish Hearings of the Scholars connected the midsummer-letter Ur with ur, ‘earth’; and we are reminded that this is the root found in the Latin words area, ‘a plot of earth’, arvum, ‘a ploughed field’, and urvare, which means ‘to drive a plough ceremonially around the proposed site of a city’ – a sense also found in the Homeric Greek ouron, ‘a boundary marked by the plough’. Grammarians assume a primitive Greek word ēra, ‘earth’ connected with this group of words; which suggests that Erana, or Arana, or Urana, was the Earth-goddess whose favour had to be asked when fields were ploughed or cities (urves or urbes) founded, and marriage with whose local representative gave a chieftain the right to rule in her lands. If this is so, the uraeus in the royal head-dress stood both for the great sea-serpent that girdled the Earth and for the Goddess’s spotted oracular snakes. But her name could also carry three or four further meanings. It might stand for ‘Mountain-goddess’ (from the Homeric Greek ouros, a mountain) which would point her identity with Mousa, the Muse, a title of the same meaning; and for ‘Queen of the Winds’ (from the Homeric Greek ouros, a wind) which would explain the uraeus as symbolizing her power over the winds, all winds being snake-tailed and housed in a mountain-cave. Urana then is a multiple title: Mother Earth, Our Lady of Summer, Mountain Goddess, Queen of the Winds, Goddess of the Lion’s Tail. It might equally mean ‘Guardian Queen’ (ouros, ‘a guardian’); or, with reference to her aspect as a Moon-cow, ‘Ruler of Wild Oxen’ (ourus, Latin urus, ‘a wild ox’), like the Irish Goddess Buana. And we must not overlook the Sanscrit word varunas, meaning ‘the night firmament’, from the root var, ‘to cover’, from which Varuna, the third member of the Aryan Trinity, took his name. When the first wave of Achaeans entered Greece and were forced under the sovereignty of the Triple-goddess Ana, or De-Ana, or Ath-Ana, or Di-Ana, or Ur-Ana, who ruled the world of day as well as the world of night, varunas lost its specialized sense, was changed from varun-to uran-, in her honour, and came to mean the sky in general. Hence Ana’s classical title Urania, ‘The Heavenly One’.
因为 Ura 是字母表的下一个字母，仲夏之母，维纳斯·乌拉尼亚的字母，三联女神最猛烈的面向。如前所述，Ura 意为夏天；也意为狮子或熊的尾巴——表达其暴怒——而 ouraios（「uraeus」，埃及王室蛇）一词由同一词根构成。「乌拉诺斯」——据希腊古典神话为提坦之父——很可能最初是他们的母亲——Ura-ana，乌拉女王。但我们不应只寻找一个甚至两个 ur 音节的含义，能集中在神圣名字中的诗义越多，其力量越大。《学者听证》的爱尔兰作者们将仲夏字母 Ur 与 ur（「大地」）联系起来；我们想起这是拉丁词 area（「一块地」）、arvum（「犁过的田」）和 urvare（意为「仪式性地用犁围绕拟建城市基址犁一圈」——此义也见于荷马希腊语 ouron（「以犁标记的边界」））中的词根。语法学家假设一个原始希腊词 ēra（「大地」）与这组词有关；这表明 Erana 或 Arana 或 Urana 是耕地或建城（urves 或 urbes）时必须祈求其恩惠的大地女神，与她的地方代表结婚赋予了酋长在她土地上统治的权利。如果确实如此，王室头饰中的 uraeus 既代表环绕大地的大海蛇，也代表女神的有斑点的神谕蛇。但她的名字还可以承载三四个进一步的含义。它可以意为「山女神」（源自荷马希腊语 ouros，山），这指向她与 Mousa（缪斯，同义的称号）的同一性；以及「风之女王」（源自荷马希腊语 ouros，风），这解释了 uraeus 象征她对风的力量——所有风都是蛇尾的且住在山洞中。因此 Urana 是一个多重称号：大地母亲、夏季之女、山女神、风之女王、狮尾女神。它同样可以意为「守护女王」（ouros，「守护者」）；或者，就她作为月母牛的面向而言，「野牛之统治者」（ourus，拉丁 urus，「野牛」），如同爱尔兰女神布阿纳。我们也不能忽略梵语词 varunas，意为「夜空」，源自词根 var（「覆盖」），雅利安三联体的第三位成员伐楼拿由此得名。当第一波亚该亚人进入希腊并被迫处于三联女神安娜、或 De-Ana、或 Ath-Ana、或 Di-Ana、或 Ur-Ana——她统治白昼世界也统治黑夜世界——的主权之下时，varunas 失去了其专门含义，被从 varun- 变为 uran- 以向她致敬，并开始泛指天空。因此安娜的古典称号是 Urania，「天之女」。





STRABLOE ATHANEATIDAS URA DRUEI




‘Ura, reeve the Immortal ones to your oak tree’
「乌拉，将不朽者们绞在你的橡树上」





The next word Tinne, or Tann, can be expanded to Tanaous ‘stretched’, in memory of Hesiod’s derivation of the word Titan from titainein, ‘to stretch’. He says that the Titans were so called because they stretched out their hands: but this explanation is perhaps intended to disguise the truth, that the Titans were men stretched, or racked, on the wheel, like Ixion. Frazer noted that the holly-oak, which is the tree of Tinne, grows nobly at Lusi, and that the valley of the Styx is full of the white poplar, Eadha, the tree sacred to Hercules.
下一个词 Tinne 或 Tann 可以扩展为 Tanaous（「拉伸的」），以纪念赫西俄德将 Titan 一词派生自 titainein（「拉伸」）。他说提坦之所以如此称呼是因为他们伸出手：但这个解释也许是用来掩盖真相——提坦是被拉伸在轮上受刑的人，如伊克西翁。弗雷泽注意到作为 Tinne 之树的圣栎在卢西生长茂盛，而斯堤克斯河谷中长满了白杨——Eadha，赫拉克勒斯的神圣之树。

Circe, ‘daughter of Hecate’ was the Goddess of Aeaea (‘wailing’), a sepulchral island in the Northern Adriatic. In this table an even closer approximation to poetic truth is discovered than in the Irish bardic system of letter-numerals, given at the end of Chapter Sixteen, which is based on a different alphabetic order and denies any value either to H or U. Here, the dominant pentad of vowels hold the first and last places, as one would expect, also the fifth, the tenth (respectively ‘the grove of the senses’ and ‘perfection’ in the Pythagorean system), and the ecstatic fifteenth, the full-moon climax of the Song of Ascents at Jerusalem. The second, fourth, sixth and eighth places – even numbers are male in the Pythagorean system, odd are female – are held by B (inception), N (flood), F (fire), Z (angry passion), a sequence suggesting a rising tide of male lust which, after being checked by H, nine, the letter of pre-marital chastity enforced by the Nine-fold Goddess, finds its consummation at U, 10, where male and female principles unite. The intermediate letters are L, 3, the letter of torch-lit regeneration presided over by three-torched Hecate; 0, 5, the letter of initiation into the mysteries of love; S, 7, the letter of female enchantment (‘Athene’ in the Pythagorean system). The eleventh and twelfth places are held respectively by D and T, the twin leaders of the company of twelve (in the Irish system the order is reversed); the thirteenth by C, the letter of the Goddess’s sacrosanct swineherd magicians; and the nineteenth by R, the Death letter, appropriate to the close of the nineteen-year cycle. The numerical values of the remaining letters work out with equal facility. Since the charm taught by the Dactyls was an orgiastic one it appropriately contained twenty elements – as it were the fingers of the woman’s hands and those of her lover’s; but Pythagoras was content to speculate on the tetractys of his own ten fingers alone.

To sum up. This twenty-word Greek charm provided the letter-names of an alphabet which was used in late Minoan Arcadia until the second Achaean invasion, by descendants of the original invaders who had gone over to the worship of the White Goddess. Their cult involved the use of an artificial thirteen-month solar calendar, each month represented by a different tree, which had been invented independently of the alphabet and was in widespread use. Some of its seasonable elements can be shown to date from pre-dynastic times, and though the trees in the Irish version, the only one that survives complete, suggest a Pontine or Paphlagonian origin the calendar may have originated in the Aegean or Phoenicia or Libya with a somewhat different canon of trees. Nor is it likely that the alphabet arrived in Britain at the same time as the calendar. The calendar may have been introduced in the late third millennium BC by the New Stone Age people, who were in close touch with Aegean civilization, along with agriculture, apiculture, the maze-dance and other cultural benefits. The alphabet seems to have been introduced late in the second millennium BC by refugees from Greece.

When and where the Zodiac originated is not known, but it is believed to have gradually evolved in Babylonia from the twelve incidents in the life-story of the hero Gilgamesh – his killing of the Bull, his love-passage with the Virgin, his adventures with two Scorpion-men (the Scales later took the place of one of these) and the Deluge story (corresponding with the Water Carrier). Calendar tablets of the seventh century BC bear this out, but the Epic of Gilgamesh is not a really ancient one; Gilgamesh is thought to have been a Hyksos (Kassite) invader of Babylonia in the eighteenth century BC to whom the story of an earlier hero was transferred, a Tammuz of the familiar sort already connected with the Zodiac.

The original Zodiac, to judge from the out-of-date astronomical data quoted in a poem by Aratus, a Hellenistic Greek, was current in the late third millennium BC. But it is likely to have been first fixed at a time when the Sun rose in the Twins at the Spring equinox – the Shepherds’ festival; in the Virgin who was generally identified with Ishtar, the Love-goddess, at the Summer solstice; in the Archer, identified with Nergal (Mars) and later with Cheiron the Centaur, at the Autumn equinox, the traditional season of the chase; in the resurrective Fish at the Winter solstice, the time of most rain. At the same time the tail of the Lion entered the Virgin’s place at the Summer solstice – hence apparently the Goddess’s subsequent title of ‘Oura’, the Lion’s Tail – and gradually the Lion’s body followed, after which for a time she became leonine with a Virgin’s head only. Similarly the Water-carrier succeeded the Fish at the Winter solstice – and provided the water to float the Spirit of the Year’s cradle ark.
与此同时狮子的尾巴进入了处女座在夏至的位置——因此女神后来显然获得了「乌拉」（Oura，狮尾）的称号——逐渐狮子的身体也跟了进来，之后一段时间她变成了狮身处女首的形象。类似地，水瓶座在冬至取代了鱼——并提供了水来漂浮年之灵的摇篮方舟。

About 1800 BC the Bull was itself pushed out of the Spring House by the Ram. This may account for the refurbishing of the Zodiac myth in honour of Gilgamesh, a shepherd king of this period; he was the Ram who destroyed the Bull. The Crab similarly succeeded the Lion at the Summer solstice; so the Love-goddess became a marine deity with temples by the sea-shore. The He-goat also succeeded the Water-carrier at the Winter solstice; so the Spirit of the New Year was born of a She-goat. The Egyptian Greeks then called the Ram the ‘Golden Fleece’ and recast the Zodiac story as the voyage of the Argonauts.
大约公元前1800年公牛本身被白羊挤出春分之宫。这可能解释了为吉尔伽美什——这一时期的牧羊人国王——翻新黄道神话的做法；他是毁灭公牛的公羊。巨蟹类似地在夏至取代了狮子；于是爱神变成了海滨设庙的海洋神祇。山羊也在冬至取代了水瓶座；于是新年之灵由母山羊所生。埃及的希腊人随后称白羊为「金羊毛」，并将黄道故事重铸为阿尔戈英雄的远航。

The disadvantage of the Zodiac is, indeed, its failure to be a perpetual calendar like the Beth-Luis-Nion tree-sequence which makes no attempt to relate the equinoxes and the solstices to the twelve constellations of the Zodiac. Perhaps the original Zodiac myth was based on the Roebuck story which is associated with a tree-sequence in the Song of Amergin; a supposed scientific improvement on it because a thirteen-month year with the equinox and solstice stations falling at irregular intervals is less easy to handle than a twelve-month year with exactly three months between each of the four stations. At any rate, the archetype of Gilgamesh the Zodiac hero was ‘Tammuz’, a tree-cult hero of many changes; and the thirteen-month tree-calendar seems more primitive than the twelve-month one.1 Certainly the story is more coherent than those of Gilgamesh or Jason, pure myth uncombined with history.
黄道带的缺点确实在于它未能像贝斯-路易斯-尼恩树序那样成为永恒历法——后者不试图将分至点与黄道十二星座联系起来。也许原始的黄道神话基于与阿默金之歌中树序相关的狍鹿故事；它是所谓科学改进——因为分至站点间隔不规则的十三月年不如四站点间恰好各三个月的十二月年易于操作。无论如何，黄道英雄吉尔伽美什的原型是「塔穆兹」——一个多变之身的树崇拜英雄；而十三月树历似乎比十二月历更原始。¹当然，这个故事比吉尔伽美什或伊阿宋的故事更连贯，是纯粹未被历史掺杂的神话。





It so happens that the tree-alphabet, with the Twins combined in a single sign, does coincide with the Zodiac as it stands at present, with the Fishes in the House of the Spring Equinox. (See the figure above.) But we have not yet answered the question: why are the Fates credited by Hyginus with the invention of the letters F and H?
巧合的是，树字母表——将双子座合为单一符号——确实与目前的黄道带相吻合，此时双鱼位于春分之宫。（见上图。）但我们尚未回答这个问题：为什么希吉努斯认为命运女神发明了字母 F 和 H？

Hyginus’s attribution to Palamedes of the invention of the disc is a helpful clue, if Professor O. Richter is right in suggesting that the late Cyprian female figurines which hold discs of the same proportionate size as the Phaestos disc (seven inches in diameter) anticipate Athene and her aegis. We know from the legend of the infant Erichthonius that the aegis was a goat-skin bag, converted into a shield by a circular stiffening. Was it a bag-cover for a sacred disc, like the crane-bag which contained the Pelasgian letters of Palamedes’s Pelasgian alphabet, and with the warning Gorgon-mask similarly placed at the mouth? If so, it seems probable that the concealed disc was engraved spirally with her own Holy and Ineffable Name as the Libyao-Pelasgian Goddess of Wisdom; and if this Name was spelt in letters, not hieroglyphs, it may have been either the five-letter IEUOA, or the seven-letter JIEUOAŌ, formed by doubling the first and last letters of IEUOA. Or, since she was the triple Moon-goddess, namely the Three Fates who invented the five vowels, together with F and H, it may have been a nine-letter form JIEHUOV(F)AŌ, composed to contain not only the seven-letter Name but also the two consonants, representing the first and last days of her week, which revealed her as Wisdom, hewer-out of the Seven Pillars. If it was JIEHUOVAŌ, Simonides (or more likely his predecessor Pythagoras) showed little inventiveness in stabilizing the eight-letter form JEHUOVAŌ in honour of the Immortal Sun-god Apollo, by the omission of I, the death-vowel, while retaining Y, the semi-vowel of generation.
希吉努斯将圆盘的发明归功于帕拉墨得斯是一条有用的线索，如果 O. 里希特教授关于晚期塞浦路斯女性小雕像持有与费斯托斯圆盘同比例（直径七英寸）的圆盘的看法是正确的——这些雕像预示了雅典娜和她的羊皮盾。我们从幼年厄里克托尼俄斯的传说中得知，羊皮盾（aegis）是一个山羊皮袋，通过圆形加固变成了一面盾牌。它是否像帕拉墨得斯的佩拉斯吉字母所装的鹤袋一样，是一个神圣圆盘的袋套，警告用的戈耳工面具同样置于袋口？如果是这样，被隐藏的圆盘很可能以螺旋形刻有她作为利比亚-佩拉斯吉智慧女神的自身神圣不可言说之名；如果这个名以字母而非象形文字拼写，可能是五字母的 IEUOA，或七字母的 JIEUOAŌ——通过加倍 IEUOA 的首尾字母形成。或者，既然她是三重月女神，即发明了五个元音加上 F 和 H 的三位命运女神，它可能是九字母形式 JIEHUOV(F)AŌ——组合了七字母之名和两个辅音，代表她星期的首尾日，揭示她为智慧、七柱之凿刻者。如果是 JIEHUOVAŌ，西摩尼德斯（或更可能是他的前辈毕达哥拉斯）在固定八字母形式 JEHUOVAŌ 以纪念不朽太阳神阿波罗时显得没什么独创性——他只是省略了死亡元音 I，同时保留了生殖半元音 Y。

1 Pausanias had evidently come at the wrong time of year for in the mayfly season trout do utter a sort of dry squeak, when they throw themselves ecstatically out of the water and feel the air on their gills. The Irish legend of ‘singing trout’ apparently refers to an erotic Spring dance, in the White Goddess’s honour, of fish nymphs who mimicked the leaping, squeaking trout: for the Irish princess Dechtire conceived her son Cuchulain, a reincarnation of the God Lugh, as the result of swallowing a mayfly, and he was able to swim like a trout as soon as born. Cuchulain’s Greek counterpart was Euphemus (‘well-spoken’) the famous swimmer, son of the Moon-Goddess Europë, who was born by the Cephissus river in Phocis but had a hero-shrine at Taenarus, the main Peloponnesian entrance to the Underworld. Euphemus’s way of swimming was to leap out of the water like a fish and skim from wave to wave; and in Classical times Poseidon, God of Fishes, claimed to be his father.
¹ 保萨尼亚斯显然来错了季节，因为在蜉蝣季节鳟鱼确实会发出一种干涩的尖叫——当它们狂喜地跃出水面、鳃部感受空气时。爱尔兰的「歌唱的鳟鱼」传说显然指的是鱼仙女模仿跳跃尖叫鳟鱼的白女神春季爱情之舞：因为爱尔兰公主德克蒂蕾因吞食蜉蝣而怀上了她的儿子库丘林——卢格神的转世——他一出生就能像鳟鱼一样游泳。库丘林的希腊对应者是欧斐摩斯（Euphemus，「善言者」）——著名的游泳健将，月女神欧罗巴之子，出生于福基斯的刻菲索斯河畔，但在塔伊纳隆——伯罗奔尼撒通往冥界的主要入口——有一座英雄祠。欧斐摩斯的游泳方式是像鱼一样跃出水面在浪尖滑行；在古典时代，鱼神波塞冬声称是他的父亲。



1 This is queer. If it stands for Abimelech son of Amalek the son of Baal, and of Anatha, it commemorates a tradition that the family were formerly lords of Canaanite Shechem. When the Irsraelite tribe of Ephraim settled in Shechem, a city which the Song of Deborah shows to have originally belonged to the tribe of Amalek, a treaty marriage was celebrated between the Ephraimite Chieftain Gideon, who thereupon took the name Jerubbaal (‘Let Baal strive’), and the local heiress, presumably a priestess of the Lion-Goddess Anatha. Her son succeeded to the throne by mother-right after a massacre of his rivals and took the Canaanite title of Abimelech; establishing his position with the help of his mother’s kinsmen and the god Baalberith.
¹ 这很奇怪。如果它代表亚比米勒——亚玛力之子巴力与阿纳塔之子——它纪念了这个家族曾是迦南示剑之主的传统。当以色列以法莲部落定居示剑——底波拉之歌表明该城最初属于亚玛力部落——一场联姻在以法莲酋长基甸与当地继承人之间举行，基甸因此取名耶路巴力（Jerubbaal，「让巴力争辩」），继承人大概是狮女神阿纳塔的女祭司。她的儿子在屠杀了竞争对手之后凭母权继承王位，取名迦南称号亚比米勒；在其母系亲族和神巴力比利土的帮助下巩固了地位。



1 At the beginning of Chapter Eleven I described Attis son of Nana as the Phrygian Adonis; and at the beginning of Chapter Eighteen mentioned that Nana conceived him virginally as the result of swallowing either a ripe almond or else a pomegranate seed. The mythological distinction is important. The pomegranate was sacred to Attis as Adonis-Tammuz-Dionysus-Rimmon, and at Jerusalem, as has been shown, the pomegranate cult was assimilated to that of Jehovah. But the almond was also, it seems, sacred to Attis as Nabu -Mercury-Hermes-Thoth, whose cult was also assimilated to that of Jehovah; which explains the myth recorded by Euhemerus, the Sicilian sceptic, that Hermes so far from ordaining the courses of the stars was merely instructed in astronomy by Aphrodite – that is to say by his mother Nana who gave her name to the planet Venus. Thus Nana, as mother of Jehovah in two of his characters can be claimed as the paternal, as well as the maternal, grandmother of Jehovah’s Only Begotten Son.
¹ 在第十一章开头我将阿提斯——娜娜之子——描述为弗里吉亚的阿多尼斯；在第十八章开头提到娜娜因吞食一颗熟杏仁或一粒石榴籽而童贞受孕。这一神话学区分很重要。石榴作为阿多尼斯-塔穆兹-狄俄尼索斯-里蒙的阿提斯是神圣的，而在耶路撒冷，如所示，石榴崇拜被耶和华崇拜吸收。但杏仁似乎也是作为纳布-墨丘利-赫尔墨斯-托特的阿提斯的神圣之树，其崇拜同样被耶和华崇拜吸收；这解释了西西里怀疑论者欧墨鲁斯记录的神话——赫尔墨斯非但没有安排星象运行，反而只是被阿佛洛狄忒——即他的母亲娜娜，金星以她命名——教授了天文学。因此，娜娜作为耶和华两个面向之母，可以被宣称为耶和华独生子之父系和母系的双重祖母。



1 The complementary Aegean word to Salma seems to have been Tar, meaning the west, or the dying sun. Tartessus on the Atlantic was the most westerly Aegean trading station, as Salmydessus the most easterly. Tarraco was the port on the extreme west of the Mediterranean, and Tarrha the chief port of western Crete. The reduplication tar-tar, meaning ‘the far, far west, has evidently given Tartara, the land of the dead, its name. For though Homer in the Iliad places Tartara ‘as far below earth as Heaven is above it’, Hesiod makes it the abode of Cronos and the Titans, whom we know to have gone west after their defeat by Zeus. Taranis was a Gaulish deity mentioned by Lucan as being served by even more terrible rites than was Scythian Diana, meaning the Taurian Artemis, who loved human sacrifice. Though the Romans identified Taranis with Jupiter she was at first probably a Death-Goddess, namely Tar-Anis, Annis of the West.
¹ 与 Salma 互补的爱琴语词似乎是 Tar，意为西方或落日。大西洋上的塔特苏斯是最西端的爱琴贸易站，正如萨尔米德苏斯是最东端的。塔拉科是地中海极西端的港口，塔拉是西克里特的主要港口。叠词 tar-tar 意为「远远的西方」，显然赋予了塔耳塔洛斯——死者之地——其名。因为虽然荷马在《伊利亚特》中将塔耳塔洛斯置于「地下与天上同等距离之处」，赫西俄德使其成为克罗诺斯和提坦的居所——我们知道他们在被宙斯击败后向西去了。塔拉尼斯是卢坎提到的一位高卢神祇，其仪式比斯基泰的狄安娜——即陶里卡的阿尔忒弥斯，好杀人祭——更为恐怖。虽然罗马人将塔拉尼斯等同于朱庇特，但她最初可能是死亡女神，即 Tar-Anis，西方的安娜。



1 The Anglo-Saxon grounding of English prevents the use of the Classical dactyl as the basic metrical foot. The dactylic or anapaestic poems attempted in the early and middle nineteenth century by Byron, Moore, Hood, Browning and others read over-exuberantly and even vulgarly; though school children enjoy them. What has gradually evolved as the characteristic English metre is a compromise between the iambic – borrowed from French and Italian, ultimately from the Greek – and the stress rhythm of Anglo-Saxon, based on the pull of the oar. Shakespeare’s gradual modification of the ten-foot iambic line that he took over from Wyatt and the Earl of Surrey is illuminating: The first lines of King John run:
¹ 英语的盎格鲁-撒克逊底层使得无法使用古典扬抑格作为基本格律。拜伦、穆尔、胡德、布朗宁等人在十九世纪早期和中期尝试的扬抑格或抑抑扬格诗歌读起来过于喧闹甚至俗气；虽然学童喜欢它们。逐渐演变为英语特征格律的是抑扬格——借自法语和意大利语，最终源自希腊——与盎格鲁-撒克逊的重音节奏——基于划桨的拉力——之间的折中。莎士比亚对他从怀亚特和萨里伯爵处继承的十音节抑扬格诗行的逐渐修改颇具启发性：《约翰王》的开头几行是：

KING JOHN: Now say, Chatillon, what would France with us?
KING JOHN: Now say, Chatillon, what would France with us?（约翰王：说吧，夏蒂永，法兰西要对我国怎样？）



CHATILLON: Thus, after greeting, speaks the King of France,
CHATILLON: Thus, after greeting, speaks the King of France,（夏蒂永：致敬之后，法兰西王如此说，）



In my behaviour, to the majesty,
In my behaviour, to the majesty,（以我的身份，向陛下，）



The borrowed majesty of England here….
The borrowed majesty of England here….（此处英格兰借来的陛下……）





Fifteen years later, in the Tempest, after the opening scene which is almost wholly prose Miranda addresses Prospero:
十五年后，在《暴风雨》中，在几乎完全是散文的开场之后，米兰达对普洛斯彼罗说：

If by your art, my dearest father, you have
If by your art, my dearest father, you have（若以你的法术，我最亲爱的父亲，你已）



Put the wild waters in this roar, allay them!
Put the wild waters in this roar, allay them!（使狂暴的海水如此咆哮，平息它们吧！）



The sky, it seems, would pour down stinking pitch
The sky, it seems, would pour down stinking pitch（天穹似乎要倾泻发臭的沥青）



But that the sea, mounting to the welkin’s cheek
But that the sea, mounting to the welkin's cheek（若非大海升上苍穹的面颊）



Dashes the fire out. O, I have suffered….
Dashes the fire out. O, I have suffered….（将火焰扑灭。哦，我受了苦……）





It has been suggested that Shakespeare was consciously working forward to a rhythmic prose. This seems to me a misreading of his intentions: after disruptive variations on the iambic ten-syllabled norm he always returned to it as a reminder that he was still writing verse; and could never have done otherwise. Here, for example, Miranda, after this first outburst of horror, finishes her speech with metrical sobriety.
有人认为莎士比亚有意识地走向一种节奏散文。在我看来这是对他意图的误读：在对抑扬格十音节规范进行破坏性变奏之后，他总是回归它以提醒读者他仍在写诗；他也无法不这样做。例如这里，米兰达在最初的恐惧爆发之后，以格律的克制结束了她的台词。

1 That the Osirian year originally consisted of thirteen twenty-eight day months, with one day over, is suggested by the legendary length of Osiris’s reign, namely twenty-eight years – years in mythology often stand for days, and days for years – and by the number of pieces into which he was torn by Set, namely thirteen apart from his phallus which stood for the extra day. When Isis reassembled the pieces, the phallus had disappeared, eaten by a letos-flsh. This accounts for the priestly fish-taboo in Egypt, relaxed only one day in the year.
¹ 奥西里斯年最初由十三个二十八天的月组成另加一天，这一点可由奥西里斯传说的统治年限——即二十八年——暗示——神话中的年常代表日，日代表年——以及他被塞特撕碎的块数即十三块（不含其阳具，阳具代表额外的那一天）。当伊西斯重新拼合碎块时，阳具已消失，被一条鲈鱼吞食。这解释了埃及的祭司鱼禁忌——一年仅放宽一天。





Chapter Twenty-Two

title: 第二十二章
content:
THE TRIPLE MUSE
三重缪斯





Why do poets invoke the Muse?
诗人为什么要祈请缪斯？

Milton in the opening lines of Paradise Lost briefly summarizes the Classical tradition, and states his intention, as a Christian, of transcending it:
弥尔顿在《失乐园》开篇几行中简要概述了古典传统，并表明他作为基督徒超越它的意图：

‘Sing, heav’nly Muse, that on the secret top
「唱吧，天上的缪斯，你在何烈山



Of Oreb, or of Sinai, didst inspire
或西奈山的隐秘山顶曾赐灵感



That shepherd, who first taught the chosen seed
给那牧人，他最先教导选民的种子



In the beginning horn the Heav’ns and Earth
太初天地如何



Rose out of Chaos: Or if Sion hill
从混沌中升起：或者锡安山



Delight thee more, and Siloa’s brook that flow’d
更令你喜悦，西罗亚溪流曾流过



Fast by the oracle of God: I thence
上帝神谕之旁：我从那里



Invoke thy aid to my advent’rous song
祈求你的帮助于我冒险的歌



That with no middle flight intends to soar
它不以中等的飞翔意图翱翔



Above th’Aonian mount, while it pursues
高于阿俄尼安山，当它追求



Things unattempted yet in prose or rhime.
散文或韵文中尚未尝试之物。」





The Aonian Mount is Mount Helicon in Boeotia, a mountain a few miles to the east of Parnassus, and known in Classical times as ‘the seat of the Muses’. The adjective ‘Aonian’ is a reminiscence of a memorable line from Virgil’s Georgics:
阿俄尼安山是彼奥提亚的赫利孔山——帕纳索斯以东几英里的一座山——在古典时代被称为「缪斯之座」。「阿俄尼安」这一形容词是对维吉尔《农事诗》中一行名句的回忆：

Aonio rediens deducam vertice Musas
Aonio rediens deducam vertice Musas（归来时我将把缪斯从阿俄尼安山巅引下）





which is spoken by Apollo, the God of poetry, who by Virgil’s time was also recognized as the Sun-god. The line means ‘On my return I shall lead the Muses down from the top of Mount Helicon’. Apollo is referring to the transplanting of the worship of the Muses from Ascra, a town on a ridge of Helicon, to Delphi, on Mount Parnassus, a place which had become sacred to himself. On Helicon rose the spring named Hippocrene, ‘The Horse Well’, which was horse-shoe shaped. The legend was that it had been struck by the hoof of the horse Pegasus, whose name means ‘of the springs of water’. Poets were said to drink of Hippocrene for inspiration. Hence John Skelton’s lines (Against Garnesche):
这是诗歌之神阿波罗所说的话——到维吉尔时代他也已被公认为太阳神。这行诗的意思是「归来时我将把缪斯从赫利孔山顶引下来」。阿波罗指的是将缪斯崇拜从赫利孔山脊上的阿斯克拉城移植到帕纳索斯山上的德尔斐——一个已为他所神圣化的地方。赫利孔山上涌出的泉水名为希波克瑞涅（Hippocrene，「马泉」），呈马蹄形。传说它是飞马佩伽索斯——其名意为「水泉之属」——的蹄子踏出来的。据说诗人饮希波克瑞涅之水以获得灵感。因此约翰·斯克尔顿的诗句（《驳加内什》）：

I gave him of the sugryd welle
I gave him of the sugryd welle（我给他那甘甜的泉水）



Of Eliconys waters crystallyne.
Of Eliconys waters crystallyne.（赫利孔水晶般的水。）





But it may be supposed that Hippocrene and Aganippe were originally struck by the moon-shaped hoof of Leucippe (‘White Mare’), the Mare-headed Mother herself, and that the story of how Bellerophon son of Poseidon mastered Pegasus and then destroyed the triple-shaped Chimaera is really the story of an Achaean capture of the Goddess’s shrine: Pegasus, in fact, was originally called Aganippe. Aganos is a Homeric adjective applied to the shafts of Artemis and Apollo, meaning ‘giving a merciful death’; so Aganippe would mean: ‘The Mare who destroys mercifully.’ This supposition is strengthened by the Greek legend of the pursuit of Demeter, the Barley Mother, by the Achaean god Poseidon. Demeter, to escape his attentions, disguised herself as a mare and concealed herself among the horses of Oncios the Arcadian, but Poseidon became a stallion and covered her; her anger at this outrage was said to account for her statue at Onceum, called Demeter Erinnys – the Fury.
但可以推测，希波克瑞涅和阿伽尼佩最初是被勒乌基佩（Leucippe，「白马」）——马头母神本人——的月牙形蹄子踏出来的，而波塞冬之子柏勒洛丰驯服佩伽索斯然后毁灭三形喀迈拉的故事，实际上是一个亚该亚人夺取女神神庙的故事：佩伽索斯最初其实叫阿伽尼佩。Aganos 是荷马形容词，用于阿尔忒弥斯和阿波罗的箭矢，意为「赐予仁慈之死」；因此阿伽尼佩意为「仁慈毁灭之牝马」。这一推测被得墨忒耳——大麦母神——被亚该亚神波塞冬追赶的希腊传说所加强。得墨忒耳为逃避他的纠缠化身为牝马，藏在阿卡迪亚人翁基俄斯的马群中，但波塞冬变成公马与她交配；据说她对这一暴行的愤怒使她在翁基翁的雕像被称为得墨忒耳·厄里倪斯——「复仇女神」。

Demeter as a Mare-goddess was widely worshipped under the name of Epona, or ‘the Three Eponae’, among the Gallic Celts, and there is a strange account in Giraldus Cambrensis’s Topography of Ireland which shows that relics of the same cult survived in Ireland until the twelfth century. It concerns the crowning of an Irish petty-king at Tyrconnell, a preliminary to which was his symbolic rebirth from a white mare. He crawled naked towards her on all fours as if he were her foal; she was then slaughtered, and her pieces boiled in a cauldron. He himself entered the cauldron and began sucking up the broth and eating the flesh. Afterwards he stood on an inauguration stone, was presented with a straight white wand, and turned about three times from left to right, and then three times from right to left – ‘in honour of the Trinity’. Originally no doubt in honour of the Triple White Goddess.
作为牝马女神的得墨忒耳在高卢凯尔特人中以埃波娜（Epona）或「三位埃波娜」之名广受崇拜，而吉拉尔杜斯·坎布伦希斯在《爱尔兰地形志》中有一段奇异的记载，表明同一崇拜的遗存直到十二世纪仍在爱尔兰存续。它涉及蒂尔康奈尔一位爱尔兰小王的加冕——其前奏是他从一匹白马中获得象征性重生。他赤身裸体四肢着地向她爬去，仿佛是她的幼驹；然后她被宰杀，切块放入锅中煮。他自己进入锅中，吸吮肉汤并食用马肉。之后他站在一块加冕石上，被授以一根笔直的白杖，先从左向右转三圈，再从右向左转三圈——「以纪念三位一体」。无疑最初是纪念三重白女神。

The horse, or pony, has been a sacred animal in Britain from prehistoric times, not merely since the Bronze Age introduction of the stronger Asiatic breed. The only human figure represented in what survives of British Old Stone Age art is a man wearing a horse-mask, carved in bone, found in the Derbyshire Pin-hole Cave; a remote ancestor of the hobbyhorse mummers in the English ‘Christmas play’. The Saxons and Danes venerated the horse as much as did their Celtic predecessors, and the taboo on eating horse-flesh survives in Britain as a strong physical repugnance, despite attempts made during World War II to popularize hippophagism; but among the Bronze Age British the taboo must have been lifted at an annual October horse-feast, as among the Latins. In mediaeval Denmark the ecstatic three-day horse-feast, banned by the Church, survived among the heathenish serf-class; a circumstantial description is given by Johannes Jensen in his Fall of the King. He mentions that the priest first sprinkled bowls of the horse’s blood towards the South and East – which explains the horse as an incarnation of the Spirit of the solar year, son of the Mare-goddess.
马或小马从不列颠史前时代起就是神圣动物，不仅仅是自青铜时代引入更强壮的亚洲品种之后。在英国旧石器时代艺术的残存中唯一的人形形象是一个戴马面具的男子，雕刻在骨头上，发现于德比郡的针孔洞——英国「圣诞剧」中骑马哑剧演员的远祖。撒克逊人和丹麦人同他们的凯尔特前辈一样尊崇马，食马肉的禁忌在英国作为一种强烈的生理厌恶存续至今，尽管二战期间曾试图推广食马肉；但在青铜时代的英国人中间，这一禁忌必然在一年一度的十月马节中被解除，如同拉丁人一样。在中世纪丹麦，被教会禁止的狂喜三日马节在异教农奴阶级中存续；约翰内斯·延森在《国王的陨落》中给出了详细的描述。他提到祭司首先将一碗碗的马血洒向南方和东方——这解释了马作为太阳年之灵化身、牝马女神之子的身份。

In the Romance of Pwyll, Prince of Dyfed the Goddess appears as Rhiannon mother of Pryderi. Rhiannon is a corruption of Rigantona (‘Great Queen’) and Dyfed consisted of most of Carmarthen and the whole of Pembrokeshire and included St. David’s; its central point was called ‘The Dark Gate’, an entrance to the Underworld. When Pwyll (‘Prudence’) first sees Rhiannon and falls in love with her, he pursues her on his fastest horse but cannot overtake her; evidently in the original story she took the form of a white mare. When at last she consents to be overtaken, and marries him twelve months later, she bears him a son afterwards called Pryderi (‘Anxiety’) who disappears at birth; and her maids falsely accuse her of having devoured him, smearing her face with the blood of puppies. As a penance she is ordered to stand at a horse-block outside Pwyll’s palace, like a mare, ready to carry guests on her back.1 The life of her son Pryderi is closely connected with a magical foal which has been rescued from a harpy; all the previous foals of the same mare have been snatched off on May Eve and never seen again. Pryderi, a Divine Child of the sort that is taken away from its mother – like Llew Llaw, or Zeus, or Romulus – is later, as usual, given a name and arms by her, mounts the magical horse and eventually becomes a Lord of the Dead. Rhiannon is thus seen to be a Mare-goddess, but she is also a Muse-goddess, for the sirens that appear in the Triads, and also in the Romance of Branwen, singing with wonderful sweetness are called ‘The Birds of Rhiannon’. The story about the puppies recalls the Roman habit of sacrificing red puppies in the Spring to avert the baleful influence of the Dog-star on their grain; the sacrifice was really to the Barley-mother who had the Dog-star as her attendant. Rhiannon, in fact, is the Mare-Demeter, a successor of the Sow-Demeter Cerridwen. That the Mare-Demeter devoured children, like the Sow-Demeter, is proved by the myth of Leucippe (‘White Mare’) the Orchomenan, who with her two sisters ran wild and devoured her son Hippasus (‘foal’); and by the myth recorded by Pausanias, that when Rhea gave birth to Poseidon she offered her lover Cronos a foal to eat instead of the child, whom she gave secretly into the charge of the shepherds of Arcadian Arne.
在《普伊尔·戴弗德亲王传奇》中，女神以普里德里之母里安农的面貌出现。里安农是里甘托纳（Rigantona，「大女王」）的讹变，戴弗德包括卡马森的大部分和整个彭布罗克郡以及圣大卫区；其中心点被称为「暗门」——冥界的一个入口。当普伊尔（Pwyll，「审慎」）初见里安农并坠入爱河时，他骑最快的马追赶她却无法追上；显然在原始故事中她以白马的形态出现。当她终于同意被追上并在十二个月后嫁给他时，她生了一个儿子，后来被称为普里德里（Pryderi，「焦虑」），出生即失踪；她的侍女诬告她吞食了婴儿，用小狗的血涂在她脸上。作为赎罪，她被命令站在普伊尔宫外的上马石旁，像牝马一样，准备将客人驮在背上。¹她儿子普里德里的生活与一匹从鸟身女妖手中救出的魔法幼驹密切相关；同一牝马此前的所有幼驹都在五朔节前夕被掳走再未出现。普里德里——一个像卢·劳、宙斯或罗慕路斯那样被从母亲身边带走的神圣男童——后来照例由她赐名和授武，骑上魔法之马，最终成为冥界之主。里安农因此被看作牝马女神，但她也是缪斯女神，因为出现在三联诗以及《布兰文传奇》中以美妙歌声吟唱的塞壬被称为「里安农之鸟」。小狗的故事让人想起罗马人在春天献祭红色小狗以消除天狼星对谷物不利影响的习俗；这一献祭实际上是献给以天狼星为侍从的大麦母神的。里安农实际上是牝马得墨忒耳——母猪得墨忒耳凯丽德温的继任者。牝马得墨忒耳像母猪得墨忒耳一样吞食儿童，这由勒乌基佩（Leucippe，「白马」）——奥尔霍迈诺斯人——的神话所证明：她与两个姐妹发狂并吞食了她的儿子希帕索斯（Hippasus，「幼驹」）；也由保萨尼亚斯记录的神话所证明：当瑞亚生下波塞冬时，她给情人克罗诺斯吃一匹幼驹代替孩子，而将孩子秘密交给阿卡迪亚阿尔涅的牧人抚养。

Mount Helicon was not the earliest seat of the Muse Goddesses, as their title ‘The Pierians’ shows; the word Muse is now generally derived from the root mont, meaning a mountain. Their worship had been brought there in the Heroic Age during a migration of the Boeotian people from Mount Pieria in Northern Thessaly. But to make the transplanted Muses feel at home on Helicon, and so preserve the old magic, the Boeotians named the geographical features of the mountain – the springs, the peaks and grottoes – after the corresponding features of Pieria. The Muses were at this time three in number, an indivisible Trinity, as the mediaeval Catholics recognized when they built the church of their own Holy Trinity on the site of the deserted shrine of the Heliconian Muses. The appropriate names of the three Persons were Meditation, Memory and Song. The worship of the Muses on Helicon (and presumably also in Pieria) was concerned with incantatory cursing and incantatory blessing; Helicon was famous for the medicinal herbs which supplemented the incantations – especially for the nine-leaved black hellebore used by Melampus at Lusi as a cure for the Daughters of Proetus, which could either cause or cure insanity and which has a stimulative action on the heart like digitalis (fox-glove). It was famous also for the erotic fertility dances about a stone herm at Thespiae, a town at its foot, in which the women-votaries of the Muses took part. Spenser addresses the Muses as ‘Virgins of Helicon’; he might equally have called them ‘witches’, for the witches of his day worshipped the same White Goddess – in Macbeth called Hecate – performed the same fertility dances on their Sabbaths, and were similarly gifted in incantatory magic and knowledge of herbs.
赫利孔山并非缪斯女神最早的座所，正如她们的称号「皮厄里亚人」所示；缪斯一词现在一般派生自词根 mont，意为山。她们的崇拜在英雄时代彼奥提亚人从北色萨利的皮厄里亚山迁移时被带到那里。但为使移植到赫利孔山的缪斯感到自在以保存古老的魔力，彼奥提亚人以皮厄里亚的相应特征命名了这座山的地理特征——泉水、山峰和洞窟。此时的缪斯为三位，一个不可分割的三联体——中世纪天主教徒在被废弃的赫利孔缪斯神庙遗址上建造自己的圣三位一体教堂时认识到了这一点。三位格的恰当名称是冥想、记忆和歌唱。赫利孔山上的缪斯崇拜（大概皮厄里亚也是如此）涉及咒语诅咒和咒语祝福；赫利孔山以辅助咒语的药草闻名——尤其是墨兰波斯在卢西用来治愈普罗埃图斯之女的九叶黑嚏根草，它既能引起也能治愈疯狂，对心脏有类似洋地黄的刺激作用。它还以山脚下塞斯皮埃城围绕石赫尔墨斯的色情丰产舞闻名——缪斯的女信徒参与其中。斯宾塞称缪斯为「赫利孔的处女」；他同样可以称她们为「女巫」，因为他那个时代的女巫崇拜同一位白女神——在《麦克白》中称为赫卡忒——在安息日跳同样的丰产舞，同样擅长咒语魔法和药草知识。

The Muse priestesses of Helicon presumably used two products of the horse to stimulate their ecstasies: the slimy vaginal issue of a mare in heat and the black membrane, or hippomanes, cut from the forehead of a newborn colt, which the mare (according to Aristotle) normally eats as a means of increasing her mother-love. Dido in the Aeneid used this hippomanes in her love-potion.
赫利孔山的缪斯女祭司大概使用马的两种产物来激发她们的迷狂：发情牝马的黏滑阴道分泌物和从新生幼驹前额割下的黑色薄膜——hippomanes——据亚里士多德记载牝马通常会吃掉它以增加母爱。《埃涅阿斯纪》中的狄多在她的爱情药剂中使用了这种 hippomanes。

Skelton in his Garland of Laurell thus describes the Triple Goddess in her three characters as Goddess of the Sky, Earth and Underworld:
斯克尔顿在《月桂冠》中如此描述三重女神在其天界、大地和冥界三个面向中的角色：

Diana in the leavës green,
Diana in the leavës green,（黛安娜在绿叶间，）



Luna that so bright doth sheen,
Luna that so bright doth sheen,（月神如此明亮地闪耀，）



Persephone in Hell.
Persephone in Hell.（珀耳塞福涅在地狱。）





As Goddess of the Underworld she was concerned with Birth, Procreation and Death. As Goddess of the Earth she was concerned with the three seasons of Spring, Summer and Winter: she animated trees and plants and ruled all living creatures. As Goddess of the Sky she was the Moon, in her three phases of New Moon, Full Moon, and Waning Moon. This explains why from a triad she was so often enlarged to an ennead. But it must never be forgotten that the Triple Goddess, as worshipped for example at Stymphalus, was a personification of primitive woman – woman the creatress and destructress. As the New Moon or Spring she was girl; as the Full Moon or Summer she was woman; as the Old Moon or Winter she was hag.
作为冥界女神她掌管生育、生殖和死亡。作为大地女神她掌管春夏冬三季：她赋予树木植物生命，统治一切生灵。作为天界女神她是月亮，在其新月、满月和残月三相中。这解释了为什么她常常从三联体扩展为九联体。但永远不可忘记的是，三重女神——例如在斯廷法罗斯受崇拜的——是原始女性的人格化——作为创造者和毁灭者的女性。作为新月或春天她是少女；作为满月或夏天她是妇人；作为残月或冬天她是老妪。

In a Gallo-Roman ‘allée couverte’ burial at Tressé near St. Malo in Brittany two pairs of girls’ breasts are sculptured on one megalithic upright, two maternal pairs of breasts on another; the top of a third upright has been broken off, but V. C. C. Collum who excavated the burial suggests that it pictured a third pair – probably the shrunken breasts of the Hag. A very interesting find in this same burial, which can be dated by a bronze coin of Domitian to the end of the first century AD, was a flint arrow-head of the usual willow-leaf shape with an incised decoration of half-moons. The willow, as we have seen, was sacred to the Moon, and in the Beth-Luis-Nion is Saille, the letter S. The most primitive character of the Greek letter S is C, which is borrowed from the Cretan linear script. Sir Arthur Evans in his Palace of Minos gives a table showing the gradual development of the Cretan characters from ideograms, and the sign C is there explained as a waning moon – the Moon-goddess as hag. The arrow-head, which in Roman Brittany was as completely out of date, except for ritual uses, as the Queen’s sword of state, or the Archbishop’s crozier is now, will have been an offering to the third person of the female Trinity.1 V. C. C. Collum took the trouble to have an analysis made of the charcoal found under the uprights, apparently the remains of the funerary pyre on which the dead man had been cremated. It was willow, oak and hazel charcoal, expressive of the sequence: enchantment, royalty, wisdom.
在布列塔尼圣马洛附近特雷塞的一处高卢-罗马式「廊式墓」中，一块巨石立柱上雕刻着两对少女乳房，另一块上雕着两对母性乳房；第三块立柱的顶部已折断，但发掘者 V. C. C. 科勒姆推测它刻画的是第三对——大概是老妪萎缩的乳房。这一墓葬可用一枚图密善铜币定年为公元一世纪末，其中一件有趣的发现是一枚常见的柳叶形燧石箭头，上面刻有半月形装饰。如我们所见，柳树是月之神圣之树，在贝斯-路易斯-尼恩中是 Saille，即字母 S。希腊字母 S 最原始的字形是 C，借自克里特线形文字。阿瑟·伊文思爵士在《弥诺斯宫殿》中给出了一个表格，展示克里特字符从象形文字逐渐演变的过程，其中 C 形符号被解释为残月——即作为老妪的月女神。这枚箭头在罗马不列颠已完全过时——除了仪式用途之外——如同今日女王的国剑或大主教的主教杖，它将是献给女性三联体第三位格的祭品。¹ V. C. C. 科勒姆还特意对在立柱下发现的木炭——显然是火化死者遗骸的柴堆残余——进行了分析。那是柳树、橡树和榛树的木炭，表达的序列是：魔法、王权、智慧。

In Europe there were at first no male gods contemporary with the Goddess to challenge her prestige or power, but she had a lover who was alternatively the beneficent Serpent of Wisdom, and the beneficent Star of Life, her son. The Son was incarnate in the male demons of the various totem societies ruled by her, who assisted in the erotic dances held in her honour. The Serpent, incarnate in the sacred serpents which were the ghosts of the dead, sent the winds. The Son, who was also called Lucifer or Phosphorus (‘bringer of light’) because as evening-star he led in the light of the Moon, was reborn every year, grew up as the year advanced, destroyed the Serpent, and won the Goddess’s love. Her love destroyed him, but from his ashes was born another Serpent which, at Easter, laid the glain or red egg which she ate; so that the Son was reborn to her as a child once more. Osiris was a Star-son, and though after his death he looped himself around the world like a serpent, yet when his fifty-yard long phallus was carried in procession it was topped with a golden star; this stood for himself renewed as the Child Horus, son of Isis, who had been both his bride and his layer-out and was now his mother once again. Her absolute power was proved by a yearly holocaust in her honour as ‘Lady of the Wild Things’, in which the totem bird or beast of each society was burned alive.
在欧洲，最初没有与女神同时代的男性神来挑战她的威望或权力，但她有一个情人，他交替地是仁慈的智慧之蛇和仁慈的生命之星，即她的儿子。儿子化身于她所统治的各图腾社会中男性精灵之中，协助在她名下举行的色情舞蹈。蛇则化身于作为死者幽灵的神圣蛇中，派遣风。儿子也被称为路西法或磷光者（Phosphorus，「携光者」），因为作为昏星他引领月亮之光；他每年重生，随年推进而成长，毁灭蛇，赢得女神的爱。她的爱毁灭了他，但从他的灰烬中诞生了另一条蛇，这条蛇在复活节产下格莱恩（glain）即红蛋供她食用；于是儿子再次作为孩童从她而生。奥西里斯是一位星之子，虽然死后他像蛇一样环绕世界，但当他的五十码长阳具被抬着游行时，顶端装饰着一颗金星；这代表他作为孩童荷鲁斯——伊西斯之子——的更新，伊西斯既是他的新娘又是他的敛葬者，如今再次成为他的母亲。她的绝对权力通过每年一次以「万物之女主」之名举行的大屠杀来证明，其中每个社会的图腾鸟兽被活活烧死。

The most familiar icon of Aegean religion is therefore a Moon-woman, a Star-son and a wise spotted Serpent grouped under a fruit-tree – Artemis, Hercules and Erechtheus. Star-son and Serpent are at war; one succeeds the other in the Moon-woman’s favour, as summer succeeds winter, and winter succeeds summer; as death succeeds birth and birth succeeds death. The Sun grows weaker or stronger as the year takes its course, the branches of the tree are now loaded and now bare, but the light of the Moon is invariable. She is impartial: she destroys or creates with equal passion. The conflict between the twins is given an ingenious turn in the Romance of Kilhwych and Olwen: Gwyn (‘White’) and his rival Gwythur ap Greidawl (‘Victor, son of Scorcher’) waged perpetual war for Creiddylad (alias Cordelia), daughter of Lludd (alias Llyr, alias Lear, alias Nudd, alias Nuada, alias Nodens), each in turn stealing her from the other, until the matter was referred to King Arthur. He gave the ironical decision that Creiddylad should be returned to her father and that the twins should ‘fight for her every first of May, until the day of doom’, and that whichever of them should then be conqueror should keep her.
因此，爱琴宗教最常见的图像是一位月之女子、一位星之子和一条智慧的有斑蛇聚集在一棵果树下——阿尔忒弥斯、赫拉克勒斯和厄瑞克透斯。星之子与蛇处于交战状态；一个在月之女子的恩宠中取代另一个，如同夏天取代冬天、冬天取代夏天；如同死亡取代出生、出生取代死亡。太阳随年的推进时强时弱，树的枝条时而满载时而光秃，但月亮的光不变。她不偏不倚：以同等的激情创造或毁灭。这对双胞胎之间的冲突在《基尔胡赫与奥尔文传奇》中有一个巧妙的转折：格温（Gwyn，「白」）和他的对手格维瑟·阿普·格雷达尔（Gwythur ap Greidawl，「胜利者，灼烧者之子」）为勒德（又名勒尔、李尔、努德、努阿达、诺登斯）之女克雷迪拉德（又名科迪莉亚）进行永久的战争，轮流从对方手中夺走她，直到此事交由亚瑟王裁决。他做出了讽刺的判决：克雷迪拉德应归还给她父亲，双胞胎应「每年五朔节为她而战，直到末日」，届时无论谁获胜即可拥有她。

There are as yet no fathers, for the Serpent is no more the father of the Star-son than the Star-son is of the Serpent. They are twins, and here we are returned to the single poetic Theme. The poet identifies himself with the Star-son, his hated rival is the Serpent; only if he is writing as a satirist, does he play the Serpent. The Triple Muse is woman in her divine character: the poet’s enchantress, the only theme of his songs. It must not be forgotten that Apollo himself was once a yearly victim of the Serpent: for Pythagoras carved an inscription on his tomb at Delphi, recording his death in a fight with the local python – the python which he was usually supposed to have killed outright. The Star-son and the Serpent are still mere demons, and in Crete the Goddess is not even pictured with a divine child in her arms. She is the mother of all things; her sons and lovers partake of the sacred essence only by her grace.
此时还没有父亲，因为蛇并非星之子之父，如同星之子并非蛇之父。他们是双胞胎，这里我们回到了唯一的诗性主题。诗人认同星之子，他的可恨对手是蛇；只有当他作为讽刺诗人写作时，他才扮演蛇。三重缪斯是女性在其神圣面向中的角色：诗人的魔法师，他的歌的唯一主题。不可忘记，阿波罗自己也曾是蛇的年度牺牲品：因为毕达哥拉斯在德尔斐他墓上刻了一段铭文，记录了他在与当地的皮同——通常被认为已被他当场杀死的那条皮同——的战斗中死亡。星之子和蛇仍不过是精灵，在克里特女神甚至不会被描绘为怀抱神圣婴孩。她是万物之母；她的儿子和情人只有凭借她的恩典才能分有神圣本质。

The revolutionary institution of fatherhood, imported into Europe from the East, brought with it the institution of individual marriage. Hitherto there had been only group marriages of all female members of a particular totem society with all members of another; every child’s maternity was certain, but its paternity debatable and irrelevant. Once this revolution had occurred, the social status of woman altered: man took over many of the sacred practices from which his sex had debarred him, and finally declared himself head of the household, though much property still passed from mother to daughter. This second stage, the Olympian stage, necessitated a change in mythology. It was not enough to introduce the concept of fatherhood into the ordinary myth, as in the Orphic formula quoted by Clement of Alexandria, ‘The Bull that is the Serpent’s father, the Serpent that is the Bull’s.’ A new child was needed who should supersede both the Star-son and the Serpent. He was celebrated by poets as the Thunder-child, or the Axe-child, or the Hammer-child. There are different legends as to how he removed his enemies. Either he borrowed the golden sickle of the Moon-woman, his mother, and castrated the Star-son; or he flung him down from a mountain top; or he stunned him with his axe so that he fell into perpetual sleep. The Serpent he usually killed outright. Then he became the Father-god, or Thunder-god, married his mother and begot his divine sons and daughters on her. The daughters were really limited versions of herself – herself in various young-moon and full-moon aspects. In her old-moon aspect she became her own mother, or grandmother, or sister, and the sons were limited revivals of the destroyed Star-son and Serpent. Among these sons was a God of poetry, music, the arts and the sciences: he was eventually recognized as the Sun-god and acted in many countries as active regent for his senescent father, the Thunder-god. In some cases he even displaced him. The Greeks and the Romans had reached this religious stage by the time that Christianity began.
从东方引入欧洲的革命性的父权制度，带来了个体婚姻制度。此前只有某一图腾社会的所有女性成员与另一社会的所有成员之间的群婚；每个孩子的母亲是确定的，但父亲可疑且无关紧要。这场革命一旦发生，女性的社会地位便改变了：男性接管了许多此前因其性别而被排斥的神圣实践，并最终宣布自己为一家之主，尽管大量财产仍由母亲传给女儿。第二阶段——奥林匹克阶段——需要改变神话。仅仅将父权概念引入普通神话是不够的，如克莱门特·亚历山大引用的俄耳甫斯公式：「是蛇之父的公牛，是公牛之父的蛇。」需要一个新孩子来取代星之子和蛇。诗人将他歌颂为雷之子、斧之子或锤之子。关于他如何除掉敌人有不同的传说。或者他借用了月之女子——他母亲——的金镰刀，阉割了星之子；或者他将星之子从山顶摔下；或者他用斧击晕他使其陷入永眠。蛇他通常当场杀死。然后他成为父神或雷神，娶了自己的母亲并在她身上生了神圣的儿女。女儿实际上是她自身的有限版本——她在各种新月和满月面向中的自身。在残月面向中她变成自己的母亲、或祖母、或姐妹，而儿子则是被毁灭的星之子和蛇的有限复活。这些儿子中有一位诗歌、音乐、艺术和科学之神：他最终被公认为太阳神，在许多国家作为其衰老的父亲——雷神——的活跃摄政者。在某些情况下他甚至取代了父亲。希腊人和罗马人在基督教开始时已达到这一宗教阶段。

The third stage of cultural development – the purely patriarchal, in which there are no Goddesses at all – is that of later Judaism, Judaic Christianity, Mohammedanism and Protestant Christianity. This stage was not reached in England until the Commonwealth, since in mediaeval Catholicism the Virgin and Son – who took over the rites and honours of the Moon-woman and her Star-son – were of greater religious importance than God the Father. (The Serpent had become the Devil; which is appropriate because Jesus had opposed fish to serpent in Matthew, VII, 10, and was himself symbolized as a fish by his followers.) The Welsh worshipped Virgin and Son for fifty years longer than the English; the Irish of Eire still do so. This stage is unfavourable to poetry. Hymns addressed to the Thunder-god, however lavishly they may gild him in Sun-god style – even Skelton’s magnificent Hymn to God the Father – fail as poems, because to credit him with illimitable and unrestrained power denies the poet’s inalienable allegiance to the Muse; and because though the Thunder-god has been a jurist, logician, declamator and prose-stylist, he has never been a poet or had the least understanding of true poems since he escaped from his Mother’s tutelage.
文化发展的第三阶段——纯粹父权的阶段，其中完全没有女神——是晚期犹太教、犹太式基督教、伊斯兰教和新教基督教的阶段。这一阶段直到英国内战时期才在英国达到，因为在中世纪天主教中，圣母子——接管了月之女子和星之子的仪式与尊荣——比父神具有更大的宗教重要性。（蛇变成了魔鬼；这是恰当的，因为耶稣在《马太福音》VII, 10 中以鱼对蛇，他本人也被信徒象征为鱼。）威尔士人比英格兰人多崇拜圣母子五十年；爱尔兰的爱尔兰人至今仍然如此。这一阶段不利于诗歌。献给雷神的赞美诗——无论以太阳神风格多么奢华地镀金他——甚至斯克尔顿宏伟的《天父颂》——作为诗歌都是失败的，因为赋予他无限且不受约束的权力否定了诗人对缪斯不可剥夺的忠诚；而且因为雷神虽然一直是法学家、逻辑学家、演说家和散文文体家，但自从他脱离母亲的监护后就从未当过诗人，也从未真正理解过诗歌。

In Greece, when the Moon-woman first became subordinated to the Thunder-god as his wife, she delegated the charge of poetry to her so-called daughter, her former self as the Triple Muse, and no poem was considered auspicious that did not begin with an appeal to the Muse for inspiration. Thus the early ballad, The Wrath of Achilles, which introduces the Iliad of Homer, begins: ‘Sing, Goddess, of the destructive anger of Achilles, son of Peleus.’ That Achilles is styled ‘son of Peleus’ rather than ‘son of Thetis’ proves that the patriarchal system was already in force, though totem society lingered on as a social convenience, Achilles being a sacred king of the Myrmidons of Thessaly, apparently an Ant clan subject to the Goddess as Wryneck; but the Goddess is clearly the Triple Muse, not merely one of the nine little Muses, mentioned in a less primitive part of the Iliad, whom Apollo later led down from Helicon, and up to Parnassus when, as recorded in the Hymn to Pythian Apollo, he superseded the local Earth-goddess in the navel-shrine at Delphi. Apollo (‘Destroyer or Averter’) was at this time considered to be a male twin to the daughter-goddess Artemis; they were represented as children of the Thunder-god, born on Quail Island, off Delos, to the Goddess Latona the Hyperborean, daughter of Phoebe and Coieus (‘Moonlight and Initiation’).
在希腊，当月之女子首次从属于雷神成为其妻时，她将诗歌之责委托给所谓的女儿——她作为三重缪斯的前身——任何不以祈请缪斯赐灵为开端的诗歌都不被视为吉利的。因此，引入荷马《伊利亚特》的早期歌谣《阿喀琉斯的愤怒》开篇道：「唱吧，女神，佩琉斯之子阿喀琉斯的毁灭性愤怒。」阿喀琉斯被称为「佩琉斯之子」而非「忒提斯之子」证明父权制已经实施，尽管图腾社会作为一种社会便利仍然存在——阿喀琉斯是色萨利默密冬人的神圣国王，大概是蚁族，受女神以扭颈鸟之形统治；但女神显然是三重缪斯，而非仅是荷马较晚部分提到的九个小缪斯之一——那些小缪斯后来由阿波罗从赫利孔山引下，又在《皮提亚阿波罗颂》所载中取代德尔斐肚脐神庙中的当地大地女神时引上帕纳索斯山。阿波罗（「毁灭者或消灾者」）此时被认为是女儿女神阿尔忒弥斯的男性双胞胎；他们被描绘为雷神的孩子，由极北女神勒托娜——福柏和科伊俄斯（「月光和入教」）之女——在提洛岛附近的鹌鹑岛上所生。

The myths get confused here because Latona, being a newcomer to Delos, was not at first recognized by the local Triple Goddess; and because Artemis, the name of Apollo’s twin, had previously been a Greek title of the Triple Goddess herself. Artemis probably means ‘The Disposer of Water’ from ard- and themis. Apollo, one may say, was securing his position by persuading his twin to take over the emblems and titles of her predecessor: he himself adopted the titles and emblems of a Pelasgian ‘Averter’ or ‘Destroyer’, in one aspect (as his title Smintheus proves) a Cretan Mouse-demon. Apollo and Artemis then together took over the charge of poetry from the Triple Muse (in this context their mother Latona); but Artemis soon ceased to be an equal partner of Apollo’s, though she continued to be a Goddess of magical charms and eventually was credited with evil charms only. So Tatian records in his Address to the Greeks: ‘Artemis is a poisoner, Apollo performs cures.’ In Ireland, similarly, the Goddess Brigit became overshadowed by the God Ogma. In Cormac’s Glossary it was necessary to explain her as: ‘Brigit, daughter of The Dagda, the poetess, that is, the goddess worshipped by the poets on account of the great and illustrious protection afforded them by her.’ It was in her honour that the ollave carried a golden branch with tinkling bells when he went abroad.
这里的神话变得混乱，因为勒托娜作为新来者最初不被当地三重女神承认；而且阿尔忒弥斯——阿波罗双胞胎之名——此前是三重女神本身的希腊称号。阿尔忒弥斯可能意为「水的处置者」，源自 ard- 和 themis。可以说，阿波罗通过说服他的双胞胎接管前任的标志和称号来巩固自己的地位：他自己则采用了一位佩拉斯吉「消灾者」或「毁灭者」的称号和标志——在一个面向（如其称号斯明透斯所证）是克里特鼠精灵。阿波罗和阿尔忒弥斯随后一起从三重缪斯（此处即他们的母亲勒托娜）手中接管了诗歌之责；但阿尔忒弥斯很快就不再与阿波罗平等，虽然她继续作为魔法咒语女神，最终只被赋予恶咒。因此塔提安在《致希腊人书》中记载：「阿尔忒弥斯是投毒者，阿波罗施行治愈。」在爱尔兰，类似地，女神布里吉特被神奥格玛所遮蔽。在科马克的词汇表中需要这样解释她：「布里吉特，达格达之女，女诗人，即因给予诗人巨大而显赫的保护而受诗人崇拜的女神。」正是为了纪念她，奥拉夫外出时携带一根挂着叮当作响铃铛的金枝。

About the eighth century BC the Muse triad became enlarged under Thraco-Macedonian influence to three triads, or an ennead. Here the nine orgiastic priestesses of the Island of Sein in West Brittany, and the nine damsels in the Preiddeu Annwm whose breaths warmed Cerridwen’s cauldron, will be recalled. A ninefold Muse was more expressive of the universality of the Goddess’s rule than a threefold one; but the Apollo priesthood who ruled Greek Classical literature soon used the change as a means of weakening her power by a process of departmentalization. Hesiod writes of the Nine Daughters of Zeus, who under Apollo’s patronage were given the following functions and names:
大约公元前八世纪，在色雷斯-马其顿的影响下，缪斯三联体扩展为三个三联体，即九联体。这里可以回想布列塔尼西部塞恩岛的九位狂欢女祭司，以及《安温的战利品》中九位气息温暖凯丽德温大锅的少女。九重缪斯比三重缪斯更能表达女神统治的普遍性；但统治希腊古典文学的阿波罗祭司阶层很快利用这一变化作为通过部门化来削弱她权力的手段。赫西俄德写道，宙斯的九个女儿在阿波罗的庇护下被赋予以下职能和名称：

Epic poetry, Calliope.
史诗，卡利俄佩。



History, Clio.
历史，克利俄。



Lyric poetry, Euterpe.
抒情诗，欧忒耳佩。



Tragedy, Melpomene.
悲剧，墨尔波墨涅。



Choral dancing, Terpsichore.
合唱舞蹈，忒耳普西科瑞。



Erotic poetry and mime, Erato.
色情诗和默剧，厄拉托。



Sacred Poetry, Polyhymnia.
圣诗，波吕许谟尼亚。



Astronomy, Urania.
天文学，乌拉尼亚。



Comedy, Thaleia.
喜剧，塔勒亚。





Calliope (‘beautiful face’) was a name of the original Muse, in her full-moon aspect; so were Erato ‘the beloved one’; and Urania ‘the heavenly one’. The first mention of Erato in Greek myth is as the Oak-queen to whom Areas was married; he gave his name to Arcadia and was the son of Callisto the She-bear and father of Atheneatis. The other names apparently refer to the several functions of the Muses. It will be observed that though the Muses of Helicon still had erotic tendencies, their chief function, that of healing and cursing by incantation, had been taken away from them under Olympianism. It had passed to Apollo himself and a surrogate, his physician son Aesculapius.
卡利俄佩（Calliope，「美面者」）是最初缪斯在其满月面向中的名字；厄拉托（Erato，「被爱者」）和乌拉尼亚（Urania，「天之女」）也是如此。厄拉托在希腊神话中首次出现是作为橡树女王，阿耳卡斯娶了她——他以自己的名字命名了阿卡迪亚，是母熊卡利斯托之子、阿特涅阿提斯之父。其他名字显然指的是缪斯的多种职能。可以注意到，虽然赫利孔山的缪斯仍有色情倾向，但她们的主要职能——以咒语治愈和诅咒——在奥林匹克体制下已被夺走。它转到了阿波罗本人及其代理人——他的医师儿子阿斯克勒庇俄斯——手中。

Apollo, though the God of Poetry and the leader of the Muses, did not yet, however, claim to inspire poems: the inspiration was still held to come to the poet from the Muse or Muses. He had originally been a mere Demon1 whom his Muse mother had inspired with poetic frenzy; now he required that, as the Ninefold Muse, she should inspire individual poets in his honour – though not to the point of ecstasy. These poets, if they proved to be his faithful and industrious servants, he rewarded with a garland of laurel – in Greek, daphne. The connexion of poetry with laurel is not merely that laurel is an evergreen and thus an emblem of immortality: it is also an intoxicant. The female celebrants of the Triple Goddess at Tempe had chewed laurel leaves to induce a poetic and erotic frenzy, as the Bacchanals chewed ivy – daphne may be a shortened form of daphoine, ‘the bloody one’, a title of the Goddess – and when Apollo took over the Delphic oracle the Pythian priestess who continued in charge learned to chew laurel for oracular inspiration. The laurel had become sacred to Apollo – his legendary pursuit of the nymph Daphne records his capture of the Goddess’s shrine at Tempe near Mount Olympus – but he was now the God of Reason with the motto ‘nothing in excess’, and his male initiates wore the laurel without chewing at it; Empedocles, as Pythagoras’s semi-divine successor, held laurel-chewing in as great horror as bean-eating. Poetry as a magical practice was already in decline.
阿波罗虽然身为诗歌之神和缪斯的领袖，但尚未声称自己赐予诗歌灵感：灵感仍被认为来自缪斯。他最初不过是一个精灵¹，由他的缪斯母亲赐予诗性迷狂；如今他要求她作为九重缪斯为他的荣誉激发个别诗人——但不到迷狂的程度。如果这些诗人证明自己是忠实而勤奋的仆人，他便以月桂冠奖励他们——希腊语为 daphne。诗歌与月桂的联系不仅在于月桂是常绿植物因而是不朽的象征：它也是一种致醉剂。坦佩的三重女神女性参与者曾咀嚼月桂叶以引发诗性和色情的迷狂，如同酒神信徒咀嚼常春藤——daphne 可能是 daphoine 的缩写，「血腥者」，女神的一个称号——当阿波罗接管德尔斐神谕时，继续负责的皮提亚女祭司学会了咀嚼月桂以获得神谕灵感。月桂已成为阿波罗的神圣之树——他追慕仙女达芙妮的传说记录了他夺取奥林匹斯山附近坦佩的女神神庙——但他现在是理性之神，格言为「勿过度」，他的男性入教者佩戴月桂但不咀嚼；恩培多克勒作为毕达哥拉斯的半神继任者，对咀嚼月桂的恐惧不亚于食豆。诗歌作为一种魔法实践已经在衰落。

The Romans conquered Greece and brought Apollo with them to Italy. They were a military nation, ashamed of their own rude poetic tradition, but some of them began to take up Greek poetry seriously as part of their education in political rhetoric, an art which they found necessary for consolidating their military conquests. They studied under the Greek sophists and understood from them that major poetry was a more musical and more philosophical form of rhetoric than could be achieved by prose and that minor poetry was the most elegant of social accomplishments. True poets will agree that poetry is spiritual illumination delivered by a poet to his equals, not an ingenious technique of swaying a popular audience or of enlivening a sottish dinner-party, and will think of Catullus as one of the very few poets who transcended the Graeco-Roman poetic tradition. The reason perhaps was that he was of Celtic birth: at any rate, he had a fearlessness, originality and emotional sensitivity entirely lacking in the general run of Latin poets. He alone showed a sincere love of women; the others were content to celebrate either comrade-loyalty or playful homosexuality. His contemporary, Virgil, is to be read for qualities that are not poetic in the sense that they invoke the presence of the Muse. The musical and rhetorical skill, the fine-sounding periphrases, and the rolling periods, are admired by classicists, but the Aeneid is designed to dazzle and overpower, and true poets do not find it consistent with their integrity to follow Virgil’s example. They honour Catullus more, because he never seems to be calling upon them, as posterity, to applaud a demonstration of immortal genius; rather, he appeals to them as a contemporary: ‘Is this not so?’ For Horace as the elegant verse-writer they may feel affection, and admire his intention of avoiding extremes of feeling and the natural Roman temptation to be vulgar. But for all his wit, affability and skilful gleemanship they can hardly reckon him a poet, any more than they can reckon, say, Calverley or Austin Dobson.
罗马人征服了希腊并将阿波罗带到了意大利。他们是尚武民族，对自己粗陋的诗歌传统感到羞愧，但一些人开始认真地学习希腊诗歌，作为政治修辞教育的一部分——他们发现这种艺术对巩固军事征服是必要的。他们在希腊诡辩家门下学习，从他们那里了解到，大诗是比散文更富音乐性和哲理性的修辞形式，小诗则是最优雅的社会才艺。真正的诗人会同意，诗歌是诗人向其同辈传递的精神照悟，不是左右大众听众或活跃醉醺醺宴会的巧妙技巧，他们会认为卡图卢斯是极少数超越了希腊-罗马诗歌传统的诗人之一。原因也许在于他有凯尔特血统：无论如何，他具有拉丁诗人普遍缺乏的无畏、独创性和情感敏感。他是唯一对女性表现出真诚之爱的诗人；其他人满足于歌颂战友忠诚或嬉戏的同性恋。他的同时代人维吉尔读来有一些品质并非以召唤缪斯之在场的意义而言的「诗意」。音乐性和修辞技巧、华美的迂回说法和滚滚的长句受到古典学者赞赏，但《埃涅阿斯纪》旨在炫目和压倒，真正的诗人发现追随维吉金的榜样与他们的一致性不合。他们更敬重卡图卢斯，因为他从不似乎在作为后世的他们面前呼唤掌声以展示不朽天才；相反，他以同代人的身份向他们呼吁：「难道不是如此吗？」至于贺拉斯作为优雅的诗人，他们可能感到亲切，赞赏他避免极端情感和罗马人天性庸俗的意图。但尽管他有风趣、和蔼和精巧的技艺，他们几乎不能把他算作诗人，如同他们不能把比如卡尔弗利或奥斯汀·道布森算作诗人。

To summarize the history of the Greek Muses: The Triple Muse, or the Three Muses, or the Ninefold Muse, or Cerridwen, or whatever else one may care to call her, is originally the Great Goddess in her poetic or incantatory character. She has a son who is also her lover and her victim, the Star-son, or Demon of the Waxing Year. He alternates in her favour with his tanist Python, the Serpent of Wisdom, the Demon of the Waning Year, his darker self.
总结希腊缪斯的历史：三重缪斯，或三缪斯，或九重缪斯，或凯丽德温，或无论你怎么称呼她，最初是大女神在其诗性或咒语面向中的角色。她有一个儿子，同时也是她的情人和牺牲品——星之子，或渐长年之精灵。他与他的替补者皮同——智慧之蛇、渐消年之精灵、他黑暗的自我——交替获得她的恩宠。

Next, she is courted by the Thunder-god (a rebellious Star-son infected by Eastern patriarchalism) and has twins by him, a male and a female – in Welsh poetry called Merddin and Olwen. She remains the Goddess of Incantation, but forfeits part of her sovereignty to the Thunder-god, particularly law-making and the witnessing of oaths.
其次，她被雷神（一个感染了东方父权主义的叛逆星之子）追求并生下双胞胎，一男一女——在威尔士诗歌中称为默丁和奥尔文。她仍然是咒语女神，但将部分主权让渡给雷神，特别是立法和见证誓言。

Next, she divides the power of poetic enchantment between her twins, whose symbols are the morning star and the evening star, the female twin being herself in decline, the male a revival of the Star-son.
其次，她将诗性魔法的权力分给她的双胞胎，其象征是晨星和昏星——女性双胞胎是衰微的自身，男性是星之子的复活。

Next, she becomes enlarged in number, though reduced in power, to a bevy of nine little departmental goddesses of inspiration, under the tutelage of the former male twin.
其次，她虽然在数量上扩展但在权力上缩减，成为一羣九个小小的部门性灵感女神，在前男性双胞胎的监护下。

Finally, the male twin, Apollo, proclaims himself the Eternal Sun, and the Nine Muses become his ladies-in-waiting. He delegates their functions to male gods who are himself in multiplication.
最后，男性双胞胎阿波罗宣布自己为永恒的太阳，九缪斯成为他的侍女。他将她们的职能委托给他自身的繁衍——男性神祇。

(The legendary origin of Japanese poetry is in an encounter between the Moon-goddess and the Sun-god as they walked around the pillar of the world in opposite directions. The Moon-goddess spoke first, saying in verse:
（日本诗歌的传说起源是月女神与太阳神在世界之柱旁相向而行时的一次相遇。月女神先开口，以诗句说：

What joy beyond compare
What joy beyond compare（无与伦比的喜悦）



To see a man so fair!
To see a man so fair!（见到如此俊美的男子！）





The Sun-god was angry that she had spoken out of turn in this unseemly fashion; he told her to return and come to meet him again. On this occasion he spoke first:
太阳神因她如此不合时宜地抢先说话而生气；他让她回去重新来与他相遇。这一次他先开口：

To see a maid so fair –
To see a maid so fair –（见到如此美丽的少女——）



What joy beyond compare!
What joy beyond compare!（无与伦比的喜悦！）





This was the first verse ever composed. In other words, the Sun-god took over the control of poetry from the Muse, and pretended that he had originated it – a lie that did Japanese poets no good at all.) With that, poetry becomes academic and decays until the Muse chooses to reassert her power in what are called Romantic Revivals.
这是有史以来创作的第一首诗。换言之，太阳神从缪斯手中夺取了诗歌的控制权，并假装自己是诗歌的创造者——这一谎言对日本诗人毫无益处。）至此，诗歌变得学术化并衰落，直到缪斯选择在所谓的浪漫复兴中重申她的权力。

*



In mediaeval poetry the Virgin Mary was plainly identified with the Muse by being put in charge of the Cauldron of Cerridwen. D. W. Nash notes in his edition of the Taliesin poems:
在中世纪诗歌中，圣母玛利亚被明确等同于缪斯——被置于凯丽德温的大锅之位。D. W. 纳什在其塔列辛诗集版本中注释道：

The Christian bards of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries repeatedly refer to the Virgin Mary herself as the cauldron or source of inspiration – to which they were led, as it seems, partly by a play on the word pair, a cauldron, and the secondary form of that word, on assuming the soft form of its initial mair, which also means Mary. Mary was Mair, the mother of Christ, the mystical receptacle of the Holy Spirit, and Pair was the cauldron or receptacle and fountain of Christian inspiration. Thus we have in a poem of Davydd Benfras in the thirteenth century:
十三和十四世纪的基督教吟游诗人反复将圣母玛利亚本人称为大锅或灵感之源——他们之所以如此，似乎部分源于 pair（大锅）一词与其软辅音变体 mair（也意为玛利亚）的文字游戏。玛利亚是 Mair，基督之母，圣灵的神秘容器；而 Pair 是大锅或容器，也是基督教灵感的源泉。因此我们在十三世纪达维德·本弗拉斯的一首诗中看到：



Crist mab Mair am Pair pur vonhedd.



Christ, son of Mary, my cauldron of pure descent.
Christ, son of Mary, my cauldron of pure descent.（基督，玛利亚之子，我纯正血统的大锅。）





In mediaeval Irish poetry Mary was equally plainly identified with Brigit the Goddess of Poetry: for St. Brigit, the Virgin as Muse, was popularly known as ‘Mary of the Gael’. Brigit as a Goddess had been a Triad: the Brigit of Poetry, the Brigit of Healing and the Brigit of Smithcraft. In Gaelic Scotland her symbol was the White Swan, and she was known as Bride of the Golden Hair, Bride of the White Hills, mother of the King of Glory. In the Hebrides she was the patroness of childbirth. Her Aegean prototype seems to have been Brizo of Delos, a moon-goddess to whom votive ships were offered, and whose name was derived by the Greeks from the word brizein, ‘to enchant’. Brigit was much cultivated in Gaul and Britain in Roman times, as numerous dedications to her attest, and in parts of Britain Saint Brigit retained her character of Muse until the Puritan Revolution, her healing powers being exercised largely through poetic incantation at sacred wells. Bridewell, the female penitentiary in London, was originally a nunnery of hers.1
在中世纪爱尔兰诗歌中，玛利亚同样被明确等同于诗歌女神布里吉特：因为圣布里吉特——作为缪斯的圣母——在民间被称为「盖尔人的玛利亚」。作为女神的布里吉特曾是一个三联体：诗歌之布里吉特、治愈之布里吉特和锻造之布里吉特。在盖尔苏格兰她的象征是白天鹅，她被称为金发新娘、白山新娘、荣耀之王之母。在赫布里底群岛她是分娩的守护神。她的爱琴海原型似乎是提洛岛的布里佐——一位月女神，人们向她献祭还愿船只，希腊人将其名派生自 brizein，「施法」。布里吉特在罗马时代的高卢和不列颠广受崇拜，大量献词铭文可证，在不列颠部分地区圣布里吉特保留其缪斯特性直到清教革命，她的治愈之力主要通过在圣井旁以诗歌咒语施展。伦敦的布莱德韦尔女子感化院最初是她的一座修女院。¹

A Cornish invocation to the local Brigit Triad runs:
一首康沃尔当地布里吉特三联体的祈请咒语如下：

Three Ladies came from the East,
Three Ladies came from the East,（三位女士从东方来，）



One with fire and two with frost.
One with fire and two with frost.（一位带着火，两位带着霜。）



Out with thee, fire, and in with thee, frost.
Out with thee, fire, and in with thee, frost.（火出去，霜进来。）





It is a charm against a scald. One dips nine bramble leaves in spring water and then applies them to the scald; the charm must be said three times to each leaf to be effective. For the bramble is sacred both to the Pentad and Triad of seasonal Goddesses, the number of leaves on a single stalk varying between three and five – so that in Brittany and parts of Wales there is a strong taboo on the eating of blackberries. In this charm the Goddesses are clearly seasonal, the Goddess of Summer bringing fire, her sisters bringing frost. A fourth rhyming line is usually added, as a sop to the clergy: In the name of the Father, Son and Holy Ghost.
这是一则治烫伤的咒语。将九片黑莓叶浸入泉水中，然后贴在烫伤处；咒语须对每片叶子念三遍方有效。因为黑莓对季节女神的五联体和三联体都是神圣的，单茎上的叶片数在三到五之间变化——因此在布列塔尼和威尔士部分地区有强烈的食黑莓禁忌。在这则咒语中，女神们显然是季节性的：夏之女神带来火，她的姐妹们带来霜。通常还会加上第四行押韵诗句，作为对教会的敷衍：以父、子、圣灵之名。



The mediaeval Brigit shared the Muse-ship with another Mary, ‘Mary Gipsy’ or St. Mary of Egypt, in whose honour the oath ‘Marry’ or ‘Marry Gyp!’ was sworn. This charming Virgin with the blue robe and pearl necklace was the ancient pagan Sea-goddess Marian in transparent disguise – Marian,1 Miriam, Mariamne (‘Sea Lamb’) Myrrhine, Myrtea, Myrrha,2 Maria or Marina, patroness of poets and lovers and proud mother of the Archer of Love. Robin Hood, in the ballads, always swore by her. She was swarthy-faced, and in a mediaeval Book of the Saints she is recorded to have worked her passage to the Holy Land, where she was to live for years as a desert anchorite, by offering herself as a prostitute to the whole crew of the only vessel sailing there; so, once in Heaven, she showed particular indulgence to carnal sins.
中世纪的布里吉特与另一位玛利亚——「吉普赛玛利亚」或埃及的圣玛利亚——分享缪斯之位，以她之名发誓的誓词「Marry」或「Marry Gyp!」即由此而来。这位迷人的蓝袍珍珠项链圣母是古代异教海女神玛丽安的透明伪装——玛丽安，¹米利暗、玛丽安姆（Mariamne，「海羔羊」）、米里涅、米尔忒亚、没药（Myrrha），²玛丽亚或玛丽娜，诗人和情人的守护神，爱之弓箭手的骄傲母亲。在民谣中罗宾汉总是以她发誓。她面容黝黑，在一部中世纪《圣徒传》中记载她以向唯一一艘驶往圣地的船的全部船员卖淫来赚取旅费，之后在沙漠中隐居多年；因此一旦升入天堂，她对肉欲之罪表现出特别的宽容。

A familiar disguise of this same Marian is the merry-maid, as ‘mermaid’ was once written. The conventional figure of the mermaid – a beautiful woman with a round mirror, a golden comb and a fish-tail – expresses ‘The Love-goddess rises from the Sea’. Every initiate of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which were of Pelasgian origin, went through a love rite with her representative after taking a cauldron bath in Llew Llaw fashion. The round mirror, to match the comb, may be some bygone artist’s mistaken substitute for the quince, which Marian always held in her hand as a love-gift; but the mirror did also form part of the sacred furniture of the Mysteries, and probably stood for ‘know thyself’. The comb was originally a plectrum for plucking lyre-strings. The Greeks called her Aphrodite (‘risen from sea-foam’) and used the tunny, sturgeon, scallop and periwinkle, all sacred to her, as aphrodisiacs. Her most famous temples were built by the sea-side, so it is easy to understand her symbolic fishtail. She can be identified with the Moon-goddess Eurynome whose statue at Phigalia in Arcadia was a mermaid carved in wood. The myrtle, murex and myrrh tree were also everywhere sacred to her; with the palm-tree (which thrives on salt), the love-faithful dove, and the colours white, green, blue and scarlet. Botticelli’s Birth of Venus is an exact icon of her cult. Tall, golden-haired, blue-eyed, pale-faced, the Love-goddess arrives in her scallop-shell at the myrtle-grove, and Earth, in a flowery robe, hastens to wrap her in a scarlet gold-fringed mantle.
