Even the most enlightened and nonattached of souls can turn clannish, bigoted and vengeful if their root surrogate is threatened, although it may be in the name of an apparently freethinking ideology. Instead of the family or the nation, the surrogate might be a spiritual or political philosophy, which then takes on a curiously emotional and compulsive cast. A good example is Marxism in Russia and Eastern Europe, espoused, in theory, to bring enlightenment and freedom to the archaic Hera-like world of the Czar, the Orthodox Church and the rigid Russian social hierarchy. However, Marxism rapidly became a root surrogate of the most suffocating and ruthless kind. The Party unconsciously metamorphosed into the Family, and the prodigal children, whether individual dissidents or recalcitrant countries such as Hungary and Czechoslovakia, were whipped into submission. Psychological dynamics of this kind—what Jung called enantiodromia — occur in both collectives and individuals who utterly reject this facet of the Moon. It may be very necessary for one's psychic (or even physical) survival to part ways with one's racial, religious and social roots, if these roots strangle rather than nourish. But we cannot dismiss the ancestral bedrock with mere intellectual sleight of hand. Until the conflict and its pain are made conscious, someone or something will inevitably replace the lost sense of roots and continuity, and we merely recreate the original dilemma somewhere else.
有时一个人可能觉得自己已经成功地与根脱离了。「啊，我是世界公民，」射手座或水瓶座的人说，「我的家人就是那些与我分享智识和精神价值观的人。」在意识人格层面，这可能确实如此，特别是当木星和天王星在出生盘中很强时。但在更深的层面上，我们没那么容易逃脱 Hera。如果不被承认，月亮的这一面向也会产生强迫性行为模式。如果我们有意识层面拒绝这些价值观，我们的归属需求可能会无意识地寻找根的替代品。即使是最开明、最不执着的灵魂，如果其根的替代品受到威胁，也可能变得宗派化、偏执和复仇心重——尽管可能是以某种看似自由思想意识形态的名义。替代品可能不是家庭或国家，而是一种精神或政治哲学，然后呈现出一种奇异的情感性和强迫性的色彩。一个好例子是俄罗斯和东欧的马克思主义——理论上被采纳，以给沙皇、东正教会和僵化的俄国社会等级制度那个古老的赫拉式世界带来启蒙和自由。然而，马克思主义迅速变成了一种最令人窒息和冷酷的根的替代品。党无意识地变成了家庭，而那些浪子——无论是个体的异见者还是像匈牙利和捷克斯洛伐克这样的不驯服的国家——都被鞭打至服从。荣格所说的enantiodromia（物极必反）——这种心理动态，在完全拒绝月亮这一面向的集体和个人中都会发生。为了心灵（甚至身体）的生存，与自身的种族、宗教和社会根分道扬镳也许非常必要——如果这些根是扼杀而非滋养的话。但我们不能仅凭智识的障眼法就抹去祖先的基石。在冲突及其痛苦被意识到之前，某个人或某种东西必然取代失去的根感和连续感，我们只不过是在别处重演了原来的困境。

It might be interesting to ask yourselves what, in your own lives, provides a sense of family, roots and connection with the past. This may be especially relevant if you have rejected these things on ideological grounds, or if your own family choked rather than nourished you. Often the frustrated Moon inside us tries to create a safe and indestructible family in some other way, through blind clinging to our partners and children, or through equally blind clinging to a job or company. If we lack a feeling of lunar roots inside, we will seek them outside. If this is unconscious, then it may be addictive and imprisoning, and then we cannot understand why we are still stuck in the boring job or the destructive marriage after thirty years when so many other potentials are being stifled. Perhaps we need to develop a genuine appreciation of the positive aspects of our ancestral past and how they might be expressed in our present lives, so that Hera can find a place to be at home.
不妨问问自己，在你们自己的生活中，什么提供了家庭感、根以及与过去的联结。如果你因意识形态理由而拒绝了这些，或者如果你的家庭是扼杀而非滋养你的，这可能特别相关。内在受挫的月亮常常试图以其他方式创造一个安全的、不可摧毁的家庭——通过盲目地依附于伴侣和孩子，或同样盲目地依附于一份工作或公司。如果我们内在缺乏月亮根的感觉，我们就会在外面寻找。如果这是无意识的，那么它可能是上瘾性和囚禁性的，然后我们无法理解为什么三十年后我们仍然困在无聊的工作或破坏性的婚姻中，而如此多的其他潜能正在被扼杀。也许我们需要发展对祖先过去的积极面向的真正欣赏，以及它们如何在我们当下的生活中表达，好让 Hera 能找到一个安身之处。

Audience: I would like to ask about what you called a matriarchal attitude in women—overvaluing the family and feeling the husband is dispensable except as a breadwinner or a sperm donor. Why do some people feel like this? It might be fine for the woman, but I wouldn't like to be the husband.
听众：我想问一下你所说的女性中的母权制态度——过分看重家庭，觉得丈夫除了作为养家糊口的人或精子提供者外可有可无。为什么有些人会有这种感觉？对女性来说也许还好，但我不想做那个丈夫。

Liz: Nor would I; and many men leave such marriages later in life. But often the man is as identified with the matriarchal world as his wife, and he needs to be mothered rather than related to as an individual. This is an archetypal attitude, which I associate with the Moon at its most primitive level. It is intrinsically neither “good” nor “bad.” Some degree of it is healthy and necessary in both men and women, in order to cope with the complexities of family and social life. We must sometimes put the collective before our own self-gratification, which is the very powerful message of environmentalists at the moment. But if one has a bit of an individual self, it can be very lonely and frustrating being the husband of a matriarchal woman or the wife of a matriarchal man (and they do indeed exist), because one's individual value is constantly being undermined and ground down. It is rather like those James Thurber cartoons with giant house-sized women pulling little spindly husbands after them on leads. Nor is it pleasant to be a child in such a matriarchal world; the child is inevitably idealised because the mythic background of the matriarchy is the parthenogenic or self-fertilising goddess. This means that the child is divine, magically engendered, and destined to be its mother's heroic redeemer. That is quite an expectation for a child to live up to, and can lead to many emotional difficulties in adulthood.
Liz：我也不想；许多男性在晚年离开了这样的婚姻。但往往男性与其妻子一样认同于母权制世界，他需要被母亲化而非被当作个体来建立关系。这是一种原型态度，我将其与月亮最原始的层面联系起来。它本身既非「好」也非「坏」。某种程度的这种态度在男女双方中都是健康和必要的，以应对家庭和社会生活的复杂性。有时我们必须将集体置于自我满足之上——这正是环保主义者目前传递的非常有力的信息。但如果一个人有点个体自我，做母权制女性的丈夫或母权制男性（确实存在）的妻子会非常孤独和沮丧，因为一个人的个体价值不断被削弱和磨灭。这有点像那些 James Thurber 的漫画——巨大的房子一样大的女人用狗链拖着瘦小的丈夫走。在这样的母权制世界中做一个孩子也不愉快；孩子不可避免地被理想化，因为母权制的神话背景是孤雌生殖或自我受孕的女神。这意味着孩子是神圣的，被魔术性地孕育，注定成为母亲的英雄救主。这对一个孩子来说是相当高的期望，可能导致成年后的许多情感困难。

I think there are many reasons why any individual woman would fall into such an archaic identification at the expense of other, equally important facets of her personality. Usually the causes lie in her own family background. If a woman has been severely emotionally undernourished in childhood, and is consequently full of anxiety, she may seek her emotional food by unconsciously identifying with the archetypal lunar goddess. Many women try to find the security of the lunar mother inside by embodying her outside. If we feel bereft of something, there are two characteristic human ways of trying to find it: hoping someone else will give it to us, or becoming an exaggerated version of it ourselves.
我认为有很多原因可以解释为什么任何一个女性会以牺牲其他同样重要的人格面向为代价而陷入这种古老的认同。通常原因在于她自己的家庭背景。如果一个女性在童年时期遭受了严重的情感营养不足，因此充满焦虑，她可能会通过无意识地认同原型性的月亮女神来寻求她的情感食物。许多女性试图通过在外在体现月亮女神来寻找内在月亮母亲的安全感。如果我们感到缺少什么，有两种典型的人类方式来试图找到它：希望别人给予我们，或自己成为它的夸张版本。

This is only one possible factor. Often there is great anger toward men because of unrequited love for the father, or a feeling that one's mother has been too powerful and has denied her daughter any feminine potency. Where we feel inadequate, we may try to borrow the magical power of the archetype to compensate for what we experience as a personal lack. The problem is that archetypal power is a fraud, because it is not one's own. If we have not worked to process these energies through the lens of our own individuality, they take us over, and we abdicate all choice and sense of personal responsibility. Hence a woman who is unconsciously identified with the lunar goddess may be deeply voracious and destructive without realising it. If we identify with the gods, we get the whole package, not just the nice bits.
这只是可能的因素之一。通常对男性有极大的愤怒，原因是单恋父亲，或感觉自己的母亲过于强大而否定了女儿任何女性力量。在我们感到不足的地方，我们可能会试图借用原型魔力的力量来补偿我们所体验的个人匮乏。问题在于原型力量是一种欺诈，因为它不是我们自己的。如果我们没有通过自身个体性的透镜来处理这些能量，它们就会占据我们，我们便放弃了所有选择和个人责任感。因此，一个无意识地认同月亮女神的女性可能在深层是贪婪的和破坏性的，自己却没有意识到。如果我们认同了神，我们得到的是整个包箱，不仅仅是美好的部分。

Audience: Can you say something about which Moon signs and aspects Hera might have affinity with?
听众：你能说说赫拉可能与哪些月亮星座和相位有亲和吗？

Liz: The Moon in Capricorn, as well as in Cancer, seems to have affinity with Hera, as does the Moon strongly aspected to Saturn. The Moon in Taurus can also resonate nicely with Hera, because of Taurus's appreciation of stability and traditional values. The Moon placed in all these signs has a well-known resistance to divorce and the breakup of families, and the person will often endure considerable personal unhappiness in order to keep the family structure intact. Anxiety is usually related to the Moon's needs being threatened or frustrated, and the Moon in Capricorn can become very moralistic and controlling in order to cope with the spectre of uprooting. The Moon in Taurus can become stubborn, acquisitive and mean (what Freud called “anal”), and the Moon in Cancer can turn manipulative and pathetic and a bit hysterical. These are all defensive reactions against the loss of roots. When the Moon's needs are being met sufficiently, the best qualities of these signs show themselves—Capricorn's deep sense of responsibility and care for others, Cancer's profound compassion and emotional empathy, Taurus's serenity and gentleness and patience. This is Hera as a beneficent deity, protector of women and young children and guardian of the home.
Liz：月亮在摩羯座以及巨蟹座似乎与赫拉有亲和，月亮与土星形成强相位亦然。月亮在金牛座也能与赫拉很好地共鸣，因为金牛座对稳定性和传统价值观的欣赏。月亮在这些星座中的任何一个都对离婚和家庭破裂有着众所周知的抵抗，当事人往往会忍受相当大的个人痛苦以保持家庭结构的完整。焦虑通常与月亮的需求被威胁或受挫有关，月亮在摩羯座为了应对连根拔起的幽灵可能变得非常说教和控制。月亮在金牛座可能变得固执、贪得无厌和小气（弗洛伊德所说的「肛门期」），月亮在巨蟹座可能变得操纵、可怜和有点歇斯底里。这些都是对失去根的防御反应。当月亮的需求得到充分满足时，这些星座的最佳品质就会展现——摩羯座对他人深厚的责任感和关怀，巨蟹座深刻的同情心和情感共鸣，金牛座的宁静、温柔和耐心。这就是赫拉作为仁慈的女神——女性和幼儿的保护者、家庭的守护者。

Audience: You mentioned other planets in strong aspect to the Moon showing an affinity with different mythic figures. Can you say something about the outer planets in conjunction with the Moon? Are the personal needs of the Moon less important for someone in that case?
听众：你提到其他行星与月亮形成强相位时显示出与不同神话人物的亲和。你能说说外行星与月亮合相的情况吗？在这种情况下月亮的个人需求就不那么重要了吗？

Liz: I would like to leave a detailed analysis of the Moon's aspects to Howard as he will be interpreting them in depth later. But in general, the Moon does not lose its importance for us, regardless of what natal aspects from other planets are involved. Another planet introduces additional and sometimes conflicting components to the Moon's basic needs and mode of expression. But the Moon remains the Moon, the primal substance on which the personality is built, because it describes our capacity to mother ourselves.
Liz：月亮的相位的详细分析我想留给 Howard，他稍后会深入解读它们。但总体而言，月亮对我们不会失去其重要性，无论涉及哪些来自其他行星的出生相位。另一颗行星会向月亮的基本需求和表达方式引入额外的、有时是冲突的成分。但月亮仍然是月亮——人格建立的原始基质，因为它描述了我们自我滋养的能力。

The outer planets may challenge the Moon's more mundane ways of expressing itself. This is particularly true of Uranus. If you have Uranus in aspect to the Moon, you will need to include Ura-nian values in your lunar expression; and if it is a hard aspect, this may complicate matters when it comes to feeling content within a traditional family structure, or identifying with life as portrayed in Coronation Street. But there are many Uranian spheres of life where the Moon can still find its sense of belonging and continuity. For example, aspects between the Moon and Uranus are traditionally associated with the study of astrology and other New Age subjects. The feeling of connection with an orderly and predictable cosmos, and the recognition of common needs which link all human beings, might provide the sort of “family” which is not desirable or possible on the more ordinary level. In effect, astrology, with its long history and absolute dependability, becomes a kind of heavenly Great Mother. Remember the statue of Artemis of Ephesus, with the zodiac carved around her neck? With Moon-Uranus, a sense of roots and family can be found in the safety of the Great Round, which might explain why these studies are so fulfilling for Moon-Uranus people.
外行星可能会挑战月亮更为世俗的表达方式。天王星尤其如此。如果你的天王星与月亮形成相位，你需要在你的月亮表达中纳入天王星的价值观；如果是硬相位，这可能会在传统家庭结构中感到满足或认同像《加冕街》那样描绘的生活方面使事情复杂化。但天王星有许多生活领域可以让月亮仍然找到其归属感和连续感。例如，月亮与天王星的相位传统上与占星学和其他新时代学科的研究相关。与一个有序且可预测的宇宙的联系感，以及对联结所有人类的共同需求的认知，可能提供了那种在更普通层面上不可取或不可能的「家庭」。实际上，占星学以其悠久的历史和绝对的可靠性，成为了一种天上的大母神。还记得以弗所 Artemis 雕像脖子上雕刻着黄道带吗？月亮-天王星配置可以在大循环的安全中找到根和家庭的感觉，这可能解释了为什么这些研究对月亮-天王星的人如此有满足感。

Audience: Could a certain kind of partnership affect the way the Moon is expressed in one's own chart?
听众：某种特定的伴侣关系是否会影响月亮在自己星盘中的表达方式？

Liz: Certainly. If your partner has planets strongly aspecting your Moon, then he or she will activate your lunar side very powerfully. This may not always be comfortable, but it can always be productive in some way, since it can help you to become more conscious of just what your Moon needs. For example, you might have the Moon in Leo opposed to Saturn in Aquarius and embedded in a very rational and self-controlled earth-air type of chart. This fiery Moon, the playful divine child who needs regular doses of joy and drama, may have been sadly ignored or repressed. Or maybe that Leo Moon is tucked away in the 12th house, and the family has covertly communicated the message that it is wrong to be selfish and individualistic. Then someone comes along with Venus in Leo conjuncting your Moon, and you feel as if for the first time in your life you can be yourself. He or she validates your need for fun and romance and self-expression, and on the emotional level you feel supported and nourished and valued.
Liz：当然。如果你的伴侣有行星与你的月亮形成强相位，那么他或她会非常有力地激活你的月亮面向。这可能不总是舒服的，但总是可以在某些方面有所产出，因为它可以帮助你更加意识到你的月亮需要什么。例如，你可能月亮在狮子座对冲水瓶座土星，嵌入一个非常理性和克制的土-风型星盘中。这颗火热的月亮——那个需要定期剂量的欢乐和戏剧的调皮的神圣儿童——可能被可悲地忽视或压抑了。或者也许那颗狮子座月亮躲在第十二宫里，家庭暗暗传递了自私和个人主义是错误的信息。然后某人带着狮子座金星合相你的月亮出现了，你觉得仿佛人生中第一次可以做你自己。他或她验证了你对趣味、浪漫和自我表达的需求，在情感层面上你感到被支持、被滋养和被重视。

Equally, if someone else enters your life with Saturn in Taurus in square to your Moon, you will also become much more aware of your Leonine emotional needs. But you may discover them through being constantly criticised for your selfishness and irresponsibility. Even if you have repressed your Leonine side, your partner's Saturn will be sure to spot it anyway, and remind you of it ad nauseam. Being told you should not be what you are is one sure way of discovering how important it is to you. You may have to fight for your Moon in such a case, or even ultimately let go of the relationship, but it will teach you what you require as essential food, through having that food denied you. We all learn a great deal about the Moon from our interaction with others. The cross-aspects to the Moon between two charts produce “gut” responses within a relationship which are not always conscious but which determine whether we feel contented and secure with that person. If the Moon is not strongly aspected by another person's planets, or is badly blocked by them, the relationship may be very valid and important, but it may not feed us on the instinctual level. We must then either find other outlets for the Moon, or find another partner. Most relationships can take a lot of pounding from other difficult planetary cross-aspects if the two Moons are mutually supported to some extent. If not, there may be deep feelings of discontent and unease, and if there is no consciousness of the problem, the stifled Moon may generate very destructive emotional situations within the relationship.
同样，如果另一个人带着金牛座土星四分你的月亮进入你的生活，你也会更加意识到你的狮子座情感需求。但你可能是通过不断被批评自私和不负责任来发现它们的。即使你压抑了你的狮子座面，你伴侣的土星也一定会发现它，并让你烦不胜烦。被告知你不应该做你自己是发现它对你有多重要的一种可靠方式。在这种情况下，你可能必须为你的月亮而战，甚至最终放弃这段关系，但它会通过拒绝你所需的基本食物来教会你你需要什么。我们所有人都通过与他人的互动中学到很多关于月亮的东西。两张星盘之间对月亮的交叉相位产生了关系中的「直觉」反应，这些反应不总是有意识的，但决定了我们是否与那个人在一起感到满足和安全。如果月亮没有被另一人的行星强相位，或被它们严重阻碍，这段关系可能非常有效和重要，但在本能层面上可能不滋养我们。我们然后要么为月亮找到其他出口，要么找到另一个伴侣。如果两个月亮在某种程度上相互支持，大多数关系可以承受来自其他困难行星交叉相位的很多打击。如果不是，可能会有深深的不满和不安感，如果没有对问题的意识，受压抑的月亮可能在关系内部产生非常破坏性的情感局面。

Audience: Then is it inevitable that a relationship where there are bad cross-aspects to your Moon will go wrong?
听众：那么与月亮有不良交叉相位的伴侣关系是否注定会出问题？

Liz: No, it is not inevitable that it will go wrong. It is inevitable that one's Moon cannot be repressed without consequences. Some conscious understanding is needed of what the difficulty is really about. The more we know how to nourish ourselves, the less resentful we are likely to be when someone else is not doing the feeding in exactly the way we might like. Because the Moon is a reflection of the instinctual nature, it is essentially inarticulate, and one often does not know that one is unhappy, or why. The Moon tends to produce moods and vapours and little illnesses if we are not conscious of our needs. Moods and vapours and compulsive behaviour are not a lot of help to an ailing relationship. It is ultimately up to each of us to form some basis of connection with our own Moon, so that we can articulate to a partner why we are unhappy, or find other outlets which compensate for what the partner might not be able to provide.
Liz：不，并非注定出问题。注定的是一个人的月亮不能被压抑而不产生后果。需要对困难到底是什么有一些有意识的理解。我们越知道如何滋养自己，当别人不以我们可能恰好喜欢的方式喂养我们时，我们就越不可能怨恨。因为月亮是本能天性的反映，它本质上是无言的，一个人往往不知道自己不开心，或为什么。如果我们不够意识到自己的需求，月亮倾向于产生情绪、忧郁和小毛病。情绪、忧郁和强迫行为对一段生病的关系没有多大帮助。最终由我们每个人来建立与自己月亮的某种联结基础，以便我们能向伴侣表达为什么我们不开心，或找到补偿伴侣可能无法提供之物的其他出口。

Now I would like to leave our mythic diagram behind and look at the issue of the personal mother in relation to the Moon; then we can begin to explore the Moon in the different signs and houses of the chart. The Moon tells us a great deal about the earliest weeks and months of childhood, because it is the personal mother who first mediates the archetype of the lunar Great Mother for us, and embodies or incarnates particular dimensions of that archetype. We “internalise” these particular characteristics as part of our own developing psychic structure because the personal mother not only enacts them; she also carries the projection of something within ourselves. So this primal relationship will set the tone for how we later relate to the Moon inwardly. No lunar configuration describes a “bad” mother. But some configurations describe energies which might inevitably be difficult for any mother to express in her role as mother—energies which are, in effect, innately incompatible with the needs of the Moon—and she might not have handled it very well. Then it is up to us to do something more constructive with the same archetypal issue. Astrology has a strange way of describing things which are both objective and subjective, inner and outer; and the Moon is not just a subjective picture of our image of mother. It also describes important qualities which the mother actually possesses, albeit sometimes repressed, so it is a kind of shared substance which describes both mother and child as well as the dynamic of the early relationship.
现在我想把神话图谱放在一边，看看个人母亲与月亮的关系问题；然后我们可以开始探索月亮在星盘不同星座和宫位中的表现。月亮告诉了我们很多关于童年最初几周和几个月的事情，因为是个人母亲首先为我们中介了月亮大母神的原型，并体现或化身了该原型的特定面向。我们「内化」了这些特定特征作为自身发展中的心理结构的一部分，因为个人母亲不仅扮演了这些特征；她还携带了我们自身内在之物的投射。因此，这段原始关系将为我们后来如何内在地与月亮关联定下基调。没有任何月亮配置描述一个「坏」母亲。但有些配置描述了任何母亲在其母亲角色中都难以避免地难以表达的能量——本质上与月亮的需求先天不合的能量——而她可能处理得不太好。然后由我们对同一个原型问题做一些更具建设性的事情。占星学有一种描述既客观又主观、既内在又外在之物的奇特方式；月亮不仅仅是我们母亲形象的主观画面。它还描述了母亲实际上拥有的重要品质——尽管有时是被压抑的——因此它是一种共享的物质，描述了母亲和孩子以及早期关系的动态。

For example, your Moon might be in Gemini, and this could reflect qualities of intellectual curiosity, restlessness, aesthetic appreciation, and a need for constant social interchange. These qualities might apply to both your mother and yourself. So far, so good —your Moon in Gemini is best nourished by having these particular needs met, and in an ideal world your mother will be just the right person to do it because she shares this aspect of your nature. One might imagine a lively, sparkling mother reading fairy tales and telling stories to her lively, sparkling child, taking the child on exciting journeys, encouraging the best schooling, and so on. Maybe such a mother is not the most domestic of creatures, but a child with the Moon in Gemini doesn't need a cordon bleu cook and resident nurse anyway. This child needs someone who will offer lunar safety and security through listening and communicating.
例如，你的月亮可能在双子座，这可能反映了求知欲、不安分、审美欣赏以及不断社交往来的需求。这些品质可能同时适用于你的母亲和你自己。到目前为止一切顺利——你的双子座月亮最好通过满足这些特定需求来滋养，在理想的世界里你的母亲恰好是做这件事的合适人选，因为她分享了你本性的这一面向。可以想象一位活泼、光彩照人的母亲给同样活泼、光彩照人的孩子读童话故事、讲故事，带孩子去令人兴奋的旅行，鼓励最好的学校教育等等。也许这样的母亲不是最有家庭气息的生物，但双子座月亮的孩子反正不需要蓝带厨师和驻家护士。这个孩子需要的是通过倾听和交流提供月亮安全和保障的人。

But what if your mother could not express her own Mercurial qualities, or could only enact them in a negative way? What if she did not even know she had such potentials? In that case she is hardly going to respond warmly to her Mercurial child's lunar needs, and may even become resentful and impatient with the child's natural inquisitiveness and restlessness because of her own frustration. You might find a configuration in your chart such as Saturn in Virgo in square to that Moon in Gemini. This could suggest that an overdeveloped sense of duty, a horror of losing her security, and a fear of what the Great They might think, combined to stifle your mother's natural sparkle, because she was too afraid of appearing flighty or callous or a “bad” mother, or too burdened with responsibilities to have time for Geminian play. Inevitably you will internalise this dilemma, and experience a conflict between your lunar needs and what you think the world expects of you. The Moon square Saturn is a problem which you share with your mother, and it is not very helpful to blame her for being critical, duty-bound and uninterested in your emotional requirements. Probably she was emotionally rejecting in some fundamental way, despite her conscious efforts. But the chances are that, as an adult, it is you who are failing to find a workable internal balance between self-nourishment and collective demands, because you have internalised her conflict and are now treating yourself as she once treated herself and you.
但如果你的母亲不能表达她自己的水星特质，或者只能以负面的方式体现呢？如果她甚至不知道自己有这样的潜能？在那种情况下，她几乎不会热情地回应她水星孩子的月亮需求，甚至可能因为自己的挫折而对孩子天生的好奇心和不安分感到怨恨和不耐烦。你可能会在星盘中发现这样的配置：处女座土星四分双子座月亮。这可能暗示着一种过度发达的责任感、对失去安全感的恐惧、以及对「大家会怎么想」的恐惧，这些结合在一起扼杀了你母亲天生的光彩，因为她太害怕显得轻浮或冷漠或一个「坏」母亲，或者负担太重无暇顾及双子式的玩乐。你不可避免地会内化这个困境，并体验到你的月亮需求与你认为世界对你的期望之间的冲突。月亮四分土星是你与母亲共享的问题，责怪她挑剔、尽责和对你情感需求不感兴趣是没什么帮助的。很可能她在某些根本方面是情感拒绝的，尽管她有意识的努力。但很可能，作为成年人，是你没有在自我滋养和集体要求之间找到可行的内在平衡，因为你已经内化了她的冲突，现在像她曾经对待自己和对待你那样对待你自己。

Thus the Moon-Saturn aspect tells you something important about your mother, and what might have been a prime source of her own depression or frustration. It also tells you that there was probably an early climate of emotional coolness and alienation in your relationship with her, even if her outward behaviour seemed dutiful and self-sacrificing. But most importantly, it tells you that you might be beating up your own Moon with your own Saturn in adult life. Or the reverse might be the case—perhaps you are wallowing in the Moon's dependency and hunger at the expense of Saturnian self-sufficiency. Recognising the inner conflict permits the possibility of change and freedom from the harsher effects of this configuration, because you can work toward a better balance if you can take responsibility for your feelings of emotional deprivation. No one else can do it for you now.
因此，月-土相位告诉你关于你母亲的一些重要事情，以及什么可能是她自身抑郁或挫折的主要根源。它还告诉你，在你与她的关系中可能存在早期的情感冷淡和疏离气氛，即使她的外在行为看起来是尽责和自我牺牲的。但最重要的是，它告诉你在成年生活中可能正在用自己的土星打击自己的月亮。或者反过来也可能是——也许你正以月亮的依赖和饥饿而沉溺于土星的自我牺牲为代价。认识到内在冲突就允许了改变和从该配置更严酷效果中解放的可能性，因为如果你能为自己的情感剥夺感承担责任，你就可以朝更好的平衡努力。现在没有别人能替你做到这一点。

The mythic images which we explored earlier belong both to our mothers and ourselves. These images can help us to understand the particular archetypal background to our emotional needs, and also the mythic themes operating within the early mother-child relationship. Lunar aspects offer incredibly rich insights about our infancy, and from the psychological point of view they can be of great help in shedding light on problems such as chronic anxiety and compulsive behaviour. The Moon can be read as a history book, telling us about important physical and emotional experiences in the earliest months of life according to the timing of applying and separating lunar aspects. But I think we must look at both the mundane and the mythic levels of the mother-child relationship when we interpret the Moon, so that we can understand its creative possibilities as well as its record of past hurts.
我们早先探索的神话意象既属于我们的母亲也属于我们自己。这些意象可以帮助我们理解情感需求的特定原型背景，以及早期母子关系中运作的神话主题。月亮相位提供了关于我们婴儿期的极其丰富的洞察，从心理学的角度来看，它们在阐明慢性焦虑和强迫行为等问题方面可以提供很大帮助。月亮可以被当作一本历史书来读，告诉我们根据出入相位的时序关于生命最初几个月中重要的身体和情感经验。但我认为在解读月亮时，我们必须同时审视母子关系的世俗层面和神话层面，以便我们理解它的创造性可能性以及它对过去创伤的记录。

The mythic tale described by lunar signs and aspects is one which has been embedded in the family psyche for generations. One passes these things down to one's children and grandchildren. Frequently a man will marry a woman who carries a similar lunar configuration to his own, because many men act out these mother issues through their female partners and female children. It is always fascinating to see how repeating lunar patterns appear in the horoscopes of most, if not all, of the individuals belonging to the same family group. The instinctual needs of the family, embodying a particular archetypal theme, will seek fulfilment through all the members, taking more destructive forms according to the degree of unconsciousness and repression present in the family. Working with lunar issues really means working on family substance. As these dilemmas pass down, each succeeding generation has a fresh opportunity to find resolutions which the previous one could not. In this way, by working to resolve lunar conflicts, we redeem the past.
月亮相位和星座所描述的神话故事是嵌入家庭心理数代人之久的故事。人将这些东西传给自己的孩子和孙辈。一个男人经常会娶一个携带与自己相似月亮配置的女性，因为许多男性通过女性伴侣和女性孩子来扮演这些母亲议题。看到重复的月亮模式出现在属于同一个家庭群体的大多数（如果不是全部）个体的星盘中，总是令人着迷的。家庭的本能需求，体现着特定的原型主题，将通过所有成员寻求实现，根据家庭中存在的无意识和压抑程度采取更具破坏性的形式。处理月亮议题实际上意味着处理家庭基质。随着这些困境传下来，每一代都有新的机会找到上一代无法找到的解决方案。这样，通过努力解决月亮冲突，我们救赎了过去。

When we interpret the Moon in relation to the personal mother, we need to take nonastrological factors into account, such as collective expectations within the particular generation and social group to which she belonged. A mother who is the child of poor immigrants, for example, may grow up with profound anxieties which effectively paralyse her capacity to take risks in life, and these very legitimate problems must be taken into account if we are to get a truthful picture of our psychological inheritance. The Moon square Saturn may describe a mother who is emotionally withholding because of a deep flaw in her character; but it may also describe a mother who started out warmhearted but was so crushed by material hardship that she could not help herself. We also need to bear basic psychological mechanisms in mind, such as the fact that a mother who is by nature independent and spirited may find the role of mothering difficult for perfectly justifiable reasons; and children do, after all, want nothing less than everything.
当我们在与个人母亲的关系中解读月亮时，需要考虑非占星学因素，例如她所属于的特定代际和社会群体中的集体期望。例如，一个母亲是贫穷移民的孩子，可能在成长过程中怀有深刻的焦虑，实际上瘫痪了她承担人生风险的能力，如果我们想要真实地了解我们的心理遗产，就必须考虑这些非常合理的问题。月亮四分土星可能描述了一位因性格中深刻缺陷而情感退缩的母亲；但也可能描述了一位本热心肠却被物质困难压垮而无法自助的母亲。我们还需要记住基本的心理机制，例如天性独立和有活力的母亲可能发现母亲角色有完全正当的理由而难以胜任；而孩子们毕竟想要的不过是一切。

If we look at this latter issue, we might make a broad generalisation that the Moon in the masculine signs, especially if aspecting dynamic planets such as Mars or Uranus, implies an inevitable dilemma. A mother who is represented by such a lunar configuration will inevitably suffer conflict simply by the act of mothering. Although this ought to be obvious, we often overlook such a simple truth because we are so aggrieved by our own sense of deprivation. How could such a woman, with the archetypal image of the untamed Mistress of Beasts alive within her, be wholly contented sitting at home and nursing you? Or we might consider the Moon in Scorpio. This placement, as I have mentioned, has considerable affinity with mythic figures such as Hekate and Circe. There is a powerful erotic component in these sorceress-women, and it may be difficult to reconcile such sexual intensity and passion, even if it is unconscious, with the role of mother—particularly if she has a daughter who begins to grow into a rival. So if you are a woman with the Moon in Scorpio, the component of sexual jealousy may very well be part of your childhood relationship with your mother. This is not “pathological”; it is just a fact of life. A passionate woman will not enjoy sharing her husband's emotional energy with a pubescent and erotically competitive daughter. And this kind of dilemma is usually deeply unconscious, because we are not taught anything about the Plutonian level of family life. No moral judgements are appropriate here. But in adulthood, if your Moon is in Scorpio, you may need to find the honesty to face the emotional undercurrents of your childhood so that you do not inadvertantly repeat the same mistakes.
如果我们看后一个问题，可以做一个大致概括：月亮在男性星座，特别是如果与火星或天王星等动态行星形成相位，意味着不可避免的困境。由这样的月亮配置所代表的母亲，仅仅通过母亲的行为就不可避免地会遭受冲突。虽然这本应该显而易见，但我们经常忽视这样简单的真理，因为我们对自身剥夺感如此愤怒。这样一个女性——内在活着未驯服的野兽女主人的原型形象——怎么可能完全满足地坐在家里哺育你？或者我们考虑月亮在天蝎座。这个位置，正如我提到的，与 Hekate 和 Circe 等神话人物有相当大的亲和。这些女巫-女性身上有强大的情欲成分，这种性的强度和激情——即使是潜意识的——可能很难与母亲角色调和，特别是如果她有一个开始成长为竞争对手的女儿。所以如果你是一个月亮在天蝎座的女性，性嫉妒的成分很可能是你与母亲童年关系的一部分。这不是「病态」；这只是生活的一个事实。一个充满激情的女性不会享受与一个青春期、性竞争的女儿分享丈夫的情感能量。而这种困境通常是深深无意识的，因为我们没有被教导任何关于家庭生活的冥王星层面。这里不适合做道德判断。但在成年后，如果你的月亮在天蝎座，你可能需要找到勇气面对童年情感暗流，以便不会无意中重犯同样的错误。

Such characteristic scenarios are present with every Moon placement. They are simply dimensions of the particular archetypal pattern at work in one's early life. Probably we all need to go through phases where we are furious about what has been done to us in childhood, for loyalty to self sometimes must begin with righteous anger; and there is no such thing as a mother who gets it wholly right. This is particularly the case if idealisation of the mother has protected us from facing our early hurts. But at the other end of the tunnel of anger and blame, it is essential to recognise that lunar substance is shared between mother and child, so that we can really forgive and move on. This shared substance may not be the Moon's most benign, nurturing face. It may be wild and unpredictable, or deep and subtle. As we have seen, the Moon is not always comfortably maternal. Demeter is one of the most reassuring of lunar deities, yet even Demeter is capable of scorching the earth and blighting the crops when her daughter loses her virginity. We may need to redefine that word “maternal” in order to understand the Moon. The lunar goddesses have sex with their sons and eat their children and do all sorts of things which one does not usually find in the Stephen Spielberg portrayal of family life. Yet they all faithfully reflect the different phases of the Moon.
每个月亮位置都有这些特征性场景。它们只是在一个人早期生活中运作的特定原型模式的不同面向。也许我们都需要经历对童年所受之事愤怒的阶段，因为对自我的忠诚有时必须始于义愤；而世上不存在一个完全正确的母亲。如果对母亲的理想化保护了我们免于面对早期创伤，情况尤其如此。但在愤怒和责备的隧道尽头，认识到月亮物质在母子之间共享是至关重要的，这样我们才能真正原谅并继续前行。这种共享物质可能不是月亮最温和、最滋养的面孔。它可能是狂野和不可预测的，或深沉和微妙的。正如我们所见，月亮并不总是舒适地母性的。Demeter 是最令人安心的月神之一，但即使是 Demeter，当她的女儿失去贞操时也能焦土千里、使庄稼枯萎。我们可能需要重新定义「母性的」这个词才能理解月亮。月亮女神们与儿子做爱、吃掉自己的孩子，做着各种在斯皮尔伯格描绘的家庭生活中通常不会看到的事情。然而她们都忠实地反映了月亮的不同阶段。

Now I would like to explore the Moon's signs and houses by starting with Chart 1 (see page 32). The Moon in this chart reflects several of the archetypal dilemmas I have just been talking about. It has no major aspects, and is placed in a fire sign (Aries) in a fiery house (the 9th). It is thus a highly combustible Moon, but unrelated to any other planet in the chart, although it forms a trine with the Ascendant. Let me give you a few details about Julian's family background first, and then we can see what the Moon might have to say about his history and his present difficulties.
现在我想从图表1（见第32页）开始探索月亮的星座和宫位。这张星盘中的月亮反映了刚才我谈到的几个原型困境。它没有主要相位，位于一个火象星座（白羊座）的一个火象宫位（第九宫）。因此它是一颗高度易燃的月亮，但与星盘中任何其他行星无关，尽管它与上升点形成三分相。让我先告诉你们一些关于 Julian 家庭背景的细节，然后我们可以看看月亮可能对他的历史和目前的困难有什么话说。

Julian is the son of a much-published and highly respected Cambridge professor of Classics. Now those of you who are familiar with the typical “Oxbridge” mentality might recognise that the Moon in Aries, along with the Sun in Aries conjunct Mars and a Leo Ascendant thrown in just to fan the flames, is not the most convenient thing to have if one's father is an aloof, intellectual and impeccably controlled sort of personality. Nor is Mercury square Jupiter and conjunct Saturn and Chiron altogether helpful if one is expected to follow in the paternal footsteps and become an Oxbridge scholar. I am not suggesting that Julian's father is the “villain of the piece.” But before we explore the lunar issues in this chart, we can already surmise that Julian, with his self-willed, fiery, dramatic temperament and his intuitive, undisciplined mind, has been born into an environment which may not be altogether sympathetic to his essential nature. This does not have to be a negative thing. But it can easily mean trouble, as part of the archetypal journey of a man with the Sun in Aries concerns rivalry with the father.
Julian 是一位著作等身、备受尊敬的剑桥古典学教授的儿子。你们中熟悉典型「牛津剑桥」心态的人可能认识到，月亮在白羊座，加上太阳在白羊座合相火星，再加上一个狮子座上升点来煽风点火——如果一个人的父亲是一个超然、学术、无可挑剔地克制的性格，这并不是最方便的配置。水星四分木星，合相土星和凯龙星，如果一个人被期望追随父亲的脚步成为牛剑学者，也不是完全有利的。我不是说 Julian 的父亲是「这出戏的反派」。但在我们探索这张星盘中的月亮议题之前，我们已经可以推测，Julian 凭其任性的、火热的、戏剧性的气质和直觉式的、不够自律的心智，出生在一个可能对他的本质天性并不完全同情的环境中。这不一定是件坏事。但它很容易意味着麻烦，因为太阳在白羊座的男人的原型旅程的一部分涉及与父亲的竞争。

With this broader background in mind, let's consider the Moon in Aries. Does this placement suggest any particular mythic images to you?
带着这个更广泛的背景，让我们考虑月亮在白羊座。这个位置让你们想到什么神话意象吗？

Audience: It makes me think of the Lady of the Beasts whom you mentioned, very fiery and wild.
听众：让我想到你提到的野兽女主人，非常火热和狂野。

听众：迈纳德怎么样？我总觉得白羊座月亮有一种非常不受控制的东西。

Liz: I think both these images are very appropriate. The Moon brings out an instinctual, irrational level of Aries, very different from the Sun's conscious initiative and leadership. It is indeed the wild, combustible dimension of the sign, raw, touchy and full of life. There is a lot of the Amazon in this Moon, the warrior woman who loves the ecstasy of battle. Liz：我认为这两个意象都非常合适。月亮激发了白羊座一种本能的、非理性的层面，与太阳的有意识的主动性和领导力非常不同。它确实是该星座的狂野、易燃的维度——原始的、敏感的、充满生命力的。这个月亮中有很多亚马逊人的特质——热爱战斗狂喜的女战士。我觉得你对迈纳德的评论也很敏锐，因为正如我之前提到的，这个词来自与「疯狂」相同的希腊词根。你们会看到随着我继续下去，这有多么贴切。

The Moon in Aries is very hot and passionate, like the Egyptian lioness-headed Sekhmet, goddess of battles, or the lionesses who accompany the ancient Anatolian Lady of the Beasts. Julian's mother had many of these qualities. Although he does not remember his early childhood at all well, he says that, before the accident which crippled her when he was 8, she was lively, “bossy,” and had a dreadful temper. He recalls frequent rows between his parents, where his father became coldly cutting and contemptuously reasonable while his mother became so enraged that she actually foamed at the mouth. Yet he has a positive memory of her despite this unattractive picture, describing her as “exciting” and “never dull.” He never felt emotionally close to her (this perhaps reflects the Moon's lack of aspects as well as its Amazonian nature), but she made a tremendous impression on him with the force of her personality. Then, when he was 8 years old, everything changed in a horrible way.
月亮在白羊座非常火热和充满激情，就像埃及的狮头女神 Sekhmet——战争女神，或陪伴古代安纳托利亚野兽女主人的母狮们。Julian 的母亲有许多这些品质。虽然他不记得自己的早期童年，但他说在8岁时那场使她致残的事故之前，她是活泼的、「专横的」、脾气暴躁。他记得父母之间频繁的争吵——父亲变得冷冷的刻薄和轻蔑地理性，而母亲变得如此暴怒以至于口吐白沫。然而，尽管这幅不雅的画面，他对她有正面的记忆，描述她为「令人兴奋的」和「从不无聊」。他从未感到与她有情感上的亲近（这可能反映了月亮缺乏相位以及其亚马逊本性），但她个性的力量给他留下了深刻印象。然后，在他8岁时，一切都以一种可怕的方式改变了。

It seems that Julian's mother and father were having one of their flaming rows, and had left the bedroom to continue matters at the top of the stairs. Julian was reading a book in the sitting room below, and saw his mother lash out and slap his father in the face. She then lost her balance, stumbled, and proceeded to fall down the stairs, landing in an unconscious heap literally at Julian's feet. The injuries to her spine left her permanently confined to a wheelchair. The change in her personality struck Julian as even more horrible than her paralysis, since she became quiet, polite and formal, retreating to some isolated inner world which excluded both husband and son, and leaving both with an appalling sense of guilt. Julian cannot help blaming his father most of all, although he has tried to approach the trauma with the reasonable view that, horrific though it was, the episode was nevertheless an accident. But the repercussions on Julian have been as complex and tragic as the event itself.
似乎 Julian 的父母正在又一次激烈的争吵中，他们离开卧室到楼梯顶继续。Julian 正在下面的客厅读书，看到母亲甩手扇了父亲一巴掌。然后她失去平衡，踉跄了一下，从楼梯上摔了下来，正好落在 Julian 脚边，不省人事。她的脊椎受伤使她永久性地困在轮椅上。她个性的变化对 Julian 来说比她的瘫痪更加可怕，因为她变得安静、礼貌和正式，退缩到某个孤立的内心世界，排斥了丈夫和儿子，给他们留下了可怕的负罪感。Julian 不由自主地最责怪父亲，尽管他试图以理性的态度来面对创伤——虽然可怕，但这终究是一场意外。但这对 Julian 的反响和事件本身一样复杂而悲惨。

This is a rather dark tale, redolent of Greek family curses; but Julian is afflicted with a rather dark problem which could have come straight from Aeschylus. He is a manic depressive, and like a great many manic depressives he is kept within reasonable bounds of behaviour by lithium. The symptoms began to show themselves just after Julian went through puberty, and have run their sad cycle many times since then; and they are typical of most manic depressives. Sometimes Julian feels grounded and sane, but then he begins to “go high.” Despite the lithium (which can only temper, not eradicate, the emotional fluctuations) he alternates between severe, suicidal depressions and states of manic flight where he becomes like a maenad. In these states he is capable of climbing to the tops of buildings and shouting abuse at people; he believes he will live forever; he enters a kind of ecstatic trance where he knows everything and can penetrate all mysteries and possesses the answers to all the ultimate questions. He generally winds up being hospitalised, since sooner or later some offended person rings the police; and, once quieted in hospital by stronger medication, shows great reluctance to leave and resume a life in the world. His mother has never visited him in hospital, although he asks for her every time. But eventually he finds his feet and comes out, and then the cycle starts all over again.
这是一个相当阴暗的故事，散发着希腊家族诅咒的气息；但 Julian 受困于一个相当阴暗的问题，仿佛直接出自埃斯库罗斯。他是一个躁郁症患者，像许多躁郁症患者一样，他靠锂盐维持在合理的行为范围内。症状在他进入青春期后开始显现，此后已经经历了多次可悲的循环；它们是大多数躁郁症患者的典型表现。有时 Julian 感到踏实和清醒，但随后他开始「高升」。尽管锂盐（只能调节而非根除情绪波动）他交替经历严重的、自杀性的抑郁和躁狂飞升状态——他变得像一个迈纳德。在这些状态中，他能够爬到建筑物的顶部对人破口大骂；他相信自己会永生；他进入一种狂喜的恍惚，知道一切、能穿透所有奥秘、拥有所有终极问题的答案。他最终总是被送进医院，因为迟早某个被冒犯的人报了警；一旦在医院被更强的药物镇静后，他极不情愿离开和恢复世间的正常生活。他的母亲从未去医院看过他，尽管他每次都要求她来。但最终他找到立足点出院，然后循环又重新开始。

The hot passion of the Moon in Aries is very evident in Julian's manic episodes, as well as the global philosophical perspective of its placement in the 9th house. This Moon, being unaspected, erupts in a pure, archetypal way, uncoloured by any other planet. It is a disturbing example of what can happen when an unaspected planet, which is usually disconnected from the ego, breaks through into consciousness. It has a way of taking over for a time, like a kind of possession. Julian himself disappears, and there is nothing but a pure, archaic Moon in Aries in the 9th house for the time that his manic episodes last. Then, when he crashes, the Moon drops into the unconscious again, and he is left bereft, lonely, guilty and ashamed.
月亮在白羊座的热烈激情在 Julian 的躁狂发作中非常明显，以及其在第九宫的全局性哲学视角。这颗月亮因为无相位，以一种纯粹的、原型的方式爆发，不受任何其他行星的染色。这是一个令人不安的例子——当一颗通常与自我脱节的无相位行星突破进入意识时会发生什么。它有一种暂时接管的方式，就像一种附身。Julian 本人在躁狂发作期间消失了，只剩下纯粹的、古老的月亮在白羊座第九宫。然后，当他崩溃时，月亮又沉回无意识，他被遗弃——孤独、内疚、羞耻。

The Moon in all the fiery signs reflects a profound need to feel special, to be acknowledged a child of the gods. Instinctively, one feels one ought to be exempt from the ordinary limits which apply to common mortals. This is an innate lunar need which cannot be reasoned away. If it is contained and balanced by more solid chart factors (particularly planets in air, which can give it structure without stifling it), a fiery Moon can give rise to a potent imagination along with the courage to express this rich inner world through creative forms. But in Julian's chart, only Jupiter falls in an airy sign, and Mercury, reflecting the capacity for formulating the inner world, is blocked by the Saturn-Chiron conjunction. This suggests that the faculties of reason and reflection, so natural to his father, do not come easily to Julian. Like many intuitive-feeling people, he tends to experience everything subjectively, finding it difficult to view life's limiting and hurtful experiences—especially his mother's accident —with any detachment. Life has injured him personally and deliberately, and so he will punish life—and his parents — accordingly.
月亮在所有火象星座都反映了一种深刻的需要——感到特别，被承认为神的孩子。本能地，一个人觉得自己应该豁免于适用于普通凡人的通常限制。这是一种先天的月亮需求，无法用理性消除。如果它被更坚实的星盘因素所容纳和平衡（特别是风象行星，可以在不扼杀的情况下给予结构），火象月亮可以产生强大的想象力以及通过创造性形式表达这个丰富内心世界的勇气。但在 Julian 的星盘中，只有木星落在风象星座，而反映内心世界形成能力的水星被土星-凯龙星合相所阻碍。这暗示着理性和反思的能力——对他父亲来说如此自然的能力——对 Julian 来说并不容易。像许多直觉-感觉型的人一样，他倾向于主观地体验一切，难以以任何超然的态度来看待生活中的限制性和伤害性经验——尤其是他母亲的事故。生活亲自地、故意地伤害了他，因此他要惩罚生活——以及他的父母——以此回应。

Audience: Would this apply if the Moon were in another element but in a fiery house?
听众：如果月亮在另一种元素但在火象宫位，情况也适用吗？

Liz: No, probably not. The signs in which the planets are placed symbolise the stuff we are made of. The houses are those spheres of life in which the planets express themselves. If Julian's Moon were in Taurus in the 9th, he would no doubt possess an instinctive need for some kind of all-encompassing philosophical perspective or worldview, along with a craving for travel and adventure. The 9th house is one of the houses of the mind, and Julian, with his Moon in Aries in the 9th, literally goes out of his mind and inwardly travels to some very exotic foreign ports. But if this Moon were in Taurus he would have different emotional needs, as well as a different mother; and he would not behave like a maenad, acting out her rage. I doubt that manic depression would be his presenting symptom. If the Moon were in Aries but in the 6th house, he might not climb buildings and shout Aristotelian philosophy at people. It might be his body which, maenadlike, expressed his rage through physical symptoms such as sudden fevers or migraine headaches.
Liz：不，可能不适用。行星所在的星座象征着我们由什么材料构成。宫位是行星在其中表达自身的生活领域。如果 Julian 的月亮在金牛座第九宫，他无疑会拥有某种涵盖一切的哲学视角或世界观的直觉需求，以及对旅行和冒险的渴望。第九宫是心智之宫之一，Julian 凭其在白羊座第九宫的月亮，字面意义上心智失常了，内在地旅行到了一些非常异国情调的外国港口。但如果这颗月亮在金牛座，他会有不同的情感需求，以及不同的母亲；他不会表现得像一个迈纳德，表演她的愤怒。我怀疑躁郁症会是他的呈现症状。如果月亮在白羊座但在第六宫，他可能不会爬上建筑物向人们喊叫亚里士多德哲学。可能是他的身体，以迈纳德的方式，通过突然的发烧或偏头痛等身体症状来表达他的愤怒。

The Moon in fire needs a sense of meaning, an imaginative connection with a deeper or higher pattern. Because we are dealing with lunar nourishment, this is not a question of formulating a philosophy or spiritual framework. It is an instinctual urge to infuse life with a mythic or archetypal dimension, so that one can feel part of something larger and more significant than the mundane world. In this sense the Moon in fire is a contradiction in terms, because the lunar realm is the realm of the body. But the Moon in Aries, Leo or Sagittarius instinctively tries to vitalise material reality with drama and imagination. What crushes a fiery Moon more than anything is a banal life, where there are no knights on white horses and no damsels in distress and no huge, giant, colourful figures crashing out of the fairy-tale world to compensate for the taxman and the grocery bill.
火象月亮需要一种意义感，一种与更深或更高模式的想象力连接。因为我们处理的是月亮的滋养，这不是制定哲学或精神框架的问题。它是一种以神话或原型维度灌注生活的本能冲动，使一个人能感到自己是比世俗世界更大、更有意义的事物的一部分。从这个意义上说，火象月亮是一个矛盾术语，因为月亮的领域是身体的领域。但月亮在白羊座、狮子座或射手座本能地试图以戏剧和想象力来活化物质现实。比任何事都更压碎一颗火象月亮的是平庸的生活——没有骑白马的骑士，没有遇险的少女，没有巨大的、色彩斑斓的神话人物从童话世界中冲出来以补偿税务员和杂货账单。

This tells us a little more about Julian's manic flights, particularly when we think of the ordered and restrained world in which he was brought up. Although English academia, like any other sphere, has its scandals and dramas, they are usually played out in a polite and well-behaved fashion. Domestic life among Oxbridge professors tends to be rather low-key, Inspector Morse notwithstanding. If a child with a fiery Moon is not taken seriously when he or she tries to bring the vividness of the imaginai world into daily life, then this can result in the child withdrawing into inflated fantasies which are split off from the everyday world. One is really a genius, a great artist or a spiritual avatar, but that lot out there are too stupid and philistine to recognise it.
这让我们对 Julian 的躁狂飞升有了更多了解，特别是当我们想到他成长于其中的有序和克制世界。虽然英国学术界像任何其他领域一样有其丑闻和戏剧，但它们通常以礼貌和规矩的方式上演。牛剑教授的家庭生活往往相当低调，《摩斯探长》除外。如果一个火象月亮的孩子在他或她试图将想象世界的生动带入日常生活时不被认真对待，那么这可能导致孩子退缩到与日常世界脱节的膨胀幻想中。一个人真的是天才、伟大的艺术家或精神化身，但外面那些人太愚蠢和庸俗了，不认识得到。

Julian's manic episodes make him the absolute centre of his world. He has landed the leading role in the play, and everyone around him drops whatever they were doing to rush to his aid. This may comprise one of the reasons for his suicidal depressions, for when he loses his connection with being the gifted and brilliant child of the gods, he can see no point to life. He cannot believe he could be loved as a mere mortal. This is Aries operating on a compulsive and deeply unconscious level.
Julian 的躁狂发作使他成为他世界的绝对中心。他在剧中获得了主角，他周围的每个人都放下手头的一切来赶去帮助他。这可能构成他自杀性抑郁的原因之一，因为当他失去与作为天赋异禀的神之孩子的联系时，他看不到生活的意义。他无法相信自己作为一个凡人也能被爱。这是白羊座在强迫性的、深层无意识的层面上的运作。

Audience: Then he is really unconsciously using blackmail against his parents.
听众：那么他其实是在无意识地用敲诈来对付他的父母。

Liz: Yes, it is unconscious blackmail, or more precisely, unconscious punishment. He is punishing his father for his “crime,” as though the man actually pushed his wife down the stairs; but most of all he is punishing his mother for abandoning him in favour of her wheelchair and her silence. This latter is probably a key issue, although less conscious than his anger toward his father.
Liz：是的，这是无意识的敲诈，或更确切地说，是无意识的惩罚。他在惩罚他的父亲的「罪行」，好像那个人真的把妻子推下了楼梯；但最重要的是他在惩罚他的母亲——因为她选择了轮椅和沉默而抛弃了他。后者可能是一个关键问题，虽然比他对父亲的愤怒不那么有意识。

Audience: And when he breaks down and winds up in hospital, he is really asking for his mother to take care of him.
听众：当他崩溃并最终进了医院时，他其实是在要求他的母亲来照顾他。

Liz: Yes, I believe so. Also, he becomes like her—an invalid, incapable of coping with life—and by becoming like her, he gets closer to her. The manipulative elements in Julian's behaviour are complicated but make a strong symbolic statement. His breakdowns serve a multiple purpose. He can punish his father for not validating him, and for being good at something he cannot hope to aspire to. He can punish his mother for her withdrawal. He can force the world to give him the mothering he is no longer getting (and possibly never did). And he can become a mythic figure, the absolute centre of the universe, without having done anything to earn it —which is one of the characteristics of the Moon, rather than the Sun, in fire. We could spend an entire seminar on the causes of manic depression and other disturbed psychic states, but 1 have used Julian's chart in this session primarily because it is such an exaggerated example of the Moon operating in an unconscious and compulsive way. Both his manic states and his very complex relationship to his mother are bound up with this unaspected Moon in Aries which, even if he expressed it more moderately, would probably still be abrasive to his father.
Liz：是的，我相信如此。而且，他变得像她——一个无法应对生活的残疾人——通过变得像她，他离她更近了。Julian 行为中操纵性的元素是复杂的，但做出了强烈的象征性声明。他的崩溃服务于多重目的。他可以惩罚他的父亲——因为没有认可他，因为擅长他无法企望达到的事物。他可以惩罚他的母亲——因为她的退缩。他可以迫使世界给予他不再得到的（也许从未得到过的）母性关怀。他可以成为一个神话人物、宇宙的绝对中心，而不需要为此做任何事来赢得它——这是月亮而非太阳在火象的特征之一。我们可以花整个研讨会来讨论躁郁症和其他心理失常状态的原因，但我在这次讲座中使用 Julian 的星盘，主要是因为它如此夸张地展示了月亮以无意识和强迫性方式运作。他的躁狂状态和他与母亲非常复杂的关系都与这颗无相位的白羊座月亮捆绑在一起，即使他更适度地表达它，也可能仍然刺到他的父亲。

Audience: What would you recommend for Julian? Presumably he was not in a manic state when he came to see you.
听众：你会对 Julian 有什么建议？推测他来见你时不在躁狂状态。

Liz: No, although I was concerned that I might give him fodder for the next one if I talked too much about myths and archetypes. I suggested to him that he undergo very deep and frequent analysis, of the four- or five-times-a-week variety. The Kleinian analysts work best with this kind of damaged personality, which needs great containment on a long-term basis. Manic depression is not “incurable,” contrary to conventional psychiatric opinion, but it is very difficult to work with, and requires a psychotherapist or analyst who can accept the periodic breakdowns which are inevitably involved without losing faith. Julian might also need an analyst who could validate the healthy dimension of his fiery nature, which tends toward the theatrical at the best of times. The alternative is a lifetime of lithium, which allows him some degree of moderation in his mood swings, but which cannot of itself stop the cycle.
Liz：不在，虽然我担心如果我过多谈论神话和原型，可能会给他的下一次发作提供燃料。我建议他接受非常深入和频繁的分析，每周四五次的那种。克莱因学派的分析师最适合与这种受损人格工作，这种人格需要长期的、大量的容纳。躁郁症并非「不可治愈」——与常规精神医学观点相反——但它非常难以处理，需要一位精神治疗师或分析师，他能够接受不可避免地涉及到的周期性崩溃而不失去信心。Julian 可能还需要一位能够认可其火热本性健康面向的分析师——这种本性在最好的时候也倾向于戏剧化。替代方案是终身的锂盐治疗，它允许他在情绪波动上有某种程度的节制，但本身无法停止循环。

Audience: You have not mentioned the semisextile to the Moon from Venus. Could this be seen as the way through in the chart?
听众：你没有提到金星与月亮的次六分相。这可以被视为星盘中的出路吗？

Liz: I am not wildly enthusiastic about taking one aspect, especially a minor one, and using it to define the solution to a problem which involves so many complicated psychological factors. I do not feel the semisextile from Venus is powerful enough to provide a container for the Aries Moon anyway, never mind all the rest. Semisextiles are delicate aspects and require conscious effort, and although this Moon semisextile Venus might describe qualities of gentleness and artistic appreciation in his nature, Julian does not yet have enough of an ego to make the best use of it. I am more inclined to look at what might help him to build an ego strong enough to contain that wild Moon. The Sun is perhaps the most important factor here, and its placement in the 9th house suggests that the more Julian can understand his suffering in a broader context, both analytically (through examining his family background) and archetypally (through exploring the deeper pattern expressing itself through his symptoms), the better equipped he will be to cope with the pain that sends him off into manic flights.
Liz：我并不热衷于取一个相位——尤其是一个次要相位——并用它来定义一个涉及如此多复杂心理因素的问题的解决方案。我不觉得金星与月亮的次六分相足够强大，无论如何都无法为白羊座月亮提供容器，更不用说其他一切了。次六分相是精微的相位，需要有意识的努力，虽然这颗月亮次六分金星可能描述了他天性中温柔和艺术欣赏的特质，但 Julian 尚未有足够的自我来最好地利用它。我更倾向于看看什么可能帮助他建立足够强大的自我来容纳那颗狂野的月亮。太阳也许是这里最重要的因素，它在第九宫的位置暗示着，Julian 越能在更广阔的背景中理解他的痛苦——无论是分析性地（通过审视他的家庭背景）还是原型性地（通过探索通过他的症状表达的更深层模式）——他就越有能力应对将他送入躁狂飞升的痛苦。

I would also look carefully at Saturn, which conjuncts Chiron in Pisces in the 8th house, suggesting considerable fear around the sphere of intimacy and emotional openness to others. This fear I believe is connected with both parents, but particularly with Julian's father, who is described by the paradoxical combination of Sun-Mars in the 9th (the academic) and by Neptune in the 4th house. This Neptune, conjuncting the South Node, suggests a hidden sensitivity and confusion in his father which Julian, with his three planets in Pisces, may be acting out for him. Julian deeply loves and idealises his father, despite the rage he feels about his mother's paralysis. In fact I wonder to what extend Julian carries both his mother's rage (which she has never expressed since the accident) and his father's sadness and weakness (which he has never expressed either).
我还会仔细审视土星——它与凯龙星合相于双鱼座第八宫，暗示着在亲密和对他人的情感开放领域有相当大的恐惧。我相信这种恐惧与双亲都有关，但特别是与 Julian 的父亲有关——他被太阳-火星在第九宫（学者）和第四宫的海王星这一矛盾组合所描述。这颗海王星与南交点合相，暗示着他的父亲有一种隐藏的敏感和困惑，而 Julian 凭其三颗双鱼座行星可能在替他表演出来。Julian 深爱并理想化他的父亲，尽管他对母亲瘫痪感到愤怒。事实上我想知道 Julian 在多大程度上同时携带了他母亲的愤怒（她从事故以来从未表达过）和他父亲的悲伤和软弱（他也从未表达过）。

So although I take your point about the aspect from Venus, which in the 8th house might also suggest a very lively sexual outlet for the wilder side of the Aries Moon, I would first want to explore Julian's very convoluted feelings about his parents. The “way through” is more likely to involve the whole chart.
所以虽然我接受你关于金星相位的观点——它在第八宫也可能暗示为白羊座月亮更狂野的一面提供非常活泼的性宣泄出口——我首先想探索 Julian 对父母非常纠结的情感。「出路」更可能涉及整个星盘。

Audience: He must feel that he has not lived up to his father's expectations. Is it possible that he might please his father by some kind of academic success, perhaps of a different kind from Classics, but still something in this sphere?
听众：他一定觉得自己没有达到父亲的期望。有没有可能他通过某种学术成就来取悦父亲——也许不是古典学，但仍然是这个领域的东西？

Liz: He has already tried that route, and studied philosophy and comparative religion at university. But he could not keep up with the academic requirements. I agree that he needs mental food —the 9th house is not called the house of higher education for nothing—and this might indeed provide a bridge to his father. But it also might set him up as his father's rival, and the Sun in Aries conjuncting Mars suggests that his father is unconsciously highly competitive and does not want a son who challenges him on his own patch. I believe there are some very complex issues at work between Julian and his father which need to be brought into the light, since I associate Aries with the myth of Oedipus enacted through the classic family triangle.
Liz：他已经尝试过那条路，在大学学了哲学和比较宗教。但他无法跟上学术要求。我同意他需要心智食物——第九宫被称为高等教育之宫不是没有原因的——这确实可能成为通往他父亲的桥梁。但这也可能使他成为父亲的竞争对手，而太阳在白羊座合相火星暗示他的父亲在无意识中非常有竞争性，不想要一个在自己的领域挑战他的儿子。我相信 Julian 和他父亲之间有一些非常复杂的议题需要被带到光明中，因为我将白羊座与通过经典家庭三角上演的俄狄浦斯神话联系起来。

Audience: Does an unaspected Moon mean no relationship with the mother?
听众：无相位的月亮意味着与母亲没有关系吗？

Liz: It means a deeply unconscious one, and often there is not much real emotional communication. From what Julian has said about his mother, there was probably never much maternal feeling in her, even when he was a baby. Although her present behaviour might be blamed on her accident, something was wrong long before. The accident has meant to him that there can never be a chance to redeem it. Julian does not have a sufficiently strong inner image of a “good mother” to know how to contain and nourish himself. This results in the archetypal level of the Moon breaking through without any human mediator. Even the cyclical nature of manic depression echoes the cyclical nature of the lunar cycle. Julian's manic states suggest the full Moon that calls the maenads to the dance, while his black depressions are the dark of the Moon when the black dogs of Hekate run amok.
Liz：它意味着一种深层无意识的关系，往往没有太多真正的情感交流。从 Julian 关于他母亲的话来看，即使在他还是婴儿时，她可能就从未有过多少母性情感。虽然她目前的行为可以归咎于她的事故，但早在事故之前就有什么不对了。事故对他来说意味着永远没有机会去补救。Julian 没有足够强大的「好母亲」内在形象来知道如何容纳和滋养自己。这导致了月亮原型层面在没有人类中介者的情况下突破。甚至躁郁症的周期性也反映了月相循环的周期性。Julian 的躁狂状态暗示着召唤迈纳德起舞的满月，而他黑色的抑郁则是 Hekate 的黑犬肆虐的暗月。

I would like to leave Julian for the moment, and look at the Moon in the other three elements. The Moon in an earthy sign seems to have affinity with the earth goddesses such as Gaia and Demeter, who preside over nature and the life of the body. Also, as we saw with the Moon in Capricorn, Hera can be seen as an earthy lunar deity, because of her rulership over roots and traditional family structures. It is the body needs which are of paramount importance for the Moon in earth, although many things can provide symbolic body security for us. For example, one's home is a kind of body, a womb within which we feel safe and protected. Selling one's home and moving to a new neighbourhood can be a terrifying and deeply traumatic experience for an earthy Moon (especially if it occurs in childhood), even if all the practical details have been impeccably organised and there are no financial problems and the move is accomplished without disasters. One has nevertheless been dislodged from one's body, and the abyss looms.
我想暂时放下 Julian，看看月亮在其他三个元素中的表现。月亮在土象星座似乎与 Gaia 和 Demeter 等大地女神有亲和，她们主持着自然和身体的生活。此外，正如我们在月亮在摩羯座中所见，赫拉可以被视为一位土象的月亮神祇，因为她对根和传统家庭结构的统辖。对土象月亮来说，身体需求是最重要的，尽管许多东西可以为我们提供象征性的身体安全感。例如，一个人的家是一种身体，一个我们感到安全和受保护的子宫。卖掉自己的家搬到新社区对土象月亮来说可能是一种可怕的、深度创伤的经验（特别是如果它发生在童年），即使所有实际细节都安排得无可挑剔，没有财务问题，搬迁也没有灾难。一个人已经被从身体中连根拔起，深渊隐现。

If one is unconscious of these earthy lunar needs, the anxiety and distress of uprooting can linger for a long time, even if the real source is overlooked or denied. There is also a deeply ritualistic quality to the Moon in the earthy signs. We all have our little daily rituals, whether this entails digging up weeds in the garden, or reading the morning paper over tea, or jogging on Hampstead Heath, or following a particular order of bathing and dressing. These rituals are terribly important for an earthy Moon, because they provide a kind of body centering which is needed for a feeling of well-being. The Moon in the earth signs often favours dietary and exercise rituals, and even if these are a little faddish and do not do much for the body's actual health, it is the repetitive security of the ritual itself which promotes the feeling of being in balance.
如果一个人对这些土象的月亮需求没有意识，连根拔起的焦虑和痛苦可能持续很长时间，即使真正的根源被忽视或否认。土象星座中的月亮还有一种深层的仪式性特质。我们都有自己的日常小仪式——无论是在花园里挖杂草、还是喝茶看晨报、或在 Hampstead Heath 晨跑、或按照特定顺序洗澡穿衣。这些仪式对土象月亮来说极其重要，因为它们提供了一种身体重心感，是安康感所需要的。土象星座中的月亮通常偏爱饮食和运动仪式，即使这些有点赶时髦，对身体实际健康帮助不大，但仪式本身的重复安全感才是促进平衡感的来源。

So there is a deep resistance to material change in the earthy Moon, and also a need for a ritualistic ordering of daily life on the physical level. These Moon placements are sometimes quite obsessive, especially if the person is stressed, but you can see why—if the Moon is being expressed unconsciously, it is likely to operate in a compulsive way, and those rituals provide protection against anxiety. The Moon in earth is often very concerned with material security and social acceptability, even if this is consciously denied, and once again you can see why. Beautiful or valuable objects, money and respectability all provide a kind of safe body, a bastion against the cold winds of chaos. When these fundamental lunar needs are denied because of an overvaluing of the intellectual or spiritual level of life, an earthy Moon has a way of generating body symptoms as well as compulsive-obsessive behaviour.
因此，土象月亮对物质变化有深层的抵抗，也有在物理层面对日常生活进行仪式性排序的需要。这些月亮位置有时相当强迫性，特别是当事人在压力下时，但你可以看到为什么——如果月亮被无意识地表达，它很可能以强迫的方式运作，而那些仪式提供了对焦虑的保护。土象月亮通常非常关心物质安全和社会认可，即使这在意识层面被否认，你再次可以看到为什么。美丽或有价值的物品、金钱和体面都提供了一种安全的身体，抵御混乱冷风的堡垒。当这些基本的月亮需求因为过度重视智识或精神层面而被否定时，土象月亮有办法产生身体症状以及强迫-强迫行为。

The Moon in earth also needs to feel useful. This is different from the earthy Sun's conscious goal of contributing something practical to life. With the Moon in Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn, there is an instinctive need to be occupied, to be doing rather than wasting time. Everything in nature is constantly moving, albeit sometimes very slowly, and if you sit around watching the insects and snails in your garden or the wildlife in the woods, you will see that there is never a moment when purposeful activity is not taking place. Ants are busy carrying bits of food to their hill, bees are busy dipping into flowers, aphids are busy feeding off leaves, birds are busy digging up worms. Even in their winter dormancy, plants carry on a secret life of their own. All this movement serves the perpetuation of the universal life of the world, and the Moon in earth is naturally attuned to such rhythms. Even the Moon in Taurus, the most fixed and serene of the signs, is constantly in motion, albeit at its own leisurely pace.
土象月亮还需要感到有用。这与土象太阳有意识地贡献实用之物的目标不同。月亮在金牛座、处女座或摩羯座，有一种被占据的直觉需要——做事而非浪费时间。自然界中的一切都在不断运动，尽管有时非常缓慢。如果你坐在花园里观察昆虫和蜗牛，或观察林中的野生动物，你会发现目的性活动一刻不停。蚂蚁忙着搬运食物碎片到蚁丘，蜜蜂忙着在花中穿梭，蚜虫忙着在叶子上取食，鸟儿忙着挖虫子。即使在冬季的蛰伏中，植物也进行着它们自己的秘密生活。所有这些运动都服务于世界普遍生命的延续，土象月亮自然地与这种律动调谐。即使是金牛座月亮——最固定和宁静的星座——也不断在运动，尽管以自己悠闲的节奏。

The Moon in the earthy signs is also highly tactile and sensuous, and there is a strong need for physical affection and stimulus of the senses. Although Virgo and Capricorn have a justified reputation for being highly controlled, they are both extremely sensuous signs, albeit rather discriminating about where they find their pleasures. I am distinguishing sensuous from sexual, because sensuality is not necessarily related to sex. The Moon in Taurus can feel deliciously sensuous while eating chocolate ice cream, whereas the Moon in Aries might experience great sexual stimulus without being sensuous. If this basic need for touch and physical pleasure is denied because of an undemonstrative or inhibited family, the Moon in earth may react with feelings of deep shame about body needs and functions.
土象星座中的月亮也高度触觉和感官，对身体抚摸和感官刺激有强烈需求。虽然处女座和摩羯座以高度克制著称，但它们都是极其感官的星座，尽管对在哪里寻找快乐相当挑剔。我区分感官性与性，因为感官性不一定与性有关。金牛座月亮可以在吃巧克力冰淇淋时感到美妙的感官享受，而白羊座月亮可能在没有感官享受的情况下体验强烈的性刺激。如果这种对触摸和身体愉悦的基本需求因为不善于表达或压抑的家庭而被否定，土象月亮可能对身体需求和功能产生深深的羞耻感。

In some Kabbalistic teachings, the Moon is related to Malkuth, the lowest level of the Tree of Life. This is the insensible substance of which the body and all material reality are made. Malkuth is a kind of blind receptive container into which the seed of the spirit descends, but in itself it possesses no consciousness. Now I was speaking earlier about the Moon having its own intelligence, which is reflected in the ancient images of the lunar goddesses. I think we can see here a difficulty in many religious or esoteric teachings which devalue the level of the Moon because it is not “spiritual.” Lunar intelligence does not evolve toward a goal as solar consciousness does, since it is geared toward safety, comfort and the survival of life. If something in nature doesn't work, such as the dinosaurs, then the line is discontinued. But if it does work, such as the gingko tree, the same model tends to remain in stock, with minimal improvements, millennium after millennium. There is no vision of a higher evolution based on ideals of potential perfection. From the solar perspective, the earthy Moon may seem dull, stupid, boring and unimaginative. It is precisely this feeling which many people with earthy Moons experience if their conscious values are aligned too powerfully with the “higher” realm.
在一些卡巴拉教导中，月亮与 Malkuth 相关联——生命之树最低的层级。这是身体和所有物质现实由以构成的无感觉物质。Malkuth 是一种盲目的接受性容器，精神的种子降入其中，但本身不具备意识。我之前说月亮有其自身的智慧，这反映在月神的古老形象中。我想我们可以在这里看到许多宗教或秘传教导中的一个困难——因为月亮不「属灵」而贬低其层面。月亮智慧不像太阳意识那样朝目标进化，因为它面向安全、舒适和生命的存活。如果自然中某物不奏效，比如恐龙，那条线就会被终止。但如果它奏效，比如银杏树，同一模型往往会保持库存，只有最小的改进，千年复千年。没有基于潜在完美理想的更高进化的愿景。从太阳的视角看，土象月亮可能显得沉闷、愚钝、无聊和缺乏想象力。正是这种感觉——许多土象月亮的人如果意识价值过于强力地与「更高」领域对齐就会体验到的那种感觉。

We all suffer if we deny our lunar needs, for whatever reason. It is actually very easy for an earthy Moon to find satisfaction and contentment, provided the person does not assume natural means unevolved. Often when someone with the Moon in earth comes along for a chart, and they seem to be afflicted with apparently deeply complicated problems, I might suggest that they begin on the most basic level, by finding out what pleases the body and gives real satisfaction and contentment. Yet so often the response is, “Oh, yes, but …,” because there is a complete undervaluing of these needs. Other, more meaningful pursuits must take priority. But if you have the Moon in earth, the foundation of your life depends for its strength on your appreciation of the reality of then body and all the mundane things which give you a feeling of pleasure and safety.
无论出于什么原因否认月亮需求，我们所有人都会受苦。实际上，土象月亮很容易找到满足和充实，只要这个人不假定自然意味着未进化。通常当月亮在土象的人来做星盘解读，他们似乎被表面看来非常复杂的问题所困扰时，我可能会建议他们从最基本的层面开始——找出什么能让身体愉悦并给予真正的满足和充实。然而答案往往是「哦，是的，但是……」，因为这些需求被完全低估了。其他更有意义的追求必须优先。但如果你的月亮在土象，你生活的基础之坚固取决于你对身体现实的欣赏以及所有给你愉悦和安全感的世俗之物。

Perhaps we might look at the Moon in the airy signs now. How many of you have the Moon in Gemini, Libra, or Aquarius? What do you need most to feel secure and contented?
也许我们现在可以看看月亮在风象星座了。你们中有多少人的月亮在双子座、天秤座或水瓶座？你们感到安全和充实最需要什么？

Audience: I need to communicate with people. I hate being alone with no one to talk to.
听众：我需要与人交流。我讨厌独自一人无人说话。

Audience: I need beauty around me. I cannot tolerate an ugly or coarse environment.
听众：我需要周围有美。我无法容忍丑陋或粗鄙的环境。

Liz: You both have expressed fundamental requirements for the Moon in air. The Sun in an airy sign may consciously strive for intellectual development, but the Moon in air simply needs verbal contact and stimulation on the mental level. There is no formulated goal of knowledge; instead, there may be a love of playing with ideas which make the mind feel alive. This is why the Moon in Gemini is such an incurable gossip. People are simply so fascinating, and talking about them is endlessly entertaining. The airy signs are social creatures, naturally gregarious, and even an introverted personality with an airy Moon will seek mental contact with others, albeit selectively.
Liz：你们都表达了风象月亮的基本需求。太阳在风象星座可能有意识地追求智力发展，但风象月亮只需要在心智层面上的口头接触和刺激。没有制定的知识目标；取而代之的是一种玩弄想法的爱，使心智感到活跃。这就是为什么双子座月亮是一个不可救药的八卦。人就是如此迷人，谈论他们是无尽的娱乐。风象星座是社交生物，天生合群，即使一个内向性格的人有风象月亮也会寻求与他人的心智接触，尽管是有选择性的。

There is nothing more painful for an airy Moon than an early environment in which there is no communication, or where the communication is dishonest and full of double messages. Also, there is a natural aesthetic feeling in the element of air. A childhood which is too dreary and disciplined, without any time for frivolity, is stultifying, and a world barren of beauty and light and style crushes the soul. The idealism of air, combined with the instinctual needs of the Moon, produces a profound hunger for a beautiful and intelligible world, and there is often an excessive hypersensitivity in these Moon signs which reacts with great distress to the usual confusion and ambiguity of human relationships. Although the Moon in air needs contact with others, it tends to shy away from complex emotional dynamics because of this excessive delicacy and aestheticism. Isolation provokes anxiety in an airy Moon, but so too do powerful feelings, which threaten to drown the airy Moon in dark undercurrents.
对风象月亮来说，没有比一个没有交流、或交流不诚实且充满双重信息的早期环境更痛苦的了。此外，风元素中有一种自然的审美感。一个太沉闷和约束、没有时间轻浮的童年是令人窒息的，一个缺乏美、光和风格的世界压碎了灵魂。风象的理想主义与月亮的本能需求相结合，产生了对美丽和可理解的世界的深刻渴望，这些星座中的月亮通常有一种过度的敏感性，对通常的人际关系的混乱和模糊以极大的不安来反应。虽然风象月亮需要与他人接触，但它倾向于回避复杂的情感动态，因为这种过度的精致和唯美主义。孤立在风象月亮中引发焦虑，但强烈的情感也是如此，它们威胁要将风象月亮淹没在黑暗的暗流中。

Audience: I have the Moon in Aquarius, and I find I am always looking for escape routes from relationships. I am afraid of getting stuck in too much emotion.
听众：我的月亮在水瓶座，我发现我总是在关系中寻找逃避路线。我害怕陷入太多情感中。

Liz: Yes, the need for breathing space in relationships is a necessary requirement for the Moon in all the airy signs. Although Libra loves romance, the romance must be clear, bright and uncontaminated with ambiguous vapours.
Liz：是的，在所有风象星座中月亮对关系中呼吸空间的需求是必要条件。虽然天秤座喜欢浪漫，但浪漫必须是清晰的、明亮的、不受暧昧迷雾污染的。

Audience: I have the Moon in Aquarius also, and I find that 1 talk about my emotions all the time. I talk about them so much that I don't have a chance to feel them. Once I have analysed them, I don't have to worry about them any more.
听众：我的月亮也在水瓶座，我发现我一直在谈论我的感情。我谈得太多以至于没有机会感受它们。一旦我分析完它们，我就不用再担心了。

Liz: That is a characteristic airy line of defence against feelings. Just as the earthy Moon becomes compulsive and obsessive with its rituals when threatened by material upheaval, the airy Moon becomes analytical, dissociated, and evasive when threatened by too much intimacy.
Liz：这是风象星座对情感的典型防线。正如土象月亮在受到物质动荡威胁时变得强迫和执着一样，风象月亮在受到过多亲密威胁时变得分析性、解离性和回避性。

Audience: Is the Moon in Aquarius evasive as well? I thought Aquarians placed such importance on truthfulness.
听众：月亮在水瓶座也回避吗？我以为水瓶座人如此重视诚实。

Liz: Aquarius is highly ethical, but we cannot be truthful with others unless we are honest with ourselves. Because the Moon in air may compulsively dissociate when faced with emotional conflict or vulnerability, one may deceive oneself about what one really feels. In this sense the Moon in Aquarius is just as evasive as the Moon in Gemini. It is not a deliberate act of dishonesty, but rather an instinctive defence against the threat of emotional pain. Air needs clarity, and nothing is so clouded and ambiguous as human feeling. Although the airy signs must communicate, communication can be very dangerous if it involves an emotional confrontation. It is much easier to change the subject, or reduce complicated issues to simple black-and-white formulae. Anyone with an airy Moon needs to create a private space within relationships, in which they can breathe and nourish themselves with those things that bring beauty and light and grace to life. Then the inevitable emotional confrontations are not so unendurable.
Liz：水瓶座高度伦理化，但除非我们对自己诚实，否则无法对他人诚实。因为风象月亮在面对情感冲突或脆弱时可能强迫性地解离，一个人可能自欺欺人地不知道自己真正感受什么。在这个意义上，月亮在水瓶座与月亮在双子座一样回避。这不是故意的欺骗，而是对情感痛苦威胁的本能防御。风象需要清晰，没有什么比人类情感更模糊和暧昧了。虽然风象星座必须交流，但如果涉及情感对抗，交流可能非常危险。转移话题，或将复杂问题简化为简单的黑白公式要容易得多。任何有风象月亮的人都需要在关系中创造一个私人空间，在其中他们可以呼吸和用那些给生活带来美、光和优雅的事物滋养自己。这样，不可避免的情感对抗就不那么不可忍受了。

Audience: This may sound a little funny, but I have found that most men with the Moon in Libra don't like to kiss.
听众：这听起来可能有点好笑，但我发现大多数月亮在天秤座的男性不喜欢接吻。

Liz: Yes, it does sound a little funny. I haven't found that to be the case, but never mind. I can see I had better avoid taking that comment any further!
Liz：是的，听起来确实有点好笑。我没有发现是这种情况，但没关系。我看我最好不要继续评论这个了！

The Moon in the airy signs recoils from fusion. There is a need to preserve the ideal intact, without too much contamination by another person's reality. The mind is a great boundary maker, just as feelings are boundary dissolvere. The mythic deities who preside over the realm of air are extremely independent creatures. For example, Aphrodite (Venus), who rules the sign of Libra, refuses to be possessed. She favours the hetaira and the lover, and shows a marked disinterest in the sanctity of marriage bonds. Hermes (Mercury), who rules Gemini, is the god of the roads and of the traveller, and favours the thief and the liar. He traverses the paths from heaven to earth and to the underworld and back again, a messenger with no fixed abode. And Ouranos (Uranus), the ruler of Aquarius, is the original god of heaven before there was a manifest cosmos. He embodies the Idea before the concrete reality, and when the reality is presented to him in the form of his Titan children, he is repelled and shuns them. All these planetary deities reflect a distaste for anything too fixed in form or bound by emotion. Thus the Moon in an airy sign tends to find its security in those crystalline spheres where the idea of life is not spoiled by the imperfections of reality.
风象星座中的月亮从融合中退缩。需要保持理想完好无损，不受他人现实的太多污染。心智是伟大的边界制造者，正如情感是边界溶解者。主持风领域的神话神祇是极其独立的生灵。例如，Aphrodite（金星），统治天秤座，拒绝被占有。她偏爱伴侣和情人，对婚姻纽带的圣洁表现出明显的不感兴趣。Hermes（水星），统治双子座，是道路之神和旅者之神，偏爱小偷和骗子。他往返于天地与冥界的路径间，一个没有固定居所的信使。而 Ouranos（天王星），水瓶座的统治者，是显现宇宙出现之前的原始天神。他体现了具体现实之前的理念，当现实以泰坦子女的形式呈现在他面前时，他感到厌恶并回避了他们。所有这些行星神祇都反映了对任何过于固定形式或被情感束缚之物的厌恶。因此，风象星座中的月亮倾向于在那些水晶球体中找到安全感——在那里，生活的理念不被现实的不完美所损害。

If these lunar needs are blocked, the Moon may generate body symptoms just as readily as other Moon signs do. But I have found that one of the most characteristic spheres of suffering for a choked airy Moon is depression. This depression may be unconscious because of the dissociating propensities of the air signs, but if there is no air to breathe, the person may descend into a kind of bleak hopelessness and apathy, masked by brittle sociability. Sometimes the detached qualities of the Moon in air are not met with sympathy in childhood, and the person is perpetually being told that he or she is cold and unfeeling. An airy Moon is not cold, but its occasional lack of demonstrativeness, as well as a cyclical need for emotional withdrawal, may be the wrong mix for an emotionally demanding parent. I would emphasise once again that the need to communicate is not the same as the need for fusion. If the Moon's essential nature is rejected in childhood, then the person may grow up feeling deeply guilty and unlovable because he or she is “unloving.”
如果这些月亮需求被阻碍，月亮可以像其他月亮星座一样容易地产生身体症状。但我发现，风象月亮受阻碍时最特征性的痛苦领域之一是抑郁。由于风象星座的解离倾向，这种抑郁可能是无意识的，但如果没有空气可呼吸，人可能陷入一种荒凉的绝望和冷漠中，以脆弱的社交性来掩饰。有时风象月亮的超然品质在童年时不被同情地对待，人不断被告知他或她冷漠和无情。风象月亮并不冷，但它偶尔缺乏表现力，以及周期性的情感退缩需求，可能不适合一个情感需求强烈的父母。我想再次强调，交流的需求与融合的需求不同。如果月亮的本质在童年被拒绝，那么这个人可能在成长中感到深深的内疚和不可爱，因为他或她「不爱」。

Now we can finally look at the Moon in the watery signs before we finish this afternoon's session. How many of you have the Moon in water? What do you feel to be your essential requirements?
现在我们终于可以看看月亮在水象星座了，在结束今天下午的讲座之前。你们中有多少人的月亮在水象？你们觉得自己的基本需求是什么？

Audience: I need emotional closeness more than anything.
听众：我最需要的是情感上的亲近。

Audience: I have a great need of my family. I dread the time when my children grow up and want to move away.
听众：我非常需要我的家庭。我恐惧我的孩子们长大后想搬走的那一天。

Audience: I need to be able to express my feelings. I hate it when I am treated as though I am being hysterical.
听众：我需要能够表达我的感情。我讨厌被当作歇斯底里来对待。

Liz: You may sometimes get that response from a partner with the Moon in air. But all your comments are very apt. The Moon in water needs above all to receive emotional response from others. It is the most important thing in the world, even if the response is hatred or anger. At least that is better than one's feelings falling down a hole somewhere. For a watery Moon, exchange of feelings is a means of drawing people together. One is no longer alone and separate, because feelings are the solvent which allows the barriers to break down between oneself and life. Nothing activates anxiety in a watery Moon more quickly than another person's unresponsiveness, because it is like dropping into the void. One ceases to exist. The Moon in water feels safe only if one is merged with others. Your comment about hysteria is sadly apt, because if you do not value this side of yourself, you can easily be provoked into highly emotional behaviour by anyone who rejects your feelings.
Liz：你有时可能会从一个月亮在风象的伴侣那里得到那种反应。但你们所有的评论都非常恰当。水象月亮最需要从他人那里得到情感回应。这是世界上最重要的事，即使回应是恨或愤怒。那至少比自己的感情掉进某个洞里要好。对水象月亮来说，情感的交流是拉近人们距离的手段。一个人不再是孤独和分离的，因为情感是溶解剂，允许障碍在自己与生活之间打破。没有什么比另一个人的无回应更快地引发水象月亮的不安了，因为那就像掉入虚空。一个人不复存在了。水象月亮只有在与他人融合时才感到安全。你关于歇斯底里的评论令人遗憾地恰当，因为如果你不重视自己的这一面，很容易被任何拒绝你感情的人激起高度情绪化的行为。

Audience: I have the Moon in a watery sign, and I have been married for twenty years to a man with the Moon in Gemini. I am always trying to get closer to him, and he is always slipping away.
听众：我的月亮在水象星座，我和一个月亮在双子座的男人结婚二十年了。我总是试图靠近他，而他总是在滑走。

Liz: There is a good deal of the classic attraction of opposites in this. Each of you has an instinctive gift which the other one finds difficult to express. But I believe the most important issue for a person with the Moon in water is not to find the perfect partner who responds to one's every emotional fluctuation. One must be able to take one's own feelings seriously, and know that they matter. Even if one has a cool and detached partner, which can be very painful at times, it is ultimately the individual's capacity for self-value which feeds the Moon. Nourishing a watery Moon means knowing the worth and truth of one's own heart, even if this is not mirrored by others. As Goethe once said, “If I love you, it's none of your business.” Perhaps you are trying too hard to get validation for your feelings because you do not quite value them yourself. You may want your husband to approve of your needs, but it is you who must do that within yourself. Then you might not mind so much when he plays Hermes and performs an emotional vanishing act.
Liz：这里有很多经典的异性相吸。你们每个人拥有对方觉得难以表达的直觉天赋。但我相信，对月亮在水象的人来说，最重要的问题不是找到一个对自己每一个情感波动都有回应的完美伴侣。一个人必须能够认真对待自己的感情，并知道它们很重要。即使有一个冷静和超然的伴侣——有时可能很痛苦——最终是个体的自我价值感在滋养月亮。滋养水象月亮意味着知道自己内心的价值和真相，即使这不被他人映照。正如歌德所说：「如果我爱你，那与你无关。」也许你太努力地试图为自己的情感寻求认可，因为你自己并不完全重视它们。你可能想要你的丈夫认可你的需求，但必须在你内在做这件事的那个人是你自己。然后当他扮演 Hermes 施展情感消失术时，你可能就不那么介意了。

The dilemma of a watery Moon is complicated, because if one needs response from others, how does one nourish oneself? A blocked Moon in the watery signs has a way of generating deeply manipulative behaviour in order to obtain the necessary care and attention. This has a sad tendency to backfire, as other people usually pull away when they feel manipulated, and one has thus created the very situation one fears most. Often there is a cool or rejecting parent in the early background, whom the child has internalised; this can result in considerable resentment in adulthood at the least sign of withdrawal from a loved one, because it brings up the old wound. Equally often there is a parent who is even needier than the child, and whose message is, “There is only room for one infant in the house, and it isn't you.” So the person grows up ashamed of needing too much, yet remains full of anger at the deprivation. All that emotional dependency seems cloying and gummy, and no one will love us if we reveal the full extent of it. Yet it is a vicious circle, because the more resentful the watery Moon feels about being rejected or ignored, the more manipulative it is likely to become, and the more others will actually be driven away by the force of the covert emotional demands.
水象月亮的困境是复杂的，因为如果一个人需要他人的回应，又如何滋养自己呢？水象星座中被阻碍的月亮有办法产生深层的操纵行为以获得所需的关怀和注意。这有一种可悲的反弹倾向，因为其他人通常在被操纵感下会拉远，于是一个人就恰恰创造了自己最恐惧的局面。通常早期背景中有一个冷漠或拒绝的父/母，被孩子内化了；这可能导致成年后一看到爱人退缩就有相当大的怨恨，因为它触动了旧伤。同样常见的有一个比孩子更有需求的父/母，其信息是：「这房子里只有一个婴儿的空间，而那个人不是你。」所以这个人在成长中对需要太多感到羞耻，却仍然满怀对被剥夺的愤怒。所有那种情感依赖似乎黏人和胶着，如果我们展露其全部，没有人会爱我们。然而这是一个恶性循环，因为水象月亮对被拒绝或忽视越怨恨，就越可能变得操纵性，而他人实际上就越被这种隐蔽情感需求的力所驱走。

I think the key to this dilemma lies in our ability to enjoy and appreciate the richness and importance of our own feelings. Longing for intimacy, expressed so powerfully by the Moon in water, only drives others away when it is full of covert resentment, and it may remain full of resentment if we unconsciously expect others to provide that constant and unconditional acceptance, love and forgiveness we cannot give ourselves. If we can appreciate our own feelings, we may succeed in communicating them without the unspoken requirement that others should heal our parental wounds. This tends to bring people closer rather than driving them away. It is worth asking yourself, if you have the Moon in a watery sign, whether you can value what you feel without an external stamp of approval. The Moon is a watery planet, and in the watery signs it reflects the most archetypal level of its nature, the primal mother goddess as the source of life. She contains all things within her own womb, and does not need anyone or anything outside to give value to what lives inside her.
我认为这一困境的关键在于我们享受和欣赏自身感情的丰富性和重要性的能力。对亲密的渴望——由水象月亮如此有力地表达——当它充满隐蔽的怨恨时只会把人推开，而如果我们无意识地期望他人提供那种我们无法给自己的持续的、无条件的接纳、爱和宽恕，它可能始终充满怨恨。如果我们能欣赏自己的感情，我们也许能成功地在没有「他人应该治愈我们的父母创伤」这一未说出口的要求下沟通它们。这倾向于拉近人们而非驱走他们。如果你月亮在水象星座，值得问自己：你是否可以在没有外部认可的情况下重视自己的感受。月亮是一颗水象行星，在水象星座中它反映了其本性的最原型层面——作为生命之源的原始母神。她在自身的子宫中包含一切，不需要外在的任何人或任何物来赋予她内在之物以价值。

Audience: I don't have the Moon in water, but I have a question. I feel I validate my own needs and appreciate my Moon sign. But I have trouble finding other people who appreciate it.
听众：我的月亮不在水象，但我有一个问题。我觉得我认可自己的需求并欣赏我的月亮星座。但我很难找到也欣赏它的人。

Liz: You will never be able to please all of the people all of the time. Sometimes accepting this fundamental fact of life can make a great deal of difference, and one can relax. But if you can really find no one at all who values this side of your nature, perhaps it might be relevant to look at the kind of people you attract into your life, and why there is a pattern of rejection. There is probably a family complex at work, and if that is so, then you may have internalised a rejecting parent, and are unconsciously far more judgmental about yourself than you admit. Then you might express your unconscious self-criticism through projection, by getting others to do it for you. This is very common and very human, and most of us do it at some point. I have found that it is usually the case when someone says, “But I like this side of myself, it's just everybody else who doesn't.” Who, after all, is this global “everybody else”?
Liz：你永远无法在所有时候取悦所有人。有时接受这一基本生活事实可以产生巨大的不同，人可以放松下来。但如果你真的完全找不到重视你这一面的人，也许值得看看你吸引到生活中的是哪种人，以及为什么存在拒绝的模式。可能有一个家庭情结在起作用，如果是这样的话，那么你可能内化了一个拒绝的父/母，比你承认的更加无意识地评判自己。然后你可能通过投射来表达你无意识的自我批评——让别人替你做这件事。这非常常见也非常人性，我们大多数人都在某个时刻这样做。我发现当有人说「但我喜欢自己的这一面，只是其他所有人都不喜欢」时，通常就是这种情况。毕竟，这个全球性的「其他所有人」是谁？
