SUN, FATHER, AND THE EMERGENCE OF THE EGO
太陽、父親與自我的浮現

THE FATHER'S ROLE IN INDIVIDUAL DEVELOPMENT
父親在個體發展中的角色

BY HOWARD SASPORTAS
HOWARD SASPORTAS 著

Individuation involves the subtle but crucial phenomenological shifts by which a person comes to see him/herself as separate and distinct within the relationship in which s/he has been embedded. In it is the increasing definition of an “I” within a “We.”
個體化涉及微妙但關鍵的現象學轉變，通過這些轉變一個人開始將自己視為在其所嵌入的關係中分離和獨立的。其中是「我們」中「我」的日益明確。

Mark Karpel1
Mark Karpel¹

This plant would like to grow
這棵植物想要生長

And yet be embryo
卻仍是胚胎

Increase, and yet escape
增長，卻又逃脫

The doom of taking shape …
成形之命運……

Richard Wilbur2
Richard Wilbur²

I can't emphasise enough the importance of the Sun. In my opinion it is the very heart of the chart. This shouldn't be surprising when you think that it comprises 99.8% of the solar system. It is the Sun which directly or indirectly furnishes all the energy that supports our earthly existence; all the foods and all the fuels we need are derived from plants which require sunlight for photosynthesis. So it makes sense that the Sun should stand out in the chart.3
我再怎麼強調太陽的重要性也不為過。在我看來它是星盤的核心。當你想到它佔太陽系的99.8%時這不足為奇。正是太陽直接或間接地提供了支持我們地球存在的所有能量；我們需要的所有食物和燃料都來自需要陽光進行光合作用的植物。因此太陽應該在星盤中突出是合理的。³

I'm certain that in order to feel complete and fulfilled we need to be giving expression to our Sun sign; we must strive to develop ourselves in the sphere of life associated with the house our Sun is placed, and we should try to find constructive ways to personify, integrate and utilise any planet which is in aspect to our Sun. When people come to me for readings, I always want to make sure that they're in touch with the qualities of their Sun sign — I want to know that the qualities of the Sun are being consciously expressed in a purposeful, positive way. Provided that the data is correct, I believe in the chart more than I do in the person sitting beside me. I also hold the opinion that most Sun sign columns start from an incorrect premise. The writers often assume that you are automatically like your Sun sign. So all Ariens are described as dynamic, egocentric and impulsive, and all Geminis are characterised as inveterate flirts and butterflies. Not true. Sun sign columns would be much more worthwhile if they began with the underlying premise that the Sun sign represents qualities which you need to build in and develop in a constructive way in order to become who you uniquely are, in order to be true to yourself and feel good about yourself. Instead of saying, “You are an Aries, therefore you are assertive,” they could write, “You Sun is in Aries and this is an indication that one of your main purposes in life is to develop your courage, dynamism and the ability to assert yourself in a manner which is viable and workable.” You see the difference. Now the readers have a goal or quest, they have something to strive for. If we then take the whole chart into consideration, we can analyse how other factors in the nature will work for or against the healthy development of the Sun sign qualities.
我确信，为了感到完整和满足，我们需要表达自己太阳星座的特质；我们必须努力在与太阳所落宫位相关的生命领域中发展自己，并且应该尝试找到建设性的方式来体现、整合和运用任何与太阳形成相位的行星。当人们来找我做星盘解读时，我总是想确认他们是否与自己的太阳星座特质有所联结——我想知道太阳的特质是否正在以有目的、积极的方式被有意识地表达。只要出生数据正确，我更相信星盘而非坐在我旁边的那个人。我也认为大多数太阳星座专栏的出发点都是错误的。作者们通常假设你自动就像你的太阳星座。于是所有白羊座都被描述为精力充沛、自我中心、冲动，所有双子座都被刻画为天生的调情高手和花花公子。事实并非如此。如果太阳星座专栏从以下基本前提出发，将会更有价值：太阳星座代表你需要建设和发展的品质，以建设性的方式，为了成为独特的你自己，为了忠于自己并对自己感觉良好。与其说「你是白羊座，所以你有主见」，不如写「你的太阳在白羊座，这意味着你人生的主要目标之一是发展你的勇气、活力和以可行有效的方式表达自我的能力。」你看出区别了吧。现在读者有了一个目标或追寻，有了为之奋斗的东西。如果我们再考虑整个星盘，就可以分析本性中的其他因素如何有利于或妨碍太阳星座特质的健康发展。

Figure 4 on page 120 gives a list of pretty obvious keywords for the Sun principle. Take a few moments this week to reflect on these words. Also take some time just to meditate on the glyph or symbol for the Sun. It is a circle which represents infinity and unboundedness, but there is a dot in the middle. The glyph shows the circle of wholeness encompassing the dot of individuality, and is therefore descriptive of what Jungians refer to as the “ego-Self axis.” The dot symbolises your individuality, your individual and unique self which is a vehicle or vessel through which your “spirit” or your transpersonal Self (sometimes referred to as the higher Self) can express itself. The principle of the Sun defines a process by which we differentiate and develop an “I” or personal ego; however, in terms of fullest possible growth and evolution, there will come a time when the personal ego is asked to acknowledge and honour something greater than itself, to realise its role as a channel through which the transpersonal or universal Self can express itself. In his book, What We May Be, Piero Ferrucci describes the transpersonal Self in this way:
第120页的图4列出了太阳原则的一些相当明显的关键词。这周花些时间反思这些词语。也抽些时间冥想太阳的符号。它是一个圆圈，代表无限和无边无际，但中间有一个点。这个符号展示了完整之环包容着个体之点，因此描述了荣格学派所说的「自我-自性轴」。那个点象征你的个体性，你独特的个体自我，它是你的「精神」或超越性自我（有时被称为高我）得以表达的工具或容器。太阳原则定义了一个过程，我们借此区分和发展一个「我」或个人自我；然而，就最充分的成长和进化而言，终将有一天，个人自我被要求去承认和尊崇比自身更伟大的事物，认识到自己作为通道的角色，超越性或宇宙自我借此表达自身。在他的著作《我们可能成为什么》中，Piero Ferrucci这样描述超越性自我：

The transpersonal Self, while retaining a sense of individuality, lives at the level of universality, in a realm where personal plans and concerns are overshadowed by the wider vision of the whole. The realization of the transpersonal Self is the mark of spiritual fulfillment.4
超越性自我在保持个体感的同时，生活于普遍性的层面，在一个个人计划和关切被整体更宏大的视野所遮蔽的领域中。超越性自我的实现是精神圆满的标志。4

In Myth and Today's Consciousness, Jungian analyst Ean Begg explains how the archetype represented by the Sun can be associated with the ego/Self axis:
在《神话与今日意识》中，荣格学派分析师Ean Begg解释了太阳所代表的原型如何与自我/自性轴相关联：

I shall summarise how I see in psychological terms the archetype of the Sun. These terms are the ego-Self axis, and the transformations in the relationship between Self and ego in the course of the individuation process. The Self is psychic totality, the original, unconscious, all-inclusive, genetic potentia, from which, at first in isolated flashes in early childhood, the ego, subject of consciousness, emerges. The ego on its hero-path of achievement, slaying the dragon of dependence on mother and family, taking responsibility for being an individual in a world of individuals, one-sidedly plays its strong suits and journeys ever further from its first home, ascribing everything to its own strength and cleverness. At some point, however, the fascinating pull of the primal wholeness reasserts itself and, from the subsequent agony of awakening, death and rebirth, a new alignment is constellated. The relativised ego acknowledges the existence of the other psychic contents and becomes aware of its responsibility as the exponent of the Self, its source and its goal, as well as the path between, and the urge to tread it.5
我将概括我如何从心理学角度看待太阳原型。这些术语即自我-自性轴，以及在个体化过程中自我与自性之间关系的转化。自性是心灵整体性，是最初的、无意识的、包容一切的、遗传性的潜能，由此在早期童年以孤立的闪光形式，自我——意识的主体——从中浮现。自我在其成就的英雄之路上，斩杀对母亲和家庭依赖的巨龙，在一个个体组成的世界上为做一个个体而承担责任，偏面地发挥自己的强项，越行越远离最初的家园，将一切归功于自身的力量和聪明。然而在某个时刻，原始整体性的迷人牵引重新确立自身，从随后的觉醒之苦、死亡与重生中，一种新的对齐被构成。被相对化的自我承认了其他心灵内容的存在，并觉察到它作为自性的代言者的责任——自性是其源头也是其目标，是两者之间的道路，以及踏上这条道路的冲动。5

While the Sun represents the process of defining our individuality and separate-self sense, it also is our link to that part of us which partakes of the wholeness of life. By expressing our uniqueness and true individuality we are pulled into participating in some greater scheme or plan through which life's wholeness becomes evident. Like the different musical instruments in an orchestra, every individual has his or her own part to play in the overall composition of life. But we first need to develop a strong sense of “I,” a healthy, honest and functional ego, before we can be a rightful vessel for something greater than ourselves.
虽然太阳代表定义我们个体性和独立自我感的过程，它同时也是我们与自身那参与生命整体性的部分之间的纽带。通过表达我们的独特性和真实的个体性，我们被拉入参与某个更宏大的计划或方案，借此生命的整体性得以显现。就像管弦乐队中不同的乐器，每个个体在生命的整体乐章中都有自己要演奏的部分。但我们首先需要发展出强大的「我」感，一个健康、诚实且功能良好的自我，然后才能成为承载比自身更伟大之物的合格容器。

“There is no ache more deadly than the striving to be oneself.”6 We examined the Moon and mother; we learned that as newborn infants we are enmeshed and merged with the Great Mother. Now we come to the Sun, and we are ready to separate from her, to differentiate who we are or are meant to be from the mother or caretaker, to stand on our own feet and be a person in our own right. Last night I talked about the Moon in terms of the early love affair we have with mother, the first big romance of our lives. By the time we're nine months old, however, we are ready to have a love affair not just with mother but with the world. We begin to crawl, we learn to walk, and we discover there is a whole world out there to be explored or mastered. I equate the Sun with the urge to disentangle ourselves from our symbiosis with mother in order to pursue the desire we all have to become a separate and distinct self, a private “I.”
「没有比努力成为自己更致命的痛苦。」6 我们考察了月亮和母亲；我们了解到作为新生婴儿，我们与伟大母亲纠缠和融合在一起。现在我们来到太阳，我们准备好从她那里分离出来，将我们是谁或注定成为谁与母亲或照料者区分开来，自立于世，成为一个拥有自身权利的人。昨晚我谈到了月亮——我们与母亲的早期恋情，我们生命中的第一段大浪漫。但到了九个月大时，我们准备好不仅与母亲、也与世界展开恋情。我们开始爬行，学步走路，发现有一整个世界等着我们去探索或掌握。我将太阳等同于那种从与母亲的共生中解脱出来的冲动，以追求我们所有人都有的成为一个独立而独特的自我、一个私密的「我」的渴望。

Now we'll examine the Sun as a symbol of the ego and also as a symbol of Father, themes Liz has explored earlier. Before we delve into all this, let's briefly look at the guidelines for interpreting the Sun which I've drawn up (see Table 2 on pages 122 and 123). I really do hope that you'll make use of these guidelines when working with charts. Honestly, if you feel “stuck” with a chart, if it isn't coming alive for you, I would suggest that you focus first on the Sun and its placement by sign, house and aspect and use it as a way to start, as a way of getting a handle on the chart (if you'll excuse the jargon). Just analysing the Sun in terms of what a person needs to tap, work on and integrate can get the reading off the ground. From there you can then bring in other facets of the chart to see how these interact with the Sun's position. Although I'm emphasising the importance of the Sun, there are nine other planets which will describe other aspects of our nature. Some people may be too identified with the Sun and not have integrated their Moon sign or any other planet properly. Others may be obviously like their Moon, but their Sun sign is still in the background and needs to be expressed. In any case, if you find yourself having difficulty getting into or working with a chart, try starting with the Sun.
现在我们将考察太阳作为自我的象征，同时也作为父亲的象征——Liz先前已探讨过的主题。在深入这一切之前，让我们简要看看我拟定的解读太阳的指导原则（见第122-123页的表2）。我真心希望你们在看盘时能利用这些指导原则。说实话，如果你觉得面对一张星盘「卡住了」，如果它对你来说不够鲜活，我建议你首先聚焦于太阳及其星座、宫位和相位，把它作为一个切入点，一种掌握星盘的方式（请原谅这个行话）。仅仅通过分析太阳——一个人需要发掘、努力和整合什么——就能让解读启动起来。然后你可以带入星盘的其他面向，看看它们如何与太阳的位置互动。虽然我强调太阳的重要性，但还有其他九颗行星会描述我们本性的其他方面。有些人可能过于认同太阳，而未能恰当整合其月亮星座或任何其他行星。另一些人可能明显更像他们的月亮，但太阳星座仍在背景中，需要被表达。无论如何，如果你发现自己在进入或处理一张星盘时遇到困难，尝试从太阳开始。

Let's play around for a while with these guidelines to illustrate how they can be used. I know some of you may find this pretty elementary, but there are definite reasons why I believe it's important to get back to basics. With the recent expansion of psychological astrology, many astrologers have become more psychologically knowledgeable and sophisticated; besides just knowing their astrology, they're taking courses in counselling or have trained in various schools of psychological thought. As a result (and I must confess that I was guilty of this myself), some of these astrologers may be inclined to delve straight into an analysis of deep psychological issues with their clients, such as infantile complexes and other baggage from early life which the client is still carrying around inside, all of which will be reflected in the chart. In doing so, however, some psychological astrologers run the risk of neglecting or overlooking certain basics, such as the meaning and significance of something as apparently simple and straightforward as the placement of the Sun by sign. So let's start by using the sign of Gemini as an example of how to work with these guidelines. Guideline number one states that your Sun sign shows the route you need to take to develop a healthy ego and sense of individuality. What qualities or traits immediately come to your mind if you think of the sign of Gemini?
让我们先用这些指导原则做些练习，说明如何使用它们。我知道你们中有些人可能觉得这相当基础，但我认为回到基本面是有明确理由的。随着心理占星学的近期扩展，许多占星师在心理学上变得更有知识和更老练；除了了解占星学之外，他们还在学习咨询课程或接受过各种心理学思想流派的训练。因此（我必须承认我自己也有这个毛病），其中一些占星师可能倾向于直接深入分析客户深层心理问题，如婴儿期情结和客户内心仍然携带的早期生活包袱——所有这些都反映在星盘中。然而，这样做时，一些心理占星师冒着忽视或忽略某些基本面的风险，比如太阳按星座排列这样看似简单明了的意义和重要性。那么让我们以双子座为例，说明如何运用这些指导原则。指导原则第一条指出，你的太阳星座显示你需要走的路线，以发展健康的自我和个体感。当你想到双子座时，什么品质或特征立刻浮现在你脑海中？
