Audience: The ability to communicate and exchange information.
听众：沟通和交换信息的能力。

Howard: Yes, we're concerned here with self-expression, whether verbal or through any other medium. Gemini is an air sign, therefore we're in the realm of the mind and intellect, the capacity for objectivity and analysis, to be able to look at oneself, other people and life in general from a variety of angles rather than just responding emotionally or instinctually to situations. There is also the need to make connections, to see how one thing influences or relates to another, to explore a wide range of the facets of existence. It is essential for our fulfilment that we have a place in our lives where we are able to radiate and give expression to the qualities of our Sun sign. I'm especially happy when people are in a vocation or a career which naturally allows them a lot of scope to use and develop the characteristics of the sign in which their Sun is placed. A few years ago I was approached by a publisher and asked to write a book describing which careers suited which Sun signs. It was intended to be a commercial, mass-market type book. In a moment of insanity I agreed to cowrite it with a friend and colleague, and it came out in Great Britain under the title of The Sun Sign Career Guide.7 This was my most extensive foray into pure Sun sign astrology, and I felt slightly apprehensive about doing it, a little embarrassed to put my name to such a book. How can you assess career just by the sign of the Sun? What about the 10th house or the 6th or other parts of the chart which would obviously influence one's calling or profession? After a bit of thought I was less apprehensive because I realised it would be a good thing for people to find work which somehow expressed their Sun sign. Think about it: it's essential for self-development that we realise and live out our Sun sign, and it's also a fact that many of us have to spend a great deal of our time working. So why not try to find a job whose very nature requires us to make use of the qualities or traits associated with our sign? That's how I justified it, at least. I am pleased when Geminis tell me they work as journalists or in the media, or even that they are cabbies or train drivers, provided they themselves are happy with what they're doing. You can see why—these professions fit with Mercury-ruled Gemini, with the need to communicate and exchange information, with the need to move around and transport knowledge, people or goods from one place to another. To be in a career which correlates with your innate archetypal make-up is a blessing.
Howard：是的，我们这里关注的是自我表达，无论是通过言语还是任何其他媒介。双子座是风象星座，所以我们处于心智和智力的领域，具备客观性和分析能力，能够从多种角度审视自己、他人和一般的生活，而不是仅仅以情绪或本能的方式回应情境。还有建立联系的需要，看到一件事如何影响或关联另一件事，探索存在之广泛面向的需要。我们在生活中拥有一个能够辐射和表达太阳星座特质的领域，这对我们的满足感至关重要。当人们从事一种自然允许他们大量运用和发展其太阳所在星座特征的职业或事业时，我特别高兴。几年前，一家出版商找到我，请我写一本书描述哪些职业适合哪些太阳星座。那打算是一本商业化的、面向大众市场的书。在一时的疯狂中，我同意与一位朋友和同事合写，在英国以《太阳星座职业指南》7为书名出版。这是我最大规模的一次纯太阳星座占星学的尝试，我对做这件事感到有些不安，把自己的名字署在这种书上有点尴尬。你怎么能仅凭太阳星座来评估职业呢？第十宫或第六宫或星盘的其他部分呢？那些显然也会影响一个人的职业或专业？想了一想后我不那么不安了，因为我意识到让人们找到能以某种方式表达他们太阳星座的工作是件好事。想想看：实现和实践我们的太阳星座对自我发展至关重要，而且事实上我们大多数人都要花大量时间工作。那么为什么不试着找一份其本质就需要我们运用与我们星座相关品质或特征的工作呢？至少我是这样为自己的行为辩护的。当双子座的人告诉我他们在新闻界或媒体工作，甚至当出租车司机或火车司机，只要他们自己对所做的事满意，我就很高兴。你能看出原因——这些职业符合水星主管的双子座，符合沟通和交换信息的需要，符合移动物品以及将知识、人或货物从一个地方运到另一个地方的需要。从事与先天原型构成相符的职业是一种福分。

Let's move on to point two under the guidelines for interpreting the Sun by sign: “The Sun sign is a symbol of what needs to be (consciously) struggled for and attained, not just that which comes instinctively.” To varying degrees most of us will have to work quite hard to develop and manifest more fully the nature of our Sun sign. Although it may be suppressed or denied, your Moon sign is what comes instinctively to you, but the fullest expression of your Sun sign usually requires conscious effort, determination and choice. And I don't think we ever feel finished where the Sun is concerned. If you're an Aries, you will probably always feel that you could be better at asserting yourself. If you're a Gemini, you will probably think you could still be more intelligent or more adept at communication. Point three states that the Sun sign colours one's animus-father image. The latter part of this talk will examine this idea in greater depth.
现在转到按星座解读太阳的指导原则第二条：「太阳星座是需要（有意识地）为之奋斗和获得的象征，而不仅仅是本能带来的东西。」在某种程度上，我们大多数人都要相当努力地工作才能更充分地发展和展现太阳星座的特质。虽然它可能被压抑或否认，但你的月亮星座是本能来到你这里的东西，而太阳星座最充分的表达通常需要有意识的努力、决心和选择。而且我认为在太阳方面我们永远不会觉得完成了。如果你是白羊座，你可能永远觉得自己在自我表达方面可以做得更好。如果你是双子座，你可能认为自己还可以更聪明或更擅长沟通。第三条指出，太阳星座影响着一个人的阿尼姆斯-父亲形象。本次讲座的后半部分将更深入地探讨这个想法。

Now take the Sun by house. Point one says that the facet of existence associated which the Sun's house is an arena in which we should actively involve ourselves, a domain where we need to distinguish ourselves in some way, to stand out and feel special. If you have the Sun in the 5th, you will find yourself through being creative, and I mean that in the broadest sense. Your path of self-actualisation requires that you give birth to something, whether these are children or the concrete realisation of an inspiration or bright idea that comes to you. Involving yourself in your Sun's natal house helps you come into your own. I remember doing a reading for a woman who had the Sun and Mars in Aries in the 5th. She consulted me over a number of years. When we first met, she really was quite meek and mild, which surprised me considering her Sun/Mars placement. A few years later, however, she had given birth to her first child and you wouldn't believe the difference it made. She came into my study beaming with strength and confidence; she had found her power and authority through this obvious 5th-house activity.
现在看太阳的宫位。第一条说，太阳所在宫位所关联的存在面向是一个我们应该积极参与的舞台，一个我们需要在其中以某种方式出类拔萃、脱颖而出的领域。如果你的太阳在第五宫，你会通过创造力来发现自我，我这里说的创造力是最广义的。你的自我实现之路要求你孕育某些东西——无论是孩子还是某个灵感或好点子的具体实现。参与太阳的出生宫位帮助你找到自己的位置。我记得给一位太阳和火星都在白羊座第五宫的女性做解读。她找我咨询了好几年。我们初次见面时，她确实非常温顺柔和，这让我惊讶，考虑到她的太阳/火星位置。然而几年后，她生下了第一个孩子，你不会相信这带来了多大的变化。她走进我的工作室，散发着力量和自信的光芒；她通过这个明显的第五宫活动找到了自己的力量和权威。

Point two asserts that life can be a struggle in the house of the Sun. This is similar to what I was saying about developing and refining the qualities of the Sun sign. If you're born with the Sun in the 7th house, you may in time become quite adept and sophisticated in the sphere of relationships, and yet you'll probably feel that there still is more to learn and unfold in this area. If you have the Sun in the 11th, you can attain the status of being a powerful force within groups, and yet you may feel that you could somehow do better or achieve more in this domain. No matter how great our accomplishment, our Sun always wants to shine more brightly. Point three relates father and animus issues with the Sun's house (something we'll be taking up in greater detail later). Finally, point four is that the Sun's house can also give clues to a natural vocation and calling. So if you're born with the Sun in the 9th, what field of life could you shine in?
第二条断言，在太阳的宫位中，生活可能是一场挣扎。这类似于我之前所说的关于发展和精炼太阳星座品质的话。如果你出生时太阳在第七宫，你可能最终会在关系领域变得相当老练和精微，但你可能仍然觉得在这个领域还有更多需要学习和展开的。如果你的太阳在第十一宫，你可以在团体中获得强大力量的地位，但你可能觉得在某种程度上可以做得更好或在这个领域取得更多成就。无论我们的成就有多伟大，我们的太阳总想更加闪耀。第三条将父亲和阿尼姆斯议题与太阳的宫位联系起来（我们稍后将更详细地讨论这个）。最后，第四条说太阳的宫位也能提供关于天生职业和使命的线索。所以如果你出生时太阳在第九宫，你可以在什么生命领域发光？

Audience: You could be a natural teacher or even a born travel agent.
听众：你可能天生适合做老师，甚至是个天生的旅行代理。

Howard: Yes, those professions are consonant with the meaning of the 9th house. There are many different levels and dimensions to each house, and for the reasons I've discussed earlier, it makes good sense to find work which relates to one of them. Of course, you may want to change or switch levels at certain times in your life, probably in synchrony with transits or progressions which affect the Sun. If your Sun is in the 12th, you can strengthen your identity and sense of self through working in an institution, being a nurse, a museum curator or a prison warden—it can be as obvious as that. Of course, the Sun in the 12th is in some ways an odd or conflicting placement. The 12th house has so much to do with merging with something greater than yourself or sacrificing your own needs and desires for the sake of other people or to the larger context of which you are a part; and yet the Sun's domain is where we are meant to develop our authority, specialness and individuality, where we are meant to shine and stand out. So some people with this placement have the curious task of finding themselves by sacrificing themselves. But it's important to remember that you can't give up your self until you have established a self to give up. So you have to forge an identity and define a sense of self, and then be prepared, given certain situations, to let go of it. If you have this placement, I would say that this might be one of your main lessons, tasks or purposes for this life.
Howard：是的，那些职业与第九宫的含义相符。每个宫位都有许多不同的层面和维度，由于我之前讨论的原因，找到与之相关的工作是有道理的。当然，你可能在生命的某些时期想要改变或切换层面，可能与影响太阳的过境或推运同步。如果你的太阳在第十二宫，你可以通过在机构中工作来强化你的身份和自我感——做护士、博物馆策展人或监狱长——可以这么直接。当然，太阳在第十二宫在某些方面是一个奇特或矛盾的位置。第十二宫与融入比自己更伟大的事物或为了他人或你所从属的更大背景而牺牲自己的需求和渴望密切相关；然而太阳的领域是我们要发展权威、独特性和个体性的地方，是我们要闪耀和脱颖而出的地方。所以一些有这个位置的人有着好奇的任务——通过牺牲自己来找到自己。但重要的是记住，你必须先建立一个自我才能放弃自我。所以你必须锻造一个身份，定义一种自我感，然后准备在某些情况下放手。如果你有这个位置，我会说这可能是你今生的主要课题、任务或目标之一。

Finally we come to the guidelines for interpreting other planets in aspect to the Sun. Point one reminds us that any planet aspecting the Sun represents an energy or archetype that is crucially linked to the development of your individuality. Planets aspecting the Sun are fellow travellers in terms of the route you need to take to find out who you are as a distinct entity. When I see a planet in aspect to the Sun, I picture the Sun going arm in arm with that planet along the path of individuation and self-realisation. So if you have a Sun-Jupiter aspect, Jupiter needs to be included in your self-definition. If you have a Sun-Saturn aspect, you will need to honour and include Saturn in the formation of your ego-identity. If you were born with the Sun aspecting Neptune, you have to find a way to incorporate at least one or more of the qualities associated with Neptune into your identity and self-expression—music, art, healing or even sea travel may be integral to the formation of your self.
最后我们来看解读与太阳形成相位的其他行星的指导原则。第一条提醒我们，任何与太阳形成相位的行星都代表一个与你的个体性发展至关重要的能量或原型。与太阳形成相位的行星是你寻找作为独立实体之自身路途上的同路人。当我看到一颗行星与太阳形成相位时，我想象太阳与那颗行星手挽手走在个体化和自我实现的道路上。所以如果你有太阳-木星相位，木星需要被纳入你的自我定义。如果你有太阳-土星相位，你就需要在自我身份的形成中尊崇和纳入土星。如果你出生时太阳与海王星形成相位，你必须找到一种方式，将海王星相关的一种或多种品质纳入你的身份和自我表达——音乐、艺术、疗愈甚至海上旅行可能是你自我形成的组成部分。

In addition to showing qualities that are linked with your selfhood, aspects to the Sun can also suggest what might be an appropriate work or vocation. Sun conjunct Neptune could find the self through art or any other calling which evokes Neptune. Many people drawn to the acting profession have Sun-Neptune contacts. I think immediately of Clint Eastwood and Rock Hudson, who were both born with Sun square Neptune—their unfoldment and self-realisation involved Neptune quite literally in the form of film. Even though the contact was a hard angle they were highly successful, although one can see other ways the Sun-Neptune square was operating in terms of the discrepancy between Rock Hudson's film persona and his private life. Nonetheless, it pleases me to see people constructively integrating the nature of any planet aspecting the Sun into their work, life or identity. As you well know, you won't have too much difficulty finding drug addicts or alcoholics born with Sun-Neptune contacts. Obviously this is not the most ideal Neptunian route to self-realisation, and yet some people may need to go down that road as part of their individuation journey, although they risk self-destruction in the process. I've often been impressed by people with Sun-Neptune aspects who have fallen into the morass of addiction and yet climbed back out again; they seem to gain a certain kind of strength, wisdom or knowledge which may not be there in someone who hasn't gone through the difficult and challenging process of addiction and recovery.
除了显示与你的自我性相关的品质外，与太阳的相位也能暗示什么是合适的工作或职业。太阳合海王星可能通过艺术或其他任何唤起海王星的职业找到自我。许多被表演事业吸引的人都有太阳-海王星联系。我立刻想到Clint Eastwood和Rock Hudson，他们出生时都有太阳刑海王星——他们的展开和自我实现相当字面地以电影的形式涉及海王星。虽然相位是困难角度，但他们非常成功，尽管人们可以看到太阳刑海王星在其他方面也在运作，即Rock Hudson的电影形象与私生活之间的差距。尽管如此，看到人们将任何与太阳形成相位的行星之本性建设性地整合到他们的工作、生活或身份中，我很高兴。如你所知，你不会太难找到出生时有太阳-海王星联系的吸毒者或酗酒者。显然这不是自我实现的最理想海王星路线，然而有些人可能需要走那条路作为其个体化旅程的一部分，尽管他们冒着在此过程中自我毁灭的风险。我经常被那些有太阳-海王星相位、陷入成瘾泥沼却又爬出来的人所打动；他们似乎获得了一种力量、智慧或知识，而这在一个没有经历过成瘾和康复这一艰难而具有挑战性的过程的人身上可能是不存在的。

Aspects to the Sun also suggest something about the pace, rhythm or nature of your self-unfoldment. With Sun-Neptune, it's possible that you may spend a lot of time wandering around in a fog, confused about what your true identity is. People born with the Sun in easy aspect to Jupiter are usually eager and enthusiastic about expressing themselves, although any Sun-Jupiter aspect may correlate with self-inflation. Sun-Saturn people often need a much longer time to get where they have to go, and they may have to work very hard in the process. Point two in the aspect guidelines is about projection, the process by which you deny or disown a planet aspecting your Sun and consequently experience it as coming at you via the agency of other people. The example given is that of Sun opposition Saturn, where you may see others as limiting or blocking you when really this is a facet of your own psyche which you are projecting onto others. Something in you is holding yourself back, but you deny its existence and then experience it as coming at you from the outside. Ultimately the process of becoming whole will require that you take back such projections. Point three covers the relationship between planets aspecting the Sun and our father or animus image.
与太阳的相位也暗示你的自我展开的步调、节奏或性质。有太阳-海王星，你可能花大量时间在雾中徘徊，困惑于自己真实的身份是什么。出生时太阳与木星形成和谐相位的人通常对表达自己充满热情和热忱，尽管任何太阳-木星相位都可能与自我膨胀相关。太阳-土星的人通常需要长得多的时间才能到达他们必须去的地方，而且他们可能必须在过程中非常努力工作。相位指导原则的第二条是关于投射，你否认或否定一颗与你的太阳形成相位的行星，因而将其体验为通过他人的中介向你袭来的过程。给出的例子是太阳冲土星，你可能看到他人限制或阻碍你，而实际上这是你自己心灵的一个面向，你将其投射到他人身上。你内心有某种东西在拖你的后腿，但你否认它的存在，然后将其体验为从外部向你袭来的。最终，变得完整的过程将要求你收回这些投射。第三条涵盖与太阳形成相位的行星与我们的父亲或阿尼姆斯形象之间的关系。

I know the question in many of your minds right now: what happens when you have more than one planet aspecting the Sun? In certain cases you may come across rather curious combinations; for instance, Jupiter conjunct the Sun but Saturn square to the conjunction. So Jupiter is on one arm pulling your Sun one way, and Saturn is on the other arm pulling it in another direction or influencing you in a very different manner. The task is to accommodate the principles represented by both Jupiter and Saturn into your self-definition. The expansiveness of Jupiter will be countered by the doubt, insecurities and restrictions of Saturn; this will produce a fair bit of psychological tension, and yet there are ways to balance them, to make them work with one another rather than against each other. I apologise for all these examples being so sketchy, but my main purpose in reviewing these guidelines has been to elaborate briefly on how you can use them yourselves.
我知道你们中许多人现在脑子里的问题：如果你有不止一颗行星与太阳形成相位怎么办？在某些情况下，你可能遇到相当奇特的组合；例如，木星合太阳但土星刑这个合相。所以木星在一条臂上拉着你的太阳往一个方向，土星在另一条臂上往另一个方向拉它或以非常不同的方式影响你。任务是将木星和土星所代表的原则都纳入你的自我定义。木星的扩张性将被土星的怀疑、不安全感和限制所制衡；这会产生相当多的心理紧张，然而有办法平衡它们，让它们相互协作而非相互对抗。我为这些例子如此简略而道歉，但我回顾这些指导原则的主要目的是简要阐述你们自己如何使用它们。

Someone asked me about Sun-Moon aspects and I promised I'd cover them, so let's discuss these now before we embark on examining the Sun in terms of father and ego-emergence. While I firmly believe expressing and “living” your Sun is the most important factor in self-fulfilment, this should not be done at the expense of your Moon sign and placement. We have to be our Sun while also acknowledging the Moon in us. When we separate from the body of mother and begin to form our own ego identity, this does not mean totally abandoning what our Moon represents. We shouldn't deny our inheritance from mother or our caretaker. We shouldn't deny our past. What I'm talking about is the distinction between differentiation and dissociation. We have to expand our identity and yet include what has been there before, not just cut off from it. Historically and mythologically speaking, when humanity emerged from its fusion with Nature and the Great Mother, people became more solar—that is, more conscious of themselves as separate from everything else in existence. This process allowed for the development of mind, reason and intellect, which has led to the remarkable technological advances of our civilisation and a fair degree of mastery over nature. But it appears that we might have gone too far, that we have become too rational and technical at the expense of heart and instinct. To put it another way, there has been a mythic dissociation from the Great Mother rather than a mythic differentiation.8 Dissociating from the past means denying it ever existed or that it is part of us. Differentiating from something means we still recognise and include it, even though we have moved beyond it. The same rationale applies to the relationship between the Sun and the Moon in the chart. The Moon shows how you instinctively act and respond to any situation or environment you are in—although as I've said, many people may be out of touch with it. The Sun, however, has more to do with self-determination and the will, the capacity to choose to act in a certain way rather than just respond or react in the instinctive manner of the Moon. You can see how life starts to get complicated if you happen to be born with the Sun and Moon in a challenging angle to one another.
有人问我关于太阳-月亮相位，我答应过会讲，所以在我们开始考察太阳作为父亲和自我涌现的象征之前，让我们先讨论这些。虽然我坚信表达和实践你的太阳是自我实现中最重要的因素，但这不应以牺牲你的月亮星座和位置为代价。我们必须做我们的太阳，同时也要承认我们心中的月亮。当我们从母亲的身体中分离并开始形成自己的自我身份时，这并不意味着完全抛弃我们的月亮所代表的东西。我们不应否认从母亲或照料者那里继承的遗产。我们不应否认我们的过去。我所说的是区分与解离之间的区别。我们必须扩展我们的身份，同时纳入之前已存在的东西，而不是简单地与之割裂。从历史和神话的角度讲，当人类从与自然和伟大母亲的融合中浮现时，人们变得更加太阳化——即更意识到自己是与存在中其他一切相分离的。这个过程允许了心智、理性和智力的发展，带来了我们文明显著的技术进步和对自然相当程度的掌控。但看来我们可能走得太远了，我们变得过于理性和技术化，而以心灵和本能的丧失为代价。换言之，存在的是与伟大母亲的神话式解离而非神话式区分。8 解离于过去意味着否认它曾经存在或它是我们的一部分。从某物区分意味着我们仍然承认和纳入它，即使我们已经超越了它。同样的逻辑适用于星盘中太阳和月亮的关系。月亮显示你如何本能地行动和回应你所处的任何情境或环境——尽管正如我所说，许多人可能与之脱节。然而太阳更多关乎自我决定和意志，选择以某种方式行动的能力，而非仅仅以月亮的本能方式回应或反应。你可以看到，如果你出生时太阳和月亮形成挑战性角度，生活如何开始变得复杂。

Let's take an obvious example—the Sun in Aquarius square to the Moon in Scorpio. What in general would your instinctive reactions be like if you had the Moon in Scorpio?
让我们看一个明显的例子——太阳在水瓶座刑月亮在天蝎座。如果你有月亮在天蝎座，你的一般本能反应会是什么样的？

Audience: You would probably respond emotionally and with strong feeling to most situations.
听众：你可能会以情感和强烈的感受来回应大多数情境。

Howard: Yes, your instinctive response is likely to come from an emotional place. But if your Scorpio Moon squares your Aquarian Sun, you have some growing to do, some work to do on yourself. What do you think you are meant to build in and develop if your Sun is in Aquarius?
Howard：是的，你的本能反应很可能来自一个情感之地。但如果你的天蝎座月亮刑你的水瓶座太阳，你有成长要做，有自我修行的功课。如果你的太阳在水瓶座，你认为你注定要建设和发展的品质是什么？

Audience: Aquarius is an air sign, which means that you need to be more objective, to stand back and view things from a broader perspective rather than just responding emotionally.
听众：水瓶座是风象星座，这意味着你需要更客观，退后一步从更宽广的视角看待事物，而不是仅仅以情感回应。

Howard: Precisely, a struggle or war is going on in the psyche. You are here to realise and develop Aquarian qualities in order to achieve a more fully formed sense of self, and yet your innate responses are Scorpionic. So I might advise someone with this combination in this way: “It is important for you to acknowledge, accept and allow your strong feelings and emotions rather than denying or condemning them, but in the name of growth and individuation you need to move beyond this place. Your Aquarian Sun asks that you work on developing the ability to view situations in a more detached or objective way as well.” Having said this, I must admit I've run into cases where certain people with the Sun in Aquarius square the Moon in Scorpio appear to respond in a very cool, objective and detached way to life, and this leads me to conclude that they are in touch with the Aquarian Sun but are denying the Scorpio Moon side. So in this case my advice will be quite different: “I'm pleased to see the qualities of your Aquarian Sun in operation, but I fear that you don't realise just how emotional, vindictive and Scorpionic you also are. Have you acknowledged this Scorpionic side to your nature, or are you simply denying it exists in order to come over as being reasonable, objective and fair?” It is never healthy to denigrate any part of ourselves, especially the Moon which is so vital to health, relationships, and emotional well-being.
Howard：完全正确，内在正进行着一场挣扎或战争。你在这里是要实现和发展水瓶座品质以获得更完整的自我感，然而你的先天回应是天蝎式的。所以我可能会这样建议有这种组合的人：「承认、接受和允许你的强烈感受和情绪很重要，而非否认或谴责它们，但以成长和个体化的名义，你需要超越这个位置。你的水瓶座太阳也要求你努力发展以更超然或客观的方式看待情境的能力。」话虽如此，我必须承认我遇到过某些太阳在水瓶座刑月亮在天蝎座的人，似乎以非常冷静、客观和超然的方式回应生活，这让我得出结论：他们与水瓶座太阳有联结，但在否认天蝎月亮的一面。所以在这种情况下我的建议会很不同：「我很高兴看到你的水瓶座太阳品质在运作，但我担心你没有意识到你有多少情绪化、报复心和天蝎特质。你承认了这种天蝎面向的本性吗，还是你仅仅为了显得通情达理、客观和公正而否认它的存在？」贬低我们自身的任何部分都不健康，尤其是月亮——它对健康、关系和情感幸福如此至关重要。

For the sake of argument, let's consider the reverse placement, someone born with the Sun in Scorpio and the Moon in Aquarius. This is a different story. With the natal Moon in Aquarius, what kind of innate responses and reactions might a person display?
为了便于讨论，让我们考虑相反的位置——某人出生时太阳在天蝎座、月亮在水瓶座。这是不同的故事。出生时月亮在水瓶座，一个人会表现出什么样的先天回应和反应？

Audience: They will probably react in an Aquarian fashion, more objectively and rationally than someone with the Moon in a water sign.
听众：他们可能以水瓶座的方式反应，比月亮在水象星座的人更客观和理性。

Howard: Yes, the emotions are sifted through the rational mind or intellect—this is the natural Moon in Aquarius way of reacting. Have you noticed that it's often very hard to know what people with the Moon in Aquarius are really feeling? They put up a front which is laid back or cool, a bit like the persona Clint Eastwood presents in a number of his movies. Many men would give their right arms to be so self-possessed and unshakeable. But what if this person was born with the Sun in Scorpio? I understand this to mean that growth and consciousness-raising entails greater acknowledgement and exposure of one's Scorpionic nature, which is more intensely feeling and emotional, even though there are many Suns in Scorpio who desperately try to hide or suppress such traits. I must add that this doesn't mean they should allow themselves to go berserk, because the Sun in Scorpio also asks that one learns to manage—that is, to control, to direct but not to repress—intense emotion. Nonetheless, growth and self-formation for this person would require moving beyond the sole honouring of rationality and objectivity, and allowing out into the open the more feeling side of the self as indicated by the Sun in a water sign.
Howard：是的，情绪通过理性心智或智力来筛选——这是月亮在水瓶座的自然反应方式。你注意到了吗，月亮在水瓶座的人真正在感受什么往往很难知道？他们竖起一道随和或冷漠的面纱，有点像Clint Eastwood在许多电影中呈现的人设。许多男人愿意付出右臂来换取这样的自制力和不可动摇。但如果这个人出生时太阳在天蝎座呢？我的理解是，成长和意识提升需要更多地承认和暴露其天蝎本质——更具强烈感受和情绪，尽管有许多太阳在天蝎座的人拼命试图隐藏或压抑这些特质。我必须补充，这不意味着他们应该允许自己失控，因为太阳在天蝎座也要求一个人学会管理——即控制、引导但不压抑——强烈情绪。尽管如此，对这个人来说，成长和自我形成需要超越仅仅尊崇理性和客观性，允许太阳在水象星座所显示的自我感受面浮现于外。

So you can see that with a square, opposition, inconjunct, sesquiquadrate or even a semisextile between the Sun and Moon, you have very different archetypes or styles of being at odds with one another in your psyche. This often produces a more tense and jittery personality than someone with the Sun and Moon in compatible signs. We could say it is a conflict between the emotions or instincts and the will, the instinctive nature and response patterns versus those qualities you need consciously to develop in order to fulfil the individuation process indicated by your Sun sign.
所以你可以看到，当太阳和月亮之间有刑相、冲相、补八分相、倍半刑相甚至半六分相时，你的内在有非常不同的原型或存在方式彼此冲突。这通常产生比太阳和月亮在和谐星座的人更紧张和焦躁的个性。我们可以说这是情绪或本能与意志之间的冲突——本能本性和回应模式与你需要有意识地发展以实现太阳星座所指示的个体化过程的品质之间的冲突。

Audience: Can you say something about the Sun in Aries in opposition to the Moon in Libra?
听众：你能谈谈太阳在白羊座冲月亮在天秤座吗？

Howard: Yes, this should be fairly clear. In general, the Moon in Libra possesses a natural inclination to compromise, harmonise and balance, although I wouldn't take this to mean that all people with this placement are sweet and charming peacemakers. But if the Sun is in Aries opposing the Moon in Libra, these people actually need to learn that it is all right to stand up for themselves and what they want and believe in, even if it means causing disruption and offending others. Try it the other way around, the Sun in Libra opposing the Moon in Aries. Most people with the Moon in Aries are pretty adept at asserting their needs and feelings, but if the Sun is in Libra then perhaps they are here to develop a greater ability to compromise and balance their wants, beliefs or desires with those of others around them. Semisextiles and inconjuncts between the Sun and Moon are particularly interesting and challenging because they ask you to accommodate or include archetypal styles of being which are by nature very different; when these angles occur between such key planets as the Sun and Moon, they highlight a collision between two signs which are incompatible not only by element but also by quadruplicity, something you don't get with a square or opposition. An Aries Sun has entirely different requirements from a Taurus Moon; a Taurus Sun may not feel all that comfortable with the impulses of a Sagittarian Moon.
Howard：是的，这应该相当清楚。总的来说，月亮在天秤座拥有妥协、和谐和平衡的自然倾向，虽然我不会把这理解为所有有这个位置的人都是甜蜜迷人的和事佬。但如果太阳在白羊座冲月亮在天秤座，这些人实际上需要学到：为自己挺身而出，为自己想要的和相信的坚持，即使这意味着造成冲突和冒犯他人，这也是可以的。反过来试试，太阳在天秤座冲月亮在白羊座。大多数月亮在白羊座的人相当擅长表达自己的需求和感受，但如果太阳在天秤座，也许他们来这里是为了发展更大的妥协能力，平衡自己的欲望、信念或愿望与周围人的。太阳和月亮之间的半六分相和补八分相特别有趣且具有挑战性，因为它们要求你纳入或包容本性上非常不同的原型风格；当这些角度发生在太阳和月亮这样的关键行星之间时，它们凸显了两个星座之间的碰撞——不仅元素不同，基本模式也不同——这是刑相或冲相所没有的。白羊座太阳与金牛座月亮的要求完全不同；金牛座太阳可能不太舒服于射手座月亮的冲动。

Pure trines and sextiles of the Sun to the Moon (I'm using the word pure to mean that the aspect isn't out of sign) are beneficial in the sense that your will and emotions are in compatible energies, so there is not such a great discrepancy felt or adjustment needed between instinctive lunar responses and conscious, solar self-determination and choices. Someone with the Sun in Cancer and the Moon in Pisces will have innate responses and reactions which are more naturally in accord with what the solar quest is asking of the person. Life may run a bit more smoothly if this is the case, because there is less conflict within you; consequently you might not meet so much external opposition or challenge, which is created by the outer world reflecting your own inner conflict or turmoil back to you. Get the picture? Of course, you could argue that there is no gain without pain; in other words, without the stress and tension inherent in a difficult Sun-Moon contact, you might not necessarily achieve the kind of positive transformation which a juicy inner struggle often yields.
太阳与月亮的纯三分相和六分相（我用「纯」表示相位不出星座）在以下意义上是有益的：你的意志和情绪处于和谐能量中，因此在本能的月亮回应与有意识的、太阳式的自我决定和选择之间，没有太大差异感或需要调适。太阳在巨蟹座、月亮在双鱼座的人将拥有与太阳追寻所要求的更自然一致的先天回应和反应。如果是这种情况，生活可能会顺畅一些，因为你内在冲突较少；因此你可能不会遇到那么多外部对立或挑战——这些是由外部世界将你自身的内在冲突或动荡反射给你所造成的。明白了吗？当然，你可以说没有痛苦就没有收获；换言之，没有困难太阳-月亮联系中固有的压力和紧张，你不一定实现那种通常由丰富的内在挣扎所yield的积极转变。

I see a few hands up. Don't even ask, I have a pretty good idea what one of your questions is going to be: “What if the Sun and the Moon are in the same sign?” Right, I see nods. This question always comes up. I'm going to have it engraved on my tombstone along with that other classic, “What does it mean if a house is empty?” which is a ridiculous question because as you well know a house is never empty—there is always a sign there and the planet ruling that sign to be considered. But that's another lecture entirely, and don't you dare even ask that question today. Any conjunction (and any aspect or placement for that matter) is always a little tricky to talk about authoritatively for the simple reason that how it manifests depends on its relation to the rest of the chart. A Sun-Moon conjunction square Pluto and opposed by Saturn is a very different kettle of fish when compared with the same conjunction trine Jupiter. We can approach it this way for now. Every sign generates many different levels or dimensions of expression, like a note in a chord. An archetype can be compared to a lift (or elevator) in a department store; one level takes you to women's fashions, another level lets you off at men's shoes, and if you're hungry and have the time and money you can travel right up to the restaurant on the top floor.
我看到有几只手举起来了。别问，我相当确定你们一个问题会是什么：「如果太阳和月亮在同一星座呢？」对，我看到点头了。这个问题总会被提出来。我要把它刻在我的墓碑上，加上另一个经典：「如果某个宫位是空的意味着什么？」——这是个荒唐的问题，因为你们都知道宫位永远不会空——总有一个星座在那里，还有主管那个星座的行星要考虑。但那完全是另一个讲座的话题，你们今天也敢问我这个问题。任何合相（以及任何相位或位置）总是有点棘手，难以权威性地谈论，原因很简单：它如何显现取决于它与星盘其余部分的关系。一个太阳-月亮合相且刑冥王星、被土星冲的，与同样的合相且木星三分的截然不同。我们可以这样来探讨。每个星座产生许多不同层面或维度的表达，就像和弦中的一个音符。一个原型可以比作百货商店里的电梯；一层带你到女装，另一层让你在男鞋处下车，如果你饿了又时间和金钱充裕，可以一直坐到顶楼的餐厅。

Let's say you are born with both the Sun and Moon in Taurus; we'll make it a conjunction but just the fact these two lights are in the same sign is relevant to this discussion. The sign Taurus has numerous facets. True, all these facets will be connected by some common archetypal thread, but there are still fairly distinct levels. The Moon in Taurus probably means that certain dimensions of the sign come instinctively to you, but the fact that the Sun is also in Taurus suggests there are other dimensions of this sign which require attention in terms of the solar process of ego-building and self-formation. You may instinctively know how to create structure and security in your life (the Moon in Taurus), but the Sun being there as well could mean that the more sensual, creative and artistic side of Venusian-ruled Taurus is calling out for further unfoldment. Or let's say you have both the Sun and Moon in Virgo. The Moon there could mean that being critical and analytical come instinctively to you—these are qualities which are innate or inbred. But if you have the Sun in Virgo as well, there are other dimensions of the sign which you need to focus on to really evolve in this life. Virgo is the sign of the craftsperson or specialist, so it may be that you are meant to work very hard at something and become highly skilled in your chosen field in order to build a healthy ego, a strong sense of “I,” or in order to feel fulfilled and complete as an individual. All right, that's enough on Sun-Moon aspects for now. At least we've cleared up some of the unfinished business from last night.
假设你出生时太阳和月亮都在金牛座；我们设为合相但仅仅是这两颗发光体在同一星座就与这个讨论相关。金牛座有许多面向。确实，所有这些面向都会被某种共同的原型线连接，但仍然有相当不同的层面。月亮在金牛座可能意味着金牛座的某些维度对你来说是本能的，但太阳也在那里意味着这个星座的其他维度需要在自我建设和自我形成的太阳过程中被关注。你可能本能地知道如何在生活中创造结构和安全感（月亮在金牛座），但太阳也在那里可能意味着金星主管的金牛座更感性、创造性和艺术的一面在呼唤进一步的展开。或者假设你的太阳和月亮都在处女座。月亮在那里可能意味着批评性和分析性对你来说是本能的——这些是天生或内禀的品质。但如果太阳也在处女座，那么这个星座还有其他维度你需要关注以真正在今生进化。处女座是工匠或专家的星座，所以也许你注定要在某件事上非常努力地工作，在你选择的领域中变得高度熟练，以建立健康的自我、强大的「我」感，或以感到作为个体是满足和完整的。好了，关于太阳-月亮相位暂时就到这里。至少我们清理了一些昨晚的未了之事。

The general discussion so far was really intended to serve as an introduction to a more in-depth examination of the Sun as a symbol of ego formation and the role that father plays in this process. So let's dive in. I'd like to start with a few lines from Homer's Odyssey, Book XVI:
到目前为止的讨论实际上是作为更深入考察太阳作为自我形成象征以及父亲在此过程中所起作用的引言。那么让我们深入。我想以荷马《奥德赛》第十六卷的几行诗句开始：

I am that father whom your boyhood lacked and suffered pain for lack of. I am he.
我就是你童年所缺失的那个父亲，
你因他的缺失而受苦。我就是他。

This is not princely, to be swept away by wonder at your father's presence.
为父亲的出现而惊得目瞪口呆，
这可不是王者的风度。

No other Odysseus will ever come for he and I are one, the same.9
不会再有别的奥德修斯归来了，
因为他和我是一体的，是同一个人。9

I find this quote very moving. Odysseus was away on his adventures and trials most of the time his son Prince Telemachus was growing up. When he returned, Telemachus didn't recognise his long-lost father. This is when Odysseus said, “I am that father whom your boyhood lacked and suffered pain for lack of. I am he,” and so on. The point I'm trying to make is that many of us didn't really know our fathers very well, and that for a great number of children-both boys and girls-father was, and could still be, a somewhat mysterious, unknown, and possibly even a forbidding presence. How deeply do you know your father? A year or so ago I was preparing a new lecture on the topic of fathers and sons. I spent so many years going on about the womb and mothers that I thought it was time to get my teeth into the father-child relationship, choosing to focus on male children and their fathers; in the process, however, I also learned more about the father-daughter relationship as well. But let me start by talking about fathers and sons for a while before bringing in fathers and daughters.
我觉得这段引文非常动人。Odysseus在他的儿子Prince Telemachus成长的大部分时间里都在外冒险和经历考验。当他回来时，Telemachus没有认出他久别的父亲。这时Odysseus说了，「我就是你童年所缺失的那个父亲，你因他的缺失而受苦。我就是他」等等。我想强调的是，我们中很多人并不真正了解我们的父亲，对大量孩子——无论男孩女孩——来说，父亲曾经是、现在仍然可能是一个有点神秘、未知、甚至令人畏惧的存在。你有多了解你的父亲？大约一年前我准备一个关于父子关系的新讲座。我花了这么多年谈论子宫和母亲，我觉得是时候咬住父亲与孩子的关系了，选择聚焦于男孩和他们的父亲；但在这个过程中，我也更多地了解了父女关系。但让我先谈一会儿父子关系，然后再带入父女关系。

According to various studies, chances are if you are an adult male between the ages of 20 and 55 brought up in North America or Britain (and I suspect these statistics apply to a number of other European countries as well), you probably didn't have a father who was significantly involved in your upbringing, who was openly affectionate and nurturing as well as strong and directive in a healthy, positive way.10 When I was gathering information for the Fathers and Sons lecture, I talked with many men about their fathers, and explored more thoroughly my own relationship with my father. As I was saying, what stood out was how mysterious a figure the father was, and how deceptively complex the father-son relationship is in general. Whether describing heroes, saints, sinners, villains or anything in between, most men (and many women as well) knew very little about their fathers' inner lives —what their fathers really thought and felt as people, as human beings.11 For many of us, he still remains a puzzle.
根据各种研究，如果你是在北美或英国长大的20至55岁成年男性（我怀疑这些统计也适用于一些其他欧洲国家），你很可能没有一个在你成长中显著参与的父亲——一个在健康、积极方面既公开表达关爱和滋养又强壮和有指导力的父亲。10 当我在为父子讲座收集资料时，我与许多男性谈论他们的父亲，并更深入地探索了我自己与父亲的关系。正如我所说，突出的是父亲这个形象有多么神秘，以及父子关系在总体上有多么看似简单实则复杂。无论描述的是英雄、圣人、罪人、恶棍还是介于其间的一切，大多数男性（以及许多女性也是如此）对父亲的内在生活知之甚少——他们父亲作为人、作为人类真正思考和感受什么。11 对我们许多人来说，他仍然是个谜。

Things are beginning to change now. Freud and his followers generated a vast mountain of literature on mother's undeniable importance to a child's development, but until relatively recently you couldn't find much written about the father-child relationship and the vital role fathers play in the developmental and maturation process of their sons and daughters. You could almost say that father was the forgotten parent. Currently, however (at least in the United States and Britain), fathers are becoming more visible, more present. Broadly speaking, we are experiencing the gradual emergence of a new kind of man—the 70's man, the 80's man, the 90's man: a man who is not so embarrassed to be seen as thoughtful and sensitive, who is less afraid to show his feelings, who wants to play a more active role in bonding with, bringing up and nurturing his children. How different from the male/paternal stereotype of the 1950's, when men who fathered were relegated mostly to the position of the macho breadwinner. They were cast as the protectors and providers for the family, but they were not meant to be openly emotional, to cry or to be the one who nurtured and bonded with the children in the same way as the female parent.
情况正在开始改变。Freud和他的追随者产生了大量关于母亲对孩子发展不可否认的重要性的文献，但直到相对近期，你找不到多少关于父子关系和父亲在子女发展和成熟过程中的关键角色的著述。你几乎可以说父亲是被遗忘的家长。然而目前（至少在美国和英国），父亲正在变得更加可见、更加在场。广义地说，我们正在经历一种新型男性的逐渐浮现——70年代的男性、80年代的男性、90年代的男性：一个不介意被看作深思熟虑和敏感、不太害怕展示自己感情、想在与孩子建立联结、抚养和滋养方面扮演更积极角色的男性。这与1950年代的男性/父亲刻板形象多么不同，那时的男性角色大多被降格为硬汉养家者。他们被定位为家庭的保护者和提供者，但不应该公开表露情感、不应该哭泣、不应该像母亲那样与孩子建立滋养和联结的纽带。

There are certain clear sociological reasons for the changing role of men and fathers. Curiously, these revolve around the Women's Movement, which has expanded rapidly over the last few decades. As women change and grow, they are better able to stand up and speak for themselves, to reject stereotypes or projections that men and society have put onto them for centuries. Men have long been projecting unlived or undeveloped sides of themselves onto women—the woman is the nurturing one, the woman is the feeling one. Now an increasing number of women are contesting being labelled solely by these roles. A woman may be very nurturing or caring but she is now beginning to demand more space and time to explore and realise other facets of her nature. Men are therefore almost forced into finding within themselves what they have let women carry and live out for them over the years. In any system, if one component of the system alters, the other components of the system have to change if the system is to survive at all. Although I live in Britain and it is a little behind America in this respect (you know what they say, “When America sneezes, Britain eventually catches a cold”), I frequently visited the States in the mid 70's and 80's. It was while watching American television that I first registered the degree of sociological change taking place within the family; advertisements for baby powder, for instance, now showed the father changing the baby. A greater number of fathers are choosing to be present at the birth of their children; you can see fathers out on the street with their kids and the mother is nowhere in sight.
男性与父亲角色的变化有某些明确的社会学原因。有趣的是，这些原因围绕着过去几十年迅速扩展的女性运动。随着女性改变和成长，她们更能够为自己站起来和发声，拒绝男性和社会几百年来投射到她们身上的刻板印象或投射。男性长期以来一直在将自己未活出或未发展的面向投射到女性身上——女性是滋养的人，女性是感受的人。现在越来越多的女性在质疑被仅以这些角色来标签化。一个女性可能非常滋养或关怀，但她现在开始要求更多空间和时间来探索和实现她本性的其他面向。因此男性几乎被迫在自身找到他们多年来让女性代为承载和实践的东西。在任何系统中，如果一个组成部分改变了，系统的其他组成部分必须改变，系统才能存续。虽然我住在英国，在这方面比美国稍落后（你知道他们怎么说，「美国打喷嚏，英国最终会感冒」），我在70年代中期和80年代经常访问美国。正是在观看美国电视时，我首次注意到了家庭内部正在发生的社会学变化程度；例如婴儿爽身粉的广告，现在展示了父亲在给孩子换尿布。越来越多的父亲选择在孩子出生时在场；你可以看到父亲们带着孩子在街上，而母亲不见踪影。

Just as you don't have to search too far afield to detect new images of male parenting, you don't have to look too hard to find astrological reasons for these new role models. Presently there is a traffic jam in the heavens happening in the sign of Capricorn, one of the signs traditionally associated with father. Neptune has been in Capricorn since 1984 and will remain there through the end of 1998. You could almost say that Neptune is dissolving a whole range of things associated with Capricorn, softening some of the rigidity of this sign, asking that the Capricorn principle (which covers fathering) become more pliable and empathetic. Uranus joined up in 1988, and will remain there until mid-January 1996, signifying new ideals and new images challenging existing Capricorn structures. In 1988, Saturn came along as well and did its number on Capricorn until February 1991. It's as if Saturn is saying the time has come to concretise these new images of fathering instigated by the movements of Neptune and Uranus.
正如你不必到太远的地方去发现男性育儿的新形象一样，你也不必太费力地找到这些新角色榜样的占星学原因。目前在天空中，摩羯座正在经历一场交通堵塞——摩羯座是传统上与父亲相关联的星座之一。海王星自1984年以来一直在摩羯座，并将持续到1998年底。你几乎可以说海王星正在溶解与摩羯座相关的一系列事物，柔化这个星座的一些刻板，要求摩羯座原则（涵盖父亲角色）变得更加柔韧和共情。天王星于1988年加入，将停留到1996年1月中旬，标志着新的理想和新的形象在挑战现有的摩羯座结构。1988年，土星也来了，对摩羯座施加影响直到1991年2月。就好像土星在说，是时候将海王星和天王星的运行所启动的新父亲形象具体化了。

A further astrological correlation with the changing role of father can be found through the sign of Leo, another sign that has long been associated with the hero-father archetype. Leo and Capricorn both represent aspects of male parenting; if these signs are prominent in someone's chart, I definitely would make a point of examining father issues with the person, just as I would dwell on stuff with mother if a client came along with seven planets in Cancer. At present, the generation of children born with Pluto in Leo are smack in or coming up to midlife, a time of self-examination and reappraisal. Just to be born with Pluto in Leo suggests complexes around the father. Pluto is now moving through Scorpio and you know what that means—sooner or later those people born with Pluto in Leo will experience transiting Pluto square natal Pluto. The transit of Pluto square its own place is very good at aggravating and bringing what is buried in you to the surface, casting light on unresolved complexes which have been doing their job of insidiously influencing the choices you make in life and the kinds of complications you attract in relationship. I know from my contemporaries that many men and women are presently discovering issues and feelings they have about their fathers which up to now they haven't acknowledged consciously. Many more books are being published which pertain to fathering, and there seems to be an influx of movies about fathers and their children. We'll shortly be examining the Sun as a significator for father and as an indication of what might have passed between you and him; right now, however, I'd like to continue looking at the father from a more purely psychological or sociological point of view.
与父亲角色变化进一步相关的占星学关联可以通过狮子座找到——这是另一个长期以来与英雄-父亲原型相关联的星座。狮子座和摩羯座都代表男性育儿的面向；如果这些星座在某人星盘中突出，我一定会着重考察与这个人的父亲议题，就像如果一位客户带着七颗行星在巨蟹座来找我，我会着重关注母亲议题一样。目前，出生时冥王星在狮子座的那一代人正处于中年或即将进入中年——一个自我审视和重新评估的时期。仅是出生时冥王星在狮子座就暗示了围绕父亲的情结。冥王星目前正在穿越天蝎座，你知道这意味着什么——那些出生时冥王星在狮子座的人迟早会经历推运冥王星刑出生冥王星。冥王星刑自身位置的过境非常善于搅动和将你内心埋藏的东西带到表面，照亮那些一直在暗中影响你生活中做出的选择以及你在关系中吸引的种种纠葛的未解情结。我从我的同龄人那里了解到，许多男性和女性目前正在发现关于他们父亲的议题和感受——这些是他们迄今未有意识地承认的。越来越多关于父亲角色的书籍正在出版，似乎也有一波关于父亲和他们孩子的电影涌入。我们很快将考察太阳作为父亲的指示星以及暗示你和他之间可能发生了什么的标志；但此刻，我想继续从更纯粹的心理学或社会学角度来审视父亲。

In the early 1980's, Harvard University psychoanalyst James Herzog coined the term father hunger to describe the psychological state of children who had been deprived of their fathers through separation, divorce or death.12 More recent research has reevaluated and expanded this definition to include the offspring of fathers who were physically present but psychologically distant or inadequate. I would define father hunger as a subconscious yearning for a lost ideal father, for the father you didn't have, for the father who wasn't there in the way you desperately needed him to be. Herzog found that children thus affected (sons in particular, but much of this applies to daughters as well) had problems in four basic areas later in life. Firstly, with caretaking—it is very hard to give something you didn't get. If you experienced paternal deprivation, you'll probably find the role of parenting or fathering more difficult to play should your turn come up. The second area where Herzog detected problems relating back to a lack of fathering is in the capacity to be close to or intimate with others in one's adult life, whether with another man or another woman. Father is the first role model of the masculine principle, of what men are like. If he is distant and remote, a male child will assume that this is what it means to be a man; a female child might deduce that this is what men are all about. Carrying around such images influences who and what we meet throughout life, not to mention how we react to and interpret other people's behaviour. I believe it was the humanistic psychologist Jean Houston who once said that life has a way of obliging our expectations.
在1980年代早期，哈佛大学精神分析师James Herzog创造了「父亲饥渴」一词，用来描述因分居、离婚或死亡而被剥夺父亲的儿童的心理状态。12 更近期的研究重新评估和扩展了这一定义，以包括那些父亲在身体上在场但在心理上疏远或不称职的孩子。我将父亲饥渴定义为对失去的理想父亲的一种潜意识渴望——对那个你没有的父亲、对那个未在你迫切需要他时以那种方式在场的父亲的渴望。Herzog发现受此影响的儿童（尤其是男孩，但其中很多也适用于女孩）日后生活在四个基本领域有问题。首先是照料——你很难给予你没有得到的东西。如果你经历了父亲的剥夺，轮到你时，你很可能会发现养育或做父亲的角色更难扮演。Herzog发现的第二个与缺乏父亲角色相关的问题领域是在成年生活中与他人亲近或亲密的能力，无论是与男性还是女性。父亲是男性原则的第一个角色榜样——男人是什么样的。如果他疏远和冷漠，一个男孩会认为这就是做男人的意义；一个女孩可能会推断男人就是这样的。携带着这样的形象影响着我们一生遇到谁和遇到什么，更不用提我们如何回应和解读他人的行为。我相信是人本主义心理学家Jean Houston曾经说过的，生活总有办法满足我们的期望。

Thirdly, Herzog noted that the lack of proper fathering could lead to problems with aggression and assertion. Interestingly enough, psychological sketches of the early lives of convicts and prisoners often reveal the absence of a father or an aggrieved relationship with him. If you are overly aggressive or hostile as a child, you will benefit from a father who teaches you limits. Mothers can do this as well, but triangular relationships activate important questions about boundaries and assertion (such as the Oedipal complex), and we have the chance to learn valuable lessons in life through facing these conflicts. If you are not assertive enough, a good father can model ways to be more forthcoming or courageous. Herzog's fourth point relates back to what I was just discussing: paternally deprived children often have difficulty with achievement and mastery in the world. By the way, there may be someone around who is not the biological father but who serves as a father substitute in respect to all the issues touched on so far.
第三，Herzog指出缺乏适当的父亲角色可能导致攻击性和自我表达的问题。有趣的是，囚犯和服刑人员早年生活的心理画像经常揭示父亲的缺席或与他的愤怒关系。如果你作为孩子过于具有攻击性或敌意，一个教你界限的父亲会让你受益。母亲也可以做到，但三角关系激活了关于边界和自我表达的重要问题（如恋母情结），我们有机会通过面对这些冲突而学到宝贵的教训。如果你不够有自我表达力，一个好的父亲可以示范如何更加主动或勇敢。Herzog的第四点与我刚讨论的相关：受父亲剥夺的儿童往往在世上的成就和掌控方面有困难。顺便说一句，身边可能有一个人不是亲生父亲，但在前面提到的所有议题方面充当了父亲替代者的角色。

I think it's wonderful that an ever-growing number of men are now seeking to take a more active role in fathering. But as I was saying before, it isn't always easy to give something you didn't get. It will be more of a challenge to father adequately if you don't have positive images of fathering recorded in your memory. Furthermore, when a father attempts to nurture and care for his newborn and helpless infant, distressing feelings left over from his own infancy can be reawakened —hitherto deeply buried pain, frustration and anger. The resurgence of such emotions is likely to interfere with a father's sincere desire to be a good parent. So in order for the “new man” to fulfil his desire to participate in the nurturing process, he may have quite a bit of psychological housecleaning to do first; in particular, working through unfinished business between his own father and himself. The same rationale applies to mothers and their sons, and of course to mothers and daughters.
我认为越来越多的男性现在寻求在父亲角色中发挥更积极的作用是好事。但正如我之前所说，给予你没有得到的东西并不总是容易的。如果你没有关于父亲角色的积极形象记录在你的记忆中，做好父亲将更具挑战性。此外，当一位父亲试图滋养和照顾他新生无助的婴儿时，他自己婴儿期残留的痛苦感受可能被重新唤醒——迄今深埋的痛苦、挫折和愤怒。这种情绪的回潮很可能干扰一个父亲做一个好家长的真诚愿望。因此，为了使「新男性」实现他参与滋养过程的愿望，他可能首先需要做相当多的心理清理；特别是，处理他自己父亲与他之间的未了之事。同样的逻辑适用于母亲和他们的儿子，当然也适用于母亲和女儿。

There is a definite connection between ego formation and the kind of interaction you had with your father. This can be illustrated quite simply by a diagram (see figure 5 on page 140) which is an extension of the diagram I used in the talk on mothers and lovers last night. In the beginning your identity is fused with that of the mother as shown by Egg A, where your incipient ego or “I” is encased within her. The developmental task from about six months onward is to free the ego (or what also might be called your sense of being a separate self) from Egg A so that it stands distinct from mother. Needless to say, there is usually a great deal of ambivalence or separation anxiety about this, because one part of you would prefer to remain fused with her in that uroboric state. The urge to individuate, however, is powerful and natural; and the point I wish to make is that the process of individuation is fostered when there is a father around (Egg B) toward whom you can move, another parent present with whom to interact. We can say that one of father's principle roles is to serve as an attractive outsider who helps you to break the merger-bond or symbiosis you have with mother.13 What is important is the otherness of father. At least this is the traditional way of looking at it. Obviously, one family is going to be different than another to varying degrees, and there are a number of alternatives to the conventional nuclear family setup. Nonetheless, we have to talk generally for now. So if mother represents closeness, fusion and security (what is known), then father stands for something other than mother—he enables us to develop a sense of self that is not solely tied to the body of mother, and in this respect he represents spirit, self-consciousness, adventure and growth. To repeat, a father can play a significant role in helping you to attain an identity separate and distinct from that of your mother. This applies to both male and female children.
自我形成与你和父亲之间的互动类型之间有明确的关联。这可以通过一个图表简单说明（见第140页图5），这是我昨晚关于母亲与恋人讲座中使用图表的延伸。最初你的身份与母亲的融合在一起，如蛋A所示，你初生的自我或「我」被包裹在她之中。从大约六个月开始，发展任务是将自我（或也可能被称为你作为一个独立自我的感觉）从蛋A中释放出来，使它独立于母亲。不用说，这通常伴随着大量的矛盾心理或分离焦虑，因为你的一部分更愿意保持与她在那种衔尾蛇状态的融合中。然而，个体化的冲动是强大而自然的；我想强调的是，当有一个父亲（蛋B）在场可以让你向他移动——另一个可以互动的家长在场时，个体化过程就被促进了。我们可以说，父亲的主要角色之一是作为一个有吸引力的外来者，帮助你打破与母亲的融合纽带或共生。13 重要的是父亲的他者性。至少这是传统的看法。显然，一个家庭与另一个家庭会有不同程度的差异，传统核心家庭设置也有许多替代方式。然而，我们目前只能总体地讨论。所以如果母亲代表亲近、融合和安全（已知之物），那么父亲就代表不同于母亲的东西——他使我们能够发展一个不仅仅系于母亲身体的自我感，在这方面他代表精神、自我意识、冒险和成长。再说一次，父亲可以在帮助你获得一个与母亲分离和不同的身份方面发挥重要作用。这适用于男孩和女孩。

Figure 5. Father as an attractive outsider toward whom we can move in the process of differentiating from mother.
图5. 父亲作为一个有吸引力的外来者，我们在从母亲那里分化的过程中可以向他移动。

The basic astrology of all this is pretty clear: Egg A represents the Moon and Mother, while Egg B is the Sun, symbolising father, but also the process of defining an individual self. We are drawn to him at that point in time when we are ready to break our uroboric bond with mother, when we first embark on establishing an “I” which is distinct from her. Therefore, what we meet when we move toward father has great bearing on our sense of individual identity. It's no wonder that astrology has traditionally linked the Sun both with father and one's striving for selfhood. I'd like to personalise this through a short exercise:
这些的基本占星学含义相当清楚：蛋A代表月亮和母亲，而蛋B是太阳，象征父亲，但也象征定义个体自我的过程。在我们准备好打破与母亲的衔尾蛇纽带、在我们首次着手建立一个与母亲不同的「我」的那个时间点，我们被他吸引。因此，当我们向父亲移动时遇到的东西对我们个体身份感有重大影响。难怪占星学传统上把太阳与父亲和对自我实现的追求联系在一起。我想通过一个简短练习来个性化这一点：

Relax, take some deep breaths and clear your mind.
放松，深呼吸几次，清空你的头脑。

Now spend a few minutes reflecting on or imagining what it
现在花几分钟反思或想象，

felt like to move toward your father.
移向你的父亲时，

Think about it.
是什么感觉。想一想。

Was your father there?
你的父亲在那里吗？

Was he an attractive enough force to encourage you to separate from mother?
他是否是一个足够有吸引力的力量来鼓励你从母亲那里分离？

Does he feel better or worse to you than mother?
你觉得他比母亲更好还是更差？

What comes to your mind or what does it feel like when you picture interacting with him or being close to him?
当你想象与他互动或亲近他时，什么来到你脑海或是什么感觉？

Natal aspects to the Sun give one indication of what you meet through father, and because of the connection between father and self-formation, natal aspects to the Sun also indicate qualities closely associated with your sense of what it means to be an “I” separate and distinct from mother. We can play around with a few simple examples to amplify this concept. What if you are born with the Sun trine Jupiter? Obviously you may have other aspects to the Sun in your chart besides this one, but I want to keep it basic and straightforward for now. Picture yourself at that stage in infancy when the developmental task is to disentangle your identity from that of mother. In a sense you are moving away from the Moon and heading for the Sun. So if your Sun is trine Jupiter, what might going toward father feel like for you?
出生时与太阳的相位给了你一个指示，说明你通过父亲遇到了什么，而由于父亲与自我形成之间的联系，与太阳的出生相位也暗示了与你作为一个与母亲分离和不同的「我」意味着什么的感受密切相关的品质。我们可以用几个简单的例子来丰富这个概念。如果你出生时太阳三分木星呢？显然你的星盘中可能还有其他与太阳的相位，但现在我想保持基础和直接。想象你在婴儿期那个发展任务是将你的身份从母亲那里解脱出来的阶段。在某种意义上你正在离开月亮走向太阳。所以如果你的太阳三分木星，向你父亲的方向去对你来说可能是什么感觉？

Audience: It should feel expansive.
听众：应该感到开阔。

Howard: Yes, it's likely to feel quite welcoming because you have positive Jupiterian images in aspect to the Sun: “Gee, separating from mother isn't so bad. It's quite interesting out here. Father is fun and how about all the new things I'm discovering and feeling with him.” So if you encounter Jupiter through the father at the time your ego is beginning to take shape, your sense of who you are, your “I,” will be coloured by qualities of adventurousness, spiritedness, and expansiveness. Such an experience will contribute to a stronger desire to express your individuality, to a joy, enthusiasm and zest for life. True, you'll probably hurry back to mother if the going gets tough, or check in with her regularly to make sure she is still there. But the die is cast; you've tasted some of the delights that exist beyond the range of mother's knee and there is no turning back. Now, for the sake of argument, let's say you are someone who is born with the Sun square Saturn. Picture yourself moving away from mother and in the direction of father, and you meet a Saturn square. What does this say to you about what it feels like to venture away from mother, to be more out on your own in the world?
Howard：是的，很可能感到相当受欢迎，因为你有积极的木星形象与太阳形成相位：「天哪，从母亲那里分离也不是那么糟糕。外面挺有意思的。父亲很有趣，我在他这里发现和感受到的所有新东西怎么样。」所以如果你在自我开始成形时通过父亲遇到了木星，你的自我感、你的「我」将被冒险、活泼和开阔的品质所着色。这样的体验将有助于更强的表达个体性的欲望，对生命的喜悦、热情和热忱。当然，如果情况变难，你可能会跑回母亲那里，或定期去检查她是否还在那里。但木已成舟；你已经品尝到了母亲膝下范围之外存在的一些快乐，没有回头路了。现在为了讨论方便，假设你是一个出生时太阳刑土星的人。想象你正从母亲身边移开朝父亲方向走，而你遇到了土星的刑相。这对你离开母亲、独自面对世界是什么感觉说了什么？

Audience: There are difficulties, problems, blockages.
听众：有困难、问题、阻碍。

Howard: Yes, a bit like running into a brick wall perhaps. There you are on the verge of forming a separate-self sense and you meet Saturn via the father—a father who might be distant, cold or remote, who might be away working all the time, or who comes over as rigid, authoritarian, judgemental, controlling and punishing. So you think, “This is not much fun, this is not very welcoming or comforting, I'd better get back to mother.” As a result, ego development could be retarded; you are not sure about standing on your own, your ego gets off to a faulty start, and this early insecurity and quite literal self-doubt (doubts about being a self) will haunt and challenge you in subsequent attempts to give form to and express your individuality. One hopes that with Saturn you'll make it there in the end, but it takes time and requires more effort because it doesn't feel as safe or as enjoyable when compared to a Sun-Jupiter contact.
Howard：是的，也许有点像撞上了一堵砖墙。你正处在形成独立自我感的边缘，却通过父亲遇到了土星——一个可能疏远、冷漠或遥不可及的父亲，可能总是外出工作，或者表现得刻板、专制、评判、控制和惩罚。所以你想，「这没什么意思，这不怎么受欢迎或令人安慰，我最好回到母亲那里。」结果是，自我发展可能被延迟；你不确定是否自立，你的自我起步就出了问题，这种早期的不安全感和相当字面的自我怀疑（对成为自我的怀疑）将在日后你试图赋予和表达你的个体性时困扰和挑战你。人们希望有土星的话你最终会到达那里，但这需要更多时间和努力，因为与太阳-木星联系相比，它感觉不那么安全或不那么愉快。

Audience: What if you are born with really hard aspects to the Moon and much nicer ones to the Sun?
听众：如果你出生时对月亮有很困难的相位，对太阳有更好的相位呢？

Howard: Good question. It may be that from the beginning mother never felt safe or never served as a solid container and provider of your needs. As a result, almost from the word go, father was preferred; he was the one to whom you were drawn—being close to him or held by him felt better than being close to mother. So, in this case, father is mother. I'm really not sure what this sets up in terms of separation and individuation, except to say that sooner or later in the name of psychological health and wholeness, you'll need to deal with the damage caused by a failed mother bond. But I feel even more pain for those children who couldn't find safety and nurturing from either parent—something that might show up in charts with mainly hard aspects to both the Sun and the Moon, or if the Sun and Moon form a close T-Square with Mars, Saturn, Chiron, or any of the outer planets (which also can indicate serious problems within the parental relationship itself). Imagine it, moving away from a “bad” mother toward father and then experiencing hurt and rejection with him as well. This doesn't bode well for your capacity to relate easily with others later in life, and certainly won't contribute to your forming an “I” blessed with a healthy sense of self-esteem. Some form of psychological, therapeutic or spiritual work on the self will be necessary to arrive at a place where you feel okay about being in the body and here on this planet. I've met successful and reasonably happy adults born with these kinds of solar and lunar aspects who have managed to come to terms with and learn from their early wounding; and I know people who haven't—some of whom are locked away in one kind of institution or another or should be, and others who are out in the world still having a truly difficult time in life. My heart goes out to each and every one of them, expect perhaps the one who decides to come at me with a knife because of something his parents “did” to him in childhood. Even so, if I survived the attack and set up his chart, I could come to some understanding of why it happened. Astrology can teach us a great deal about acceptance and tolerance. How can you judge someone born with such challenging aspects? Reincarnationists track these situations back to karma and past lives, and there are those who believe that the deeper Self chooses the chart according to the lessons and kind of growth you need this time around.
Howard：好问题。可能是从一开始母亲就从未让人感到安全，从未作为一个坚固的容器和你需求的提供者。结果，几乎从一开始，父亲就被偏好；他是你被吸引的那个人——亲近他或被他抱着比亲近母亲感觉更好。所以在这种情况下，父亲就是母亲。我真的不确定这在分离和个体化方面设置了什么，只能说为了心理健康和完整性，你迟早需要处理失败的母亲纽带造成的伤害。但我对那些从任何一方都找不到安全和滋养的孩子感到更加心痛——这可能显示在主要对太阳和月亮都有困难相位的星盘中，或者如果太阳和月亮与火星、土星、凯龙或任何外行星形成紧密T三角（这也可能表明父母关系本身存在严重问题）。想象一下，从一个「坏」母亲那里移开走向父亲，然后在他那里也经历伤害和拒绝。这对你日后轻松地与他人建立关系的能力来说不是好兆头，当然也不会有助于你形成一个有幸拥有健康自尊感的「我」。某种形式的心理、治疗或灵性修行将是必要的，才能达到你觉得在这身体里和这颗行星上还行的地步。我遇到过有这种太阳和月亮相位但成功且相当幸福的成年人——他们设法接受并从早期创伤中学习；我也认识那些没有做到的人——其中一些被关在这种或那种机构里或应该被关着，另一些则在世界上仍然过着真正困难的生活。我的心为每一个人而痛，除了那个决定因为他父母在童年「做了」什么而拿刀来刺我的人。即便如此，如果我幸存下来并排了他的星盘，我能理解为什么它会发生。占星学能教我们很多关于接纳和容忍的知识。你怎么能评判一个出生时有如此挑战性相位的人呢？轮回论者将这些情况追溯到业力和前世，也有人相信更深的自性根据你这次需要的功课和成长类型选择了星盘。

Let's continue exploring a few more natal aspects to the Sun in the light of father and ego formation. What if you are born with Sun well aspected to Mars?
让我们继续在父亲和自我形成的光照下再探讨几个出生太阳相位。如果你出生时太阳与火星形成良好相位呢？

Audience: Father appears strong, confident, assertive or stimulating, and this shapes your sense of what it is like to be an individual in your own right.
听众：父亲显得强壮、自信、有主见或令人振奋，这塑造了你对自己作为独立个体意味着什么的感受。

Howard: Precisely, just as you are establishing an ego identity, you meet a positive Mars figure in father, something which should help to equip you with a sense of potency and power. But what if you have a natal Sun-Mars square, especially one in cardinal or fixed signs?
Howard：完全正确。正当你建立自我身份时，你在父亲那里遇到了一个积极的火星形象，这应该有助于赋予你一种力量感和权力感。但如果你有出生时太阳刑火星，尤其是在基本星座或固定星座呢？

Audience: You might find him too rough or aggressive, or immediately run into a conflict of wills.
听众：你可能觉得他太粗暴或太有攻击性，或立即陷入意志冲突。

Howard: Yes, he might seem gruff, angry, violent, unsafe or sexually unruly in some way. How will that affect a male child?
Howard：是的，他可能显得粗暴、愤怒、暴力、不安全或在某种方式上性方面不守规矩。这会如何影响一个男孩？

Audience: He'll grow up with problems around aggression.
听众：他长大后在攻击性方面会有问题。

Howard: Yes, let's look at that. Remember that father is likely to be our first role model of the masculine. A boy who repeatedly experiences his father as violent or aggressive could easily end up equating these qualities with what it means to be a man. A female child who encounters such a father probably will conclude that men are brutes, and you can imagine where that might lead later in life. Interestingly enough, I've seen people of both sexes with difficult Sun-Mars contacts who seem meek, mild and docile, or who try hard to control their anger and not appear too pushy or demanding. It's as if they've experienced an abusive or tyrannical father and decided, “I am never going to be that way.” The trouble is that when you straightjacket Mars because you've only seen negative expressions of it, you also forfeit the potential to develop the positive things Mars has to offer—such as the power to affirm your identity through asserting your will and going after what you want in the world. It's like throwing the baby out with the bathwater.
Howard：是的，这是可能的后果之一，但不是唯一的结果。许多出生时太阳刑火星的男性非常成功——他们找到了建设性的方式来表达这种攻击性。但我也见过一些人，他们要么过于粗暴，要么如此害怕自己的攻击性以至于在胆怯、懦弱或被动的极端中发展。我有一个侄子，即将满三岁，脾气非常暴躁。他父亲不在家时，他显得很乖；但父亲一回家，冲突就爆发了。这位父亲当然不是坏人，但从他的言行来看，显然他也在与自己的攻击性做斗争。所以想象一下，这个小男孩正在形成自我，与父亲的互动教会了他「成为一个独立的我会生出愤怒和冲突」。这可能会使他日后在表达攻击性方面产生问题，但他也可能学会如何管理它。但无论如何，太阳-火星刑相带给你的挑战和任务之一是学会如何以一种建设性的方式自信和表达攻击性，这种方式的表达方式不会伤害他人，也不会让你事后感到内疚。

Father is a role model for the animus, and we can embrace models or reject them. We can idealise him as a hero or cast him as a villain. In either case he is a force to be reckoned with because he is a manifestation of something within you whether you like it or not. I believe that the placements by sign, house and aspect of the personal planets in your chart show innate archetypal predispositions, the kinds of images or expectations you are born with (for whatever reasons) which influence what you experience in respect to the various facets of existence associated with the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars. So if you “come in” with a negative animus image as symbolised by a square of Sun to Mars, this reflects something inside you which you may then project onto the father whether or not he is an appropriate hook. Your actual father may not be all that martial, but you are predisposed to notice or register when he is acting in that fashion; or something in the chemistry or timing between the two of you activates a negative Mars in him. Then again, he truly may be that way and exactly fit your inner image. You can read more about these and other basic premises of psychological astrology in my book The Twelve Houses14 and in the chapter “The Stages of Childhood” in The Development of the Personality.15
父亲是阿尼姆斯的角色榜样，我们可以接受这些榜样，也可以拒绝它们。我们可以把他理想化为英雄，或将他塑造成反派。无论哪种情况，他都是一个不可忽视的力量，因为无论你喜欢与否，他都是你内在某种东西的体现。我相信，个人行星在你星盘中的星座、宫位和相位，显示了你与生俱来的原型倾向——你天生携带的某种意象或期望（无论出于何种原因），这些会影响你在与太阳、月亮、水星、金星和火星相关的存在各个方面的体验。因此，如果你「带着」由太阳刑火星所象征的消极阿尼姆斯意象而来，这反映了你内在的某种东西，你可能将其投射到父亲身上，无论他是否是一个合适的钩子。你的亲生父亲可能并不那么好斗，但你倾向于在他表现出那种方式时注意到或记录下来；或者你们之间的某种化学作用或时机激活了他内在的消极火星。当然，他真的可能就是这样，完全符合你内在的意象。你可以在我的书《十二宫位》14以及《人格的发展》中「童年阶段」一章15中读到更多关于这些以及心理占星学其他基本前提的内容。

Let's continue with a few more solar aspects. How about the Sun in hard angle to Pluto in terms of father's influence on ego formation?
让我们继续讨论一些更多的太阳相位。太阳与冥王星呈困难相位，在父亲对自我形成的影响方面，意味着什么？

Audience: Could he feel dangerous and threatening?
听众：他会让人觉得危险和有威胁感吗？

Howard: Yes, it might very well manifest that way. A difficult Sun-Pluto contact can give rise to a whole host of different issues around father. First of all, Pluto is the god of the underworld, which, as you all know, is equated with the unconscious in psychological parlance. Therefore you are not going to take him at face value: whatever he outwardly says or does, however he appears, you're likely to be more sensitive to what he is sitting on or hiding. What happens from there depends on the nature of the feelings or drives simmering away in his unconscious. Perhaps he appears fairly happy or content, but underneath he is depressed. You'll register the depression, not the facade. What if he seems to act lovingly and kindly towards you, but underneath he is feeling angry or explosive about some problems at work or in the marital relationship? You'll register his destructive or more threatening feelings, not necessarily in a conscious or mental way, but through undercurrents which hit you in the face or agitate your gut when you're in his vicinity. Like certain animals, you possess a sharp scent enabling you to smell what is in the air, to pick up on what is not immediately visible or apparent. Sexual undertones could riddle the relationship with father for a female child, and both parties could feel guilty, dark or bad because of such feelings. Are you getting the picture? Remember, all this could be happening just as you are beginning to define yourself as an “I”; so if you meet Pluto in the process, you're likely to conclude that being a separate self means having to be on guard, and it also makes life more complex. A Plutonic father may be seen as omnipotent and almighty. If you are to be safe and not sorry, you'll need to be deeply watchful, wary and probing, careful about what you give away or allow to happen. You'll want to establish as much control over your self and the environment as possible in order to guarantee things run your way—it's too risky otherwise. Power issues ensue, subtle games are played, and so on. I've even noticed these patterns in people who have Sun trine or sextile Pluto, although they seem more naturally equipped to adapt, work through and learn from the issues at hand than someone born with the conjunction, square, opposition or inconjunct.
Howard：是的，很可能以这种方式表现出来。困难的太阳-冥王星相位可能在围绕父亲的问题上引发一系列不同的议题。首先，冥王星是冥界之神，正如你们所知，在心理学术语中等同于无意识。因此你不会只看表面：无论他表面上说什么或做什么，无论他看起来如何，你更可能对他隐藏或压抑的东西敏感。结果如何，取决于他无意识中酝酿的感受或冲动的性质。也许他看起来相当快乐或满足，但底层是抑郁的。你会察觉到抑郁，而不是表面。如果他似乎对你慈爱友善，但底层却因工作或婚姻关系中的问题而感到愤怒或暴躁呢？你会察觉到他的破坏性或更具威胁性的感受，不一定是通过有意识或心理的方式，而是通过你在靠近他时迎面扑来或搅动你内脏的暗流。就像某些动物一样，你拥有敏锐的嗅觉，能够嗅到空气中的味道，察觉到那些不直接可见或明显的东西。对于一个女孩来说，性暗示可能充斥着与父亲的关系，双方都可能因此感到内疚、阴暗或糟糕。你能想象这个画面吗？记住，这一切可能恰在你开始将自己定义为「我」的时候发生；所以，如果在这个过程中你遇到了冥王星，你很可能会得出结论：成为一个独立的自我意味着必须保持警惕，这也让生活变得更加复杂。一个冥王星式的父亲可能被视为全能而强大的。为了安全无恙，你需要非常警觉、谨慎和探究，小心你暴露或允许发生的事情。你希望尽可能多地控制自己和环境，以确保事情按照你的方式发展——否则风险太大了。权力问题随之而来，微妙的游戏就此展开，等等。我甚至在太阳三分或六分冥王星的人身上也注意到这些模式，尽管他们似乎比出生于合相、刑相、对相或梅花相的人更自然地具备适应、处理和从当前议题中学习的能力。

A Sun-Pluto contact also suggests that you are very sensitive to those times when your father is in the process of change or transformation, or when he is contending with troublesome issues within himself. Again, this leads you to link selfhood with such things as crisis, self-examination and self-knowledge, and the periodic need to shed your existing skin for a new one—a propensity to create situations which require more psychological deaths and rebirths than other solar aspects might ask of a person. To be quite literal, Pluto is the god of death, and some people born with Sun-Pluto aspects experience the death or disappearance of the father while still at a tender age. Events that happen to us in early life do leave their mark, however clever you are at covering it up.
太阳-冥王星相位也表明，你对你父亲处于变化或转变过程中，或他在与自身内部麻烦问题作斗争的时候非常敏感。同样，这使你将自己与危机、自我审视和自我认知以及周期性地需要蜕去旧皮换新皮联系在一起——这是一种倾向于创造需要比其它太阳相位要求的更多心理死亡和重生的情境的倾向。直白地说，冥王星是死亡之神，一些出生有太阳-冥王星相位的人在年幼时就经历了父亲的死亡或消失。我们早期生活中发生的事件确实会留下痕迹，无论你多么善于掩饰。

Audience: I've met a number of people with Sun conjunct Venus and they hated their fathers. I can't understand this.
听众：我见过很多太阳合金星的人，他们讨厌自己的父亲。我无法理解这一点。

Howard: I've noticed this as well, but I'm pretty sure the plot is more complex. To have the symbol for father linked to the planet associated with love and beauty has to mean that at some stage you adored or idealised him. Then, for whatever reason, he let you down or erected firmer boundaries between the two of you, perhaps because he felt it was getting a little too “hot,” or mother was jealous and creating ripples. Sun-Venus also suggests that you were born with high expectations with regard to the Father archetype, that he should have embodied everything charming and wonderful, and offer you flawless love and affection. When the actual corporeal father invariably slipped up and failed to meet these unrealistic expectations, you may have been left angry and disappointed with him. I've seen a similar dynamic at work with Sun-Neptune contacts. In terms of ego formation, a Sun-Venus contact which is working well would mean that you did meet love and appreciation through the father and this will enhance your own sense of self-worth and esteem. Ultimately, however, I believe we all have to learn to love and value ourselves for ourselves, and not have our worth dependent on other people's validation.
Howard：我也注意到了这一点，但我很确定情况更为复杂。将父亲的象征与代表爱与美的行星联系在一起，必然意味着在某个阶段你崇拜或理想化了他。然后，出于某种原因，他让你失望了，或在你们之间竖起了更坚固的界限，也许是因为他感觉有点太「热」了，或者母亲嫉妒并制造了波澜。太阳-金星也表明，你对父亲原型有着很高的期望——他应该体现一切迷人和美妙的东西，并给予你无懈可击的爱和情感。当真实的肉身的父亲不可避免地犯错，未能满足这些不切实际的期望时，你可能对他感到愤怒和失望。我在太阳-海王星相位中也看到了类似的作用机制。就自我形成而言，一个运作良好的太阳-金星相位意味着你确实通过父亲获得了爱和欣赏，这将增强你的自我价值感和自尊。然而，最终，我相信我们都必须学会为自己爱和珍视自己，而不是让我们的价值依赖于他人的认可。

Let's consider Sun-Uranus. Here you are moving away from the body of mother toward father and greater self-definition, but you have a difficult Sun-Uranus conjunction, square, opposition or inconjunct.
让我们考虑太阳-天王星。在这里，你正在远离母亲的身体，走向父亲和更大的自我定义，但你有一个困难的太阳-天王星合相、刑相、对相或梅花相。

Audience: Maybe he is not around.
听众：也许他不在身边。

Howard: Uranus is a complex planet which can express itself in contrasting ways. But it's true that Uranus aspects often manifest as disruption, separation and unconventionality, so the family setup may not be a traditional one or may go through significant upheavals which disrupt and disarm you just when you thought life was settled. If your family differs from the norm, your sense of self is coloured by the idea that you are not quite like the kids you know from other families—you might come from a broken home or your father and mother aren't legally married. Father may reflect Uranus in that he gets restless and leaves for a while and then comes back to roost until the urge for change grabs him again, or he works at a distance and is only home on weekends. You can't be certain of him; he is an unknown quantity, changeable and erratic. A male child's sense of self and what it means to be a man could mirror what he sees in his father and he might find himself leading a similar life-style later in life. A female child with Sun in aspect to Uranus who strongly identifies with the father or prefers him to mother may grow up reflecting his attributes; or she might assume that men generally are not reliable, even though they can be rather fun or stimulating when they are around.
Howard：天王星是一个复杂的行星，可以以对比鲜明的方式表达自己。但天王星相位确实常常表现为分裂、分离和非常规，所以家庭结构可能不是传统的，或者可能经历重大的动荡，在你以为生活已经安定时打乱和解除你的武装。如果你的家庭与常态不同，你的自我感会被「你不像其他家庭的孩子」这种想法所染色——你可能来自一个破碎的家庭，或你的父亲和母亲没有合法结婚。父亲可能反映出天王星，因为他变得不安分，离开一段时间，然后又回来栖息，直到变化的冲动再次抓住他，或者他在远处工作，只有周末才回家。你无法确定他；他是一个未知数，善变而反复无常。一个男孩的自我感和成为男人的意义可能反映了他从父亲身上看到的，他可能会发现自己后来过着类似的生活方式。一个与天王星成相位的女孩，如果强烈认同父亲或更喜欢父亲胜过母亲，可能会成长起来反映出他的特质；或者她可能认为男人通常不可靠，尽管他们在身边时可能相当有趣或刺激。

In Greek mythology, Ouranus was a sky god, and we can associate the expansiveness of the starry heavens with the mind and intellect, with beliefs, theories, philosophies, systems, anything abstract and conceptual. For this reason, strongly Uranian people (depending on rest of the chart) are sometimes disconnected or dissociated from their bodies and the realm of feeling. Very often, they think or make a decision about how they “ought” to feel and try to be that way rather than allowing the emotions free reign or a natural expression. They're great to talk to, they have principles and strong political or social beliefs, they spark off ideas in you and you spark off new ideas in them; but if you're needing reassurance, comforting or holding and you ask them if they truly love you, their reply might be, “Well, what is love really?” after which they launch into an abstract diatribe on the topic. Not much solace at a time when what you are actually craving is physical or emotional warmth or stroking. If you are a child with a Sun-Uranus contact and your chart is predominantly fire and air, a Uranian father is probably just your cup of tea. You'll readily identify your nature with his, and provided that your father is not the overly dogmatic type of Uranian who is certain that his truth is everyone's truth, you'll develop an “I” that relishes space, freedom and room to move. If you have a close Sun-Uranus aspect but the rest of your chart is comprised mostly of water and earth, a Uranian father may not be able to meet your physical or emotional needs. In the process of separating from mother, you move toward him; you may find him exciting, stimulating and even enjoy his unpredictability and sense of humour, but when you need the kind of closeness or warmth I've just been talking about, you will probably experience him as a little distant, a little cold, unresponsive or unreliable. He can be kind to you, generous with you in many ways, and yet you get the feeling he would be that way with the neighbour's children as well. He's fair, he'll treat everyone equally. That's great, but what you really want is to feel special to him. If you have the kind of mother who can offer the emotional closeness and reassurance you need, you'll go back to her. But then you get bored with the known, you start to feel smothered or confined by her, so it's back to father again for a breath of fresh air, for a different kind of stimulation. You see how this sets up a pattern of to-ing and fro-ing. Later in life, you start a project, job or relationship in the hope it will offer you satisfaction or even lasting fulfilment, but when you realise it doesn't quite match up to your ideals or expectations or you start to feel bored by the familiarity of it all, off you go to try something new.
在希腊神话中，Ouranus是一位天空之神，我们可以将星空的广阔与心智和智力、信念、理论、哲学、体系以及任何抽象和概念性的东西联系起来。因此，强烈天王星型的人（取决于星盘的其他部分）有时与他们的身体和情感领域脱节或分离。他们常常思考或决定自己「应该」如何感受，然后试图成为那样，而不是让情感自由流露或自然表达。和他们交谈很棒，他们有原则，有强烈的政治或社会信念，他们能激发你的想法，你也能激发他们的新想法；但如果你需要安慰、抚慰或拥抱，你问他们是否真的爱你，他们的回答可能是：「嗯，爱到底是什么？」然后他们就这个话题展开一场抽象的论述。当你真正渴望的是身体或情感上的温暖或爱抚时，这并不能给你多少安慰。如果你是一个有太阳-天王星相位的孩子，且你的星盘以火象和风象为主，那么一个天王星式的父亲可能正合你意。你会很自然地将你的本性与他的等同起来，只要你的父亲不是那种过于教条的天王星人——那种确信自己的真理就是所有人的真理的人——你将会发展出一个享受空间、自由和活动余地的「我」。如果你有紧密的太阳-天王星相位，但你的星盘其余部分主要由水象和土象组成，那么一个天王星式的父亲可能无法满足你的身体或情感需求。在脱离母亲的过程中，你走向他；你可能会发现他令人兴奋、刺激，甚至喜欢他的不可预测性和幽默感，但当你需要我刚才谈到的那种亲密或温暖时，你可能会觉得他有点疏远、有点冷漠、反应迟钝或不可靠。他可能对你很好，在很多方面都很大方，但你感觉他对邻居的孩子也会这样。他很公平，对每个人都一视同仁。这很好，但你真正想要的是在他面前感到特别。如果你有那种能够提供你所需的情感亲密和安慰的母亲，你会回到她身边。但随后你对已知的东西感到厌倦，开始觉得被她窒息或限制，于是你又回到父亲那里呼吸新鲜空气，寻求不同的刺激。你看这如何建立了一种来回摇摆的模式。后来在生活中，你开始一个项目、工作或关系，希望它能给你带来满足感甚至持久的成就感，但当你意识到它并不完全符合你的理想或期望，或者你开始对这一切的熟悉感到厌倦时，你就离开去尝试新的东西。

To discuss Sun-Neptune aspects with you, I'd like to use the chart of a man we'll call “Paul.” (See Chart 2 on page 150.) In fact, we are now going to delve into a fairly extensive case history, because not only do I have Paul's chart, but I also have the chart of his father, “Bill,” and Paul's own son, whom we'll call “Max.” We will focus on Paul's chart now, and later on (see pp. 167–193) Liz and I will discuss Paul's chart in relation to the charts of his father and his son. Studying a lineage like this one is a good way to learn about the kinds of issues that can come up between fathers and sons. And when I tell you their stories, you'll see how early complexes and other unfinished business from the past are passed on from one generation to the next, and how accurately these are reflected in the three charts concerned. Astrology is a superb tool for detecting and unravelling the intricacies of family dynamics.
为了与你们讨论太阳-海王星相位，我想用一位我们称之为「Paul」的男人的星盘为例。（见图2，第150页。）实际上，我们现在要深入探讨一个相当广泛的案例，因为我不仅有Paul的星盘，还有他父亲「Bill」的星盘，以及Paul的儿子「Max」的星盘。我们现在将聚焦于Paul的星盘，稍后（见第167-193页）Liz和我将讨论Paul的星盘与其父亲和儿子星盘的关系。研究这样的家族谱系是了解父子之间可能出现的问题的好方法。当我告诉你们他们的故事时，你们会看到过去的早期情结和其他未了之事是如何代代相传的，以及这些在三个相关星盘中反映得多么准确。占星学是检测和解析家庭动态复杂性的极好工具。

When looking for father in the chart, I would begin by examining the Sun by sign, house and aspect. In particular, I would focus first on the closest aspects to the Sun, whether these are major or minor aspects. You know what is meant when we say an aspect is exact—it's when the aspect is exact to the degree or with hardly any orb of variance. It's often quite stunning just how powerful an influence on one's psyche and one's life an exact “minor” aspect such as a semisquare or sesquiquadrate can have. So don't ignore a minor aspect if it is exact or very close to being exact. Also you'll need to see what is going on in the natal house associated with father. As does Liz, and for reasons which I won't go into now because most of you are familiar with them, I often find that the 4th house works as a significator for father, but many of you may prefer to keep him in the 10th. I do have more to say on this quandary a little later. For now, however, I want to start with the placement of the Sun in Paul's chart. You see it in 0 degrees Cancer in the 8th. What planet most closely aspects it?
在星盘中寻找父亲时，我会首先检查太阳的星座、宫位和相位。特别是，我会首先关注最接近太阳的相位，无论是主要相位还是次要相位。你们知道我们所说的精确相位是什么意思——就是当相位精确到度或几乎没有容许度差异时。一个精确的「次要」相位，如半刑相或倍半刑相，对一个人的心理和生活的强大影响常常令人震惊。所以，如果一个次要相位是精确的或非常接近精确，不要忽略它。此外，你还需要查看与父亲相关的本命宫位中发生了什么。与Liz一样，出于我现在不打算深入讨论的原因（因为你们大多数人都熟悉它们），我经常发现第四宫可以作为父亲的指示星，但你们中的许多人可能更倾向于将他放在第十宫。关于这个困境，我稍后会有更多要说的。但现在，我想从Paul星盘中太阳的落点开始。你们看到它在巨蟹座0度，位于第八宫。什么行星最接近它形成相位？

Audience: Neptune gives a pretty close square.

Howard: Yes, the Sun is in 0 degrees, 22 minutes Cancer and Neptune is 29 degrees, 19 minutes Virgo. It is out of sign, but still only a degree and a bit away from an exact square. Remember your minor aspects as well: in Paul's chart you'll find a very tight semi-square between Venus and the Sun, something we were talking about earlier in terms of the love we crave from father and the high expectations we have of him. Right now I want to focus on the meaning of Sun square Neptune. Before I reveal Paul's history, what do you think about Sun-Neptune aspects in regards to the formation of an ego identity and one's interaction with father?
Howard：是的，太阳在巨蟹座0度22分，海王星在处女座29度19分。虽然跨星座，但距离精确刑相只有一度多一点。不要忘记你们的次要相位：在Paul的星盘中，你会发现金星和太阳之间有一个非常紧密的半刑相，这是我们之前讨论过的关于我们从父亲那里渴望的爱以及我们对他的高期望。现在我想聚焦于太阳刑海王星的含义。在我揭示Paul的历史之前，你们对太阳-海王星相位在自我认同形成和与父亲互动方面有什么看法？
