Nigel does not do things because he thinks they will be good for his soul's evolution. He wants concrete results. I also feel this Mars says something about his capacity to work long and hard. He is not merely “lucky” or intuitively opportunistic, as it might appear from the sudden successes he has had. He has worked for every bit of it, patiently and carefully, although his Leonine need to present a larger-than-life personality might make him play down this dogged, hard-working side of his nature because it lacks glamour.
Liz：是的，这是磨垮对手的原则。火星在金牛座可能起步较慢，但一旦开始滚动，就没有什么能阻止它。而且它需要实际的成就；竞争本能通过土象的形式表达，如赚钱和获取职业地位。Nigel 做事不是因为觉得这对他的灵魂进化有好处。他想要具体的成果。我也觉得这个火星说明了他长时间努力工作的能力。他不仅仅是「幸运」或直觉敏锐的机会主义者，就像他那些突然的成功可能看起来的那样。他为之付出了每一分努力，耐心而细致，尽管他狮子座的需要——展现一个超越生命的人格——可能会淡化这种坚韧、勤奋的一面，因为它缺乏光环。

Audience: Mars in Taurus is also very sensual. There is a strong sex drive.
观众：火星在金牛座也非常性感。性驱力很强。

Liz: Yes, it reflects a powerful physical drive. Nigel's romantic career is, to put it euphemistically, rather colourful. As we might expect, he has had a great number of women in his life. A man with Mars in Taurus tends to identify his sense of power and potency with sexual pleasure and conquest, which is very different from an airy Mars which might identify power with intellectual acumen or organisational abilities.
Liz：是的，它反映了强大的身体驱力。Nigel 的感情生涯，委婉地说，相当丰富多彩。正如我们所料，他的生命中出现了很多女人。一个拥有火星金牛座的男人倾向于将自己的权力感和 potency 与性愉悦和征服联系在一起，这与风象火星截然不同——后者可能将权力与智力敏锐度或组织能力联系在一起。

Audience: I would like to know more about his mother. You said that Nigel needed to fulfil his mother's expectations for success which she did not achieve herself. Does Mars at the MC always mean this?
观众：我想了解更多关于他母亲的情况。您说 Nigel 需要满足母亲未实现的成功期望。火星在天顶总是意味着这个吗？

Liz: No, it does not always mean that the mother ruthlessly drives her child toward achievement. Any planet at the MC reflects a shared substance between mother and child, which can be expressed creatively by both. I have known many people with Mars at the MC whose mothers were successful in the world, and embodied positive models of achievement and energy for their children. We cannot tell from the chart alone whether the mother has been able to express these qualities herself, or whether she is even conscious of them. If they remain unconscious, then problems are likely to occur between mother and child, for there is a powerful unspoken pressure on the child to live the planet out for both. In Nigel's case we can make some educated guesses from his family history. We know that his mother had to “look after” an alcoholic husband, and that she was possessive, domineering and did her best to keep her son from forming any relationship with his father. She never worked, but expressed her Martial qualities in an indirect and unconscious way, for martyrdom is often a form of covert aggression and control; and I would guess that she contributed to or colluded with her husband's drinking problem because this gave her a justification for the “self-sacrifice” which disguised her inability to make anything of her own life. A husband with a “problem”—be it alcohol, womanising, financial failure or whatever—can be a very useful whipping-boy upon whom to heap one's rage that life has not fulfilled all the dreams for free.
Liz：不，这并不总是意味着母亲无情地驱使孩子去成就。天顶的任何行星都反映了母亲与孩子之间的共享特质，双方都可以创造性地表达。我认识许多火星在天顶的人，他们的母亲在世界上是成功的，并为孩子体现了成就和能量的积极榜样。仅从星盘我们无法判断母亲是否能够自己表达这些特质，或者她是否甚至意识到它们。如果它们仍然是无意识的，那么母子之间很可能出现问题，因为有一种强大的无声压力施加在孩子身上，让他为双方活出这颗行星。在 Nigel 的案例中，我们可以从他的家庭历史中做出一些有根据的推测。我们知道他的母亲必须「照顾」一个酗酒的丈夫，而且她占有欲强、专横，并尽力阻止儿子与父亲建立任何关系。她从未工作过，而是以一种间接、无意识的方式表达她的火星特质，因为殉道常常是一种隐蔽的攻击和控制形式；我猜她促成或纵容了丈夫的酗酒问题，因为这给了她一个「自我牺牲」的正当理由，掩盖了她无法让自己的生活有所成就的事实。一个有「问题」的丈夫——无论是酒精、女人、财务失败还是其他什么——可以成为一个非常有用的替罪羊，用来发泄她对生活没有实现所有自由梦想的愤怒。

To be fair, we must also take into account the generation into which Nigel's mother was born, for there was far less encouragement and support for a Martial woman than there is now. So the difficulty between Nigel and his mother, suggested by Mars at the MC, would probably reflect a combination of the collective values of her time (which expected every woman to be a devoted wife and mother), her own character (which opted for a dishonest rather than a clean way of living Mars), and her parental background, which might through no fault of hers have destroyed her confidence at an early age and made it even more difficult for her to express Mars in an open, positive way.
公平地说，我们也必须考虑到 Nigel 母亲所出生的那个时代，因为那时对火星型女性的鼓励和支持远不如现在。因此，Nigel 和他母亲之间的困难，由火星在天顶所暗示，可能反映了她那个时代的集体价值观（期望每个女人都是奉献的妻子和母亲）、她自己的性格（选择了不诚实而非干净利落地活出火星的方式）以及她的父母背景——这也许并非她的过错，而是在她早年就摧毁了她的自信，使她更难以一种开放、积极的方式表达火星——这三者的结合。

If we put all these factors together—and some are not described by the chart—then we can guess that there was a ferocious push from his mother for Nigel to “become” somebody. But it is also Nigel's push, and we must remember this before we indulge in too much parent-bashing. One of the important issues which Nigel would have to confront is that of distinguishing between what he wants for himself, and what he wants in order to placate his mother. It is the difference between compulsion and choice. If Nigel owns his own Mars, then he can pursue his own goals and desires. If he is unconsciously identified with his mother's unlived life, he will try to become something which is more her dream than his, and he will feel that he is working for somebody else all the time, and will not be able to relax and enjoy the fruits of his labours. There has been some of this element in the story of Nigel's relationships with women, for he had a tendency when younger to become involved with women who idolised him and wanted to be looked after, contributing nothing to the relationship themselves either financially or creatively. This is a repeat of the pattern of Nigel's relationship with his mother.
如果我们将所有这些因素放在一起——其中一些并非星盘所能描述的——那么我们可以推测，Nigel 的母亲对他有着强烈的推动力，要他「成为」某个人物。但这也是 Nigel 自己的推动力，在我们过度指责父母之前，我们必须记住这一点。Nigel 必须面对的一个重要问题，是区分他自己想要什么，以及他想要什么来安抚母亲。这是强迫与选择之间的区别。如果 Nigel 拥有自己的火星，那么他可以追求自己的目标和欲望。如果他在无意识中认同于母亲未活出的生命，他将努力成为某种更像是她的梦想而非他自己的东西，他会感觉自己一直在为别人工作，无法放松和享受自己劳动的成果。在 Nigel 与女性关系的故事中，有一些这样的元素，因为他年轻时倾向于与那些崇拜他、希望被照顾、在经济或创造性上对关系毫无贡献的女性交往。这是 Nigel 与母亲关系模式的重复。

Audience: Is it possible for a woman not to express the Moon, or a man not to express the Sun?
观众：女人有可能不表达月亮，或者男人不表达太阳吗？

Liz: Certainly. I am very wary of sweeping generalisations about men living the Sun and women living the Moon. The Sun and Moon are archetypal significators for male and female, but people vary enormously in their modes of expression of these qualities. Very often I have found that the Moon is quite unconscious in a particular woman's chart. She may try to find it through a lunar man, just as a man who is not well-connected with his Sun may try to find its creative fire through a solar woman. There is nothing inherently “wrong” or pathological in this, although I think that sooner or later we are pushed by our own psyches to live out as best we can what we have within us, which includes all the planets. But chart placements are highly individual, and a woman with an angular Sun and the Moon tucked away in the 12th house with few aspects will at first relate more easily to the solar principle. Sometimes it is family complexes, rather than chart significators, that disconnect a woman from the Moon or a man from the Sun. Then there is usually more pain around the issue, for one is reacting compulsively rather than expressing what comes most naturally. Once upon a time, the clearly defined roles of men and women were inevitable and natural and dictated by biology and the demands of the environment. But as we have increased in complexity, sophistication and individuality over the centuries, these archetypal roles have become much less rigid on the outer level. However, disconnection from any planet poses a problem sooner or later, because what is unconscious in us is compulsive and leads us into being victimised by our complexes and therefore by life.
Liz：当然可以。我非常警惕那些关于男人活出太阳、女人活出月亮的笼统概括。太阳和月亮是男性和女性的原型象征，但人们表达这些特质的方式千差万别。我经常发现，在某些女性的星盘中，月亮是完全无意识的。她可能试图通过一个月亮型的男人来找到它，就像一个与自己的太阳连接不好的男人可能试图通过一个太阳型的女人来找到它的创造之火一样。这本身并没有什么「错误」或病态的，尽管我认为，迟早我们会被自己的 psyche 推动，尽可能好地活出我们内在的东西——这包括所有行星。但星盘位置是高度个人化的，一个拥有强角度太阳、月亮隐藏在第十二宫且相位很少的女性，最初会更容易与太阳原则相关联。有时，是家庭情结，而非星盘象征，使女性与月亮或男性与太阳断开联系。那时这个问题通常伴随着更多的痛苦，因为人们是在强迫性地反应，而非表达最自然的东西。曾经，男女之间明确界定的角色是不可避免和自然的，由生物学和环境需求所决定。但几个世纪以来，随着我们变得日益复杂、精致和个性化，这些原型角色在外在层面上已经变得不那么僵化了。然而，与任何行星的断开联系迟早都会带来问题，因为我们内在无意识的东西是强迫性的，会导致我们被自己的情结所害，进而被生活所害。

I would also like to look at the squares between Mars and the Sun-Moon conjunction. We have seen a fair amount of these squares during the course of the week. Do any of you have any comments on these aspects in Nigel's chart?
我还想看看火星与日月合相之间的相刑。在过去的这一周里，我们已经看到不少这种相刑了。你们对 Nigel 星盘中的这些相位有什么看法吗？

Audience: He must be very angry and irritable a lot of the time.
观众：他一定经常非常愤怒和易怒。

Liz: Actually, the odd thing is that he never gets angry. This is a good example of what often happens with squares—one end gets pushed into the unconscious, and the person meets it outside. If Nigel finds himself in a situation which might invoke rage in less controlled folk, he just makes a subtle, Cancerian inference and goes quietly away, and the person never sees him again. If he must dismiss someone who works for him, he invariably has another employee do it for him, and vanishes for a couple of weeks, because he loathes direct confrontation. Despite his ambition and drive toward achievement, you could not imagine anyone less Mars-like in personal encounters. The result of all this evasion and avoidance is that a great many people wind up very angry with Nigel. He has a lot of enemies who are still waiting to corner him and “have it out” with him.
Liz：实际上，奇怪的是他从不生气。这是相刑常常发生的情况的一个好例子——一端被推入无意识，个体在外部遇见它。如果 Nigel 发现自己在那种可能会让不那么克制的人暴怒的情况下，他只会做出微妙的、巨蟹式的暗示，然后安静地走开，那个人再也见不到他了。如果他必须解雇某个为他工作的人，他总是让另一个员工替他做，然后消失一两周，因为他厌恶直接对抗。尽管他有野心和成就驱动力，你无法想象还有谁在个人交往中比 Nigel 更不像火星了。所有这些回避和逃避的结果是，很多人最终对 Nigel 非常愤怒。他有很多敌人，他们还在等着逮住他，跟他「彻底了结」。

So one manifestation of these squares is that Nigel's Mars—the dimension of it which reflects directness, confrontation with others, defence of one's own position, healthy aggression—is quite unconscious, and is therefore projected outward and comes to meet him through other people, usually involved with his work. I have seen this a great deal with Sun square Mars, because the sense of self (which includes the self-image) is in conflict with the aggressive impulse, and the person becomes frightened of his or her own anger and cannot bear to be seen by others as brutal or forceful. I also think that this Sun-Mars square has something to do with why Nigel fosters the talents of others but has not put himself on stage, although one might expect it with all the planets in Leo in the 1st house.
所以，这些相刑的一种表现是，Nigel 的火星——其中反映直接性、与他人的对抗、捍卫自己立场、健康攻击性的维度——是相当无意识的，因此被投射到外部，并通过其他人（通常与他的工作相关）来遇见他。我在太阳刑火星的情况下见过很多次这种情况，因为自我感（包括自我形象）与攻击冲动相冲突，这个人变得害怕自己的愤怒，无法忍受被他人视为粗暴或强硬。我也认为这个日火相刑与 Nigel 为何培养他人的才华却未将自己置于舞台之上有关——尽管他拥有第一宫狮子座的所有行星，人们可能会期待相反的情况。

Audience: It sounds as though he has not really separated his Mars from his mother.
观众：听起来他似乎还没有把自己的火星与母亲分离开。

Liz: Exactly. That is what I think as well. Nigel can express certain attributes of Mars—ambition, competitive spirit in work—but these attributes are the ones his mother wanted him to express on her behalf. What he was not allowed to express in childhood was his own aggression, his direct expression of his own wishes. Nigel's will collided with his mother's will (both being exceedingly self-willed), and in this sense his mother has taken possession of his Mars. To put it more brutally, she has performed a kind of psychological castration of him. You would not think this from his career with women, or from his worldly success, but it may account in part for the compulsive quality which drives him to keep reasserting his potency. And it may also account in part for his real inability to be direct with other people in a personal context.
Liz：正是如此。我也这么认为。Nigel 可以表达火星的某些属性——野心、工作中的竞争精神——但这些属性是他母亲希望他代表她表达的。他在童年时期不被允许表达的是他自己的攻击性，他自己愿望的直接表达。Nigel 的意志与他母亲的意志发生了碰撞（两者都极其固执己见），在这个意义上，他的母亲已经占据了他的火星。更直白地说，她对他进行了一种心理阉割。从他的感情生涯或世俗成功中你不会想到这一点，但这可能部分解释了他不断重新确认自己 potency 的强迫性驱力。也可能部分解释了他真正无法在个人语境中对他人保持直接的原因。

Audience: Is there any significance to the fact that Leo is intercepted in the 1st house?
观众：狮子座在第一宫被截夺，这有什么意义吗？

Liz: When a sign is intercepted, it is not directly connected with a house cusp, and therefore does not have a direct channel out into the world. Each house governs a particular sphere of concrete life, and has a planetary ruler which is its conduit. But an intercepted sign in a house is like a tenant who must answer to the landlord—the planet which rules the sign on the cusp, which in Nigel's case is the Moon, the ruler of Cancer. So the Leo energy, in order to express itself, must be directed through the Moon, which means that Nigel's great sensitivity to others—albeit unconscious—makes it difficult for him to “shine” overtly. This may also have something to do with why he fosters others' talents rather than his own need to be seen and recognised.
Liz：当一个星座被截夺时，它与宫头没有直接连接，因此没有直接通道通向外部世界。每个宫位掌管特定的具体生活领域，并有一个行星守护者作为其管道。但宫中被截夺的星座就像一个必须向房东（即宫头星座的守护星，在 Nigel 的情况下是月亮，巨蟹座的守护星）负责的租客。所以，狮子座能量为了表达自己，必须通过月亮来引导，这意味着 Nigel 对他人的巨大敏感性——尽管是无意识的——使他难以公开地「闪耀」。这也可能与他培养他人才华而非自己需要被看见和认可有些关系。

Audience: Does he have children?
观众：他有孩子吗？

Liz: Yes, and he seems to get on extremely well with them. I think he is a very generous and attentive father, which one might expect from the combination of Cancer and Leo; and also because he knows what it is like to be utterly ignored by his own father. He has a number of children by different women, which seems to reflect a bit of that Sun-Jupiter conjunction—the profligate Zeus who fathers demigods on many mortal women. Zeus had a problem with his father, too.
Liz：有，而且他似乎和孩子们相处得非常好。我认为他是一个非常慷慨和细心的父亲，这可以从巨蟹座和狮子座的结合中预料到；也因为知道被自己父亲完全忽视是什么滋味。他有几个不同女人生的孩子，这似乎反映了日木合相的一些特质——那好色的宙斯，在无数凡间女人身上孕育了半神。宙斯和他的父亲也有问题。

Audience: Can you say more about the feeling of a New Moon in the birth chart?
观众：您能再多说说本命盘中新月的感觉吗？

Liz: It has a strong flavour of Aries about it. In Nigel's case this could be explained by the New Moon falling in Aries' natural house, the 1st; but I have seen this same quality even if the New Moon is in a more obscure house. There is great sensitivity about oneself, but not very much sensitivity to the feelings of others as separate people. That is the gift of a Full Moon, which can be so preoccupied with others that it generates indecision and tension. A New Moon tends to be so preoccupied with its own creative goals that the lunar function usually gets put second. Yet anything unconscious is always enormously potent in a covert way—hence the hypersensitivity about one's own feelings being hurt. One sometimes needs to shout, “Hello, I'm here!” three times at New Moon people, whereas with the Full Moon you need merely to blink inadvertantly and they are immediately worried about whether they have offended you.
Liz：它带有强烈的白羊座味道。在 Nigel 的案例中，这可以解释为新月落在白羊座的自然宫——第一宫；但即使新月在更隐蔽的宫位，我也见过同样的特质。对自己非常敏感，但对他人作为独立个体的感受没有那么敏感。那是满月的天赋——满月可能如此专注于他人，以至于产生犹豫不决和紧张。新月则倾向于如此专注于自己的创造目标，以至于月亮功能通常被放在第二位。然而，任何无意识的东西总是以隐蔽的方式极其强大——因此对自己的感受被伤害有着超乎寻常的敏感。有时你需要对新月型的人大喊三声「喂，我在这儿！」，而对于满月型的人，你只需不经意地眨一下眼，他们就会立即担心是否冒犯了你。

Despite Nigel's powerful intuition and ability to manipulate people, he often really puts his foot in it with regard to their emotions—in spite of that Cancer Ascendant. He is sensitive, as one might expect, but primarily about himself. He is easily hurt by others, but genuinely does not recognise when he has completely flattened another person. He can see the creative potentials in others without recognising how they feel, unless they spell it out in no uncertain terms. This can sometimes be true of the fire signs in general—there may be a great sense of the potential in others, but little capacity to respond to the nuances of others' timing and needs. That is why many people feel pressured and pushed about by fiery types, who are astonished by such an accusation because they were genuinely and selflessly trying to nurture the other person's abilities, without noticing that it needed more time or a gentler method of handling. Of course Nigel's typically fiery attitude is that it is up to the other person to complain, and if he or she doesn't, Nigel shrugs and says, “How was I supposed to know? I'm not a telepath.”
尽管 Nigel 有着强大的直觉和操控他人的能力，他常常在涉及他人情感方面真的搞砸——尽管有巨蟹上升。他敏感，如你所料，但主要是关于他自己。他容易被他人伤害，但真的不认 识到自己何时完全压倒了另一个人。他能看到他人的创造潜力，却不认识他们感受如何，除非他们毫不含糊地说出来。这有时对火象星座来说是普遍成立的——可能对他人的潜力有很强的感觉，但很少有能力回应他人时机和需求的细微差别。这就是为什么很多人感到被火象类型逼迫和推动，而火象类型对这种指责感到惊讶，因为他们真诚地、无私地试图培养对方的能力，却没有注意到这需要更多时间或更温和的处理方式。当然，Nigel 典型的火象态度是，抱怨是对方的事，如果对方不抱怨，Nigel 就耸耸肩说：「我怎么会知道？我又不是读心术。」

Now shall we look at Nigel's Venus? It is a rather difficult Venus, I think, because although it has a nice trine to Mars, it is in the sign of its fall, and square both Saturn and Uranus, as well as being on their midpoint. Ebertin describes Venus = Saturn/Uranus6 as “Tensions and stresses in love-relationship.” Also, Venus turned retrograde when Nigel was around fourteen years old, which suggests a lot of frustration in the sphere of love and sexuality at a particularly sensitive age. If we take Venus as a symbol of Nigel's sense of self-worth, this is being challenged or hurt by the isolated feeling of Saturn in Gemini in the 11th house of the group, the collective. The 11th house is our experience of belonging to the larger human family, and Saturn in the 11th can suggest someone who is very much a “loner,” who feels painfully different in some way. In Gemini, Saturn brings out fears of being misunderstood and thought stupid, and it can reflect not only the early childhood—Nigel was the only child, with no siblings to talk to—but also a quality of intellectual depth and seriousness which can create communication problems on the ordinary “social chit-chat” level.
现在我们来看看 Nigel 的金星？我认为这是一颗相当困难的金星，因为虽然它有一个不错的火星三分相，但它位于其落陷的星座，并且与土星和天王星相刑，同时位于它们的中点。Ebertin 将金星 = 土星/天王星描述为「爱情关系中的紧张和压力」。此外，金星在 Nigel 大约十四岁时转为逆行，这表明在特别敏感的年龄，爱情和性领域有很多挫折。如果我们将金星视为 Nigel 自我价值感的象征，那么它正受到土星在双子座第十一宫（团体、集体）的孤立感的挑战或伤害。第十一宫是我们对归属更大人类家庭的体验，土星在第十一宫可能暗示某人是「独行侠」，在某种程度上感到痛苦地与众不同。在双子座，土星带来了对被误解和被认为愚蠢的恐惧，它不仅可以反映早期童年——Nigel 是独生子，没有兄弟姐妹可以交谈——也可以反映一种智识深度和严肃性，这在普通「社交闲聊」层面上会造成沟通问题。

Saturn in Gemini often has a problem with “small talk” (overcompensation notwithstanding), and can be very shy and experience discomfort in ordinary social situations such as parties. So the strong Saturnian feelings of isolation and differentness interfere with Nigel's sense of his own value, especially his feeling of being worthwhile and attractive on the physical level (Venus in the 2nd in Virgo). He will need to work to find a sense of worth about his own body, and may also need to confront the issue of inner integrity and not being “for sale” in order to win the love of others. Saturn in square keeps telling him, “But other people won't like you.” Nigel certainly does not give an initial impression of being underconfident and shy, because he has developed excellent camouflages (Cancer Ascendant); and his capacity for self-mythologising tends also to throw people off the scent.
双子座土星在「闲聊」方面通常有问题（尽管可能会有过度补偿），并且可能非常害羞，在普通社交场合如派对中感到不适。因此，强烈的土星式孤立和差异感干扰了 Nigel 对自身价值的感受，尤其是他感觉自己值得被爱、在身体层面有吸引力的感受（金星在处女座第二宫）。他需要努力寻找对自己身体的自我价值感，也可能需要面对内在正直的问题——不为了赢得他人的爱而「出卖自己」。土星相刑不断告诉他：「但别人不会喜欢你。」Nigel 给人的第一印象当然不是缺乏自信和害羞，因为他已经发展出了极好的伪装（巨蟹上升）；他的自我神话化倾向也常常让人偏离方向。

Audience: But his feelings of inadequacy would be much more obvious in close relationships. Saturn rules the 7th house.
观众：但他的自卑感在亲密关系中会更明显。土星掌管第七宫。

Liz: Yes, it is more obvious, and I am sure it is through his close encounters that he experiences most of the fear and diffidence of the Venus-Saturn square. But Venus-Saturn people often unconsciously choose “safe” partners—people who are emotionally, intellectually or socially not up to their level of competence—because they feel less threatened, and so the women Nigel chooses may not notice his unexpressed fear of being unloved. They will simply think he is hard and insensitive.
Liz：是的，更明显，我相信正是通过他的亲密关系，他体验到了金土相刑的大部分恐惧和胆怯。但金土型的人常常无意识地选择「安全」的伴侣——那些在情感、智力或社交上不如他们的人——因为他们感到威胁较小，所以 Nigel 选择的女人可能不会注意到他未被表达的对不被爱的恐惧。她们只会觉得他冷漠而麻木。

Another thing I have found about Venus in the earthy signs is that one needs to be able to live the quiet, inarticulate dimension of earth. I have heard many people with Venus in earth express the fear of being boring, because the element of earth reflects the mute, serene world of nature. Earth does not sit chattering away at you, being clever. It just is. The positive qualities of stillness and serenity and harmony with natural rhythms are often underrated or overlooked if there is a chart emphasis in fire, or if one's parents were hoping for a lifetime's entertainment; but if this happens when Venus is in earth, one loses one's sense of self-worth through trying to shine and be exciting all the time. Nigel is no doubt frightened that if the performance stops, and he is anything less than mythic and charismatic and brilliant, that people will find him stupid and boring. I remember reading an interview with John Malkovich, who said that he defined an exciting weekend as staying home and staining a table. I don't know if he has Venus in an earth sign, but I suspect something similar might be said about Nigel. Nigel, however, would probably find it much more difficult to admit.
关于金星在土象星座，我还发现一点：一个人需要能够活出土象那安静、难以言表的维度。我听过很多金星在土象的人表达对无聊的恐惧，因为土元素反映了自然那沉默、宁静的世界。土不会坐在那里喋喋不休地对你说话、表现聪明。它只是存在。静止、宁静和与自然节奏和谐相处的积极品质常常被低估或忽视，如果星盘中火象突出，或者如果父母希望获得终身的娱乐；但如果金星在土象时发生这种情况，人们就会因为试图一直闪耀和令人兴奋而失去自我价值感。Nigel 无疑害怕，如果表演停止了，他不再那么神话般、魅力四射和才华横溢时，人们会发现他愚蠢而无聊。我记得读过约翰·马尔科维奇（John Malkovich）的一次采访，他说他心目中一个激动人心的周末就是待在家里给一张桌子上色。我不知道他是否有金星在土象星座，但我怀疑 Nigel 可能也有类似的情况。不过，Nigel 可能会更难以承认这一点。

There may also be a fear, when Venus is in earth but undervalued, that the body itself is lumpish, boring and uninteresting. I would guess that Nigel's square of Saturn to Venus in Virgo in the 2nd house reflects many deep unexpressed fears about being physically unattractive and boring—despite the erotic conquests. The trine from Mars at the MC is a great help, because worldly success and sexual prowess help to compensate for the more vulnerable feelings. The more success Nigel has, the more he can forget about those other, uncomfortable issues. But I think he will need to bring more consciousness into the Venusian realm, which may serve as a kind of bridge to opening up more of that obscured Moon.
当金星在土象但被低估时，还可能有对身体本身的恐惧——觉得身体笨拙、无聊、无趣。我猜测 Nigel 的土星与金星在处女座第二宫的相刑反映了许多深层的、未被表达的恐惧——关于身体上缺乏吸引力、令人厌烦——尽管有那些情色征服。天顶火星的三分相是个很大的帮助，因为世俗成功和性能力有助于补偿那些更脆弱的感受。Nigel 越成功，就越能忘记那些其他令人不舒服的问题。但我认为他将需要把更多意识带入金星领域，这可以作为打开那被遮蔽的月亮的一种桥梁。

I am aware that we are running out of time, so perhaps we can move on now and deal with any other questions or issues around the Sun and Moon cycles and the nodal axis.
我知道我们的时间不多了，所以也许我们可以继续，处理关于日月周期和交点轴的其他任何问题或议题。

Audience: If something is projected, like Nigel's Mars, does this mean he is not living it at all?
观众：如果某样东西被投射了，比如 Nigel 的火星，这是否意味着他根本没有在活出它？

Liz: I don't think it is quite so stark a division as that. Every planet has different facets, and we may be conscious of some of them, and able to express them in adequate enough ways, while experiencing difficulty or even great unconsciousness around other facets. Nigel certainly expresses Mars at the MC in Taurus in many recognisable ways—he is wealthy and successful, he has carved a highly individual place for himself in an extremely competitive profession, and he can be very aggressive in business dealings with others. In worldly terms, he is a winner. So he is “living” many facets of Mars. But he has difficulty in expressing Mars in one-to-one encounters, and his aggression on this level is covert and unconscious. Rather than responding to another person's anger, he backs away and disappears and doesn't answer the telephone. It is very annoying to try to speak your mind to someone directly and then find that they are just never available. That is a way of saying, “I can't be bothered,” and it is why people become so infuriated with Nigel.
Liz：我不认为这是一个如此截然二分的划分。每颗行星都有不同的侧面，我们可能对其中一些有意识，能够以足够的方式表达，而围绕其他侧面则经历困难甚至很大的无意识。Nigel 当然以许多可识别的方式表达了火星在天顶金牛座——他富有成功，在一个竞争极其激烈的行业中为自己开辟了高度个人化的位置，并且在商业交易中可以非常激进。在世俗层面，他是一个赢家。所以他「活出了」火星的许多侧面。但他在一对一交往中表达火星有困难，他在这个层面的攻击性是隐蔽和无意识的。他不对他人的愤怒做出回应，而是后退、消失、不接电话。试图直接对某人说出你的想法，然后发现他们永远不在，这非常令人恼火。这是一种说「我懒得理你」的方式，这就是为什么人们对 Nigel 如此愤怒。

It is very unusual to find a planet totally unconscious and blanked out in the personality. There are usually bits of it which are owned and lived, and bits which are not. A planet is like a person in a way, complex and multifaceted, and we develop and deepen the expression of each planet over the course of a lifetime. When we are dealing with psychological issues such as projection, we need to be careful not to be too literal and sharp-edged about it, for it is usually a question of a mixture of things. The Sun square Mars may have no problem at all owning an image of macho sexuality, yet may find great difficulty in being direct in emotional encounters. Also, Nigel's positive expression of Mars—his worldly achievement—provides him with an outlet for the anger which he cannot articulate at the personal level. He can bash the competition where he cannot shout at his mother, and this keeps him healthy because he has some outlet, however contaminated it might be with unconscious family issues. No factor in a chart is ever totally conscious and expressed to the point where there is nothing left to discover.
要找到一颗在人格中完全无意识和空白化的行星是非常罕见的。通常有部分是被拥有和活出的，有部分则不是。一颗行星在某种程度上就像一个人，复杂而多面，我们在整个生命过程中发展和深化每颗行星的表达。当我们处理投射等心理议题时，我们需要小心不要太字面和尖锐地理解它，因为这通常是各种因素的混合。太阳刑火星可能完全没有问题拥有一个阳刚的性形象，但可能在情感交往中难以直接表达。此外，Nigel 对火星的积极表达——他的世俗成就——为他提供了一个出口，来发泄那些他无法在个人层面表达的愤怒。他可以在竞争中打击对手，而不是对母亲大喊大叫，这使他保持健康，因为他有某种出口，无论它可能被无意识的家庭议题污染到什么程度。星盘中没有任何因素是永远完全有意识并表达到了没有什么可发现的程度。

Audience: Can you discuss the intercepted signs and planets in greater detail? I think I understand, but not quite enough.
观众：您能更详细地讨论截夺的星座和行星吗？我想我理解了，但还不够。

Liz: I will give you one of my crude analogies. The signs can be seen as energy fields, which colour the expression of a planet's basic drive or impulse. The house cusps are like lightning conductors, which exteriorise the planetary drives and sign energies and make them manifest in the world. The house cusps of a chart define the concrete reality in which the individual lives, the limits within which the planets must function. If there is a planet in a sign which does not have a house cusp to work through, it is like a tenant renting a flat from the landlord who owns the building (the ruler of the cusp). If you own your own flat, you can do more or less what you like with it; you can paint the walls purple and plant deadly nightshade in the garden and no one will interfere. But if you are a tenant, you must ask the landlord for permission first. The landlord may say, “Sorry, but all flats in Zürich must be white.” So your flat stays white. You can of course move out, but a planet in an intercepted sign cannot. All the intercepted Leo planets in Nigel's chart must ask permission of the Moon (which is itself in Leo) before they can express themselves through the 1st house.
Liz：我给你一个我粗浅的类比。星座可以被视为能量场，它们为行星基本驱力或冲动的表达着色。宫位就像避雷针，它们将行星驱力和星座能量外化，使它们在世界上显化。星盘的宫位定义了个体生活的具体现实，行星必须在其间运作的界限。如果有一颗行星在一个没有宫头可以运作的星座中，它就像一个从房东（宫头守护星）那里租房子的租客。如果你拥有自己的公寓，你基本上可以为所欲为；你可以把墙壁涂成紫色，在花园里种上致命的茄属植物，没人会干涉。但如果你是租客，你必须先得到房东的许可。房东可能会说：「对不起，苏黎世的所有公寓必须是白色的。」所以你的公寓保持白色。你当然可以搬出去，但截夺星座中的行星不能。Nigel 所有被截夺的狮子座行星在通过第一宫表达自己之前，必须征得月亮（它本身在狮子座）的许可。

Audience: Would you say that all that Leo makes Nigel narcissistic?
观众：您会说所有这些狮子座让 Nigel 自恋吗？

Liz: I think we need to be careful in how we use that word. Narcissism is both a clinical term and an expression people use to insult others who are not giving them what they want. Remember Ambrose Bierce's definition of an egotist? We can dispense with this second, more common usage since it is relative to the person making the accusation, and has no objective basis. As for the clinical definition, narcissism is a psychological state wherein the individual self is not yet developed enough to interact with the outer world as a separate organism. Freud used the term “primary narcissism” to describe the perspective of an infant who is aware only of its own overwhelming needs, and who falls into a raging tantrum if those needs are not gratified. The infant is all-powerful, the centre of the universe, and there is no comprehension of “other.” The adult who is narcissistic in this sense, however clever and socially adapted he or she may appear to the unfocussed eye, has usually been deeply hurt in childhood, and has not developed enough of a self to recognise the reality of other people. Everything and everyone exists as a “part-object,” an extension of oneself, like one's arm or leg. One takes for granted that one will be given what one needs, just as we take for granted the fact that our arms and legs will move when we want them to; and if this assumption is challenged by the boundaries of another person, great rage ensues. We all have our narcissistic pockets, and some people have bigger pockets than others. And some are so terribly stuck in this infantile state that other people are no more than objects to feed oneself, even if the surface behaviour is apparently loving and self-sacrificing.
Liz：我认为我们需要小心如何使用这个词。自恋既是一个临床术语，也是人们用来侮辱那些没有给予他们想要的东西的人的表达。还记得安布罗斯·比尔斯（Ambrose Bierce）对自我主义者的定义吗？我们可以搁置这第二种更常见的用法，因为它相对于提出指控的人而言，没有客观基础。至于临床定义，自恋是一种心理状态，个体自我尚未充分发展，无法作为一个独立的有机体与外部世界互动。弗洛伊德使用「原发性自恋」一词来描述婴儿的视角——婴儿只意识到自己压倒性的需求，如果这些需求没有得到满足，就会陷入狂怒的暴怒中。婴儿是全能的，宇宙的中心，完全无法理解「他人」。在这个意义上自恋的成年人，无论他们在不专注的眼中看起来多么聪明和适应社会，通常都在童年时期受到过深深的伤害，并且没有发展出足够的自我来认识他人的现实。一切事物和每个人都作为「部分客体」存在，作为自我的延伸，就像自己的手臂或腿一样。人们理所当然地认为他们会得到自己需要的东西，就像我们理所当然地认为我们的手臂和腿会在我们想要的时候移动一样；如果这个假设被另一个人的边界所挑战，就会产生巨大的愤怒。我们都有自恋的口袋，有些人的口袋比其他人更大。有些人如此严重地困在这种婴儿状态中，以至于他人不过是喂养自己的对象，即使表面行为看起来是充满爱和牺牲的。

Now, the fiery signs are focussed more on their inner imaginative world than on the needs of others. But that is not narcissism in the clinical sense. At worst, it is simply insensitivity. Fire is theatrical, and self-mythologising; it is far preferable to live life as grand drama, even if it is difficult, than to live it as an obscure, ordinary mortal. Hence, the fiery signs tend to draw attention to themselves in one way or another—when this is unconscious, it can be highly manipulative and even rather hysterical—but clinical narcissism reflects profound injury to the structure of the identity, and this can happen to anyone, regardless of sign. Each zodiacal sign responds to conflicts and wounds in its own unique way, and a fiery person who has suffered in this fashion may be narcissistic in a particularly flamboyant and obvious way. But an earthy or watery sign may be equally narcissistic in the clinical sense, and express the problem through martyrdom or bodily symptoms.
现在，火象星座更关注自己的内在想象世界，而非他人的需求。但这不是临床意义上的自恋。最坏的情况，只是不敏感。火象是戏剧性的，自我神话化的；把生活过成宏大戏剧——即使很艰难——也远比把它过成一个不起眼的普通凡人要好得多。因此，火象星座倾向于以某种方式吸引注意力——当这是无意识的时候，它可能高度具有操控性，甚至相当歇斯底里——但临床自恋反映了身份结构的深层伤害，这可能发生在任何人身上，无论星座如何。每个星座都以自己独特的方式应对冲突和创伤，一个以这种方式遭受痛苦的火象人可能以特别张扬和明显的方式自恋。但一个土象或水象星座在临床意义上同样可能自恋，并通过殉道或身体症状来表达问题。

To some extent I would say that Nigel has narcissistic elements in his personality, but not to the extent that he is truly handicapped in his functioning; and I would not attribute this to his being a Leo, but rather, to his childhood background. As I said, we all have pockets where we have not yet sufficiently formed, and Nigel's parenting was certainly undermining to his will and identity because of his mother's efforts to possess him. However, the form in which this narcissistic wound expresses itself will be Leonine in Nigel's case, which means that he needs the approval of the audience (especially female) to feel real.
在某种程度上，我会说 Nigel 的人格中有自恋元素，但还没有到真正妨碍他运作的程度；我不会将其归因于他是狮子座，而是归因于他的童年背景。正如我所说，我们都有尚未充分形成的口袋，而 Nigel 的父母教养方式肯定削弱了他的意志和身份认同，因为他母亲试图占有他。然而，在 Nigel 的案例中，这种自恋创伤的表达形式将是狮子座式的，这意味着他需要观众的认可（尤其是女性）来感到真实。

Narcissism is a lonely, anxiety-producing state, because one feels empty and unreal inside unless something outside is found which can provide the mirror for one's identity. Do you all remember the myth of Narcissus? He was not permitted to see a reflection of his own face, because his mother forbade it. When he finally encountered it in the mirror of the pool, he fell in love with it, and could not break free, nor recognise another's love (Echo). This is a profound myth, which tells us a good deal about the problem. If the mother does not validate her child's developing “me-ness,” but requires her child to mirror her needs and unfulfilled life, it is like denying Narcissus a view of his own face. Then the child will grow up seeking mirrors everywhere, and will depend upon the validation of the outside world to fill up the empty hole which is felt inside. Fire may depend upon the outside world's perception of oneself as a larger-than-life symbol; earth may depend upon the show of external wealth and status; air may depend upon validation of one's cleverness; and water may depend upon a family unit through which to live vicariously. But the tragedy of narcissism, when it is severe, is that the individual is really a very young child who cannot adapt to outer reality because it does not exist. The only thing that exists is the empty place inside where the self, the hero's treasure, was robbed by a mother who was herself narcissistically wounded and needed her child to fill up her own emptiness. Narcissism thus runs in families. The only antidote is what we have been talking about all week; the slow building of a sense of independent identity through the developing the functions of the Sun and Moon.
自恋是一种孤独的、产生焦虑的状态，因为内在感到空虚和不真实，除非在外部找到什么可以为自己的身份提供镜像。你们都记得那喀索斯（Narcissus）的神话吗？他不被允许看到自己脸的倒影，因为他的母亲禁止了。当他最终在水池的镜子中遇到它时，他爱上了它，无法挣脱，也无法识别另一个人的爱（回声）。这是一个深刻的神话，告诉我们很多关于这个问题的信息。如果母亲不认可她的孩子正在发展的「自我感」，而是要求孩子镜像她的需求和未满足的生活，这就好比拒绝让那喀索斯看到自己的脸。那么孩子长大后将在各处寻找镜子，并依赖外部世界的认可来填补内心感到的空洞。火象可能依赖外部世界对自己作为一个超越生命之象征的感知；土象可能依赖外部财富和地位的展示；风象可能依赖对自己聪明才智的认可；水象可能依赖一个通过它来间接生活的家庭单位。但自恋的悲剧，当它严重时，在于个体实际上是一个非常年幼的孩子，无法适应外部现实，因为它不存在。唯一存在的是内心那个空的地方——自我、英雄的宝藏——被一个自身也受到自恋创伤、需要孩子来填补自己空虚的母亲所掠夺。因此自恋在家族中代代相传。唯一的解药就是我们这一周一直在谈论的东西：通过发展太阳和月亮的功能，逐步建立独立身份感。

ABOUT THE CENTRE FOR PSYCHOLOGICAL ASTROLOGY
关于心理占星学中心（The Centre for Psychological Astrology）

The Centre for Psychological Astrology provides a unique workshop and professional training programme designed to foster the cross-fertilisation of the fields of astrology and depth, humanistic and transpersonal psychology. The programme includes two aspects. One is a series of seminars and classes, ranging from beginners' courses in astrology to advanced seminars in psychological interpretation of the horoscope. The seminars included in this volume are representative of the latter, although the same seminar is never given verbatim more than once because the content changes according to the nature of the participating group and the new research and development which is constantly occurring within the field of psychological astrology. All these seminars and classes, both beginners' and advanced, are open to the public. The second aspect of the programme is a structured, in-depth, three-year professional training which awards a Diploma in Psychological Astrology upon successful completion of the course. The main aims and objectives of the three-year professional training are:
心理占星学中心提供独特的工作坊和专业培训项目，旨在促进占星学与深度心理学、人本心理学和超个人心理学领域的交叉融合。该项目包括两个方面。一方面是一系列研讨会和课程，从占星学初级课程到星盘心理解读的高级研讨会。本卷所收录的研讨会属于后一类，尽管同一研讨会绝不会以完全相同的方式重复两次，因为内容会根据参与群体的性质以及心理占星学领域不断发生的新研究和发展而变化。所有这些研讨会和课程，无论是初级还是高级，都向公众开放。该项目的第二个方面是一个结构化的、为期三年的深度专业培训，成功完成课程后将授予心理占星学文凭。三年专业培训的主要目标是：

To provide students with a solid and broad base of knowledge both within the realm of traditional astrological symbolism and techniques, and also in the field of psychology, so that the astrological chart can be sensitively understood and interpreted in the light of modern psychological thought.
为学生提供传统占星学象征和技术领域以及心理学领域的坚实而广泛的知识基础，使星盘能够在现代心理学思想的视角下被敏锐地理解和解读。

To make available to students psychologically qualified case supervision along with training in counselling skills and techniques which would raise the standard and effectiveness of astrological consultation.
向学生提供有心理学资质的案例督导，以及咨询技巧和技术的培训，以提高占星咨询的标准和效果。

To encourage investigation and research into the links between astrology, psychological models and therapeutic techniques, thereby contributing to and advancing the already existing body of astrological and psychological knowledge.
鼓励对占星学、心理学模型和治疗技术之间联系的研究和探索，从而为已有的占星学和心理学知识体系做出贡献并推动其发展。

The in-depth professional training programme cannot be done by correspondence, as case supervision work is an integral part of the course. It will normally take three years to complete, although it is possible for the trainee to extend this period if necessary. The training includes approximately fifty seminars (either one-day or short, ongoing weekly evening classes) as well as fifty hours of case supervision groups. The classes and seminars fall broadly into two main categories: astrological symbolism and technique (history of astrology, psychological understanding of signs, planets, houses, aspects, transits, progressions, synastry, etc.), and psychological theory (history of psychology, psychological maps and pathology, mythological and archetypal symbolism, etc.). Case supervision groups meet on weekday evenings and consist of no more than twelve people in each group. All the supervisors are both trained psychotherapists and astrologers. Each student has the opportunity of presenting for discussion case material from the charts he or she is working on. At the end of the third year, a 15,000-20,000 word paper is required. This may be on any chosen subject—case material, research, etc.—under the general umbrella of psychological astrology. Many of these papers may be of publishable quality, and the Centre will undertake facilitating such material being disseminated in the astrological field.
深度专业培训项目不能通过函授完成，因为案例督导工作是课程不可分割的一部分。通常需要三年完成，尽管学员可以在必要时延长这一期限。培训包括约五十场研讨会（全天或短期持续的晚间课程），以及五十小时的案例督导小组。课程和研讨会大致分为两大类：占星学象征和技术（占星学史、对星座、行星、宫位、相位、行运、推进、合盘等的心理学理解），以及心理学理论（心理学史、心理图谱和病理学、神话和原型象征等）。案例督导小组在工作日晚间举行，每组不超过十二人。所有督导员都同时是受过训练的心理治疗师和占星师。每位学生都有机会展示并讨论其正在处理的星盘案例材料。在第三年结束时，需要提交一篇15,000至20,000字的论文。论文主题可自由选择——案例材料、研究等——在心理占星学的总体框架下。许多论文可能达到可出版的质量，中心将协助推动这些材料在占星学领域中的传播。

Completion of the seminar and supervision requirements entitles the trainee to a certificate of completion. Acceptance of the thesis entitles the trainee to the Centre's Diploma in Psychological Astrology and the use of the letters D. Psych. Astrol. The successful graduate will be able to apply the principles and techniques learned during the course to his or her profession activities, either as a consultant astrologer or as a useful adjunct to other forms of psychological counselling. Career prospects are good as there is an ever-increasing demand for the services of capable astrologers and astrologically oriented therapists. In order to complete the professional training, the Centre asks that all students, for a minimum of one year, be involved in a recognized form of psychotherapy with a therapist, analyst or counsellor of his or her choice. The rationale behind this requirement is that we believe no responsible counsellor of any persuasion can hope to deal sensitively and wisely with another person's psyche unless one has some experience of his or her own.
完成研讨会和督导要求后，学员将获得结业证书。接受论文后，学员将获得中心的心理占星学文凭，并有权使用 D. Psych. Astrol. 头衔。成功的毕业生将能够将课程中学到的原则和技术应用于其职业活动中，无论是作为占星咨询师，还是作为其他形式心理咨询的有用辅助。职业前景良好，因为对有能力的占星师和占星导向治疗师的需求日益增长。为了完成专业培训，中心要求所有学生至少在一年的时间内，参与其选择的有治疗师、分析师或咨询师所进行的认可形式的心理治疗。这一要求背后的理由是，我们相信，除非一个人对自己有某种体验，否则任何负责任的心理咨询师都无法指望能够敏感而明智地处理他人的 psyche。

The seminars offered in this book are just six of the fifty or so workshops offered by the Centre. The other volumes in the Seminars in Psychological Astrology Series are The Development of the Personality, Volume 1, Dynamics of the Unconscious, Volume 2, and The Inner PLanets: Building Blocks of Personal Reality, Volume 4. As stated earlier, these seminars are never repeated in precisely the same way, as the contributions and case material from each individual group vary, and as there are constant new developments and insights occurring through the ongoing work of the seminar leaders and others in the field. If the reader is interested in finding out more about either the public seminars or the in-depth professional training offered by the Centre, please write to The Centre for Psychological Astrology, BCM Box 1815, London WC1N 3XX, England. Your request for information should include a stamped, self-addressed envelope (for United Kingdom residents only) or an International Postal coupon to cover postage abroad.
本书中提供的研讨会只是中心提供的约五十个工作坊中的六个。心理占星学研讨会系列中的其他卷册包括《人格的发展》第一卷、《无意识的动力学》第二卷和《内行星：个人现实的基石》第四卷。如前所述，这些研讨会永远不会以完全相同的方式重复，因为每个参与群体的贡献和案例材料各不相同，而且通过研讨会领导者和其他从业者的持续工作，不断有新的发展和见解出现。如果读者有兴趣了解更多关于中心提供的公开研讨会或深度专业培训的信息，请致函：The Centre for Psychological Astrology, BCM Box 1815, London WC1N 3XX, England。您的信息请求应附上贴好邮票、写好地址的信封（仅限英国居民）或国际邮政代金券（用于海外邮资）。
